From my observation, the injuries were 
rather severe. I wonder if there's even 
a 50% chance of survival――

MsgJp:
セシリー、せっかくお父さんと会えたのに
これじゃぁ、あんまりだよ
MsgEn:
Cecily, you finally got to meet your 
father, and yet... this is so unfair.

MsgJp:
ガラダ族長は、村近くのまだ毒されていない
森深くに運び込まれました――
MsgEn:
Chief Gearóid was taken deep into the 
untouched forest near the village—

MsgJp:
森の精霊に呼び掛けて、後は――
見守るしかないそうです
MsgEn:
It seems that one must call on the 
forest spirits, and after that— 
all that's left is to keep watch.

MsgJp: 父の意識はまだ戻りません
MsgEn: My father still hasn't regained consciousness.

MsgJp:
身体の傷を見る限り、相手は人ではありません
いったいどんな怪物があそこに棲みついて
いるのか――
MsgEn:
From the looks of the wounds on the body, 
the attacker was not human.
What kind of monster could be dwelling there—

MsgJp:
父と同行した戦士たちの実力を思うと
よほどの強敵が潜んでいると考えなくては
なりません
MsgEn:
Considering the strength of the warriors 
who accompanied my father, we must think 
that a formidable enemy lies in wait.

MsgJp:
しかもその者は、"芯なる樹"――
世界を救ってくれるはずの、《原始の雫》を
持ち去ったようです
MsgEn:
Moreover, it seems that the assailant
took the "Primeval Drops,"
which is supposed to save the world.

MsgJp:
となれば、父を襲ったのは
魔物の暴力だけではありません
何者かの悪意を感じずにはいられません
MsgEn:
In that case, it seems Father
was attacked not just by violent monsters.
I cannot dismiss the malice of another presence.

MsgJp:
わたしは父の回復を信じています
隊長も、その時を今少し待って下さい
MsgEn:
I am confident in Father's recovery. 
Captain, please hold on for a 
little while longer.

MsgJp:
父は、わたしたちが進むべき道を
知っているはずです
MsgEn:
Father must know the path we should 
take as we move forward.

MsgJp: 《原始の雫》を持ち去った――
MsgEn: They took the 《Primeval Drops》――

MsgJp:
いいえ、奪い去った者がいるのだとしたら
わたしはその者を、けして許しません
MsgEn:
If there truly is one who has snatched it away,
I will not forgive them.

MsgJp:
俺の見たところ、ガラダと護衛の傷は
間違いなく魔物の仕業だったけどな
MsgEn:
As far as I can tell, Gearóid and the 
guards' injuries were without a doubt 
the work of monsters.

MsgJp: この世界には裏切り者がいるってことだよね
MsgEn:
This implies that there are traitors 
in this world, doesn't it?

MsgJp:
フィンダムがこのまま滅んでしまっても
かまわないって人がさ
自分の未来まで捨てちゃうってことだよね
MsgEn:
If Phindym is to perish like this 
and they don't care, it means 
they're discarding their own 
future as well, doesn't it?

MsgJp:
どこかへ行って戦ったり、探したりするのは
俺たちが引き継げばいいけど

それもこれも族長の回復があってこそですよね
族長、早く目を覚まさないかな――
MsgEn:
All of this relies on the chief's recovery, 
doesn't it? I hope the chief awakens soon—

MsgJp:
《原始の雫》が無くなったって？
しかも、ガラダは重態で口もきけない状況――
MsgEn:
You say the 《Primeval Drop》 is gone? 
Additionally, Gearóid is in serious 
condition and unable to speak—

MsgJp:
セシリーの気持ちを考えると
いたたまれないね
MsgEn:
Considering Cecily's feelings, 
it's unbearable, isn't it?

MsgJp:
こっちは、まあ、なんとかやってるから
彼女のそばにいて励ましてあげるのが
いいと思うよ
MsgEn:
I'm managing here, so I think it's best 
to stay by her side and encourage her.

MsgJp:
病んだフィンダムを救う方法を知る
唯一の人物、ガラダが襲われた――
MsgEn:
Gearóid, the sole person who knows 
how to ease the suffering Phindym, 
has been attacked――

MsgJp:
危険な場所に入り込んでいたのだろうが
単なる魔物の仕業とは思えんな
MsgEn:
It seems they entered a perilous area, 
yet I doubt it is merely the work of 
ordinary monsters.

MsgJp:
となると、犯人は人――
うーむ、その者の闇の深さは
いかほどだろうか――
MsgEn:
So, the perpetrator is human— 
Hmm, I can't help but wonder 
just how deep that person's darkness goes—

MsgJp: 《原始の雫》をガラダから奪った者――
MsgEn:
The one who took the 《Primeval Drops》
from Gearóid...

MsgJp:
その者の闇の深さが
悪しき者たちに利用されなければよいが――
MsgEn:
Let us hope that their deep darkness
is not being used by evil—

MsgJp:
かつて仲間だったイリスの闇は
ディアマンテスに悪用され――
MsgEn:
Once a comrade, the darkness 
of Iris was taken advantage of 
by Diamantes—

MsgJp:
そのディアマンテスが抱えていた闇も
何者かの餌食にされたのかもしれん
MsgEn:
And the darkness that Diamantes was carrying,
may have been preyed upon by someone else.

MsgJp:
もしもフィンダムでも同じ事が
繰り返されているのであれば――
我々の経験が役に立つことだろう
MsgEn:
If the same thing is 
happening in Phindym, 
then our experience 
will surely be useful.

MsgJp:
さあ、早く行ってやりなさい
もし闇を抱えている者がいるならば
明るい日差しの下に引っ張り出してやるのだ
MsgEn:
Do not tarry and go.
If anyone holds darkness,
bring them out into the shining light of day.

MsgJp:
誰の仕業にせよ、優先すべきは、やはり
《原始の雫》の回収ということになろう
MsgEn:
The priority, regardless of whose doing it,
is to recover the 《Primeval Drops》.

MsgJp:
もし、力尽くで奪回する必要があるのなら――
いいな？　未来に禍根を残すなよ
MsgEn:
If it is necessary to reclaim by force――
understand? Do not leave future troubles behind.

MsgJp:
ガラダが意識を取り戻していたら
君はきっと、会って話すことになるだろうね
MsgEn:
If Gearóid has regained consciousness,
you will surely meet and speak with him.

MsgJp:
いいかい？
絶対に揉めないようにね
MsgEn:
Understood?
Make sure there are no disputes.

MsgJp:
僕もフィンダムを探索したいんだから
その時のために、友好的な関係で
いてもらわなくちゃ
MsgEn:
After all, I also wish to explore Phindym.
We need to keep a friendly rapport 
for when that time comes.

MsgJp: おお、想像どおり、良い顔をしておるわ
MsgEn:
Oh, as I expected, you have a 
fine appearance.

MsgJp:
父が意識を取り戻しました
隊長、ぜひ、話を聞いてください
MsgEn:
Father has regained consciousness.
Captain, please listen to what I have to say.

MsgJp: 君たちもロイグを知っているのだろう？
MsgEn: You all know Loeg, don't you?

MsgJp:
もし友情を結んだのなら――
申し訳ないが、諦め、捨ててくれ
MsgEn:
Should you have formed a bond— 
I regret to say, abandon it and let it go.

MsgJp:
ロイグが――？
やっぱり、信じられません
MsgEn:
Loeg—?
I just can't believe it.

MsgJp:
ロイグが使う魔物は
家畜が魔物化したもの――
MsgEn:
The monsters that Loig uses are
livestock turned into demons--

MsgJp: こりゃ、強さの見当がつかねえな
MsgEn:
This is quite difficult to gauge 
the strength of them.

MsgJp:
レスタニアで――
メイリーフの家で笑い合っていた時のロイグは
すっかり記憶を無くしていたと思いたいな
MsgEn:
In Lestania--
I'd like to think that when we were laughing at 
Mayleaf's house, Loeg had lost all memory of it.

MsgJp:
ええ、やる時はやりますから、俺
知り合いだって、敵なら、仕方ないですよね
MsgEn:
Yes, when it's time to act, I will do so.
Even if it's someone I know,
if they are an enemy,
there's nothing to be done.

MsgJp: ロイグ！　魔物を止めて！
MsgEn: Loeg! Stop these monsters!

MsgJp: 話しましょう？　ロイグ、話そう？
MsgEn:
Shall we talk? 
Loeg, let's discuss this?

MsgJp: こんなの、ちがうよ、ロイグ
MsgEn: Not like this, Loeg.

MsgJp: 原始の雫、返して！
MsgEn: Return the Primeval Drops!

MsgJp: こんなことをしても何も変わらない！
MsgEn: Nothing will change by doing this!

MsgJp: 今からでも――遅くないから！
MsgEn: Even now ――it's not too late!

MsgJp: 一緒にフィンダムを変えていこう？
MsgEn: Let's change Phindym together, okay?

MsgJp: ロイグ、逃げて――雫を置いて、逃げて！
MsgEn: Loeg, flee—leave the droplets behind, run!

MsgJp: もう、容赦はしないから
MsgEn: There will be no mercy from now on.

MsgJp: あとひと息！
MsgEn: Just a few more steps!

MsgJp: ロイグ、これは違う、間違っている！
MsgEn: Loeg, this is not it; it's a mistake!

MsgJp: ロイグ！　考えなおして
MsgEn: Loeg! Please reconsider!

MsgJp: セシリー、すっかりレスタニアに染まったな
MsgEn:
Cecily, 
you have become fully stained
by those filthy Lestanians now.

MsgJp: 苦しめ――両親のように、わたしのように！
MsgEn: Suffer ―― like my parents, just like me!

MsgJp: 叫べ――楽には終わらせないぞ
MsgEn: Cry out ―I'm not going to make it easy on you.

MsgJp: やってしまえ！　倒せ！
MsgEn: Do it! Defeat them!

MsgJp: 父さん、母さん、見物だろう？
MsgEn: Father, Mother, I know you're watching, right?

MsgJp: 精一杯戦って――絶望するがいいさ！
MsgEn: Fight as hard as you can - and despair!

MsgJp: わたしの後ろ盾を知っているか？
MsgEn: Are you aware of my benefactor?

MsgJp: 薄々は気づいているんだろう？
MsgEn: I suppose you have an inkling, right?

MsgJp: ふふふ――いい気味だ
MsgEn: Hehe――how delightful.

MsgJp: 心に刻まれた恨みはけして消えない！
MsgEn: The resentment engraved in my heart won't go away!

MsgJp: ふふふ――今この時も大地は朽ちていくぞ！
MsgEn:
Hehehe―even now, the land 
is crumbling into decay!

MsgJp: おまえたちの死が崩壊のとば口だ！
MsgEn: Your deaths herald the onset of ruin!

MsgJp:
モルフォール村に戻り、父に事の次第を
報告しなくてはなりません
MsgEn:
I have to return to Morfaul Village 
to relay the events to my father.

MsgJp:
《原始の雫》の使い方を教えてもらって――
もちろん、ロイグの処遇も相談しないと
MsgEn:
I need to be taught how to use 
the 《Primeval Drops》 --
and, of course, 
we need to discuss what to do with Loeg.

MsgJp:
混乱の原因を作ったのは確かにロイグでしょう
でも、あの人を追い詰めたのは、わたしたちの
ようです
MsgEn:
It is true that Loeg caused the chaos,
but it seems it was us who drove him to it.

MsgJp:
見たな？　見たよな！？
ロイグの奴、黒い霧に包まれて――
MsgEn:
You saw it, right? You did see it, 
didn't you?! Loeg, he was wrapped 
in a black fog――

MsgJp: あの霧は――あれはどう見ても黒騎士の――
MsgEn:
That fog―― 
no matter how you look at it,
it's the Black Knight――

MsgJp:
いや、んな馬鹿な！
黒騎士はきっちり倒したはずだ
MsgEn:
No, that's absurd!
The Black Knight was defeated for sure.

MsgJp: ねえ、隊長、ロイグを助けてあげなくちゃ
MsgEn: Hey, Captain, we have to help Loeg.

MsgJp:
黒騎士に"見捨てる気か"とかなんとか
怒っていたよね？
つまり、背後で事態を操っているのは――
MsgEn:
The Black Knight was furious, asking, "Are you 
going to forsake me?" or something, right? 
So, the one orchestrating 
things behind the scenes is—

MsgJp:
隊長、ロイグとか黒騎士のことは
一度忘れませんか？
MsgEn:
Captain, how about we set aside thoughts of Loeg 
and the Black Knight for now?

MsgJp:
《原始の雫》のこと、俺たちまだ何も
知りませんから！
MsgEn:
We still don't know anything about the
《Primeval Drops》!

MsgJp:
あなたたちが見聞きしたことはすでに
ここまで届いている
MsgEn: What you witnessed has already reached us.

MsgJp:
ガラダはそれを受けて
族長同士の会談を召集した
MsgEn:
In response to that, 
Gearóid called a meeting between the chiefs.

MsgJp:
あなたたちも急ぎ、会談の場に
向かってくれ
MsgEn:
You guys should hurry up too 
and head to the meeting place.

MsgJp:
時は待ってくれません
溜息をついている時間なんてありませんよね
MsgEn:
Time does not pause for us. 
We have no time to waste on sighs, do we?

MsgJp:
レスタニアの覚者たちよ
心苦しい限りだが、このフィンダム
まだまだ安定への道半ば――
MsgEn:
Arisen of Lestania, 
I am truly pained to say that 
Phindym is still far from stable――

MsgJp: 最後まで、我々とともに歩んでくれ
MsgEn: Walk with us until the very end.

MsgJp:
あと少しですよ、隊長
《原始の雫》が芯なる樹を――
ひいてはこのフィンダムを浄化してくれます
MsgEn:
Just a little more, Captain.
The 《Primeval Drops》 will purify
the Core Tree and, in turn, cleanse
Phindym for us.

MsgJp:
その後の美しいフィンダムを
皆さん、ご案内しますからね
MsgEn:
And after that, I'll take you to beautiful Phindym.
I'll show you all around.

MsgJp: さぁ、ひとまずはレスタニアに戻ろうぜ
MsgEn: Come on, let's get back to Lestania for now.

MsgJp: ロイグのしたことは許せないけど――
MsgEn: Loeg's actions are unforgivable, but—

MsgJp:
わたしは憎めないな
フィンダムの人たちはどう裁くつもりなんだろう
MsgEn:
I don't hate them. I just wonder how the people of
Phindym are going to judge me.

MsgJp:
あははは
なんだかセシリーが大きく見えますよね
ここで居心地悪そうにしてた時とは
別人のようです
MsgEn:
Ahahahaha!
Doesn't Cecily seem much more confident now? 
It's like she's a different person from when 
she was so uncomfortable standing here.

MsgJp:
そうか、あのロイグが――
人の心の奥底なんて、分からんものよ
MsgEn:
Well, that Loeg--
You never know the depths of a person's soul.

MsgJp:
して、その芯なる樹とやらを治療できれば
侵食が止むかも知れんのだな
MsgEn:
If we can heal the Core Tree, 
the corruption may cease.

MsgJp:
ああ、任せておけ
レスタニアは、必ず守り抜いて見せようぞ
MsgEn:
Yeah, leave it to me.
I'll make sure Lestania is protected 
and shown the way.

MsgJp:
なぜかな――
あんたなら、きっとやり遂げてくれるって
思っちまうんだよ
MsgEn:
I don't know why— 
but I believe you can surely see it through.

MsgJp: 白衛騎士団の士気は、未だ健在だ
MsgEn:
The morale of the White Guard 
Knights is still strong.

MsgJp:
《原始の雫》というのは、とてつもない
力を秘めているんだろうね
レスタニアにもあればなあ
MsgEn:
The 《Primeval Drops》 
must hold immense power. 
If only it existed in 
Lestania as well.

MsgJp:
ほう――
セシリーがフィンダムの未来を託されるとは！
MsgEn:
So――
Cecily is being entrusted with 
the future of Phindym!

MsgJp:
初対面の時の頼りない印象が強いが――
人は立場によって作られるものだ
MsgEn:
The unreliable impression from our
first meeting lingers strong―
but, people are shaped by their roles.

MsgJp: 未来を託されし者は、自ずと自身を定めるのであろう
MsgEn:
The ones entrusted with the future 
will surely find their own paths.

MsgJp: あとひと息というところかな？
MsgEn: Maybe it's time to take a break?

MsgJp:
いやいや、当面、レスタニアの様子を気にしつつ
暮らした方が良さそうだな
MsgEn:
It seems best to live while keeping an eye on 
the situation in Lestania for the time being.

MsgJp:
待っていたぞ
いましがた使いの者から連絡がきた
MsgEn:
We've been waiting for you.
We have just received word from a messenger.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの各族長の結託により
"精霊の地"を封じていた印が解かれたようだ
MsgEn:
It seems the seal that bound the "Spirit Land" 
has been lifted due to the alliance of the tribal 
leaders of Phindym.

MsgJp:
もちろん、その奥深くにある芯なる樹の
汚染原因を絶つのがその目的だ
MsgEn:
Of course, the goal is to eliminate 
the source of the corruption in the 
Core Tree deep within.

MsgJp:
さあ、行きなさい
セシリーが待っているだろう
MsgEn:
Now, make haste. 
Cecily will be waiting for you.

MsgJp:
最後まで、誠意を持って戦うんだ
ふむ――これでは「覚者に理を説く」だな
MsgEn:
Until the very end, fight with sincerity. 
Hmm―― this is "teaching order to the Arisen."

MsgJp: さあ、フィンダムに戻ってやりなさい！
MsgEn: Now go, back to Phindym!

MsgJp: "精霊の地"とか"芯なる樹"とか――
MsgEn: "The Spirit Land" and "Core Tree" ――

MsgJp:
おそらく、フィンダムという世界の核心というか
成り立ちの根本に関係するような場所のはず
敬虔な気持ちを忘れないようにね
MsgEn:
It is likely a place related to the core of 
the world of Phindym, or the very foundation 
of its existence. Do not forget to keep 
a devout heart.

MsgJp: 待っていたぞ、レスタニアのお方よ
MsgEn:
I have been waiting for you, noble one of 
Lestania.

MsgJp:
今後のわたしの役割を話しておきたいが
ここはひとまずガラダ族長と話してくれ
MsgEn:
I would like to discuss my role moving 
forward, but for now, please speak with 
Chief Gearóid.

MsgJp: 俺はドハティ
MsgEn: I am Doherty.

MsgJp:
おまえたちに最大限の便宜を図るように
ガラダから言われている
MsgEn:
I have been told by Gearóid to give you the 
best possible accommodations.

MsgJp:
わたしはマイア
精霊竜の守番が仕事です
MsgEn:
My name is Maia, 
and my duty is to guard the Spirit Dragon.

MsgJp:
どうか――
かつてのように、精霊竜とともに過ごせるよう
ご助力くださいませ
MsgEn:
I implore you— 
Help me to be able to be with
the Spirit Dragon again.

MsgJp:
ターグだ
精霊竜の守番をしている
MsgEn:
I am Tadhg. 
I serve as the Spirit Dragon's guard.

MsgJp:
竜が不在の今、せめて、おまえたちの
役に立てるのなら本望だ
MsgEn:
With the Dragon gone,
I would be honored if I could 
be of service to you.

MsgJp:
"精霊の地"の中心である"芯なる樹"を
目指してくれ
まずは、到達することが大事だ
MsgEn:
Make your way to the "Core Tree,"
the heart of the "Spirit Land."
First and foremost, reaching it is
of utmost importance.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの未来をおまえたちに託す
頼んだぞ
MsgEn:
The future of Phindym is in your hands. 
I'm relying on you.

MsgJp:
俺と話しても何も変わらんぞ
いや、俺の機嫌が悪くなるだけだ
無駄なことが大嫌いでね
MsgEn:
Nothing will change by talking to me. 
No, it will just put me in a bad mood. 
I have a strong aversion to uselessness.

MsgJp:
フィンダムのために――ウィルミアのために
どうかよろしくお願いします
さあ、早く"芯なる樹"へ
MsgEn:
For Phindym―― for Willmia,
please lend us your aid. 
Now, we must hurry to the "Core Tree."

MsgJp:
初めて見た者は誰もがその美しさに
目を奪われ、息をすることも忘れる――
MsgEn:
Those who see it for the first time
are all captivated by its beauty,
forgetting even to breathe――

MsgJp:
"芯なる樹"は、本来そういうものだ
ああ――本来はな
MsgEn:
The "Core Tree" is meant to be such a thing.
Ah―― it is meant to be that way.

MsgJp:
《原始の雫》はわたしがしっかりと身につけて
目的地まで運びますからご安心ください
MsgEn:
I will ensure the 《Primeval Drop》
is safely carried to the destination,
so you can be at ease.

MsgJp:
フィンダムへ来てからこっち、空気が濃くて
何度もむせ返ったが――
このあたりは、また、別格に濃いな
MsgEn:
Ever since arriving in Phindym, the air has 
felt heavy, making me cough repeatedly, but— 
this area is exceptionally dense.

MsgJp:
みんな笑ったけどさあ――
掃除なんか好きな人って、いる！？
MsgEn:
Everyone laughed, but you know--
who actually likes cleaning!?

MsgJp:
まあ、それはともかく、隊長、早く行こう
嫌なことはさっさと終わらせちゃおうよ
MsgEn:
Anyway, Captain, let's get moving 
and wrap up this unpleasantness quickly.

MsgJp: 中は魔物がいっぱい棲みついてるんでしょうね
MsgEn: I'm sure there are a lot of demons living inside.

MsgJp:
いえいえ、怖じ気づいたわけじゃなくて
気が急くというかなんというか――
MsgEn:
No, no, I'm not scared.
I'm just in a hurry--

MsgJp: 父から、鍵を預かっています
MsgEn: I have received the key from my father.

MsgJp:
わたしたちの村は、ずっとずっと、長い間
この洞を守り、竜の世話をしてきました
MsgEn:
Our village has long protected this cave
and cared for the Dragon.

MsgJp:
この鍵を使って、回廊の横にある扉を開け
中に入って下さい
MsgEn:
Use this key to open the door next to
the corridor and enter inside, please.

MsgJp: そこに、礎があります
MsgEn: Therein lies the Portcrystal.

MsgJp:
礎を解放し、芯脈の治療と、樹内の侵食魔を
掃討するための足掛かりとしましょう
MsgEn:
Release the Portcrystal, treat the Core Vein, 
and use this as a foothold to eliminate 
the corruption within the tree.

MsgJp:
道中の安全は確保されたようです
みなさんは、どうか休息を
MsgEn:
It seems our safe passage
has been secured. Everyone,
please take this time to rest.

MsgJp:
侵食魔をぶっ倒さねえと、俺たちの仕事は
終わらねえってことだな？
MsgEn:
If we don't take down the Corruption Demons,
then our work won't be done, right?

MsgJp:
ふん、俺たち待ちなんて、気が重い
さっさと終わらせようぜ
MsgEn:
Hmph, it's burdensome to wait like this. 
Let's finish this up quickly.

MsgJp:
あー、今からが掃除本番ってこと？
あーあ！
MsgEn:
Ah, so now the real cleaning begins? 
Oh, great!

MsgJp:
俺は掃除嫌いじゃないですよ
やればかならず良い結果になりますからね！
MsgEn:
I'm not against cleaning. 
If you do it, you'll definitely see 
positive results!

MsgJp:
フィンダムの浄化はおあずけということだね
うん、報告はとてもうれしいけど、戻った方が
良くはないかな？
MsgEn:
It seems the purification of Phindym is on hold.
Yes, I'm very pleased with the report,
but wouldn't it be better to return?

MsgJp:
――このところ白竜が押し黙ったままなのだ
意識だけをどこかに飛ばしているのだろうか
MsgEn:
――The White Dragon has been silent lately. 
Could it be that his consciousness
has drifted away somewhere?

MsgJp: 過去を振り返ると――あまりよい兆候とはいえない
MsgEn:
Looking back at the past――
It's not a very good sign.

MsgJp:
フィンダムでの活動が佳境だと思うが
頭の片隅にでも、置いといてくれ
MsgEn:
I believe our activities in Phindym 
are coming to a head.
Please keep it in the back of your mind.

MsgJp:
行くのだな？
向こうの皆によろしく伝えてくれ
MsgEn:
You're leaving, then?
Please give my regards
to everyone over there.

MsgJp:
"芯なる樹"が元に戻ればフィンダムの大地は
回復する――
そして、君たちは、治療の準備として
患部周辺の魔物の掃討を任されているわけだ
MsgEn:
Once the "Core Tree" is restored, 
the land of Phindym will heal―― 
You are tasked with rooting out
the monsters near the affected area 
as preparation for the cure.

MsgJp:
僕なんかには耐えられない重圧だな
さすがだよ
MsgEn:
That's a pressure I could never withstand. 
You truly are something else.

MsgJp:
あなたたちは毒に侵された魔物を"侵食魔"と
呼んでいるそうだな
MsgEn:
You refer to the tainted monsters
as "Corruption Demons," it seems.

MsgJp: ――実に示唆に富んだ名だ
MsgEn: ―― It is indeed a name full of insight.

MsgJp:
侵食魔が集まると、汚れた力も集まり
その結果、大地ばかりか、水も、空気も、全てが
侵食されたように汚染されてしまうのだ
MsgEn:
When the infected monsters gather,
the tainted power also accumulates.
As a result, not just the land, but
water, air, and everything becomes
polluted as if tainted.

MsgJp:
ともあれ芯脈の浄化を、侵食魔に
邪魔されるようなことがあってはならない
MsgEn:
Regardless, the cleansing of the 
core vein must not be hindered 
by the encroaching beasts.

MsgJp:
となれば、樹内に巣くった魔物の一掃――
これが最優先となる
MsgEn:
If that is the case, clearing the 
monsters lurking inside the tree 
must take precedence.

MsgJp:
芯脈が治癒できれば
ウィルミアも本来の意識を取り戻すだろう
MsgEn:
If the core vein can be healed, 
Willmia should regain consciousness
as her madness may subside.

MsgJp:
ただ、いまのウィルミアにとっては
我々も樹内に侵入した外敵――
MsgEn:
However, for Willmia at present, 
we too are external foes that 
have invaded the tree.

MsgJp:
くれぐれも警戒しつつ
樹内の侵食魔を掃討して欲しい
MsgEn:
Please remain vigilant and 
cleanse the tree of the 
encroaching monsters.

MsgJp:
侵食魔に関する知識は、残念ながら
我々にはほとんどない
むしろ、あなたたちの方が戦いを通じて
よく知っていることだろう
MsgEn:
Regrettably, we have almost no knowledge about 
the Corruption Demons. In fact, it is likely 
that you know them better from your own battles.

MsgJp:
あなたたちがいてくれて
とても心強く思っていることを
ぜひ、知ってほしい
MsgEn:
I want you to know 
how reassuring it is to 
have you here with us.

MsgJp:
隊長が留守のあいだはガルドリンが
いろいろと助言をくださいました
侵食魔の掃討は全員で手分けしてやりましょう
MsgEn:
During the Captain's absence, Gurdolin gave 
various suggestions. Let's all join forces 
to eradicate the invading demons.

MsgJp:
セシリーとも話したんだが、このあたりで
遭遇した侵食魔の強さを考えると
分担して事に当たった方が早く終わりそうだ
そういうことでいいな？
MsgEn:
I spoke with Cecily, and considering the 
strength of the Corruption Demons we've faced 
around here, it seems quicker to divide 
our tasks. Is that acceptable?

MsgJp:
隊長、どっちがいっぱい魔物を退治するか――
競争する？
MsgEn:
Captain, who can kill the most demons--
How about a contest?

MsgJp: さあ、隊長、始めましょう！
MsgEn: Come on, Captain, let's get started!

MsgJp: みなさん、ありがとうございました
MsgEn: Thank you, everyone.

MsgJp:
わたしは、父とともに
芯脈の浄化に取りかかります
MsgEn:
I, along with my father,
will begin to cleanse the core vein.

MsgJp: 気がかりなのは先ほどの咆哮――
MsgEn:
What bothers me is that roar
we heard earlier――

MsgJp:
ウィルミアが、私たちを外敵とみなして
警戒しているのかもしれません
MsgEn:
Willmia might see us as intruders
and is likely on high alert.

MsgJp:
浄化には少し時間がかかりそうです
みなさんもどうか、今のうちに休息をとって下さい
MsgEn:
Purification may take some time,
so in the meantime, everyone,
please rest while you can.

MsgJp:
浄化はわたしが進めますから
皆さんは休んで、見ていてください
MsgEn:
I will take care of the purification,
so you can all rest and watch,
if you'd like.

MsgJp:
ごくろうだった
ほどなく芯脈が――そして侵食された
すべてが浄化されることだろう
MsgEn:
You have done well. Soon, the core
vein will be cleansed—and everything
that has been corrupted will be purified.

MsgJp:
あなたたちの献身のおかげだ
本当に感謝しているよ
ゆっくりと休んでくれ
MsgEn:
Your devotion has brought us here. 
I am truly grateful. Please take 
your time to rest.

MsgJp:
竜はまだ暴れてるんだ
油断はできねえぞ
MsgEn:
The Dragon is still rampaging. 
We cannot let our guard down.

MsgJp:
はあ――
結構頑張ったけど、隊長にはかなわないよ
まあ、それはそうだよね～
MsgEn:
Hah―― 
I tried really hard,
but I'm no match for the Captain.
Well, we knew that already, right?

MsgJp:
なんでしょう、この胸騒ぎは――
さっきの咆哮は――
MsgEn:
What is this uneasy feeling in my chest―― 
That roar from earlier――

MsgJp: ああ、早く全てが浄化されますように！
MsgEn: Oh, may everything be purified soon!

MsgJp:
あれ？
戻って来て良かったのかい？
向こうはかなり重要な局面なんだろう？
MsgEn:
What?
You sure it was a good idea to come back?
It's a pretty critical time over there, isn't it?

MsgJp: ロイグのことを考えていたのだが――
MsgEn: I was thinking about Loeg――

MsgJp:
見くびるわけではないが
ごくごく普通の男だったはずだ
MsgEn:
I do not mean to belittle him,
but he was supposed to be
just an average man.

MsgJp: それがこれほどの――
MsgEn: That's what makes this such a--

MsgJp:
世界がひとつ、崩壊するかもしれぬほどの
大それた事件を起こすとは――
MsgEn:
To think that one person's actions could cause
such a grand turn of events leading to
the potential collapse of an entire world—

MsgJp:
我々の脅威だったディアマンテスを
思い出さずにはいられんな
MsgEn: I can't help but remember our threat, Diamantes.

MsgJp: フィンダムの様子はどうだ？
MsgEn: How's Phindym doing?

MsgJp: 行方の知れないロイグは見つかったのか
MsgEn: Has the missing Loeg been found?

MsgJp: フィンダムの様子が気になるねえ
MsgEn: I'm worried about what's happening in Phindym.

MsgJp: うーむ――
MsgEn: Hmm ――

MsgJp:
隊長――
お待ちしていました
MsgEn:
Captain――
We've been waiting for you.

MsgJp: 原始の雫を含む輝く地層――
MsgEn: A glowing layer that holds Primeval Drops―

MsgJp:
我々が通常立ち入る範囲で
そのような場所は、ついぞ見たことがない
MsgEn:
Within the bounds we normally tread, 
I've never encountered such a location.

MsgJp:
あるとすれば前人未踏の地という
ことになるだろう
MsgEn:
If it is true, it would mean a place 
untouched by previous explorers.

MsgJp: となれば、やはりキンガル峡谷の奥地か――
MsgEn:
Then it seems we are talking about 
the inner reaches of Kingal Canyon.

MsgJp:
これから行くキンガル峡谷の奥地は
かなり広いので、手分けして
効率よく探しましょう！
MsgEn:
The area we are going to
in Kingal Canyon is rather widespread,
so let's split up and search efficiently!

MsgJp:
魔物はいるでしょうけど、危険は
声をかけ合えば避けられますよね？
MsgEn:
There are likely to be monsters,
but we can avoid danger if we
alert each other, right?

MsgJp:
おまえらの手に負えない時は
俺も行ってやらないでもないが――
とりあえず、なんとかしろ
MsgEn:
When it becomes too much for you all, 
I could step in if needed, but for now,
try to manage on your own.

MsgJp:
ごめん、ちょっと休ませてね
ここに来て、ガクッと、連戦の疲れが出たみたい
MsgEn:
I'm sorry, I need to rest a bit. 
Since coming here, it seems the fatigue
from all these consecutive battles has set in.

MsgJp:
隊長、行ってらっしゃい
こうして見送るのは不本意ですけど
二の矢、三の矢の準備は必要ですからね
MsgEn:
Captain, off you go. 
I do not wish to see you off like this,
but we must stay prepared,
a second and third arrow, just in case.

MsgJp:
この感じ――
気をつけてください、何かいます――
MsgEn:
This feeling--
be careful, there's something--

MsgJp:
隊長、本当にありがとうございました
さあ、みんなのところへ帰りましょう
ゆっくりしていると探しに来ちゃいますよね？
MsgEn:
Thank you, Captain. 
Now, let's head back to everyone. 
If we take too long, they'll come 
looking for us, won't they?

MsgJp: 素晴らしい！　素晴らしいぞ！
MsgEn: Excellent! That's fantastic!

MsgJp:
成し遂げたあなたたち――
新たな原始の雫――どちらも素晴らしい！
MsgEn:
You all have accomplished a remarkable feat――
A new Primeval Drop――
Remarkable!

MsgJp:
隊長、待ちきれません
早く原始の雫で浄化を始めましょう
MsgEn:
Captain, I can't hold back any longer. 
Let's swiftly start the purification
with the Primeval Drop!

MsgJp:
ふん！
もう少しで迎えを出すところだったぜ
MsgEn:
Hmph!
I was just about to call for assistance.

MsgJp:
ガルドリンったら、憎まれ口叩いてるけど
一番心配してたんだから
MsgEn:
Though Gurdolin talks tough,
he was the most worried one of us all.

MsgJp: おつかれさまです、隊長
MsgEn: Thank you for your hard work, Captain.

MsgJp:
実は、変なモノを持ち帰るんじゃないかと
不安でしたけど――
MsgEn:
Truth be told, I was anxious about you 
bringing back something weird, but――

MsgJp:
みんなの喜び方を見る限り
それは間違いなく《原始の雫》のようです
俺もホッとしましたよ
MsgEn:
Seeing how everyone is overjoyed, 
it surely resembles the 《Primeval Drops》. 
I'm relieved as well.

MsgJp: 鬱陶しいクズ虫どもめ――
MsgEn: Annoying, worthless bugs――

MsgJp: 我が世に居合わせたことを嘆くがよい
MsgEn: You should lament being in my world.

MsgJp: 強者の理（ことわり）に弱者は不要
MsgEn: The Order of the strong does not require the weak.

MsgJp: 堕ちた竜に殉じて消えろ
MsgEn: Be martyred in service to the fallen dragon.

MsgJp: 貴様らなど大界の塵芥（ちりあくた）よ
MsgEn: You are nothing but detritus in this great realm.

MsgJp: 勝てると思ったか――
MsgEn: Did you think you could win――

MsgJp: ここまで食い下がるとは――潰しがいがある
MsgEn:
I didn't expect you to persist this much―― 
Crushing you will be worth my time.

MsgJp: 死は常におまえたちの側（がわ）にある
MsgEn: Death is ever present beside you.

MsgJp: 半端覚者め――こしゃくな！
MsgEn: You half-hearted Arisen――how insolent!

MsgJp: ロイグを放しなさい！
MsgEn: Release Loeg!

MsgJp: みなさん、気をつけて！
MsgEn: Everyone, be careful!

MsgJp: たーーーっ！
MsgEn: Taaa――!

MsgJp: ガルドリンさん、エリオット、リズ、隊長――
MsgEn:
Ser Gurdolin, Elliot, Lise,
and Captain...

MsgJp: みなさん、生き延びてください――
MsgEn: Everyone, please survive--

MsgJp: あーーーっ！
MsgEn: Aaaaahhh!

MsgJp: ロイグ！　正気に戻って！
MsgEn: Loeg! Come to your senses!

MsgJp: フィンダムの闇は悪の住みかではない！
MsgEn:
The shadows of Phindym
will not be harbored by evil!

MsgJp: 他人に身を潜める卑怯者！　去れ！
MsgEn:
You coward who lurks in the shadows!
Leave this place at once!

MsgJp: てめえの正体はなんだ！
MsgEn: What is your true identity!

MsgJp: この、けむり野郎め！
MsgEn: You, wretched smoke fiend!

MsgJp: 騎士を名乗るんじゃねえ
MsgEn: You dare call yourself a knight?

MsgJp: おら、隊長！　なんとか言ってやれ！
MsgEn:
Hey, Captain!
Tell him what for!

MsgJp: てめえら全財産を俺の負けに賭けやがれ！
MsgEn: You guys bet all your money my loss!

MsgJp: 疲れた――１回やすませろ！
MsgEn: I'm exhausted—give me a break!

MsgJp: この勇姿、ジョゼフ様にお見せしたい！
MsgEn:
I want Master Joseph 
to witness this valiant form!

MsgJp: 負けない！　負けないったら負けない！
MsgEn: I won't lose! I absolutely will not lose!

MsgJp: 俺、けっこうやりますよね？
MsgEn: I'm pretty capable, aren't I?

MsgJp: 黒騎士？　ロイグ？　誰と戦ってるんだ！？
MsgEn:
Black Knight? Loeg? 
Who are you fighting against!?

MsgJp: 隊長、このまま戦ってていいんですか！？
MsgEn: Captain, is it okay to keep fighting!?

MsgJp: ロイグ、俺が分からないのか！？
MsgEn: Loeg, don't you recognize me?!

MsgJp: もうしつこいの嫌い！
MsgEn: I despise your persistence!

MsgJp: そんな攻撃なんて怖くないんだから！
MsgEn: I'm not afraid of such attacks!

MsgJp: ここが踏ん張りどころ！
MsgEn: This is where we dig in our heels!

MsgJp: 今、わたし、覚者人生の頂点かも！
MsgEn:
Right now, I may be at the peak of my
Arisen life!

MsgJp: キラッキラ輝いてる？
MsgEn: Aren't I shining brightly?

MsgJp: わたし、いける！
MsgEn: I can do it!

MsgJp:
竜はこの大地を救おうとしたが
毒を吸い込み、その結果、自らも
侵食されてしまった
MsgEn:
The Dragon tried to save this land
by drawing out the poison itself,
and as a result, it also got infected.

MsgJp:
大地が浄化されても、ウィルミアは
元には戻らないだろう
なんとかしてやりたいが――
MsgEn:
Though the land may be purified,
Willmia will not go back to how she was. 
I want to do something about it, but―

MsgJp:
隊長――
あと少し――
MsgEn:
Captain—
We're almost there—

MsgJp: あと少しだけ、一緒にいてください
MsgEn: Stay with me just a little bit longer.

MsgJp:
ふん！
竜が元に戻らないと大地はどうなるよ
MsgEn:
Hmph! 
If the Dragon doesn't return to normal, 
what will become of the land?

MsgJp:
浄化はされても
痩せて、枯れちまうんじゃねえのか？
MsgEn:
Even if it is purified,
won't it shrink and wither away?

MsgJp:
浄化が始まっても竜がいなくちゃ
世界は不完全なまま――
MsgEn:
Even if the purification starts,
without the Dragon,
the world will be incomplete――

MsgJp: 俺たち、これから何をすればいいんです？
MsgEn: What are we supposed to do now?

MsgJp: ウィルミア――ああ、ウィルミアよ――
MsgEn:
Willmia――
Oh, Willmia――

MsgJp:
――定めと戦おうという我々の決意が
あと幾日か早ければ――
MsgEn:
――If our determination to battle fate 
had come a few days sooner――

MsgJp:
ウィルミアは浄化されない――
そういうことですね？
MsgEn:
Willmia cannot be purified――
Is that what you're saying?

MsgJp:
たとえ大地が浄化されても
竜は戻らないのか――
MsgEn:
Even if the land is cleansed,
the Dragon will not be restored--?

MsgJp:
どうするんだい？
これ以上、君にできることは何かあるのかい？
あとは向こうの人たちに任せた方が
いいんじゃないのかな
MsgEn:
What will you do?
Is there even anything more you can do?
Maybe it would be best to leave
the rest to the people over there.

MsgJp: その、なんというか――君たちのためにさ
MsgEn:
Well, how should I put this—
It's for your sake, after all.

MsgJp:
喜びも半分――
どうやら、そういうことのようだな
MsgEn:
A half-victory—
it seems that's how it is.

MsgJp: 精霊竜は――無念なことをした
MsgEn:
The Spirit Dragon--
How regrettable.

MsgJp:
急ぎ、倒し、竜の尊厳を守ってやれ
魔物に堕する前に――倒してくれ
MsgEn:
Make haste, defeat them, and safeguard
the Dragon's dignity before they fall
to the enemy―― slay it.

MsgJp: 案ずることはない
MsgEn: There's nothing to waver about.

MsgJp:
精霊竜は覚者を残した
さだめを予期していたのだろう
MsgEn:
The Spirit Dragon left the Arisen,
perhaps anticipating their fate.

MsgJp:
時はきた――だな
心して行くがよい
MsgEn:
The moment is here―― 
Head on with resolve.

MsgJp:
竜と人が交わした親愛の情――
フィンダムの命が長い歴史の中で
結びあった絆――
MsgEn:
The cherished ties between 
Dragons and humans―― 
the bonds intertwined 
through the ages of Phindym――

MsgJp:
それら全てを忘れた竜の強さは
おまえたちの想像を上回るだろう
MsgEn:
The might of a Dragon 
that has forgotten it all 
will exceed what you 
can possibly imagine.

MsgJp:
思いが挫けては倒せぬ
心身の備えを万全にして挑むがよい
MsgEn:
One cannot fall if their spirit does not waver.
Steady your body and soul to face this trial.

MsgJp: 竜を倒して竜を守る覚者――
MsgEn: The Arisen who slays and protects Dragons――

MsgJp:
長い歴史でも、君たちが最初だろうね
うん、すごいことだと思うな
MsgEn:
In all this time, you are surely the first. 
Indeed, I believe that is quite remarkable.

MsgJp:
いよいよ最後の戦いに挑む――
と言ったところかな？
MsgEn:
Now it's time to take on the final battle―― 
Would that be accurate to say?

MsgJp:
こちら側のことは我々に任せて
存分に戦ってくれ
MsgEn:
Leave everything on our side to us; 
fight with all your might.

MsgJp:
我らの心は決まっている
もう嘆きはしない
MsgEn:
Our hearts are set.
We mourn no more.

MsgJp: 隊長――
MsgEn: Captain...

MsgJp:
隊長、あと少しですね
がんばりましょう！
MsgEn:
Captain, we're almost there. 
Let's give it our all!

MsgJp:
話し足りねえのか？
もう、行くしかねえぞ
MsgEn:
Do you feel there is more to say? 
Well, we must move forward now.

MsgJp:
もう、決心した――覚悟した
だから、出発！
MsgEn:
I've made up my mind―― I'm ready. 
So, let's set off!

MsgJp:
ここまで来て怖じ気づくとか
尻込みするとか、あり得ませんから――
ええ、あり得ませんとも！
MsgEn:
There's no way I would hesitate or
shrink back after coming this far――
Indeed, that is unthinkable!

MsgJp: 竜よ――ウィルミアよ――
MsgEn:
O Dragon――
Dear Willmia――

MsgJp: わたしはこの試練を乗り越える！
MsgEn: I will overcome this Trial!

MsgJp: 眠って――静かに眠りについて――
MsgEn:
Sleep now―― 
And settle into a quiet slumber――

MsgJp: 精霊竜よ、鎮まりたまえ！
MsgEn: Be still, O Spirit Dragon!

MsgJp: ためらいは命取りです！
MsgEn: Hesitation is fatal!

MsgJp: ウィルミア、こっちを見て！
MsgEn: Willmia, look at me!

MsgJp: これでどう！？
MsgEn: How about this!?

MsgJp: せいやっ！
MsgEn: Hyah!

MsgJp: 波状攻撃でいきましょう！
MsgEn: Let's do it in waves!

MsgJp: みなさん――頑張って
MsgEn: Everyone ―― good luck.

MsgJp: ――わたしには使命がある
MsgEn: ――I have a mission to complete.

MsgJp: ウィルミア――あとはわたしが！
MsgEn: Willmia—I'll do the rest!

MsgJp: 遠慮はしねえぞ！
MsgEn: I won't hold back!

MsgJp: おい、手加減は無礼だぞ？
MsgEn:
Hey, you know
holding back is disrespectful, right?

MsgJp: リズ、腰が引けてる！
MsgEn: Lise, you're holding back!

MsgJp: 隊長、相変わらずキレがいいな
MsgEn: Captain, you are as sharp as ever.

MsgJp: エリオット、もっと動け！
MsgEn: Elliot, get a move on!

MsgJp: どんな状況でも竜は竜――手強いぜ
MsgEn:
A Dragon is a Dragon no matter what
the circumstance--they're tough.

MsgJp: 高く舞って攻撃！　これはどう！？
MsgEn: Jump high and attack! How about this!?

MsgJp: 低く駆けて攻撃！　いい感じ？
MsgEn: Run low and attack! How's that?

MsgJp: 素早く回って攻撃！　速っ！　我ながら速っ！
MsgEn:
Turn quick and attack! Swiftly!
As fast as I am!

MsgJp: 疲れたかも！　これ、まずいかも！
MsgEn:
My stamina is running out!
This might not end well!

MsgJp: ここまで来たんだもの！　最後まで見届ける！
MsgEn:
We've come this far! 
We will see it through to the end!

MsgJp: 生き残るぞ～！　わたしは生き延びるぞ～！
MsgEn: I will～! I will survive～!

MsgJp: 精霊竜よ、許したまえ！
MsgEn: Forgive me, Spirit Dragon!

MsgJp: 病んでも竜――やっぱり凄いですね
MsgEn:
Even when it is ill,
a Dragon is truly formidable, isn't it?

MsgJp: 逃げませんよ、ええ、おれ、逃げません！
MsgEn: I won't run away, I will not flee!

MsgJp: 隊長、一気に決めましょう！
MsgEn: Captain, let's decide this once and for all!

MsgJp: はぁ――はぁ――キツいなあ
MsgEn: Hah--hah--that's tough.

MsgJp: もう――ジョゼフ様だって褒めてくれるはず――
MsgEn:
Surely―― 
Even Master Joseph will commend me now――

MsgJp:
行っちまったなあ――
若い娘ってのは、まったくよ――
MsgEn:
She really took off―― 
Young women, they can be quite something――

MsgJp:
セシリーは覚者なんだから――
わかっていた――
こうなるって知ってたけど――
MsgEn:
Cecily is an Arisen―― 
I knew――
I knew this was going to happen, but ――

MsgJp: なんでだろう――泣けちゃう
MsgEn: I don't know why--it makes me cry.

MsgJp:
これはお別れじゃありませんよ？
セシリーが竜になる
理どおりです
問題なんかありません
MsgEn:
This is not a goodbye, you know? 
Cecily will turn into a Dragon. 
It is as it should be. 
There is no problem at all.

MsgJp:
いや――しいて言えば――
俺のこの胸が張り裂けそうなのは
かなり問題です――隊長――俺、つらいです
MsgEn:
No, if I must say—
this pain in my chest
is quite a problem, Captain—
I'm struggling here.

MsgJp:
たとえ姿が変わっても、あれはわたしの娘だと
思うことは許されるのだろうか？
MsgEn:
Even if her form has changed,
is it still right to think of her as my daughter?

MsgJp:
いや、ダメだと言われても
心の中ばかりはどうしようもないがな
MsgEn:
Even if I'm told it's forbidden, 
I can't help but feel this way 
in my heart.

MsgJp:
ガラダを見よ――
なんと立派な族長――そして父親
MsgEn:
Look at Gearóid――
What a great Chief―― and father.

MsgJp:
あの親子がいてくれなかったら
フィンダムは朽ち果てていただろうよ
MsgEn:
If that parent and child hadn't been there,
Phindym would have surely fallen into ruin.

MsgJp:
フィンダムに娘を捧げた父親に
かける言葉はけして惜しむまい
MsgEn:
I shall never hold back words for a father
who gave his daughter for Phindym.

MsgJp:
あなたたちへの感謝を、わたしたちは
生涯忘れないでしょう
MsgEn:
Our gratitude towards you will never
be forgotten, for the rest of our lives.

MsgJp:
覚者の顔を知っている竜の守番は
初めてだな――
MsgEn:
This is the first time a Dragon Guardian
knows the face of the Arisen――

MsgJp: つい、必要以上に世話を焼いてしまいそうだ
MsgEn: I might end up being overly protective.

MsgJp: セシリーは、どうなの？　元気にしている？
MsgEn: What about Cecily? Is she doing okay?

MsgJp:
ひさしぶりにセシリーに会いたいな
今度、一緒にここに来てね！
MsgEn:
I want to see Cecily again after a long time.
Next time, come here with me!

MsgJp:
レスタニアに入り込んだ侵食魔は
ほとんど退治したぞ
MsgEn:
The Corruption Demons that entered 
Lestania have nearly been exterminated.

MsgJp: まだ完全とはいかないが、時間の問題だろうよ
MsgEn:
Though it isn't complete,
I believe it's only a matter of time.

MsgJp:
精霊竜を倒したんだよね？
ということは、セシリーは――
MsgEn:
You defeated the Spirit Dragon, right?
So that means that Cecily--

MsgJp:
ごめん――
聞くまでも――ないよね
MsgEn:
I'm sorry-- I don't-- 
I don't have to ask, do I?

MsgJp:
覚者であることを忘れた娘――
危うい存在ではあったが
理の中に戻ったようだな
MsgEn:
The daughter who forgot she was Arisen—
though she was a perilous existence,
it seems she has returned to order.

MsgJp:
我が覚者よ、無事の帰還を祝そう
今はただ、休むがいい
MsgEn:
My Arisen, we shall celebrate your 
safe return. For now, just rest.

MsgJp:
そうか、ついにやったか！
これにて一件落着というわけだな！
MsgEn:
Well, you finally did it!
I guess that settles the matter!

MsgJp:
――おや、どうした
なぜ沈んでいる――
――つらいことがあったのか？
MsgEn:
――Oh, what troubles you? 
Why do you appear so down? 
――Has something been difficult?

MsgJp:
たまにはフィンダムへ渡り
様子を見てきてはどうだ？
大地は順調に回復しているのか？
MsgEn:
Perhaps you should visit 
Phindym from time to time 
and see how things are? 
Is the land healing well?

MsgJp: おお、よく来てくれたな
MsgEn: Oh, thank you for coming.

MsgJp:
すでにうわさになっているようだが――
空を飛ぶ、赤々と燃える火球の目撃談が
あちこちから入っている
MsgEn:
The rumors have already started―― 
People everywhere are reporting seeing 
a bright red fireball flying through the air.

MsgJp:
記録を漁ったが、そのような火球は
レスタニア史上一度も話題になっていない
そこでおまえの出番だ
MsgEn:
I went through the records, yet no such fireball 
has ever been discussed in Lestania's history. 
Now, it's your turn to act.

MsgJp:
まず、セネカと話してくれ
各地の火球の情報をまとめるように
指示しておいた
MsgEn:
Start by talking to Seneka. 
I've ordered her to compile reports 
on the fireballs seen across the land.

MsgJp:
セネカと話したら、戻って来てくれ
おまえの意見を聞かせてほしい
MsgEn:
Once you've talked to Seneka, come back.
I want you to hear your opinion.

MsgJp: では頼んだぞ――
MsgEn: I entrust this task to you――

MsgJp:
まず、セネカと話してくれ
各地の目撃談を整理して教えてくれるはずだ
MsgEn:
First, speak to Seneka.
She should have compiled the reports 
from every region.

MsgJp:
民が驚くほどの空飛ぶ火球――
近頃は習いなきことが多いな
MsgEn:
A fireball soaring through the sky― 
The people are shocked. 
Lately, many strange things are happening.

MsgJp: 空の火球か――自然現象ではなさそうだね
MsgEn:
A fireball in the sky, huh?
It doesn't seem to be a natural phenomenon.

MsgJp: セネカはいつものところだろ？
MsgEn: Seneka should be at the usual place, right?

MsgJp:
――この間、平和なのはいいけれど
ちょっと退屈だな――なんて思ったんだよね
MsgEn:
"――The peace lately is nice, 
but it feels a bit dull――"
That's what I was thinking, y'know?

MsgJp: だから火球のことは、すこーし後ろめたいんだ
MsgEn:
That's why I feel a bit guilty
about it raining fire now.

MsgJp:
火球の件で隊長が動くそうですね
もし調査へ行くなら、俺を忘れないでくださいよ
MsgEn:
I've heard the Captain is taking action 
about the fire falling from the sky.
If you go to investigate,
don't forget about me, alright?

MsgJp: ずいぶん立派な武装だね
MsgEn: That's a pretty splendid weapon.

MsgJp: へえ、武器は飾りじゃないってことか
MsgEn: Oh, so that weapon isn't just for show, huh?

MsgJp: 強いね――熟練の戦士？
MsgEn:
You're quite strong—
Are you an experienced warrior?

MsgJp: わたしより強いんじゃない？
MsgEn: Aren't you stronger than me?

MsgJp: そんな戦い方、ある！？
MsgEn: Is there such a way to fight!?

MsgJp: 残りのオーク、全部任せるよ
MsgEn: I'll leave the rest of the orcs to you.

MsgJp: オークめ、次から次へとぞろぞろぞろぞろ――
MsgEn: Orcs, one after the other ――

MsgJp: 敵の中に大将級はいない、さっさと終わらせよう
MsgEn:
There aren't any commanders among the enemies; 
let's wrap this up quickly.

MsgJp: あー、臭い！　オークめ！　来るな！
MsgEn:
Ah, it stinks! Get away, orc!
Don't come near me!

MsgJp: おい、娘！　ここはどこだ！
MsgEn: Hey, miss! Where am I?

MsgJp: 隊長、オークどもの装束を見ろ
MsgEn: Captain, take a look at the orc's armor!

MsgJp: オークどもめ、いつの間にこんな武具を――
MsgEn: Those orcs, when did they get such gear―

MsgJp: どうも勝手が違うぜ
MsgEn: Things feel a bit different here, huh?

MsgJp: 隊長、俺の考えじゃここは――
MsgEn: Captain, in my opinion, this place――

MsgJp: くっそう！　まさに世の末だなこりゃあ
MsgEn:
Damn it!
This truly feels like the end of days.

MsgJp: え、このオーク、強すぎない？
MsgEn: Eh, isn't this orc too strong?

MsgJp: 隊長、違うよね？
MsgEn: Captain, it's different, isn't it?

MsgJp: わからない？　手応えとか――違うよ
MsgEn:
Don't you see? 
Their response, too-- it's not the same.

MsgJp: オークだけどオークじゃないみたい
MsgEn: It's an orc, but it's not an orc.

MsgJp: やっぱりわからない！　ここどこ！？
MsgEn:
I really don't understand! 
Where are we!?

MsgJp: とにかくオークを全部倒しちゃおう
MsgEn: Let's just kill all the orcs.

MsgJp: やっぱりこれはオーク戦争！？
MsgEn: This is the Orc War after all!?

MsgJp: 戦いの時代に逆戻り！？
MsgEn: Back to the days of battle!?

MsgJp: 世の末ってどういう意味でしょうね
MsgEn:
What do you think it means, 
the end of the world?

MsgJp: 未来？　ここは未来のレスタニア！？
MsgEn:
The future? 
This is the Lestania of the future!?

MsgJp: ねえ君！　君！　お嬢さん！　娘さん！
MsgEn: Hey there! You! Miss! Young lady!

MsgJp: 戦闘が終わったら質問攻めだよ！
MsgEn:
Once the battle is over,
I'll barrage you with questions!

MsgJp: ったく、また厄介なことになっちまったな
MsgEn:
Damn it,
I've gotten myself into trouble again.

MsgJp:
状況を把握するまでは
あの娘に従うしかねえだろう
MsgEn:
Until we figure out what's going on,
we're gonna have to follow that lady.

MsgJp: 若い娘は――任せるぜ
MsgEn: The young lady――I trust her to handle it.

MsgJp:
オークとの戦争――
しかも人間側は敗色濃厚という感じですかね
MsgEn:
A war with orcs--
And the humans appear to be losing.

MsgJp:
あのこ、丘の上の方へ行っちゃったよ
早く行こうよ
MsgEn:
She's gone over the hill.
Let's get out of here.

MsgJp: おかしな真似はしない方が身の為だ
MsgEn:
It's best for you to refrain
from doing anything foolish.

MsgJp: おたがい、聞きたいことがいろいろありそうだね
MsgEn: I'm sure we both have a lot to ask each other.

MsgJp: ここはなんだ？
MsgEn: What is this place?

MsgJp:
見たところ、村なんだろうが
活気ってもんがねえな
MsgEn:
It looks like a village,
but there's no sign of life here.

MsgJp:
――敵意は感じませんけど
歓迎されているわけでもなさそうですね
MsgEn:
――I don't sense any hostility,
but it doesn't seem to be welcoming either,
does it?

MsgJp:
あー、見られてる
刺すような視線を感じる――
MsgEn:
Ah, I'm being watched.
I feel a piercing gaze—

MsgJp: ふん、いい腕してるようだが――
MsgEn: Hmph, you seem to have some skill, but—

MsgJp:
まさかオークどもの手先じゃないだろうな
もしそうなら今この瞬間寝返った方がいい
MsgEn:
I hope you're not working for the orcs.
If you are, you should turn yourselves in 
this very moment.

MsgJp: なかなかの手練れだそうだな
MsgEn: It seems you are quite the skilled one.

MsgJp:
わたしはこの国から平穏を奪った竜と戦う
解放軍の世話人クインタス
早速だが君たちの素性を聞かせてもらおうか
MsgEn: Let's get right to it. Let's hear who you are.

MsgJp: ――ほう
MsgEn: ―― Ho

MsgJp:
レスタニアから来た白竜の覚者――
４人とも覚者だと言うのだな
MsgEn:
The White Dragons' Arisen from Lestania--
You say all four are Arisen.

MsgJp:
あなたたち――
自分が覚者だってことは証明できる？
MsgEn:
You guys ――
Can you prove that you're Arisen?

MsgJp:
たとえば、ほら、あの礎に
触れてみるとか
MsgEn:
For instance, how about touching 
that Portcrystal over there?

MsgJp:
あれはわたしたちには扱えない代物だからね
どう？　証明できる？
MsgEn:
That is something we cannot manage, you know. 
How about it? Can you demonstrate it?

MsgJp:
覚者って言うならできるよね？
礎はこの村の奥よ
MsgEn:
If you are Arisen, you can do it, right?
The Portcrystal is deep within this village.

MsgJp:
いつの時代も覚者はひとり――
少なくともこの国ではそういう習わしだ
MsgEn:
In every age, the Arisen stands alone—
At least, that's the custom in this land.

MsgJp:
俺たちが覚者だってことは
話しても良かったのか？
MsgEn: Was it alright to reveal us being Arisen?

MsgJp: こりゃ微妙な情勢だな――
MsgEn: It's a delicate situation --

MsgJp:
やっちゃいましょうよ、隊長
礎の解放なんて簡単なことですしね
MsgEn:
Let's get it done, Captain.
Attuning to the Portcrystal is a simple task.

MsgJp: とりあえず、礎の場所を確認しなくちゃ
MsgEn:
In the meantime, 
we need to locate the damn thing.

MsgJp:
力尽くでエリオットを取り戻すって手もあるが――
ま、やめておいた方が無難だな
MsgEn:
We could forcibly take back Elliot, 
but―― it's probably best to avoid that.

MsgJp:
黒い竜――悪しき竜――
白竜様なら何かご存知かもね
MsgEn:
Black Dragon ―― Evil Dragon ――
Lord White Dragon might know something.

MsgJp:
あなたたちの強さはよく分かった
だからこそ、そう簡単に信じるわけにいかないの
MsgEn:
I understand your strength very well. 
That's precisely why I cannot easily trust you.

MsgJp:
悪く思わないでくれ――
と言っても無理だろうな
MsgEn:
Don't hold it against me―― 
Though I suppose that's asking too much.

MsgJp:
いいんだ
我々がなめた辛酸は理解できまい
MsgEn:
It's fine. 
You cannot understand the hardships
we've endured here.

MsgJp:
ジリアンたちの手前強がったけど
正直、俺、不安で倒れそうですからね
MsgEn:
I put on a brave face in front of Gillian
and the others, but honestly, I'm on the 
verge of collapsing from anxiety.

MsgJp: 信じてますよ！　待ってますよ！
MsgEn:
I believe in you!
I'll be waiting!

MsgJp:
ちょっとちょっと、あのあと、神殿が燃えて
覚者さまが炎に呑み込まれたって――
MsgEn:
Hold on, hold on, after that,
the temple caught fire, and the Arisen
was consumed by the flames—

MsgJp: あれれ！？　おかえりなさい！
MsgEn: Huh?! Welcome back!

MsgJp:
聞いたぞ
エリオットを置いてきて良かったのか？
MsgEn:
I heard.
Was it sound to leave Elliot behind?

MsgJp:
力尽くで取り返す算段はいらないのか？
他の覚者にも声をかけた方が良くはないのか？
MsgEn:
Is there no plan to get him back by force?
Shouldn't we reach out to the other Arisen, too?

MsgJp:
エリオットを人質に取られたんだって？
あまり友好的な相手じゃなさそうだね
MsgEn:
I heard they took Elliot hostage.
They don't sound very friendly.

MsgJp: やはり竜であったか――
MsgEn: It was a Dragon, after all――

MsgJp:
フィンダムに続き、また新たな大陸で
理が崩れようとしている――
MsgEn:
Following Phindym,
order is about to collapse on a new continent...

MsgJp:
あの邪悪な炎を放っておけば
レスタニアにも燃え移ることは必至
MsgEn:
If that evil flame is left unchecked,
it will inevitably spread to Lestania.

MsgJp:
既にアッカーシェランへの航路は
ここ神殿の商業区――
海側にある竜の礎においても開かれている
MsgEn:
The gate to Acre Selund has already 
opened in the Shopping District
of the Temple, as well as at the 
Dragon's Portcrystal by the sea.

MsgJp:
危機に備え、禍根を断つためにも
急ぎアッカーシェランへ飛んで情報を集めるのだ
MsgEn:
In order to brace for the crisis
and cut off the source of calamity, 
hasten to Acre Selund to gather information.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜はなぜおまえたちを巻きこんだのか――
その問いを、常に忘れてはならぬ
MsgEn:
Why did the Evil Dragon get you involved? 
That question remains.

MsgJp: 頼んだぞ、我が覚者たちよ
MsgEn: I ask you, my Arisen.

MsgJp: →初期（Lv上げ）ダンジョン解放
MsgEn: → Initial (leveling up) dungeon unlocked

MsgJp:
さあ、準備が整ったのならアッカーシェランへ
飛んでくれ
MsgEn:
Now, if you are ready,
fly to Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
まずは穏便にエリオットを取り返して
友好的な関係を築くこと
MsgEn:
First, we need to get Elliot back quietly
and amicably and build a rapport.

MsgJp:
これはフィンダムの一件よりも大ごとだ
本心はどうあれ、情報収集のためには
アッカーシェラン側の協力が不可欠
MsgEn:
This matter is more serious
than the incident in Phindym.
Regardless of your true feelings,
cooperation from the Acre Selund side
is essential for gathering information.

MsgJp:
また向こうでは、何が待ち受けているやも分からん
ポーンも連れて行くと良い
MsgEn:
You cannot predict what lies
ahead over there. It would be good
to take your Pawns along as well.

MsgJp:
いいな？
目的は状況の把握
なるべく小まめに報告してくれ
MsgEn:
Understood?
The goal is to understand the situation,
so please report in as frequently as possible.

MsgJp:
エリオットは人質だ
命を奪われるようなことはないと思うが――
MsgEn:
Elliot has been taken hostage.
I don't think they'll take his life--

MsgJp:
また余計なひとことで
事を荒立ててはいないだろうな
MsgEn:
You haven't made matters worse with
any unnecessary comments, have you?

MsgJp:
交流どころか、存在すら知らなかった大陸と
また繋がりができたわけだ
MsgEn:
Far from any sort of cultural exchange,
we've formed a connection with a continent 
we were previously unaware of.

MsgJp: 好奇心は刺激されるけど、怖くもなるね
MsgEn:
It stirs my curiosity,
yet its discovery is frightening.

MsgJp: エリオットのやつ、どんな顔してやがるかね
MsgEn:
That Elliot, I wonder what kind of face
he's showing right now.

MsgJp:
エリオット、待ってるよ？
早く行ってあげようよ
MsgEn:
Elliot, are you waiting?
Hurry up, let's go.

MsgJp: ほう――戻って来たのか
MsgEn: Oh, so you've returned.

MsgJp: ここから先はジリアンの指示に従え
MsgEn: Follow Gillian's instructions from here on out.

MsgJp:
妙な考えを起こすなよ
仲間に何かあったらおまえたちを
疑うからな
MsgEn:
Don't get any funny ideas.
If anything happens to one of our guys, 
we'll be looking at you.

MsgJp:
あと先のことを考えると
連中の信頼は勝ち取っておきてえよな
MsgEn:
Considering what lies ahead, 
I want to earn their trust.

MsgJp:
白竜の覚者ここにありってところを
見せつけておかなくちゃ
MsgEn:
I need to demonstrate that 
the White Dragons' Arisen are here to help.

MsgJp:
もちろん信じていましたけど
こうして戻ってきてくれたこと――
MsgEn:
I certainly believed, but to have
you return like this――

MsgJp:
本当にうれしいです
想像より、ずっとうれしいです
MsgEn:
I am truly happy.
It's so much more than I imagined.

MsgJp:
ここから北へ向かったその先に
敵の、ちょっとした野営地があるの
MsgEn:
If you head north from here, 
there's a minor enemy camp up ahead.

MsgJp:
このあたりを監視するために作られたみたい
そこにね、わたしたちの仲間が捕まっているんだ
MsgEn:
It was built long ago
to monitor the area.
Our companions are trapped
over there.

MsgJp:
近づいて探りを入れたいんだけど
こっちに来るのはひさしぶりだから――
MsgEn:
I'd like to get closer and investigate, 
but it's been a long time since I've been here――

MsgJp:
ああ、そうか
あなたたちの紹介もしなくちゃね
MsgEn:
Oh, yeah.
I have to introduce you guys too.

MsgJp:
エリアマスターのエンデールに会ってきてよ
挨拶して、このあたりの最新情報を
仕入れてきて
MsgEn:
Please meet with Endale, the Area Master.
Greet him and gather the latest news
about this area.

MsgJp:
もし、気が変わったとか、怖じ気づいたとかなら
今のうちにそう言って
MsgEn:
If you are having second thoughts
or are now filled with fear,
now is the time to speak up.

MsgJp:
大事な時に逃げ出すくらいなら
最初からいない方がいいから
MsgEn:
If you're going to run away when it matters, 
it's better you were never here at all.

MsgJp:
俺はこの一帯のエリアを仕切っている
エンデールというものだ
この国がどういう状況か、教えてやろう
MsgEn:
I am Endale, who oversees this area. 
Let me enlighten you on the situation 
of this land.

MsgJp:
既に辺り一面、魔軍の手に堕ちている
以前は獣を追って狩人が集まる豊かな山だったが
今や人間が狩られる有様――
MsgEn:
The surroundings have already succumbed 
to the Demon Army. It used to be a 
bountiful mountain where hunters
once gathered to hunt beasts, but now,
humans are the ones being hunted.

MsgJp:
情けない話だが――
誰もこの先に希望なぞ見出せん
俺を含め、この国を愛した戦士たち誰もがな
MsgEn:
It's a pitiful tale. Moreso—
no one can find hope ahead.
Not a single one, including myself,
among the warriors who love this land.

MsgJp:
そのうえ、真に忌々しいのは魔軍の戦車――
戦車といっても、４本足のどデカいやつのことだ
そいつのせいで、このエリアは壊滅状態に陥った
MsgEn:
Furthermore, the truly detestable thing
is the Demon Army's war machine—
Though when I say war machine,
I mean the massive four-legged behemoth.
Because of that creature, this area 
has fallen into a state of complete ruin.

MsgJp:
これからお前が向かう野営地は
魔軍の支配する拠点のひとつ――
ヤツらの動きには充分、注意するんだな
MsgEn:
The encampment you're heading to now
is one of the strongholds 
controlled by the Demon Army--
Be very careful of their movements.

MsgJp:
他に何か知りたいことがあれば、遠慮はするな
このあたりのことならなんでも教えてやろう
MsgEn:
If there's anything else you'd like to know,
don't hesitate to contact me.
I'll tell you anything you need
to know around here.

MsgJp:
なんでも聞いてくれ
質問に答えるのも俺の役目だからな
MsgEn:
Ask me anything you want.
I'm here to answer your questions.

MsgJp:
ジリアンは既に出立した
おまえたちもジリアンの後を追ってくれ
MsgEn:
Gillian has already left.
You guys go after Gillian too.

MsgJp: おい、とっとと俺たちも行こうぜ
MsgEn: Hey, let's get the hell out of here.

MsgJp:
あー、野営地って、敵がうじゃうじゃいそうな
予感がするんだけれど
MsgEn:
Ah, I have a feeling that the encampment
is going to be crawling with enemies.

MsgJp:
野営地を探っていた仲間に
何かしらの動きがあったみたいです
MsgEn:
I've got a buddy who was exploring
the encampment and it looks like
there's been some movement.

MsgJp: どうやら怖じ気づきはしなかったみたいね
MsgEn: Apparently, it didn't scare him off.

MsgJp:
いい、仲間の工作によって
閉じられた野営地への突入路は確保した
MsgEn:
Certainly, with the aid of my allies, 
we have secured the route to the 
closed-off campsite for our approach.

MsgJp:
わたしは裏から忍び込むから
あなたたちは仲間と共に正面から切り込んで
派手に暴れてくれない？
MsgEn:
I'll sneak in from the back
and you guys can cut in from the front
with your buddies and go on a rampage
with a bang, right?

MsgJp:
わたしが囚われた仲間を見つけ出すあいだ
敵を引きつけてほしいの
MsgEn:
While I find my captive companions,
I want you to keep the attention of the enemies.

MsgJp:
それと、魔軍の中には戦甲で身を固めた敵が
いるみたいだから注意して
MsgEn:
Also, it seems there are foes among
the Demon Army clad in battle armor,
so be wary.

MsgJp:
野営地の中には、必ず囚われた仲間が
いるはずなんだ
MsgEn:
Within the encampment, there should 
definitely be captured allies.

MsgJp:
はじめて見る顔だな
だが、手を貸してくれるなら歓迎だ
MsgEn:
I've never seen your face before,
but you're welcome to lend a hand.

MsgJp:
作戦の手筈はジリアンから聞いて欲しい
突入路は既に開いている
MsgEn:
Please listen to the strategy from Gillian; 
the route for infiltration is already clear.

MsgJp:
新入りさん？
頑張ってね
MsgEn:
Fresh blood?
Good luck out there.

MsgJp:
待ち人は来ず――か
いや、こちらの話だ
MsgEn:
Our rendezvous has not come—
Don't mind, this is about us.

MsgJp: 解放されても未来があるわけじゃない――か
MsgEn:
Being released doesn't guarantee 
a future—does it?

MsgJp:
こりゃ助ける方にとってもキツい戦いだな
なんに命を賭けりゃいいんだ
MsgEn:
This battle is tough for the ones 
offering help too. What should 
we put our lives on the line for?

MsgJp: ジリアンさ、希望を探してるって言ってたよね
MsgEn: Gillian, you said you were looking for hope.

MsgJp:
それ、なんだろう
ここには無さそうだけど――
MsgEn:
What could that be? 
It seems it's not here, though―

MsgJp: 隊長、一度レスタニアに戻りませんか？
MsgEn: Captain, why don't you go back to Lestania?

MsgJp:
ここも気になるけど――
どうせ休むなら、あっちの方が
身体にはいいはずです
MsgEn:
This place interests me too, but― 
if we must rest, over there should be 
better for the body.

MsgJp:
おかげでみんな無事
相変わらず、疲れ切っているけどね
ねぎらいや感謝がなくても悪く思わないで
MsgEn:
Thanks to that, everyone is safe.
They're still exhausted as ever, though.
Don't take it badly if there's no praise
or gratitude.

MsgJp:
あの忌々しい戦車が立ち去った後――
敵が新たな部隊を配備する前に、あの野営地は
わたしたちで確保しておくつもり
MsgEn:
After that accursed tank has moved on, 
we will ensure that camp is secured 
before the enemy assigns a new force.

MsgJp:
けれど、アッカーシェランはもう終わりが
近いんだと思う
たとえ大地が生き続けても、人の心は死にかけている
MsgEn:
But I think the end is near for Acre Selund.
Even if the land continues to live, 
people's hearts are dying.

MsgJp:
火竜様が倒れてから――
大地を巡る竜力が変わったせいだと思う
MsgEn:
Since Lord Fire Dragon's defeat, 
I believe the dragon power that
circulates through the land has changed.

MsgJp:
あなたたちも休んでおくといいよ
ここだって、オークどもが来ないとも限らない
その時は戦ってもらうからね
MsgEn:
You all should take a rest as well.
Even here, there's no guarantee
that orcs won't appear.
If that happens, I'll need you to fight.

MsgJp: アッカーシェランか――
MsgEn: So, Acre Selund―

MsgJp:
こことは違う歴史、こことは違う思想の人々が
暮らす世界
でもやっぱり、戦争だけはあるんだね
MsgEn:
People with a different history, 
a different ideology from the world we live in.
But still, there is always war, isn't it?

MsgJp:
なるほど――
アッカーシェランの民たちは
疲れ、絶望しているというわけか
MsgEn:
I see...
The people of Acre Selund
are tired and bereft of hope.

MsgJp:
そんな状態では、いくら戦いに勝利しても
ずるずると終焉に向かって滑り落ちるだけ――
MsgEn:
In such a state, no matter how many battles
you win, you will be battered down
toward the end, slowly but surely――

MsgJp:
こんな時こそ強い指導者が必要なのだが
聞く限り、ジリアンもクインタスもそういう人物では
なさそうだな
MsgEn:
It's times like this when the people
need strong figures to lead them.
From what I've heard, neither Gillian
nor Quintus seem to be that kind of person.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランの人々は竜を失い
町や村も失ってしまった――
MsgEn:
The people of Acre Selund have lost their Dragon,
their towns and villages--

MsgJp:
想像を絶する苦境に立たされ
人々は生きる気力もなくしかけている
MsgEn:
In such unimaginable hardship,
people have almost lost the will to go on.

MsgJp:
しかし、そのような状況の中で
ジリアンという娘は"希望を探している"と
言った――
MsgEn:
Yet, in that situation, a girl named Gillian 
claimed she was "looking for hope"――

MsgJp:
それはいったいなんだ？　人か？　物か？
それとなく探るのだ
MsgEn:
What is it? Is it a person?
Is it a thing? I'll look for it implicitly.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランの希望が
仮に、一撃で形勢を逆転するほどの
兵器であれば――
MsgEn:
If Acre Selund's hope were a weapon
that could, in a single blow, turn the tide――

MsgJp:
向こうとは距離を置いた方が良いという
判断になるだろう
おまえたちがもたらす情報は重要だぞ
MsgEn:
It would serve us well if you keep your distance
from the other side. Judgements will be made.
The information you bring is valuable, you know.

MsgJp: アッカーシェランは混乱しているんだろう？
MsgEn: Acre Selund is confusing, isn't it?

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様はあからさまに警戒しているけど
今、交流を深めておくことは
両方の大陸にとって、良いことばかりだと
思うけどね
MsgEn:
Joseph is clearly on guard,
but I believe deepening our ties now
would be beneficial for both continents.

MsgJp:
待ち人が来なければ
こちらから行くしかない
MsgEn:
If the awaited one does not arrive,
then we must go to them ourselves.

MsgJp:
活動の方針を少しばかり変えることにしたから
詳しいことはジリアンから聞いてくれ
MsgEn:
I've decided to change the course
of our activities a bit.
You'll have to get more details from Gillian.

MsgJp:
しっかしアレだな
人が増えたら活気が出そうなもんだが――
MsgEn:
But really, it seems that if there were 
more people, the atmosphere would 
become more lively――

MsgJp:
こりゃ気をつけねえと、こっちの気分まで
どんよりしちまうぜ
MsgEn:
I must be cautious, or else this 
mood will darken my spirits too.

MsgJp: わからないな――
MsgEn: I don't know--

MsgJp:
わたしたちは悪しき竜の意志で
ここに来たんだよね？
こっち側にいても、いいのかな？
MsgEn:
We came here by the will
of the Evil Dragon, didn't we?
Is it really alright for us to be on this side?

MsgJp:
方針を変えるなんて話が耳に入って
来ましたけど――
MsgEn:
I heard rumors of a shift in our 
approach, but――

MsgJp:
俺たち、そもそもの方針だって
知りませんよね
MsgEn:
We don't even know what 
our approach is to begin with.

MsgJp: メイロワ将軍のことは聞いた？
MsgEn: Have you heard about General Meirova?

MsgJp:
将軍はわたしたち解放軍の指導者
ちりぢりになっていた仲間たちを集めて
解放軍に仕立てあげた張本人だね
MsgEn:
The General leads our Liberation Army, 
having gathered our scattered comrades
from all over and shaped us
into a force that fights for freedom.

MsgJp:
将軍は、あなたたちが来る前に
用があってここを出て行ったんだけど
約束の日を過ぎても戻らないんだ
MsgEn:
Before you came, the General had to 
leave for an important matter,
yet the promised day has passed,
and they still haven't come back.

MsgJp:
待っているばかりじゃ何もできやしないから
こっちから探しに行こうと思う
MsgEn:
Waiting is not going to get us anywhere,
so I think I'll go look for him ourselves.

MsgJp:
将軍は黒い竜と火竜様の戦いを
間近で目撃した数少ない生き証人
MsgEn:
The General is among the rare
surviving witnesses who saw the clash
between the Black Dragon
and Lord Fire Dragon firsthand.

MsgJp:
一緒に来て欲しい
あなたたちの役に立つ話も
何か聞けるかもしれない
MsgEn:
I would like you to come with me.
I may have some information that
could be useful to you all.

MsgJp: 将軍の、だいたいの居場所はわかっているんだ
MsgEn: I have some idea of where the General is.

MsgJp:
危険な場所だけど――
だからこそ少数精鋭で乗り込みたくてね
MsgEn:
It's a dangerous place--
that's why I wanted to get in with a select few.

MsgJp:
わたしたち、信用されてるみたいだね
うれしくなっちゃうな
MsgEn:
It seems we are being trusted,
which makes me quite happy.

MsgJp: 期待に応えなくちゃね
MsgEn: You've got to live up to the expectations.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍――
どんな人物でしょうね
MsgEn:
General Meirova――
What kind of person is he?

MsgJp:
ここの人たちはなかなか心を開いて
くれないので、少しでも親しみやすい人だと
いいのですが――
MsgEn:
The folks here are not very open,
so I hope I can come across
as someone more approachable.

MsgJp:
リズたちは喜んでるみてえだが
うまく使われてるだけじゃねえか？
MsgEn:
It seems Lise and the others are happy,
but are they just being used effectively?

MsgJp:
ま、流れに呑み込まれねえように
せいぜい気ぃつけようぜ
MsgEn:
Well, let us be cautious not to 
be swept up in the current.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍はアッカー家に長く仕える
家臣団の長老のようなお方だ
MsgEn:
General Meirova is like an elder
of the vassals who have served
the Acre family for many years.

MsgJp: わたしの、かつての上官でもある
MsgEn: He is also my former superior officer.

MsgJp:
ピレモス村から来てくれたんだろう？
助けてくれ！
MsgEn:
You came from Piremoth village, right?
Please help me!

MsgJp:
なになに！？
状況が変わった感じ？
MsgEn:
What's happening!? 
Does it seem like the situation 
has shifted?

MsgJp: いま、伝令らしき兵士が来ましたが――
MsgEn:
Right now, a soldier that appears to be 
a messenger has come――

MsgJp:
何があったんでしょうね
悪い報せじゃなければいいんですが
MsgEn:
I wonder what happened.
I hope it's not bad news.

MsgJp:
予期せぬ、厄介ごとが起こった――
そんな空気だなこりゃあ
MsgEn:
It seems an unforeseen hassle
has occurred―― it certainly looks that way.

MsgJp:
近くの村が敵に襲われているという
情報が入ったの
MsgEn:
We have received information that a nearby
village is under attack by the enemy.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍の消息が途絶えたのは
このあたりだけど――
MsgEn:
This is the area where news
of General Meirova stops cold, but――

MsgJp:
まず、村を救おう
将軍は後まわし
MsgEn:
First, let's save the village.
The General will come later.

MsgJp: オークどもが村で暴れている
MsgEn: Orcs are running amok in the village.

MsgJp:
村にいる兵で、外へと抜け出せたのは
俺だけでね――
本当に、恩に着るよ
MsgEn:
Of the soldiers in the village, I'm the 
only one who got away outside― I truly 
thank you.

MsgJp:
将軍が気になるけど仕方ないよね
隊長、ひと暴れ、行こうか
MsgEn:
I'm concerned about the General,
but it can't be helped.
Captain, let's go out and make some noise!

MsgJp:
人捜しの旅気分でいましたけど――
気持ちを入れ替えて、戦いましょう！
MsgEn:
I thought I was on a quest to find someone,
but we'll put that aside and fight!

MsgJp: 人捜しなんてかったるいぜ
MsgEn: I'm tired of looking for people.

MsgJp:
俺は戦ってる方が楽でいいね
目の前の敵のことだけ考えてりゃ
いいからな
MsgEn:
I find it easier to do battle.
I just have to focus on the enemy in front of me.

MsgJp: おお、ジリアン、来てくれたか！
MsgEn: Oh, Gillian, you're here!

MsgJp: おぬしたち見ない顔だな？
MsgEn: Some new faces?

MsgJp: 何者であろうが、加勢、感謝するぞ！
MsgEn: Whoever you are, join us, and thank you!

MsgJp: ジリアン、ほれ、後ろだ
MsgEn: Gillian, look out, behind you!

MsgJp: いいぞジリアン
MsgEn: Good one, Gillian.

MsgJp: どこにいる！？　大将を呼べ！
MsgEn:
Where is he?!
Bring out the General!

MsgJp: 誇りを捨てたオークなど虫けら以下！
MsgEn:
An orc that has abandoned its pride 
is less than even a mere insect!

MsgJp: その武器はどこであつらえた！？
MsgEn: Where did you get that weapon!?

MsgJp: もしや北の地の者たちか！？
MsgEn:
Is it possible they are from the 
northern lands?!

MsgJp: オークどもよ存分に吠えろ！　これが最期だ！
MsgEn:
Orcs, howl to your heart's content! 
This is the end!

MsgJp: 悪しき竜に仕えて何を得た！？　皆無だろう？
MsgEn:
What have you gained by serving a
wicked dragon?! Surely nothing, right?

MsgJp: ジリアン、この者達、何者だ！？
MsgEn: Gillian, who are these guys!?

MsgJp: 将軍を守って
MsgEn: Protect the General.

MsgJp: ジイ、どいて！　退避して！
MsgEn: Step aside! Evacuate now!

MsgJp: 血気盛んなのはいいけど、自重して
MsgEn:
It's all well and good to get bloodthirsty, 
but don't lose your head.

MsgJp: 将軍がいないと軍がまとまらない！
MsgEn: Without a General, the army cannot be united!

MsgJp: うるさい？　いま、うるさいって言った！？
MsgEn: Huh? Did you just tell me to shut up!?

MsgJp: 将軍、あとは任せて
MsgEn: General, I'll take care of the rest.

MsgJp: 時間をかけると敵が増える！　急いで
MsgEn:
The longer we take, 
the more enemies will come! Hurry!

MsgJp: ジイ！　言うこと聞いて！　聞け！
MsgEn: Old man! Listen to what I say! Listen!

MsgJp: もう、勝手にして！
MsgEn: Suit yourself!

MsgJp:
村人たちはもう連行されたあとだと思う
奴隷の烙印を押されて――
MsgEn:
I think the villagers have already been taken 
away after being branded as slaves--

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍には会えたが
村を救うことはできなかった――か
MsgEn:
We have General Meirova,
but we couldn't save the village in the end...

MsgJp: ケッ――知ったことかよ――なあ？
MsgEn: Hah, I know that well enough.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍は――なんというか
大変に闊達なお方のようですね
ジョゼフ様とはまた違う人柄のお年寄りだ
MsgEn:
General Meirova is―how shall I put it?
He seems to exude magnanimity.
An elder with a personality that differs
quite a bit from Master Joseph's.

MsgJp:
――お年寄りなんて言ったら
大変なことになりそうですけど
MsgEn:
―Though, calling him an elder
may lead to serious trouble, I fear.

MsgJp:
ねえ、隊長――
わたしたちも一緒にネド王子を探すでしょう？
MsgEn:
Hey, Captain ――
We'll look for Prince Nedo together, right?

MsgJp:
なんといっても、ジリアンたちの
希望だもんね！
MsgEn: After all, it's the hope of Gillian and her team!

MsgJp:
おぬしらがこのアッカーシェランで
悪しき竜の意図を探ろうというのであれば
MsgEn:
If you intend to uncover the Evil Dragon's plans
here in Acre Selund, then...

MsgJp:
解放軍は喜んで協力しよう
もちろん、見返りは期待させてもらうぞ
MsgEn:
The Liberation Army will 
gladly cooperate with you.
Of course, we'll expect something in return.

MsgJp:
腕の立つ戦士は
喉から手が出るほどほしいからな
MsgEn:
We seek the skill of brave warriors,
so much so that we cannot hide it.

MsgJp:
解放軍の希望は若干１２歳の王子――
そして王子を守るのは高齢の将軍――
MsgEn:
The hope of the Liberation Army 
lies with a Prince, just 12 years old--
And the prince's protector is an aging general--

MsgJp:
うーん、こんなことを言うと失礼だけど
先行きは、やっぱり不安だね
MsgEn:
Hmm, it might be rude to say this,
but I really feel uncertain about
what lies ahead.

MsgJp: ――なるほど
MsgEn: ――I see.

MsgJp:
そのネド王子の存在が絶望的な状況ながらも
解放軍が戦い続ける理由というわけか
MsgEn:
I wonder if Prince Nedo's existence is the reason 
why the Liberation Army continues to fight even 
in such hopeless conditions.

MsgJp:
ふむ、王家の末裔ならば
人々をまとめる旗印としては適任だ
MsgEn:
Hmm, a descendant of a royal family
would be a good banner under
which to unite the people.

MsgJp:
しかも、王子が次代の竜になるという
習わしならばなおさらのこと――
MsgEn:
Even more so if it's the custom here
that the Prince becomes the next Dragon――

MsgJp:
いや待て
ネド王子は覚者なのか？
もし違うのであれば――
MsgEn:
Wait a moment.
Is Prince Nedo an Arisen? 
If that's not the case――

MsgJp: 希望と呼ぶには――なんとも心許ないな
MsgEn:
To call it hope—
It doesn't sit well with me.

MsgJp:
→弱ダンジョン（弱素材）解放
→生産素材解放（１～４）
MsgEn:
→ Weak Dungeon (Weak Materials) unlocked 
→ Production Materials (1-4) unlocked

MsgJp:
ネド王子が覚者ではない場合のことを
あれこれ考えてみたのだが――
MsgEn:
What if Prince Nedo is not an Arisen?
I've thought about it, but—

MsgJp:
それ以前に、安否さえもわからない状況だ
無事を祈らずにはいられんな
MsgEn:
Before that, we don't even know if he's safe.
I can't help but pray for him.

MsgJp:
なにしろ、アッカーシェランの情勢の正常化が
我々の平和にも繋がるわけだ
MsgEn:
Ultimately, solving Acre Selund's predicament
is likely the key to our peace.

MsgJp:
行って、王子の捜索を優先するように
進言してみるのはどうだ？
MsgEn:
Why don't you go and suggest
searching for the Prince to be the top priority?

MsgJp:
王子の無事を祈る気持ちにうそ偽りはないが
まずは安否の情報が欲しいところだ
MsgEn:
Though my prayers for the Prince's safety 
are genuine, what is his actual status?

MsgJp:
わたしにとってはレスタニアの平穏が最優先
この先に起こることは可能な限り早めに
知っておきたいからな

ネド王子の存在がどれほどの希望を
人々にもたらすのか――
それは僕たちにはわからないけど
MsgEn:
It is unclear to us the extent of hope 
Prince Nedo's existence brings to the 
people, yet we sense its significance.

MsgJp: 一番重要なことは――
MsgEn: And the most important thing --

MsgJp:
王子は次の竜になれるのかという
ことだよね
MsgEn: Is whether the Prince can become the next Dragon

MsgJp: メイロワ将軍がさっそく張り切っているよ
MsgEn:
General Meirova is getting into 
the swing of things.

MsgJp:
あなたたちのこと、かなりあてにしているから
将軍のお相手、よろしく
MsgEn:
I have high hopes for you all,
so please take care of the General.

MsgJp: さーて、張り切って、貸しを作ろうぜ
MsgEn:
Alright, let's get fired up and
make some connections!

MsgJp:
俺の見たとろ、あの将軍は
恩義には必ず報いようとする典型だ
MsgEn:
From my observations, that General
is the type who will always repay a favor.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍、なんだかうれしそう
何があったのかな？
MsgEn:
General Meirova looks to be in a good mood;
I wonder what has happened?

MsgJp:
将軍がああいう人で良かったですよね
ジョゼフ様みたいだったら――
MsgEn:
I'm glad the General is like that.
If he was like Master Joseph—

MsgJp: おっと、これ以上はやめておこう
MsgEn: Oops, let's not go any further.

MsgJp:
解放軍には、特に指令は出ていない
今のところ、将軍は全軍を動かすつもりは
ないらしいな
MsgEn:
There are no special orders
for the Liberation Army; for now,
it seems the General does not intend
to mobilize the entire force.

MsgJp: 戻ったか！
MsgEn: You're back!

MsgJp:
わしのこの破顔を見ればわかるだろうが
ネド王子の居場所がわかったのだ
MsgEn:
Just by looking at this grin, you can tell 
I've figured out the location of Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
ほれ、わしらの初対面の村――
あの村の民達がティネス砦に移されたという
情報を掴んだ
MsgEn:
See, the village where we first met—
I've obtained information that the people
of that village have been moved to Fort Thines.

MsgJp:
民達の中には、多くの子供の姿があったらしい
王子はきっとその中に紛れ、潜んでいるはず！
MsgEn:
Among the villagers,
there were many children, it seems.
The prince must be hiding amidst them!

MsgJp:
いやー、気が急いて仕方がないわ
ほれ、ティネス砦へ行くぞ
MsgEn:
I can't help but feel anxious—
let's head to Fort Thines!

MsgJp:
目的地はティネス砦――と言ってもわからんか
地図で確認してくれ
MsgEn:
The destination is Fort Thines— 
though that may not mean much. 
Please refer to the map for clarity.

MsgJp:
あなたたちの戦闘能力をあてにして
作戦を考えてみたんだ
MsgEn:
I've based the strategy on your
combat abilities—what do you think?

MsgJp: 精鋭部隊によるティネス砦強襲作戦――
MsgEn:
An elite force will execute
a surprise assault on Fort Thines—

MsgJp:
防戦一方だったわたしたちが攻勢に転じれば
向こうも混乱するだろうからね
MsgEn:
If we turn from defense to attack, 
they will likely be thrown into disarray.

MsgJp:
ティネス砦へは各自で向かうことになるから
場所は確認しておいてね
MsgEn:
Since everyone will head to Fort Thines
on their own, make sure to check the location.

MsgJp:
ティネス砦は、オークに奪われた
砦らしいな
MsgEn: I heard that Fort Thines was taken by orcs.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍め、何も言わないが
砦の奪回も狙ってるはずだ
MsgEn:
Though General Meirova says nothing, 
he must also be aiming to reclaim the fort.

MsgJp: 王子って、１２歳なんでしょ？
MsgEn: The prince is 12 years old, right?

MsgJp:
どんな感じなのかな――
王子なんて、物語の中にしか
いないと思ってたよ
MsgEn:
I wonder what it's like--
I thought princes were only in stories.

MsgJp:
聞いた話ですけどね――
ネド王子は、素直で聡明な少年だということです
MsgEn:
Rumor has it that Prince Nedo
is an honest and intelligent young lad.

MsgJp:
素直で聡明――
本当でしょうかね
MsgEn:
Honest and intelligent—
Is it true?

MsgJp:
ティネス砦に王子がいると
決まったわけではない
MsgEn:
There's no guarantee that the Prince
is at Fort Thines.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍が、そう推測しているだけ――
ということを忘れずに
MsgEn:
Remember that General Meirova
is only speculating that--

MsgJp:
砦の前に並んでる大砲が見える？
あれで撃たれたらこちらはひとたまりもないの
MsgEn:
Do you see the cannons lined up 
before the fortress? If they fire at us, 
we won't stand a chance.

MsgJp:
あれをね、使い物にならなくしてほしいんだ
いい？　なるべく全部――
MsgEn:
Render that thing useless, okay? 
As much as you can――

MsgJp:
とにかく、こっちが砦までたどり着けるくらいの
時間を稼いでほしいの
MsgEn:
Anyway, I need you to buy us enough
time to get to the fort.

MsgJp:
そっちの様子を見て、わたしたちも
突入するから、よろしく
MsgEn:
As we assess your situation,
we'll also move in, so take care of it for us.

MsgJp:
あと、偵察隊からの話しによると
砦の中には前回同様、戦甲で身を固めた
巨大な魔物がいるみたい
MsgEn:
Also, the scouting team told me that
there is a huge demon inside the fortress
that is clad in battle armor, just like last time!

MsgJp:
上手く戦甲をみんなで破壊しないと倒せないから
遭遇したら注意してね
MsgEn:
If we don't collectively destroy
the armored enemies, we cannot win. 
So be cautious if we meet them.

MsgJp: じゃあ、はじめよう
MsgEn: Let's get started.

MsgJp:
クインタスたちと手分けして
この砦に捕らわれた同志たちを見つけ出し
解放するのがわしの役目だ
MsgEn:
My task is to collaborate with Quintus 
and the others to locate and liberate 
our comrades trapped this fortress.

MsgJp:
仲間の救出は任せてくれ
あんたはひたすらに敵を蹴散らしてくれればいい
MsgEn:
Leave it up to me to rescue my comrades.
You should just scatter your enemies.

MsgJp:
ジリジリジリジリ、気分が
盛りあがってきたじゃねえか――なあ？
MsgEn:
The tension is building up, isn't it?
I can feel it rising――what do you think?

MsgJp: ネド王子、待っていて！
MsgEn: Wait for me, Prince Nedo!

MsgJp: さあ、心おきなく暴れてやりましょう！
MsgEn: Now, let's go on a rampage without worrying!

MsgJp:
ここ、ティネス砦はな――
オークどもとの幾度とない激戦に耐え抜いた要衝だ
MsgEn:
This place, Fort Thines, has withstood 
many fierce battles against the orcs.

MsgJp: もう二度と手放してなるものか
MsgEn: I'll never give it up again.

MsgJp:
落胆？
そんなことはないぞ
MsgEn:
Discouraged?
Not at all.

MsgJp:
王子への道は途絶えていないし
こうして砦を取り戻したんだからな
MsgEn:
The road to the Prince hasn't been severed,
and we've reclaimed the fort.

MsgJp:
王子はいなかったが、行方に関する情報が
入ったのは久しぶりだ
MsgEn:
Though the prince wasn't found,
it's been a while since we heard anything
about his whereabouts.

MsgJp:
砦も取り戻すことができたし――
ああ、追い風を感じるな
MsgEn:
We managed to regain the fort―― 
Ah, I feel a surge of momentum.

MsgJp:
"契りの歌"は――
竜がもたらす有形無形の恵に感謝し
王家と竜の契りが未来永劫続くことを祈る歌なの
MsgEn:
The "Song of Covenant" is―― 
a hymn of gratitude for the gifts,
both seen and unseen, that dragons bestow,
praying for the royal family's bond with dragons 
to last forevermore.

MsgJp:
くたびれ損ってやつだな
まあ、一回、二回は覚悟の上よ
MsgEn:
What a pointless endeavor. 
Still, I'm prepared for it once
or twice, no matter what.

MsgJp:
俺はちょっと砦見て回ってから
休ませてもらうわ
MsgEn:
I'm gonna take a little look around the fort
and then I'll take a break.

MsgJp:
竜に感謝する歌なんて、素敵だなあ
レスタニアにもあればいいのに
MsgEn:
Songs to thank dragons are wonderful.
I wish Lestania had them too.

MsgJp: わたし、毎日歌っちゃうと思う
MsgEn: I think I'd sing it every day.

MsgJp: ふう――
MsgEn: Phew――

MsgJp:
ここは身体を休めて次に備えましょう
王子と会うときは笑顔でいたいですからね
MsgEn:
Let's take a moment to rest our bodies
and prepare for what lies ahead.
I want to greet the prince with a smile
when we eventually meet.

MsgJp: ネド王子はどうだった？
MsgEn: How was Prince Nedo?

MsgJp:
そうか――まだ会えていないんだね
でも、望みは繋がっているんだろう？
MsgEn:
I see—so you still haven't met,
have you? But the hope remains,
doesn't it?

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランの人たちがそう信じているなら
大丈夫なんだろうね
MsgEn:
If the people of Acre Selund believe that,
then it should be fine, right?

MsgJp: そうか――
MsgEn: I see...

MsgJp:
砦を奪回しただけではなくネド王子の手がかりまで
手に入れるとは上出来
MsgEn:
Reclaiming the fortress is one thing, 
but also a lead on Prince Nedo to boot.

MsgJp:
しかも、メイロワ将軍は、おまえたちのおかげで
運が巡ってきたと考えているのだな？
MsgEn:
Furthermore, General Meirova thinks
that luck has turned in his favor thanks to you.

MsgJp:
いいぞ
良い関係を築けそうではないか
MsgEn:
That's great! 
It looks like we can foster a good bond.

MsgJp: →時間経過スポット①（弱研磨剤？）解放
MsgEn: → Time Passage Spot ① (Weak Abrasive?) Unlocked

MsgJp:
歳を取ると、良いことばかりを
思い続けることが難しくなるのだ
MsgEn:
As you grow older, it becomes difficult 
to focus solely on the positives.

MsgJp:
特に、良い流れに乗っているように
見える時ほどな
MsgEn:
Especially when it seems like one is
riding a good wave, that's when it
happens.

MsgJp:
もし、ネド王子が行方不明のままだったら――
もし覚者ではなかったら――
そして、悪しき竜の目的――
MsgEn:
If Prince Nedo remains missing――
if he is not the Arisen――
and the purpose of the Evil Dragon――

MsgJp:
これらが最悪の形で結びついてしまう――
そんなことを考えてしまうのだ
MsgEn:
These might link in the worst manner―― 
it's something I find myself considering.

MsgJp:
さあ、行け
ここにいると、わたしの不安がうつるぞ
MsgEn:
Now, go.
You're going to catch my anxiety if you stay here.

MsgJp:
ネド王子は盗賊と行動をともにしているという
話だったな
MsgEn:
There were stories that Prince Nedo is 
moving with a band of thieves, right?

MsgJp:
子供の頃に読んだ冒険譚のような状況だが
盗賊といっても色々いるからな――
MsgEn:
It's a situation like an adventure tale I
read as a child, but there are many kinds
of thieves, after all――

MsgJp:
ネド王子のことはもちろん気になるけど
砦を奪われた敵の反撃もあるだろうね
MsgEn:
While I'm worried about Prince Nedo, 
there's bound to be a counterattack by 
the foes we seized the fort from.

MsgJp: そのことは忘れないようにね
MsgEn: Don't forget that.

MsgJp:
将軍がソワソワしてるぜ
かわいい王子との再会が近いってな
MsgEn:
The General is getting all weepy,
saying that a reunion with 
his adorable Prince is approaching.

MsgJp:
さっさと会わせてやらねえと、あの爺さん
倒れちまうぞ
MsgEn:
If we don't get them together soon, 
that old man will collapse.

MsgJp:
ネド王子と一緒にいる盗賊って
わたしが想像する盗賊と違うみたい
ゴブリンを思い浮かべちゃった
MsgEn:
The thieves with Prince Nedo
were different from the ones I imagined.
I pictured something akin to goblins.

MsgJp:
ジリアンとメイロワ将軍が言い争っていましたけど
大丈夫でしょうか
MsgEn:
Gillian and General Meirova were 
quarreling. I hope they're all right.

MsgJp:
今回はジリアンが正しい
わたしはそう思うね
MsgEn:
Gillian is right this time.
I agree.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍が前に出ると
まとまる話もまとまらないよ
MsgEn:
When General Meirova takes the lead, 
even discussions that should be 
settled become disordered.

MsgJp:
おぬしたち、早速西へ向かおうではないか
実はな、ジリアンがすでに出発してしまったのだ
MsgEn:
You guys, let's head west as soon as possible.
In fact, Gillian has already left.

MsgJp:
国の治安を守るわしと盗賊どもの因縁を思うと
わしではなくジリアンが前に出て交渉した方がいい
――そういう意見が多くてな
MsgEn:
Reflecting on the connection between me,
the protector of the realm, and those thieves,
many believe it would be better for Gillian
to step forward and negotiate instead of me.

MsgJp:
おぬしたちを交えて検討しようと話し合って
いたのだが――ジリアンめ！
MsgEn:
We were having discussions to include 
you in our deliberations, but—Gillian!

MsgJp:
ともあれ、盗賊の地へ行くには、まず、敵の支配下の
西門を超えて西方へ行く必要がある
MsgEn:
That aside, to enter the thieves' territory,
we must first overcome the western gate
under enemy control and proceed west.

MsgJp:
西門を抜けた先に、城壁の村、ロスギルがある
わしの盟友がおる土地だ
きっと力になってくれるだろう
MsgEn:
Past the western gate, there is the 
walled village of Rothgill,
a place where my ally dwells.
They will surely be of help to us.

MsgJp: 西門周辺はオークの領土となってしまっておる
MsgEn:
The area around the West Gate
has become orc territory.

MsgJp:
そう簡単には通り抜けられないだろうから
準備の方、よろしく頼むぞ
MsgEn:
It won't be easy to pass through,
so I ask that you prepare well.

MsgJp: 王子に会うのはそう簡単じゃねえってことらしいな
MsgEn: It seems like it's not that easy to meet a Prince.

MsgJp:
ジリアン、大丈夫かなあ
結構危なっかしいよね
MsgEn:
I wonder if Gillian is okay;
things seem quite dangerous.

MsgJp: さあ隊長、俺たちも早めに行きましょう
MsgEn:
Come on, Captain. 
Let's go as soon as possible.

MsgJp:
わたしは砦に残るが――
将軍たちをよろしく頼むぞ
MsgEn:
I'll stay at the fort--
and take care of the General.

MsgJp:
道中に攻め落とした西門は
応援の解放軍が完全に制圧した
MsgEn:
The Western Gate we seized on the way
has been completely secured by the
Liberation Army reinforcements.

MsgJp:
おぬしたちは魔物の巣窟とやらへ行って
魔物退治を頼む
MsgEn:
You lot will venture into the lair
of the monsters and deal with
slaying them for me.

MsgJp:
一歩一歩、悪しき竜の勢力を
取り除こうではないか！
MsgEn:
Step by step, let us eliminate the
forces of the Evil Dragon!

MsgJp: それにしてもイェルハルドめ――
MsgEn: Even so, Gerhard ――

MsgJp:
昔はわしの部下だったが、その頃から
面倒くさい奴だったわ
MsgEn:
He used to be my subordinate back in the day, 
but even then he was a pain in the ass.

MsgJp: 魔物退治は得意中の得意
MsgEn: Slaying monsters is one of my specialties.

MsgJp:
俺たちにとっちゃあ悪くねえ話だぜ？
さっさと片付けようぜ
MsgEn:
It's not a bad deal for us, right?
Let's get it done.

MsgJp:
魔物の巣窟って！？
はー、もしかして、あっちの水辺あたりから漂う
嫌な気配のこと？
MsgEn:
A monster's den!?
Is it that unsettling presence
drifting from the water's edge over there?

MsgJp:
イェルハルドはメイロワ将軍の部下から
転身して、ここの領主に収まったのだとか
MsgEn:
It seems that Gerhard went from being a 
subordinate of General Meirova, 
to the lord of this place.

MsgJp:
将軍の言い分もわかりますけど
領主なら、あれくらい慎重な方がいいかも
しれませんね
MsgEn:
I understand the general's point,
but for a lord, being that cautious
might be for the best, don't you think?

MsgJp:
ごくろうだったな
イェルハルドとの交渉はわしにまかせてくれ
MsgEn:
Good job. 
I'll handle the talks 
with Gerhard myself.

MsgJp: ふう――
MsgEn: Phew――

MsgJp:
俺は休んでるから、あとは適当に
話つけてくれ
MsgEn:
I'm taking a break, so just
wrap up the talk as
you see fit.

MsgJp: 王子の居場所って、ハッキリわかるのかな？
MsgEn: Do you have a clear idea of where the Prince is?

MsgJp:
なんとなく、メイロワ将軍の思い込みに
みんなで引きずられている気がしない？
MsgEn:
Doesn't it feel like we're all
being dragged along by 
General Meirova's assumptions?

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍は人をその気にさせるのが
上手ですけど、イェルハルドには
効かないみたいですね
MsgEn:
General Meirova is skilled at
motivating people, but it seems
it doesn't work on Gerhard.

MsgJp:
ようこそメイロワ将軍と
レスタニアから来た覚者のみなさん
MsgEn:
Welcome, General Meirova
and all the Arisen who 
have come from Lestania.

MsgJp:
色々と聞きたいこともあるでしょうが
まずはわたしから最新の情報です
MsgEn:
There are probably a lot of things you want to 
hear, but I'll start with the latest information.

MsgJp:
――王都メガドに続き、竜の神殿である
メガド離宮もついに堕ちたとのこと
MsgEn:
――Following the Royal Capital, Megado,
it is said that the Dragon's Temple,
the Megado Detached Palace, has finally fallen.

MsgJp:
執拗な包囲戦に長く耐えていましたが
敵方に強力な援軍が加わり
守備隊はあっという間に総崩れ――
MsgEn:
After enduring a relentless siege for so long, 
the defenders were quickly overwhelmed 
as powerful reinforcements joined the enemy.

MsgJp: これまで以上に厳しい状況になったようです
MsgEn:
It seems that the situation has become 
more difficult than ever.

MsgJp:
さて、将軍――みなさん――
わたしから言えることはただひとつ
MsgEn:
Well, General ―― everyone ――
I can only say one thing.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランの未来――ネド王子との再会を
本気で願っているのであれば
まず、メイロワ将軍が盗賊たちに頭を下げて
過去の仕打ちを詫びることですね
MsgEn:
The future of Acre Selund ――
If you really hope for a reunion with 
Prince Nedo, the first thing to do is for 
General Meirova to bow before the bandits
and apologize for their past treatment.

MsgJp:
もちろん、将軍にしてみれば盗賊の処罰は
職務を忠実に遂行しただけのことでしょう
しかし、盗賊たちがそれで納得すると思いますか？
MsgEn:
Of course, for the general, punishing thieves
is simply a matter of faithfully carrying out
his duties. But do you think the bandits will
be satisfied with that?

MsgJp:
彼らの協力が不可欠だというのなら
メイロワ将軍――まずは真摯に頭を下げるのです
MsgEn:
If their cooperation is essential, then
General Meirova— first, you must sincerely
bow your head.

MsgJp:
王子と一緒にいる盗賊の名はベルタ
そうです、あのベルタです
ほら、将軍、そんな顔はいけません
MsgEn:
The bandit who is with the Prince
is called Bertha. That's right,
that very same Bertha. 
Now, General, don't make such a face.

MsgJp:
ふたりの確執はもちろん知っています
だからこそ頭を下げることには価値があるとは
思いませんか？
MsgEn:
I'm well aware of the feud between you two. 
And that's why bowing your head is worth it, 
don't you think?

MsgJp:
王都メガドの牢獄に囚われていたはずのベルタは
敵襲の混乱の中、脱獄してしまったとのこと
MsgEn:
Bertha was supposed to be imprisoned
in the dungeons of Megado, but she escaped
during the confusion of the attack.

MsgJp:
その後の行方は知れないが、神殿で目撃された
老婆がベルタだと考えることは理にかなっています
MsgEn:
Though her whereabouts remain unknown,
it makes sense to think that the old woman
spotted at the temple is Bertha herself.

MsgJp: ふーむ
MsgEn: Hmmm

MsgJp: 王子と一緒にいるのはあの老盗賊ベルタか
MsgEn: That old rogue Bertha with the Prince, huh?

MsgJp:
あの婆さんに頭を下げろだと？
うーむ――
MsgEn:
You want me to bow to that crone? 
Hmph...

MsgJp:
盗賊のアジトはここよりさらに西方というだけで
具体的な場所はわかっておらん
MsgEn:
It's just that the bandits' hideout 
is further west than here.
I don't know the specific location.

MsgJp:
いずれにしても、場所の調査には時間がかかるだろう
わしはそれまでに心を決めねばな
MsgEn:
In any case, it will take some time 
to investigate the location.
I'll have to make up my mind by then.

MsgJp:
盗賊たちは一族郎党が集まって住んでいるらしい
いったん揉めたら大ごとだ
一度レスタニアに戻っておくか？
MsgEn:
The bandits appear to live with their family. 
If trouble starts, it'll be serious. 
Should we return to Lestania for now?

MsgJp:
ねえ隊長――
敵に新たな援軍があったってイェルハルドは
言ってたよね？
MsgEn:
Hey Captain――
Gerhard said that the enemy
had new reinforcements, right?

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍とベルタとかいう盗賊のあいだに
どんな因縁があるのか――
MsgEn:
What kind of ties are there between 
General Meirova and the thief Bertha?

MsgJp:
全然わかりませんけど、とりあえず将軍が
頭を下げないと物事が動かないようですね
MsgEn:
I have no idea, but it seems that unless
the General bows, nothing will move forward.

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様はネド王子への贈り物を
考えているようだけど――
MsgEn:
Master Joseph seems to be thinking of
a gift for Prince Nedo――

MsgJp:
完全に無事が確認されてから――
あるいは生きていることを確認してからじゃないと
ネド王子に関してうかつなことは言えないね
MsgEn:
I can't say anything careless about Prince Nedo 
until we're completely sure he's okay--
or even alive.

MsgJp:
そうか――ネド王子はまだおらんか
しかし、そのイェルハルドなる者の情報は
信ぴょう性が高そうだな
MsgEn:
I see... Prince Nedo is still absent.
However, the information from that
Gerhard seems quite credible.

MsgJp:
そして気になるのは、メガド離宮が
援軍の登場で堕ちてしまったということ――
MsgEn:
And what's worrisome is that the 
Megado Detached Palace has fallen
with the arrival of reinforcements--

MsgJp:
レスタニアで言えば、この神殿が
敵の手に落ちたのと同じ
MsgEn:
In the context of Lestania,
it's like the Temple falling into enemy hands.

MsgJp: アッカーシェランの嘆きが聞こえるようだぞ
MsgEn: You can almost hear Acre Selund lamenting.

MsgJp:
さて――
ネド王子はベルタという老盗賊と
行動をともにしており――
MsgEn:
Well then―― 
Prince Nedo is traveling with the 
old thief named Bertha――

MsgJp:
目下、かの地では、盗賊のアジト探しが
行われているのであろう
MsgEn:
As of now, they must be searching 
for the bandits' hideout in that area.

MsgJp:
ネド王子と早く会えると良いな
友好的な関係を築ける相手であることを祈ろう
MsgEn:
I hope you and Prince Nedo meet soon.
Let's hope it's someone with whom you can build 
an amicable relationship.

MsgJp: ここだけの話――
MsgEn: Just between you and me...

MsgJp:
よその大陸の王子は凡庸であるほど
ありがたい
そうは思わんか
MsgEn:
The more ordinary the Prince
of another continent is, the more
reverence and appreciation he gets.
Don't you think so?

MsgJp: フィンダムの時もそうだったけど――
MsgEn: It was the same with Phindym's――

MsgJp:
よその大陸と交わると、ジョゼフ様はすぐに
どっちが上か――なんてことを考える
時々、いやになるんだ
MsgEn:
Whenever we cross with another continent, 
Master Joseph is quick to wonder 
which is the better continent.
That's what I don't like sometimes.

MsgJp:
将軍はもういねえぞ？
誰かと話して状況の確認といこうぜ
MsgEn:
The General's gone, okay?
Let's go talk to someone 
and see what's going on.

MsgJp:
交渉の主役はジリアンですよね？
今頃は敵陣にいて、熱弁を振るって
いるのかもしれませんよ
MsgEn:
Gillian is the star of the negotiations, right?
She's probably behind enemy lines by now, 
making impassioned speeches.

MsgJp:
あー、心配――
何もかもが心配！
MsgEn:
Oh, I'm worried--
Worried about everything!

MsgJp: わたしたちも早く動こうよ！
MsgEn: Let's move fast too!

MsgJp:
あんたが来たら状況を報告するようにと
将軍から仰せつかっている
MsgEn:
The General has asked me to inform you 
of the situation when you arrive.

MsgJp:
我々は盗賊のアジトに関する情報を集めるために
奔走した
MsgEn:
We worked hard to gather information 
about the bandit hideout.

MsgJp:
その結果、盗賊のアジトは、西の湖の畔にある
洞窟の一画にあることが分かった
MsgEn:
As a result, the bandits' hideout
was found to be in one of the caves
on the shores of the western lake.

MsgJp:
すでに洞窟に向かっているメイロワ将軍と合流して
一緒に事に当たってくれ
MsgEn:
Join up with General Meirova, 
who is already on his way to the cave, 
and work together on this.

MsgJp: ベルタのことは聞いているか？
MsgEn: Have you heard about Bertha?

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍とは同世代の古強者で――
狙いはいつも王家の財宝だった
MsgEn:
She and General Meirova have history
as old, powerful contemporaries.
She was always after the royal treasures.

MsgJp:
奪い、取り戻し、将軍とは因縁の仲
王家の財宝だの盗賊だの、今の状況を考えれば
古き良き時代の物語だがな
MsgEn:
The taking, the getting it back,
the General and the Foe, the royal treasure, 
the banditry, it's a tale of the good old days, 
considering the current state of affairs.

MsgJp:
行かねえのか？
西にある湖の湖畔だとよ
MsgEn:
Aren't you going?
They say it's on the shores of a lake to the west.

MsgJp:
急ぎましょう
将軍と盗賊ベルタの話を聞けば聞くほど
問題発生の予感しかしませんよ
MsgEn:
Let's hurry up.
The more I listen to the story of the General
and Bertha the Bandit, the more I have a hunch
that a problem will occur.

MsgJp:
王子は盗賊たちの人質にされたという
考えもあるみたいだよ
MsgEn:
Some people think the Prince
is held hostage by the bandits.

MsgJp: ネド王子はダクレイム砦か――
MsgEn: Prince Nedo is at Dacreim Fortress――

MsgJp:
ダクレイムもまたオークに奪われた砦よ
そんなところへ王子がなぜ――
MsgEn:
Dacreim is another fort lost to the orcs.
So why would a Prince come to such a place--

MsgJp:
盗賊との因縁が深い将軍よりも
わたしの方が、相手も交渉しやすい――
そう思っていたのに――ああ、やっちゃった
MsgEn:
I thought I would be easier for them
