to negotiate with than the General, 
who has a long history with bandits.
I thought that was the case, but—ah, 
I've gone and done it!

MsgJp:
盗賊は生業だって開き直られたら
腹が立っちゃってね
MsgEn:
When a thief claims it's their livelihood,
it really makes me angry, you know?

MsgJp:
予想はしていたが、解放軍と盗賊団は
友好的な雰囲気とはいえねえ
MsgEn:
As expected, the Liberation Army and the bandits
don't exactly have a friendly atmosphere.

MsgJp:
出来ることなら、さっさとここから
立ち去りてえがな
MsgEn: If I could, I'd get the hell out of here.

MsgJp:
少々揉めましたけど
王子の居場所がはっきりしたのは
大きな収穫ですね
MsgEn:
It's been a bit of a struggle, 
but it's a huge victory for us
to know exactly where the Prince is.

MsgJp: ネド王子は何を考えているのかな――
MsgEn: I wonder what Prince Nedo is thinking--

MsgJp:
盗賊に連れ去られたというわけじゃあ
ないみたいだし
MsgEn: It seems he didn't get abducted by the bandits.

MsgJp: おまえたちが噂の異国の覚者たちか――
MsgEn:
You are the exotic Arisen 
we've heard so much about...

MsgJp:
王都メガドにある、メガド離宮が堕ちたのは
知っているだろう？
MsgEn:
You know that the Megado Detached Palace
in Megado, the Royal Capital, has fallen, right?

MsgJp:
メガド離宮の牢に捕えられていたお頭は
陥落寸前に神殿守護兵から王子を連れて
逃げるよう託されたんだ
MsgEn:
The Boss was held captive in the prison
of Megado's Detached Palace, 
and just before it fell, the temple guard 
entrusted her with escaping with the Prince.

MsgJp:
敵で埋め尽くされた辺境を切り抜け
この近くまで来たのだが、あと少しというところで
オークどもに見つかってしまった
MsgEn:
They cut through the enemy-infested frontier
to get this close, but just as they were about to leave...
Orcs found them.

MsgJp:
その時、お頭は王子を逃がして
自分は捕まっちまった
MsgEn:
At that time, the Boss let the Prince
escape while she herself was caught.

MsgJp:
俺たちはオークからもかっぱらっていたからな
奴らの法に従えば、処刑は確実だ
MsgEn:
We've been ripping off the orcs too.
If we follow their laws, execution is a certainty.

MsgJp:
俺たちはなんとしてもお頭を助けたい
おまえたちの力を貸してくれ
MsgEn:
We want to save the Boss any way we can. 
We need your help.

MsgJp:
ここからも腕の立つ連中が行っているが
相手はオークだからな
MsgEn:
There are some very skilled people here too, 
but they're up against orcs.

MsgJp:
俺たち盗賊には荷が重い
どうか、力を貸してくれ
MsgEn:
We bandits can't handle it. 
Please, we need your help.

MsgJp: これは難儀なことだ――
MsgEn: This is a conundrum--

MsgJp:
ダクレイム砦攻略は大変だぞ――
じっくり作戦を練らねば――
MsgEn:
We're going to have a tough time
capturing Dacreim Fortress.
We'll have to plan carefully...

MsgJp: おぬしら、一度国に帰ってはどうだ
MsgEn: Why don't you go back home for a time?

MsgJp: ダクレイムは難攻不落と名高い要衝
MsgEn:
Dacreim is long renowned
as an impregnable stronghold.

MsgJp:
潜入はそう簡単ではない
ここは思案のしどころだ
今少し、考える時間をもらおう
MsgEn:
Infiltration is not so simple.
This is a moment for deliberation.
Let us take a bit of time to think.

MsgJp:
いまだにネド王子と会えずにいるのは
巡り合わせが悪いとしか言いようがない
MsgEn:
Not having met Prince Nedo yet 
can only be described as bad luck.

MsgJp:
でも、これが運命とあきらめるわけにはいかない
王子が、最後の希望なんだから
もう、それしかないんだ
MsgEn:
However, I cannot simply give up
and accept this as fate,
for the Prince is our last hope.
There is nothing else.

MsgJp: 俺たちにとっちゃお頭の命が最優先
MsgEn: For us, the life of the Boss is our top priority.

MsgJp:
もちろんネド王子のことも忘れちゃいない
何かあったら、寝覚めが悪いからな
MsgEn:
Of course, I haven't forgotten about Prince Nedo. 
If anything happens to him, 
I won't be able to sleep at night.

MsgJp: 盗賊と手を組むことになるとはな
MsgEn: I never thought I'd join forces with bandits.

MsgJp:
ったく、何が起こるかわかんねえな
まあ、そこが人生の面白いところだけどよ
MsgEn:
You never know what's going to happen. 
Well, that's the interesting thing about life.

MsgJp:
王子の安否は気になりますけど
どうやらすぐには動きはないようです
MsgEn:
I am concerned about the Prince's safety,
but it seems there won't be any movement
for a while.

MsgJp: ここらでレスタニアに戻りましょう
MsgEn: Let's go back to Lestania at this point.

MsgJp:
なかなかお会いできないなあ
さすが王子だね
MsgEn:
It seems we cannot meet easily,
as expected of a Prince.

MsgJp: やあ、おかえり
MsgEn: Hey, welcome back.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランの方は小休止かい？
ゆっくり休むといいよ
MsgEn:
Is there a break at Acre Selund? 
Make sure to take your time to rest.

MsgJp: ついにネド王子の居場所がわかったのだな！
MsgEn: At last you know where Prince Nedo is!

MsgJp: しかし、敵の支配下の砦にいるとは――
MsgEn: But to be in a fortress under enemy control--

MsgJp:
事はそう簡単ではないだろうから
くれぐれも慎重にな
MsgEn:
It's not going to be easy.
So, be very careful.

MsgJp: →準最ダンジョン（準最素材）解放
MsgEn: → Semi-Final Dungeon (Semi-Final Materials) Unlocked

MsgJp:
順当に行けばアッカーシェランでは
ネド王子のベルタ救出作戦が始まることだろう
MsgEn:
If all goes as planned, in Acre Selund, 
the mission to save Prince Nedo
and Bertha is set to begin.

MsgJp:
存分に力を発揮して
白竜の覚者の力を見せつけてこい
味方で良かったと思わせるのだ
MsgEn:
Show them the power
of The White Dragons' Arisen to the fullest,
and make them glad they are on our side.

MsgJp: ネド王子はまだまだ子供だが――
MsgEn: Prince Nedo is still just a boy, but--

MsgJp:
話を聞く限り、義理堅く
人情にも篤い人物のようだ
MsgEn:
From what I've heard, he seems to be a man
of sound principle and of compassion.

MsgJp:
わかるな？
なんとかして、貸しを作ってくるのだ
MsgEn:
You understand? 
Find a way to create a debt of gratitude.

MsgJp:
いかにしてアッカーシェランの王家に
恩を売るか――
MsgEn:
How to earn the favor of Acre Selund's
Royal Family――

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様は近頃そんなことばかり
考えているみたいなんだ
MsgEn:
Master Joseph seems to be thinking about 
that a lot these days.

MsgJp:
わたしの子供じみた振る舞いは忘れて欲しい
将軍にもたっぷり説教されたからね
MsgEn:
Forget my childish behavior,
the General already gave me 
quite a scolding for it.

MsgJp:
さて、ネド王子の行き先はダクレイム砦
でも、その前に、ロスギル村へ行ってほしいんだ
MsgEn:
Now, the destination for Prince Nedo
is Fort Dacreim. But first, 
I want you to go to the village of Rothgill.

MsgJp:
ダクレイム突入準備のために、イェルハルドを訪ねた
メイロワ将軍からの連絡が来ない
MsgEn:
I visited Gerhard to prepare for the Dacreim raid.
No word from General Meirova.

MsgJp:
行って、状況を確認して、必要であれば
将軍の力になってほしい
MsgEn:
Go, see what's going on, 
and if necessary, help the General.

MsgJp: わたしはここで連絡を待つよ
MsgEn: I'll wait to hear from you here.

MsgJp: ネド王子は――そうだね
MsgEn: Prince Nedo ―― yes.

MsgJp:
年の割にはしっかりした子供だ
物事の道理をわきまえ、おごることなく
民たちにも平等に接してくれる――
MsgEn:
He's a strong kid for his age,
has a good mind for reason, doesn't get cocky, 
treats his people as equals...

MsgJp:
頼りないという声もあるけど
そこはわたしたちが補えばいい
MsgEn:
Some say he's unreliable, 
but we can make up for that.

MsgJp:
王子は幼い頃、わしのことをメロジイ、メロジイと
慕ってくださってな――
ほどなく会えるのかと思うとわしはもう――
MsgEn:
In his childhood, the Prince used to call me 
Uncle Meimei, Uncle Meimei, with such fondness―― 
Just the thought of seeing him soon 
fills me with emotion――

MsgJp: さあ、頼むぞ、白竜の覚者たちよ
MsgEn: Now, please, Arisen of the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
どうやら、この大陸じゃあ、盗賊どもも
けっこう大きな勢力らしいな
MsgEn:
Apparently, bandits are quite a force
to be reckoned with on this continent.

MsgJp:
となれば、両方に恩を売っておくのは
悪くねえぞ
MsgEn:
If so, it's not a bad idea
to do them both a favor.

MsgJp:
ここの連中、少々気風が荒いようだけど
悪人ではなさそうですよね
MsgEn:
These people here, they're a little feisty,
but they don't seem to be bad people.

MsgJp:
職業には目をつぶる必要がありますけど
戦力として期待してもいいんじゃないですかね
MsgEn:
We might need to turn a blind eye
to their chosen profession,
but I think they can be relied upon 
as a strong ally in battle, don't you agree?

MsgJp:
こんなことを気にしているのは
わたしだけかもしれないけど――
MsgEn:
I know I'm probably the only one who 
cares about this stuff--

MsgJp: ネド王子、結構美形なんだって！
MsgEn: Prince Nedo, I hear, is quite handsome!

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランは遠からず
悪しき竜に踏みにじられて滅んでしまう
この運命はもう変えられないのだろう
MsgEn:
Acre Selund will soon be trampled
by the Evil Dragon and fall to ruin.
I doubt this fate can be changed now.

MsgJp:
だから最後の日々くらいは善人になろうとして
お頭は、王子を助けたんだろうよ
その王子が今度はお頭を助けようと
しているってわけだ
MsgEn:
So for the final days at least, 
she was trying to be a virtuous person.
The Boss must have saved the Prince.
Now, he is trying to help the Boss in return.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍はネド王子が希望だというが――
俺たちに必要なのは希望じゃなくて
奇跡じゃねえのか？
MsgEn:
General Meirova says Prince Nedo is our hope―― 
but isn't what we need not hope, but a miracle?

MsgJp: メイロワ将軍の様子？
MsgEn: How is General Meirova doing?

MsgJp:
ああ、ジリアンが心配したわけですね
将軍ならほら、そこに
MsgEn:
Oh, so Gillian was worried. 
If you want the General, he's over there.

MsgJp:
おお、来てくれたのか
思いのほか時間をくってしまったが
突撃の手はずは整ったぞ
MsgEn:
Well, you're here. 
We took longer than expected, 
but we're ready to launch the assault.

MsgJp:
ダクレイム砦の前には、敵が増築した
柵があってな――その柵を解放する下準備に
少々手間取ったというわけだ
もう、問題はない
MsgEn:
Before the Dacreim Fortress,
there is a fence that the enemy has reinforced.
The preparations to dismantle that fence
took some time, but there are no more issues.

MsgJp:
突撃を妨げる柵のことはもう気にしなくてもいい
王子のことだけ考えよう
MsgEn:
We don't have to worry about the fence
blocking the assault anymore, 
we just have to mind the Prince.

MsgJp:
まもなく伝令に走るはずだったんだ
来てくれて助かったよ
MsgEn:
I was going to make a run to the messenger soon.
Thank goodness you're here.

MsgJp:
ダクレイム砦は久しぶりだ
もう二度と行くことはないと思っていたが――
先のことなどわからないものだな
MsgEn:
It's been a long time
since I've been to Dacreim Fortress,
and I thought I'd never go back-
you never know what the future holds.

MsgJp: ひとつ忠告をさせて下さい
MsgEn: Let me give you one piece of advice.

MsgJp:
このダクレイムを奪い、支配しているのは
獣の将と呼ばれるオークです
これまでのオークとはまるで違う化け物です
MsgEn:
The one who has seized and now rules
Dacreim is the orc known as the Beast Commander. 
This is a monster unlike any orc
we have encountered before.

MsgJp:
ですが、砦の中ではすでに
ネド王子と盗賊たちが動いているとのことです
MsgEn:
But inside the fortress, it seems that 
Prince Nedo and the bandits are already 
taking action.

MsgJp:
今や一刻を争います
ジリアンとイェルハルド様には伝令を
走らせました――
MsgEn:
Now, in a race for time, 
I've sent word to Gillian and Master Gerhard to--

MsgJp:
みなさんはどうか急ぎ砦の中へ
王子をよろしくお願いします！
MsgEn:
Everyone, storm the fortress
and find the Prince!

MsgJp:
ジリアンは一緒じゃないのか？
解放軍本隊は！？
MsgEn:
Gillian is not with you?
What has happened to the main force
of the Liberation Army!?

MsgJp:
わたしは早々に負傷してしまいました
無念です――王子をよろしくお願いします――
MsgEn:
I was injured early on. I'm sorry――
Please take care of the Prince――

MsgJp: 忠義面下げて死にに来たか
MsgEn:
Have you come to throw away your life 
in the name of loyalty?

MsgJp: いいだろう――王子と一緒に死ね
MsgEn:
Fine --
Die along with your Prince.

MsgJp: もろとも魔物に喰われてしまえ
MsgEn:
May you be devoured by the monsters
alongside your companions!

MsgJp: 我がしもべたちよ！　焦るな！　じっくりとなぶれ！
MsgEn:
My faithful servants! Do not be hasty! 
Savor the moment and torment them!

MsgJp: なかなかやるな――人間にしてはな
MsgEn: That's pretty good--for a human.

MsgJp: 我がしもべたちよ！　こやつらを引き裂いてしまえ！
MsgEn: My loyal servants! Tear these wretches apart!

MsgJp: ふん――面白い！
MsgEn: Hmph― interesting!

MsgJp: わははは！　愉快愉快！
MsgEn: Hahaha! How delightful, delightful!

MsgJp: 人間め！　戦士というなら最期の戦いを楽しめ！
MsgEn:
Human!
If you are a true warrior, enjoy your last fight!

MsgJp: なんと――劣勢？
MsgEn: What ―― a disadvantage?

MsgJp: まだまだ！
MsgEn: Not yet!

MsgJp: くそう――力が入らぬ！　血肉をすすらせろ！
MsgEn:
Damn - no power!　
Let it rain flesh and blood!

MsgJp: みんな気をつけて！
MsgEn: Everyone, be careful!

MsgJp: 王子、安全な場所に隠れて！
MsgEn: Prince, hide in a safe place!

MsgJp: ベルタ、聞こえるか！　身を潜めて！
MsgEn:
Bertha, can you hear me?
Hide yourself!

MsgJp: 隊長、こいつは強いよ
MsgEn: Captain, this guy's strong.

MsgJp: オーク四将軍、獣の将！
MsgEn:
The Beast Commander,
one of the Four Orc Generals!!

MsgJp: いける！　いけるよ！
MsgEn:
We can do this!
We can do it!

MsgJp: へへ、いかにも大将だな
MsgEn: Heh, a general indeed.

MsgJp: ほーら、予想どおり手強いぜ
MsgEn: See, as expected, they are tough.

MsgJp: どんなに強くても俺にとっちゃ、オークはオークよ
MsgEn: No matter how strong it is, an orc is an orc.

MsgJp: 攻めろ攻めろ
MsgEn: Attack! Attack!

MsgJp: くそ、強ええな
MsgEn: Damn, that's strong.

MsgJp: おらおら！
MsgEn: Here I am!

MsgJp: 凄い臭い！　さすがオークの大将！
MsgEn:
What an awful stench!
As expected of the orcs' commander!

MsgJp: 隊長、見た？　王子、想像より子供！
MsgEn:
Captain, did you see that? 
The Prince is even younger than I thought!

MsgJp: 盗賊のお婆さんはどこ？
MsgEn: Where is the old bandit?

MsgJp: ジリアン、王子は無事なの？
MsgEn: Gillian, is the Prince all right?

MsgJp: もう！　オーク嫌い！
MsgEn: Enough! I can't stand orcs!

MsgJp: エリオット、もっと動け～！
MsgEn: Elliot, move it～!

MsgJp: 王子救出に参加できるとは光栄！
MsgEn:
I am honored to be able to participate 
in the rescue of the prince!

MsgJp: 凄い武装ですね――
MsgEn: They're damn well-armed――

MsgJp: ああ、強いや――こいつは強い！
MsgEn: Oh, he's ―― this guy is strong!

MsgJp: ネド王子、見てくれてますか～！
MsgEn: Prince Nedo, are you watching～!

MsgJp: 俺、そろそろ余裕ないかもです
MsgEn: I'm starting to feel a bit overwhelmed.

MsgJp: なんのこれしき！
MsgEn: What the hell is this!

MsgJp: 異国の覚者の皆さん――
MsgEn: To all the Arisen from foreign lands――

MsgJp:
僕は、覚者のことを何も知りません
その自覚もなかったほどです
MsgEn:
I don't know anything about the Arisen.
So much so that I wasn't even aware of it.

MsgJp:
それに、戦士としての力もありません
ですから、皆さんに教えて頂きたいことが
山ほどあるのです
MsgEn:
I lack the strength to be a warrior, 
so I have many questions I need you all 
to help me with.

MsgJp:
皆さんの武運をお借りして
解放軍はティネス砦を
取り戻すことができたと聞いています
MsgEn:
I am told that with the help
of your military might, the Liberation Army
was able to retake Fort Thines.

MsgJp:
そのティネス砦で、じっくりお話を
聞かせていただけませんか？
よろしくお願いします
MsgEn:
Would you be so kind as to sit down
and talk with us at Fort Thines? 
I look forward to working with you.

MsgJp:
こうして王子と再会できたのも
おぬしらの尽力があったからこそ
いくら感謝しても、し足りない
MsgEn:
I can't thank you enough for your efforts
in reuniting me with the Prince.

MsgJp:
しかし、わしらの戦いはこれが始まりだ
これからもよろしく頼むぞ
MsgEn:
But this is only the beginning of our fight.
I'm asking for your continued support.

MsgJp:
これだけ世話になっておいて厚かましいけど
ネド王子の手本になってほしい
MsgEn:
I apologize for being so brazen
after all you've done for me, but...
I want you to set an example for Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
覚者のことは、覚者にしかわからない
わたしたちでは限界があるからね
MsgEn:
Only an Arisen can know
what is best for the Arisen.
We are all limited in what we can do.

MsgJp:
あんたたちの噂はちゃーんと
届いていたよ
よその大陸から来た覚者たちが
解放軍に参加しているってさ
MsgEn:
We've heard rumors about you, 
that Arisen from other continents
have joined the Liberation Army.

MsgJp:
ここへ来た目的はなんだい？
まさか、あたしのお宝を狙ってるんじゃ
ないだろうねえ
MsgEn:
What is your purpose for coming here? 
You're not after my treasure, are you?

MsgJp: こう言っちゃ悪いけど――
MsgEn: I'm sorry to say this, but――

MsgJp:
王子と言っても、普通の子供ですよね
正直、なーんだと思ったんですけど――
MsgEn:
Even if he is referred to as a Prince,
he is just an ordinary child.
To be frank, I thought, 
"How disappointing"――

MsgJp:
普通の子供だとしたら、この状況って
すごい重圧だと思うんですよ
支えてあげなくてはって使命感みたいな――
MsgEn:
The pressure of this situation is too much
for a normal child to bear.
It feels like a sense of obligation
to support them――

MsgJp: この感覚――新鮮です
MsgEn: This feeling--how novel.

MsgJp:
まあ、王子なんてお飾りみたいなもんだ
覚者とは言え、まだガキだからな
MsgEn:
Well, a Prince is like a decoration.
He may be an Arisen, but he's still a kid.

MsgJp:
となれば、俺の出る幕じゃねえ
リズかエリオットに相手させとけ
MsgEn:
If that's the situation, I won't interfere. 
Let Lise and Elliot deal with it.

MsgJp: メイロワ将軍、見た？
MsgEn: General Meirova, did you see?

MsgJp:
孫でも見るみたいに目を細ーくするのかと思って
観察していたらね――
時々、寂しそうな悲しそうな顔するんだよね
MsgEn:
I thought he would smile
as if he were seeing his grandchild,
but he was observing him, and at times,
he looked sad or even lonely.

MsgJp:
それ見てさあ――
ああ、これはまだ始まりなんだ
本当の苦労はこれからなんだって
思ったよ
MsgEn:
When I saw that, I thought――
Oh, this is still the beginning.
The real hardships are yet to come.

MsgJp:
ここまで、おつかれさまでした
色々お話を――と思っていましたが
戻ってみると、対処しなくてはならない問題が
山積みのようです
MsgEn:
Thank you for your efforts thus far. 
I had planned to discuss various things, 
but upon returning, it seems that there 
are many issues piling up to be dealt with.

MsgJp: 虫のいいお願いで心苦しいのですが――
MsgEn: I'm sorry to be the one to ask for this, but--

MsgJp:
僕と共に、ここから全てを始めさせてください
この未熟な覚者のご指導を
どうかよろしくお願いいたします

ふーむ
まずはどこから手をつけるべきか――
じっくりと思案しなくてはな
MsgEn:
Hmm...
Where should I start ――
I have to think carefully.

MsgJp:
ネド王子が戻ったら戻ったで
色々と急がないとね
敵も黙ってはいないだろうし
MsgEn:
With Prince Nedo returned, we will
have to hurry with various matters.
The enemy won't just sit idly by either.

MsgJp: ネド王子――
MsgEn: Prince Nedo――

MsgJp:
あの年頃の少年は、少し見ないと
ずいぶん顔つきが変わるな
MsgEn:
Boys at that age change their appearance
quite a bit with just a little time apart.

MsgJp: 少しの間に、実にたくましくなられた
MsgEn: You have grown very strong in a short time.

MsgJp:
一度戻って少し骨休めといかねえか？
けっこう連戦してるぜ
MsgEn:
How about we head back for a brief rest?
We've been in quite a few battles already.

MsgJp:
ネド王子ったら――
あんな風に頼られると
張り切っちゃうよね
MsgEn:
Oh, Prince Nedo...
When he asks you for help like that...
I get all worked up!

MsgJp:
いい雰囲気に水を差すわけじゃありませんけど
これからですよね
ジリアンの言うとおりです
MsgEn:
I don't mean to put a damper on the good vibe, 
but it's just the beginning.
Gillian is right.

MsgJp:
ネド王子を無事に保護したんだろう？
まずは、おめでとう――だね
MsgEn:
I assume you have Prince Nedo
safely under your protection?
First of all, congratulations――

MsgJp:
希望が、グッと身近になったんだ
解放軍のひとたちは
これからは、希望とともに行動できる
さぞ、勢い付くことだろうね
MsgEn:
The hope has drawn much closer now. 
The Liberation Army will now 
be able to act alongside that hope. 
Surely, they will feel invigorated by this.

MsgJp:
ご苦労だったな
解放軍はついにネド王子をみこしに乗せることが
できるようになった
MsgEn:
You have done well. 
The Liberation Army has at last become 
capable of placing Prince Nedo
onto the palanquin.

MsgJp:
これが物語なら、さしずめ、第１章の
終わりというところだろうか――
MsgEn:
If this were like those tales,
it feels like this would be the end
of chapter one, does it not?

MsgJp: アッカーシェランにも覚者がいたというわけか
MsgEn: So there was an Arisen in Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
しかしその幼い覚者に力を継承すべきと
目される竜は、悪しき竜と呼ばれるほどに
憎まれている
MsgEn:
Yet the Dragon expected to pass on its power 
to that young Arisen is despised enough
to be called the "Evil Dragon."

MsgJp: 竜力の状態によっては――
MsgEn: Depending on the state of the Dragon's Force--

MsgJp: その覚者も悪しき心に呑み込まれてしまうやもしれず
MsgEn:
Even the Arisen may be swallowed 
up by the malicious mind.

MsgJp:
覚者たちよ――
目を凝らし、成り行きを見極めよ
MsgEn:
Arisen――
keep your eyes peeled and see what happens.

MsgJp:
→エリアミッション解放
→王家の協力者解放
→アチーブ報酬官解放
→時間経過スポット②（経験値？）解放
MsgEn:
→ Area Mission Unlocked 
→ Cooperators of the Royal Family Unlocked 
→ Achievement Rewards Officer Unlocked 
→ Time Lapse Spot ② (Exp. Points?) Unlocked

MsgJp:
悪しき竜の思惑か――
どれ、その立場になって考えてみるか
MsgEn:
Is this the Evil Dragon's scheme―― 
Well then, shall we consider it
from that position?

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様の言い方を借りるなら
アッカーシェランは第２章に入ったようだね
MsgEn:
To paraphrase Master Joseph, 
it looks like Acre Selund has entered chapter two.

MsgJp:
そろそろ悪しき竜が動き出すだろうから
勢いにまかせた行動は危険だと思うよ
MsgEn:
Soon the Evil Dragon will start to move, 
so I believe that acting on impulse is dangerous.

MsgJp: この状況――
MsgEn: This situation--

MsgJp:
悪しき竜が望んだことなのか――
そうは思えぬ――
MsgEn:
Is it what the Evil Dragon wanted? ――
I don't think so ――

MsgJp: お待ちしていました
MsgEn: We've been waiting for you.

MsgJp:
まずはメイロワ将軍とお話しください
僕は後ほど改めて挨拶させて頂きます
MsgEn:
Please speak with General Meirova first.
I will address you again later.

MsgJp: 砦の雰囲気が変わったと思わねえか？
MsgEn:
Don't you think the atmosphere 
at the fort has changed?

MsgJp:
賑やかになったっていうかよ
王子効果ってやつかね
MsgEn:
I wonder if it's become lively
because the Prince is here.

MsgJp:
――こんなこと、ここの人たちには
言えないけどさあ
MsgEn: --I can't say this to the people here, but...

MsgJp:
キラキラした場所にいないと
王子って、なんだか悲しいね
MsgEn:
If the Prince isn't in a shining place, 
it feels rather sad, doesn't it?

MsgJp:
砦の中が慌ただしいですね
出陣の準備でも始まったんでしょうか
MsgEn:
There's a flurry of activity in the fort. 
I wonder if they've started preparing 
to go into battle.

MsgJp:
今後のことを将軍やベルタと考えていたんだ
あなたたちは最初から数に入っている
頼りにしてるよ
MsgEn:
I was discussing future matters
with the General and Bertha.
You all have been part of the plan
from the very beginning.
I'm depending on you.

MsgJp:
大勢の人間が戦に備えるこの空気――
わかるだろう？
MsgEn:
A great many are preparing for battle; 
this atmosphere—do you feel it?

MsgJp: あんたたちのことだ――嫌いではないよな
MsgEn:
In regards to you guys――
You don't hate me?

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ殿のお気持ち、しかと受け取った
いつか恩返しをしなくてはな
MsgEn:
I have taken Master Joseph's kindness to heart.
I must return the favor one day.

MsgJp:
さて、早速だが――
ネド王子が戻られたことで
解放軍の士気はこの上なく高まっている
MsgEn:
Well, let's get right to it ――
with Prince Nedo's return, the morale of 
the Liberation Army has never been higher.

MsgJp:
この機運をもってすれば
各地でくすぶっている戦士たちの説得も
不可能ではなかろう
MsgEn:
With this momentum, it may be possible
to persuade the warriors who have been
lying in wait across the lands.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜への反撃の時に備えて
解放軍の増強をはかりたいのだ
MsgEn:
In readiness for the moment
to retaliate against the Evil Dragon,
I want to bolster the Liberation Army's strength.

MsgJp:
そこでこのメイロワ、ネド王子をお連れして
イェルハルドに北への進軍協力を要請するつもりだ
MsgEn:
So I'm going to take Meirova and Prince Nedo
and ask Gerhard to cooperate in advancing north.

MsgJp: ついてはおぬしたち、先行して、魔物払いを頼む
MsgEn:
Therefore, we ask you to go ahead 
and clear the area of monsters.

MsgJp: ネド王子をイェルハルドのロスギルの村へお連れする
MsgEn: I'll take Prince Nedo to Gerhard in Rothgill Village.

MsgJp:
目立たぬよう、道中の魔物を速やかに排除しながら
先行してくれ
MsgEn:
Stay out of sight, quickly eliminate monsters 
along the way, and stay ahead of them.

MsgJp:
あらためまして――
アッカー家当主のネドと申します
MsgEn:
Allow me to reintroduce myself―― 
I am Nedo, the head of House Acre.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍を始め、解放軍、民たちが
大変にお世話になったと聞いています
本当にありがとうございました
MsgEn:
I have heard that General Meirova, 
the Liberation Army and my people 
are very much indebted to you.
I offer you my deepest gratitude.

MsgJp:
今回はロスギルの村への先遣隊を
引き受けてくださるとのこと
MsgEn:
It seems you will undertake the 
advance party to Rothgill Village this time.

MsgJp:
噂の戦いぶり、間近で見られないのは残念ですが
また機会もあるでしょう
今後ともよろしく
MsgEn:
It's a pity I won't be able to see the rumored 
battle up close, but I'm sure there will be another 
opportunity. Keep up the good work.

MsgJp: ――お願いします
MsgEn: ――We'll be relying on you.

MsgJp:
ロスギル村方面はこのあたりよりも
魔物が多い土地です
MsgEn:
The area around Rothgill Village
has more monsters than here.

MsgJp:
先駈けての魔物払いは大変と思いますが
どうぞよろしくお願いします
MsgEn:
I know it's a lot of work to exterminate the 
monsters ahead of time, but please do so.

MsgJp:
いいね
子守しながら戦えと言われなくてよ
MsgEn:
Sounds good. I won't be told to fight 
while babysitting.

MsgJp:
さーて、ネド王子と解放軍のために
もうひと肌脱ぎますか！
MsgEn:
Well then, shall I lend a hand for Prince Nedo 
and the Liberation Army?

MsgJp:
イェルハルドは動いてくれますかね――
ネド王子のご威光に期待ですね
MsgEn:
Will Gerhard make a move--
I'm hoping Prince Nedo's authority 
will do the trick.

MsgJp: わたしはここで留守番だ
MsgEn: I'm staying here.

MsgJp:
王子の移動は目立たないように
ギリギリの少人数がいいはずだからね
MsgEn:
The Prince's relocation should be discreet.
A small group of people at the 
last minute should be good.

MsgJp: ここで君らの無事を祈らせてもらうよ
MsgEn: I'll stay here and pray for your safety.

MsgJp: ネド王子もご一緒ですかな？
MsgEn: Is Prince Nedo with you?

MsgJp:
イェルハルドめ――
王子を試すとは無礼このうえなし！
あとで叱っておかねばな
MsgEn:
Gerhard...
You are so rude to test the Prince!
I shall have to scold you later.

MsgJp: 癒しの泉はどこでしょうね？
MsgEn: Where is the healing spring?

MsgJp:
イェルハルドめ、王子を試すとは
いい根性だぜ
本物だな、あいつは
MsgEn:
Gerhard, you've got some guts
trying to test the Prince.

MsgJp: 王家の秘蹟か――
MsgEn: The Sacrament of the Royal Family, is it...

MsgJp:
ネド王子、何をどうしたらいいかも
わからないみたいだけど、大丈夫かな
MsgEn:
It seems like Prince Nedo is lost
on what to do, but will he be okay?

MsgJp:
癒しの泉のあたりも魔物が多いんでしょうね
引き続き、魔物払いといきますか！
MsgEn:
It seems there are many monsters
near the Spring of Healing, huh?
Shall we continue our monster-clearing efforts?

MsgJp:
この村を出て北へ向かうと、やがて
関所に当たります
MsgEn:
If you leave this village and head north, 
you will eventually come to a gate.

MsgJp:
癒やしの泉は、その関所を越えた奥地にありますが
少なくともこの数十年――
この村から、泉のところまで行った者は
誰もいません
MsgEn:
The healing spring is located deep beyond 
the barrier, but no one from this village has 
made it to the spring in at least 
a couple of decades.

MsgJp:
そのようなわけで、泉の場所や現在の様子は
我々よりも詳しい者から直接聞いた方が
よろしいでしょう
MsgEn:
As such, it would be better to hear directly 
from someone who knows more about the location 
of the spring and its current condition than we do.

MsgJp: 北の関所を越えたその先に小さな村があります
MsgEn:
There is a small village just beyond 
the northern checkpoint.

MsgJp:
そこにはエリアマスターのナヤジークが
住んでいますから、尋ねてみてください
MsgEn:
The Area Master, Nazik, 
lives there, so ask her.

MsgJp:
彼女なら、わたしなどよりもずっと有益な
話を聞かせてくれるでしょう
MsgEn:
I'm sure she can tell you
a much more useful story than I can.

MsgJp: 北の関所を越えれば、村はその先です
MsgEn:
Once you cross the northern checkpoint, 
the village is just beyond it.

MsgJp:
まずはエリアマスターのナヤジークを
訪ねてください
MsgEn: First, please visit Area Master Nazik.

MsgJp:
こんなところにお客さまとは珍しい
いえ――噂はこの地まで届いております
わたしはここのエリアマスター、ナヤジーク
MsgEn:
It's unusual to have a visitor here. 
No, the rumors have reached this place. 
I am the Area Master here, Nazik.

MsgJp:
ご存じかも知れませんが
このエリアには王家代々と継がれてきた山城
展望城と呼ばれる要衝がございます
MsgEn:
As you may know, this area is home
to a mountain castle that has been
in the Royal Family for generations.
It is called Lookout Castle.

MsgJp:
しかし、いまやその城は魔軍の手に堕ち
王都メガドへの進行はおろか
ここより北に進むことすら危険な状態です
MsgEn:
But now that the castle has fallen into the hands 
of the Demon Army, it's not safe to proceed north 
of here, let alone to the Royal Capital of Megado.

MsgJp:
ただ耐えるしかない無為な日々でしたが
もし、ネド様のお役に立てるのならば
それが、わたしたちの喜びになるでしょう
MsgEn:
We have done nothing but endure, 
but if we can be of service to Lord Nedo, 
it will be our pleasure.

MsgJp:
癒しの泉ですね？
ここを出て、南西の崖へ向かってください
水路の入り口には、すぐにお気づきになられるかと
MsgEn:
It's the healing spring, isn't it?
Leave here and head southwest toward the cliffs. 
You'll soon find yourself at the entrance
to a waterway.

MsgJp:
その水路の最深部に、癒しの泉はあります
魔物の巣窟になっているはずですから
どうぞお気をつけください
MsgEn:
The healing spring is located
at the deepest part of the canal, 
which is supposed to be a den of demons, 
so please be careful.

MsgJp:
南西の崖に向かってください
それから、礎の解放がまだでしたら
けして忘れないでくださいね
MsgEn:
Head for the southwest cliffs, 
and don't forget to attune to the Portcrystal
if you haven't already.

MsgJp:
イェルハルドが内密で話したいってよ
王子抜きだと
MsgEn:
Gerhard wants to speak to you in private, 
without the Prince present.

MsgJp: おかしな陰謀に巻きこまれたりしねえだろうな
MsgEn:
I hope you don't get caught up in some 
crazy conspiracy.

MsgJp:
どうやら王子たちは少し遅れているようですな
ならば、好都合です
MsgEn:
It seems that the Prince is running a bit late.
Well then, that works in our favor.

MsgJp: みなさん
MsgEn: Everyone.

MsgJp:
時に王子の堅き盾として――
時に解放軍の鋭き剣として――
今後ともよろしくお願いします
MsgEn:
At times, the unwavering shield of the Prince―― 
At times, the keen blade of the Liberation Army―― 
Thank you for your continued support.

MsgJp:
ベルタとその一族郎党は、国が復興するその日まで
盗賊稼業は休止にして我々解放軍に全面協力する
とのことだ
MsgEn:
Bertha and her family will suspend their banditry 
and cooperate fully with the Liberation Army 
until the day the country is restored.

MsgJp: まあ、当然だがな
MsgEn: Well, of course.

MsgJp: いろいろとありがとうございました
MsgEn: Thank you for everything.

MsgJp:
でも、竜力を使うと疲れるものですね
いつか慣れるのでしょうか
MsgEn:
But using Dragon Force can be tiring. 
I wonder if I'll get used to it someday.

MsgJp:
イェルハルドが加わるとなれば
相当な戦力だぜ
MsgEn:
With the addition of Gerhard,
we'll be quite a force to be reckoned with.

MsgJp:
盗賊団に加えて、辺境の知将が参加となれば
もっと多くの人たちが解放軍に
同調してくるれるでしょうね
MsgEn:
With the addition of the bandit band 
and the wise general from the frontier, 
more people will likely join the Liberation Army.

MsgJp:
思わず張り切っちゃったけど
ネド王子、ますます後に退けないよね
MsgEn:
I got a little too excited, but Prince Nedo,
there's no turning back now.

MsgJp: 退くつもりなんて、ないんだろうけどさあ
MsgEn: I know you have no intention of backing down.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜は現れぬか――
あやつめ何を考えている――
MsgEn:
Will the vile dragon not appear―― 
What is it scheming――

MsgJp:
なんだか、意気揚々という感じだね
そうでもないのかな？
MsgEn:
It seems like there's a buoyant spirit here, 
or am I mistaken?

MsgJp:
戦いが好きな覚者――戦場でこそ輝く覚者
そういう覚者がいても当然だと思うよ
MsgEn:
An Arisen who loves to fight— 
the kind that truly shines on the battlefield. 
I think it's only natural for such Arisen to exist.

MsgJp: なるほど――
MsgEn: I see...

MsgJp:
悪しき竜の竜力はネド王子が継承可能な――
つまり、王家伝来の竜力で
あるか否かが重要というわけか
MsgEn:
The Evil Dragon's power can be 
inherited by Prince Nedo— 
this means that the significance lies in
whether it is the Royal lineage's
Dragon Force or not.

MsgJp:
確かにこれはネド王子以外には
見極めが不可能だろうな
MsgEn:
Surely this would be impossible for anyone
but Prince Nedo to discern.

MsgJp:
しかし、一方で気味が悪いのは悪しき竜の動き
気を引き締めて動くのだぞ
MsgEn:
Yet, on the other hand, what is unsettling
is the Evil Dragon's actions. 
Keep your wits about you 
and proceed with care.

MsgJp: ネド王子とはうまくやっているのだろうな？
MsgEn:
You're probably getting along well
with Prince Nedo?

MsgJp:
王子は次代のアッカーシェランの王――
そして竜になる人だ
MsgEn:
The prince is the next king of Acre Selund――
and the one who will become the Dragon.

MsgJp:
おまえたちと王子の関係が
そのまま未来のレスタニアとアッカーシェランの
関係になるだろう
MsgEn:
Your relationship with the Prince 
will become the future link 
between Lestania and Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
責務は重いが――これもレスタニアのためだ
さあ、行きなさい
MsgEn:
It's a heavy responsibility, 
but it's for the good of Lestania. 
Now, be off.

MsgJp: アッカーシェランとどう付き合うべきか――
MsgEn: How should we deal with Acre Selund ――

MsgJp:
これは追々考えるとして
まずは悪しき竜にまつわる問題を
解決しなくてはな
MsgEn:
We'll think about this later, but first we need 
to solve the problem of the Evil Dragon.

MsgJp:
解放軍はどうにか格好がついたんだよね？
となると、次は、戦略を決めるんだろうな
MsgEn:
The Liberation Army has finally
pulled itself together, so next, 
we'll have to decide on a strategy.

MsgJp:
出せるところは、口出しした方が
いいと思うけど、まあ、場の雰囲気も見ながら
判断するしかないよね
MsgEn:
I think it's better to speak your mind, but you 
need to judge based on the atmosphere.

MsgJp:
大変だ
オークがここに向かって進軍中だ
MsgEn:
Trouble is coming— 
the orcs are headed our way.

MsgJp: ネド王子の解放軍合流を知られたらしい
MsgEn:
It seems that they have learned that 
Prince Nedo joined the Liberation Army.

MsgJp:
王子率いる部隊が城壁近くに集まっている
まもなくここは封鎖する、急いで合流してくれ
ネド王子、たっての希望だ
MsgEn:
The troops led by the Prince
are gathering near the city walls.
We will seal off the area shortly.
Hurry and join up. It is Prince Nedo's request.

MsgJp:
王子たちの居場所は行けばわかるはず
急ぎ、合流してくれ
MsgEn:
You'll know where the Prince
and his men are when you get there.
Hurry and join up with them.

MsgJp:
王子たちは城壁の上で、迫り来る敵を
見計らっているはずだ
MsgEn:
The Prince and his men should be on the ramparts, 
watching the oncoming enemy.

MsgJp:
ふたたびここを失えば、もう後はないんだ
命に代えても守りきるよ
MsgEn:
If we lose this foothold again, 
there will be nothing left.
I'll defend it with my life.

MsgJp:
浅ましいオークどもめ！
さっそく反撃に来たってわけか
MsgEn:
Those vile orcs!
They've come to strike back so soon.

MsgJp:
あんた、すごく腕が立つんだってな！
頼りにしてるよ
MsgEn:
I hear you're very skilled! 
I'm counting on you.

MsgJp:
幼い王子が命を張っているんだ
俺もとにかくやってみるつもりさ
MsgEn:
The little prince is putting his life on the line.
I'm going to risk mine as well.

MsgJp:
まもなく敵がこの砦に到達する
もう時間がないぞ
MsgEn:
Soon the enemy will reach this fort. 
We are running out of time.

MsgJp: はやく！　城壁にいる王子の元へ急いで！
MsgEn:
Quickly!　
Hurry to the Prince on the ramparts!

MsgJp: 気づいてるだろうが――
MsgEn: I'm sure you've noticed--

MsgJp:
こっちのオークどもの装備は
なかなかのもんだ
押しと引きの呼吸、間違えるなよ
MsgEn:
These orcs over here are pretty well equipped.
Don't mess up the timing of 
your advances and retreats.

MsgJp:
隊長、風にあの臭いが混じってる
オークの戦闘臭！
MsgEn:
Captain, the wind carries that scent... 
The foul odor of orc combat!

MsgJp:
これは、言わば王子の初陣ですね
気持ち良く勝たせてあげましょう！
MsgEn:
This is the prince's first battle, so to speak. 
Let's let him win comfortably!

MsgJp:
待っていたぞ！
まず、陣頭指揮を執るネド王子と
話してくれ
MsgEn:
We've been waiting for you!
First, you need to talk to Prince Nedo, 
who's in command of the group.

MsgJp:
実は迫り来る敵への対応策を決められなくて
困っています
MsgEn:
Actually, I'm having trouble deciding
what to do about the oncoming enemy.

MsgJp:
意見は出尽くし、決断しなくては
ならないのですが――
MsgEn:
All opinions have been exhausted
and decisions have to be made――

MsgJp: ――いや――いいえ
MsgEn: ――Wait――no.

MsgJp:
隊長さんの顔を見たら
勇気が出てきました！
MsgEn:
Seeing your face, Ser Captain, 
I feel my courage returning!

MsgJp: 無茶だって言われるかもしれないけど――
MsgEn: You might say it's ridiculous――

MsgJp:
敵の部隊をこの砦に誘い込んで殲滅する
この作戦で行かせてください！
MsgEn:
We will lure the enemy's troops into this fort 
and destroy them.
Let us go with this strategy!

MsgJp:
我々は少数ですから戦力が拡散してしまうと
弱いと思うんです
MsgEn:
We are a small group, and I think we are 
vulnerable if our forces are spread out.

MsgJp:
だから、外に打って出るよりも
敵を砦に呼び込めば――
MsgEn:
So, rather than hitting them outside,
if you bring the enemies into the fort――

MsgJp:
向こうは兵を少しずつ送り込むことしか
できませんから、各個撃破で互角に
戦うことができるはずです
MsgEn:
They can only funnel in a small number of troops, 
so we should be able to fight them on equal terms
by cutting them down individually.

MsgJp: ではご一同様、よろしくお願いします
MsgEn: Well, I look forward to working with you all.

MsgJp:
折悪しく、ジリアンを遠方の斥候に
出してしまった
MsgEn:
Unfortunately, Gillian was sent 
on a distant scouting mission.

MsgJp:
おぬしたちの負担が増えるが
今さら遠慮もいらんと思ってな！
MsgEn:
It's going to be more of a burden on you guys, 
but I figured there's no need to hold back now!

MsgJp:
敵を砦に引き込むなんてのは――
好き嫌いで言えば大キライだが
MsgEn:
Drawing the enemy into the fortress— 
if I had to say, I'm not a fan.

MsgJp: ま、仕方がねえな
MsgEn: Well, it can't be helped.

MsgJp: オークの臭い、強くなってきた？
MsgEn: Is the smell of orc getting stronger?

MsgJp:
気のせい？
もう、鼻が鈍感になっちゃってわからない！
MsgEn:
Is it my imagination?
I can't tell anymore, my nose has become so dull!

MsgJp:
砦の中に敵を引き入れるとなれば
取りこぼしは許されませんね
MsgEn:
When it comes to drawing the enemy into the fort, 
there's no room for error.

MsgJp:
ジリアンは、今頃は帰路だろう
だが、到着してすぐに戦闘では可哀想だ
MsgEn:
Gillian is probably on her way back by now, 
but it would be a pity if she had to head
into battle as soon as she arrived.

MsgJp:
だから、わたしたちで
一気に片をつけようではないか
MsgEn: So let's get this done in one fell swoop!

MsgJp:
僕の顔を見ればみんな勇気が
出るだろうなんて思い上がったことを
考えてるわけじゃないんです
MsgEn:
I'm not so conceited as to believe
that everyone would feel brave
just by seeing my face.

MsgJp:
ただ、砦でジッとしているのも
違うと思うんです
MsgEn:
However, I believe that simply staying 
still in the fortress is not the answer.

MsgJp:
王子はたった一戦で一皮むけた感じだね
さすが覚者――というべきなのかな
MsgEn:
It seems the Prince has evolved
after just a single battle, doesn't it? 
Perhaps it should be said—an Arisen indeed.

MsgJp: そうそう――
MsgEn: Yes, indeed.

MsgJp:
あちこち見てきたけど
オークどもの動きが活発になっているんだ
これからもっと忙しくなるよ
MsgEn:
I've been looking everywhere.
There's a lot of activity among the orcs.
It's going to get busier.

MsgJp:
オークどもにネド王子ここにありと
見せつけたわけだが、はてさて
吉と出るか凶と出るか――だな
MsgEn:
We have shown the orcs that Prince Nedo
is here to stay, and now we will see
if it is a good thing or a bad thing...

MsgJp: 王子め、なかなかやるな――
MsgEn: Prince, you're quite something!

MsgJp:
と、褒めてやりたいところだが
調子に乗られても困るからやめておくわ
MsgEn:
I'd like to give you a compliment, 
but I don't want you to get carried away, 
so I'll respectfully refrain.

MsgJp:
わたし、ネド王子の味方だからね
――というか、心配でたまらないの
MsgEn:
I'm on Prince Nedo's side.
--I mean, I'm worried about him.

MsgJp:
戦いがこれから本格化する――
みんなそう思っているみたいですね
もちろん、俺もです
MsgEn:
The battle is about to get serious-- 
everyone seems to think so, 
including me, of course.

MsgJp:
解放軍はかつてないほどに勢い付いているが
実際の活動には少々準備時間が必要だ
MsgEn:
The Liberation Army is gaining momentum
like never before, but actual operations
require a bit of prep time.

MsgJp: おぬしら一度レスタニアへ戻ってはどうかな
MsgEn: I suggest you return to Lestania.

MsgJp:
解放軍の躍進か――と思ったら
攻め込まれたそうだね
MsgEn:
I thought the Liberation Army
was making progress,
but they've been attacked instead.

MsgJp:
士気だけは高いけど、まだ劣勢という
ところかな
MsgEn:
Morale is high, 
but they're likely still outnumbered.

MsgJp: やはり敵軍も動き出したな
MsgEn: The enemy forces are on the move, after all.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜が現れてからの戦いは
敗走につぐ敗走だったと聞いている
とすれば、本格的な反撃はこれから――
MsgEn:
I've heard that the battle since the appearance 
of the Evil Dragon has been one defeat
after another, and if that's the case,
a full-scale counterattack from the orcs
is just around the corner.

MsgJp:
わかっているな？
レスタニア覚者隊の、武勇見せどころだぞ
MsgEn:
Do you understand? 
This is chance to show valor
for the Lestanian Arisen Corps.

MsgJp:
さあ、アッカーシェランへ急ぐべきでは
ないか？
MsgEn:
Now come on, 
shouldn't you hurry to Acre Selund?

MsgJp:
ネド王子がどういう人物か知らなくても
解放軍が活気づいたことは敵にも伝わる
MsgEn:
Even if they don't know who Prince Nedo is, 
the enemy can tell that the Liberation Army 
forces have been energized.

MsgJp:
流れに乗り遅れないように――
いや、流れを生み出すくらいの勢いで
丁度良いかもしれないぞ
MsgEn:
To not fall behind the flow—
Nay, it might be just right to create
a flow of our own with enough momentum.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜の思惑はまだわからん
くれぐれも用心するのだぞ
MsgEn:
We still don't know what the Evil Dragon
has in store for us, so beware.

MsgJp:
戦いのことは素人だけどね――
防戦一方じゃ気持ちがふさぐと思う
MsgEn:
I'm not a battle expert, but I think that 
always being on the defensive could be 
quite discouraging.

MsgJp:
砦なんか、壁に囲まれているから
なおさらだ
MsgEn: Especially since the fort is surrounded by walls.

MsgJp:
各地から報告が入っています
状況はますます厳しくなってきたようです
MsgEn:
Reports are coming in from all over 
that the situation is getting tougher and tougher.

MsgJp: 詳しいことは将軍からお願いします
MsgEn: For more information, please ask the General.

MsgJp:
敵は同時にあちこちで動き出している
どこから手をつけたらいいのか――
MsgEn:
The enemy is moving all over the place
at the same time, where to start--

MsgJp:
増強されたと言ってもまだまだ
多勢に無勢
MsgEn:
Even though they are now stronger, 
they are still outnumbered.

MsgJp:
兵を効率的に動かさないと
勝利が遠のく
MsgEn:
If we don't move our troops efficiently, 
our victory will fall from certainty.

MsgJp:
ジタバタしても仕方がねえ
メイロワ将軍と話してこいよ
MsgEn:
There's no point in being jittery now.
Go talk to General Meirova.

MsgJp:
おそらく、部隊を分散することに
なるんでしょうね
その時は、僕にも考えがあります
MsgEn:
Perhaps the troops will be divided, then. 
When that happens, I have some plans
in mind too.

MsgJp: ネド王子の面倒はわたしに任せて
MsgEn: Let me take care of Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
この気持ち、なんだろうね
お姉さん気分――え？　母親気分！？
MsgEn:
What is this feeling?
I feel like a big sister—huh?
Motherly instinct!?

MsgJp:
おお、おぬしら、状況は切迫しておるぞ
ロスギルの村、ベルタのアジトともに敵の攻撃を
受けている
MsgEn:
Oh, you all! The situation is urgent. 
Both Rothgill Village and Bertha's 
hideout are under enemy assault.

MsgJp: やつらめ、本腰を入れて攻めて来たようだ
MsgEn: They're getting serious about attacking us.

MsgJp:
ネド王子の合流で士気は高まったが
このまま劣勢になれば元も子もない
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo joining us has boosted morale, 
but if we continue to be outnumbered, 
we will be losing it all.

MsgJp:
起死回生――派手な戦果を上げて
士気を維持するのだ
MsgEn:
We need a comeback--
a significant war effort to keep morale up.

MsgJp:
派手な戦果を求めるとなれば
ネド王子の出陣は必須
MsgEn:
If we're seeking a flashy victory, 
then Prince Nedo's deployment is essential.

MsgJp:
危険ではあるがこれも王家の責務
武運は王子にあると信じて
前進あるのみだ
MsgEn:
It's dangerous, but it's also a royal duty, 
and we must move forward, believing that 
the Prince will be the one to carry the day.

MsgJp:
あなたはロスギルへ行ってくれる？
わたしはここでもう少し報告を聞いて
行き先を決めるから
MsgEn:
Can you go to Rothgill?
I'll stay here and listen to a few more reports 
and decide where to go.

MsgJp: ベルタのところか、それとも、他のところか
MsgEn: Bertha's place or elsewhere.

MsgJp:
とにかく、ロスギルはあなたに任せるから
お願いね
MsgEn: Anyway, I'd like to leave Rothgill to you

MsgJp:
ロスギルは任せるから――
急いでね
MsgEn:
I'll leave Rothgill to you--
hurry up.

MsgJp: 僕はベルタのところへ行こうと思います
MsgEn: I think I'll go to Bertha's.

MsgJp:
あそこには子供が多いから――
子供たちなら、僕でも勇気づけて
やれるはずです
MsgEn:
There are a lot of children there―― 
I think I can give them courage, 
even if it's just me.

MsgJp: この砦の留守はまかせてくれ
MsgEn: I'll take care of this fortress.

MsgJp:
ロスギルへ行くんだろ？
だったら、急ごうぜ
MsgEn:
You're going to Rothgill, right? 
Then hurry up.

MsgJp:
隊長、行ってきて
王子はわたしが守るから
MsgEn: Captain, go. I'll protect the prince.

MsgJp:
ロスギル村ですよね？
何度か行き来した村ですけど
間違えたら大変です
MsgEn:
It's Rothgill Village, right? 
I've traveled there a few times,
but getting lost would be a disaster.

MsgJp: 地図で確認しながら行きましょう
MsgEn: Check the map as you go.

MsgJp:
おお、ありがたい！
なんと心強い顔ぶれでしょうか
MsgEn:
Oh, thank you! 
What a reassuring face!

MsgJp:
ここまでは手勢で持ちこたえていますが
あらたな敵の情報が入りましてな――
MsgEn:
So far, our forces have held their own,
but we have received intelligence
of a new enemy appearing...

MsgJp:
わたしたちはここの防衛で手一杯
どうぞ、外の敵の相手をよろしくお願いします！
MsgEn:
We have our hands full defending here. 
Please take care of the enemies outside!

MsgJp:
敵の援軍は村の外です
中に入られては守り切れるかどうか――
どうぞ、よろしくお願いします！
MsgEn:
Enemy reinforcements are outside the village. 
If they get inside, I'm not sure we can defend 
against them-- please!

MsgJp:
故郷は自分たちで守る――
そう言いたいところだが多勢に無勢
応援、感謝するよ
MsgEn:
We will protect our hometown ourselves ――
I want to say so, but we're outnumbered. 
Thanks for the support.

MsgJp:
おう、俺とエリオットでロスギルを襲撃する
敵を防いでやるよ
MsgEn:
Alright, Elliot and I will go to Rothgill. 
We'll hold off the enemy for you.

MsgJp: それ以外は頼んだぜ
MsgEn: Other than that, I'm all yours.

MsgJp:
隊長、さっさと片付けましょう
ネド王子が心配ですから
いつでも向こうに行けるように！
MsgEn:
Captain, let's wrap this up quickly. 
Prince Nedo is at risk,
so we must be ready to go at any moment!

MsgJp:
倒したオークが捨て台詞を残しました――
ほどなくベルタも生きちゃいまい
オークからは逃げられない
MsgEn:
The defeated orc left some parting words―― 
Bertha won't live for much longer, 
you can't escape from the orcs.

MsgJp: もちろん、王子も――
MsgEn: And of course, the Prince--

MsgJp:
隊長、ここはもう我々で対処可能です
どうぞ、ベルタのところへ！
王子をお守りください
MsgEn:
Captain, we can handle this place now. 
Please, go to Bertha! Protect the Prince.

MsgJp:
ここはもう大丈夫です
どうぞ、盗賊のアジトへ――王子のところへ！
MsgEn:
You're all set here. 
Please, go to the bandit's hideout- 
to the Prince!

MsgJp:
おかげで助かったよ
あんた、やっぱりすごいな
MsgEn:
Thanks for saving me.
You're still amazing after all.

MsgJp:
話なら、あっちでしようぜ
王子と盗賊どもに何かあったら
俺たちが責められそうな勢いだ
MsgEn:
We'll talk when we get over there. 
If something happens to the Prince
and the bandits, we might end up getting blamed.

MsgJp:
王子の護衛が何人いるかなんて
隊長も聞いてないですよね
MsgEn:
The Captain didn't ask
how many guards the Prince had.

MsgJp:
リズだけってことはないですよねえ
不安です、早く行きましょう！
MsgEn:
It can't just be Lise...
I'm anxious, let's get going!

MsgJp: 何か――予感がするんです
MsgEn: Somehow-- I have a feeling.

MsgJp:
吉兆か凶兆かわからないけど――
いいえ、その両方が混じり合ったような――
MsgEn:
I don't know if it's a good omen or a bad omen--
No, it's a mixture of both.

MsgJp:
こりゃあ、あれだ
嵐の前の静けさってやつだな
MsgEn: This is it, the calm before the storm.

MsgJp: 油断するなよ
MsgEn: Don't let your guard down.

MsgJp:
隊長――
やっぱり顔見るとホッとするよ
MsgEn: Captain-- it's a relief to see your face.

MsgJp:
ベルタはちょっと機嫌が悪いから
気をつけてね
MsgEn:
Bertha's in a bit of a bad mood, 
so watch your step.

MsgJp: ここは、戦いには不向きですね
MsgEn: This place is not suitable for fighting.

MsgJp: 攻め込まれたら、逃げ場がないですよ
MsgEn: If we are attacked, there is no way out.

MsgJp:
メイロワのじじいめ、ネド王子まで
寄越すなんて何を考えているんだい！？
MsgEn:
That geezer Meirova.
What were you thinking, 
sending Prince Nedo over here!?

MsgJp:
希望だ、旗印だ、と言われて懸命だけど
まだ子供じゃないか
MsgEn:
They call him hope, a symbol to rally around, 
but he's still just a child.

MsgJp:
――まあ、それはともかく、とりあえず
この急場をどう凌ぐかだよ
MsgEn:
--Well, anyway,
let's see how we can get out of this emergency.

MsgJp:
一番重要なことはね、ここで戦えば
こっちに勝ち目はないってことだ
MsgEn:
The most important thing to remember
is that if we fight here, we don't stand a chance.

MsgJp: その代わり、ほら――
MsgEn:
Instead――
Look over yonder――

MsgJp:
迎え撃つにはうってつけの場所がある
地図に印をつけてやるから行ってみな
MsgEn:
There's a good place to intercept them. 
I'll mark it on the map, you go there.

MsgJp:
手下たちを走らせてあるから、そいつが
案内するよ
MsgEn:
I've got my guys running around, 
they'll show you the way.

MsgJp:
地図を見せてください
――ああ、やっぱりそうですね
MsgEn: Let me see the map -- oh, I knew it.

MsgJp:
オークは洞窟の裏手の、地形が入り組んだ
山の中を進軍してくるはずです
MsgEn:
Orcs will likely march through the 
intricate mountain terrain behind the cave.

MsgJp:
谷間の道は狭くて大軍には不向き
この地の利を活用しなさい――
MsgEn:
The path through the valley is too tight
for a large force to pass through.
Make use of the terrain's advantage—

MsgJp: それがベルタの考えだと思います
MsgEn: I believe that's Bertha's idea.

MsgJp: さあ、隊長さん、行きましょう
MsgEn: Come on, Captain, let's go.

MsgJp: なんだい――
MsgEn: What the――

MsgJp:
王子は見違えたようだね
でも、まだまだ子供なんだからね
それを忘れたら後悔するよ
MsgEn:
The Prince seems to have changed, doesn't he? 
But he's still just a child, you know. 
Forget that, and you'll regret it.

MsgJp:
谷間の様子を見に行きませんか？
早い方がいいと思うんです
MsgEn:
Why don't we go check out the valley? 
I think the sooner the better.

MsgJp:
なるほど――谷底のオークどもを
山の上から奇襲するってわけだ
MsgEn:
I see... a surprise attack on orcs
on the valley floor from up the mountain.

MsgJp:
奇襲ってのがひっかかるが
戦上手は手段選ばずってな
MsgEn:
I'm not so sure
about the 'surprise attack' part, but...
They say a good fighter does whatever it takes.

MsgJp: 王子、頼もしいねえ
MsgEn: The Prince is quite reliable, isn't he?

MsgJp:
王子が精神的に成長したといっても
戦いに関してはまだまだです
MsgEn:
Even though the Prince has grown mentally,
when it comes to fighting, 
he still has a long way to go.

MsgJp: 俺たちの出番ですよ
MsgEn: That's where we come in.

MsgJp: この先は危険だ
MsgEn: It's not safe up ahead.

MsgJp:
おかしらに指示された
谷を見下ろせる場所があるから
そこまで登るんだ
MsgEn:
The old man told me there's a spot overlooking 
the valley, so we're going to climb up to it.

MsgJp: 仲間が待ってるはずだ、指示に従ってくれ
MsgEn:
Your friends will be waiting for you. 
Follow the instructions.

MsgJp:
来たね！
ほら、ここを登るんだよ
MsgEn:
You've arrived!
Look, we're going up here.

MsgJp:
おかげで、悪しき竜の竜力を
近くで感じることができました
MsgEn:
Thanks to your efforts,
I was able to feel the Dragon Force
of the Evil Dragon up close.

MsgJp: 僕は、あの竜力を継承することができます！
MsgEn: I believe can inherit that Dragon Force!

MsgJp:
邪悪な意識の奥深くに
火竜であった女王の力を感じました
MsgEn:
Deep within that evil consciousness, 
I felt the power of the Queen
who was once the Fire Dragon.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜に打ち勝つことができれば
竜力は僕に共鳴してくれるはずです
MsgEn:
If I can overcome the Evil Dragon, 
the Dragon Force will resonate with me.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜が、アッカーシェランの竜と
まったく異なる竜力を持つ存在であれば
僕はその力を継承できないのではないか――
MsgEn:
If the Evil Dragon possessed powers 
entirely different from those
of the Acre Selund Dragon,
then I may not be able to inherit that strength――

MsgJp:
そう思って不安だったのですが
確認できて良かったです
MsgEn:
That's what I was worried about, 
but I'm glad I got confirmation.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜のやつ――
俺たち――いや、隊長に用があったみたいだな
MsgEn:
The Evil Dragon...
I think he wanted us--
Nay, he wanted the Captain.

MsgJp: なんだってんだ、まったく
MsgEn: What the hell, man?

MsgJp:
さっきの竜――
本気じゃないって言うか
あまり殺気を感じなかったっていうか――
MsgEn:
The Dragon from earlier— 
I can't say it was being serious,
nor did I feel much killing intent—

MsgJp:
悪しき竜の奴――
俺たちに何か期待してるんですかね
MsgEn: That Evil Dragon-- what does he expect from us?

MsgJp:
悪しき竜は隊長に会いに来た――
僕など眼中にありませんでした
いったいどういうことでしょうね
MsgEn:
The Evil Dragon came to see the Captain— 
It had no interest in someone like me. 
What could this possibly mean?

MsgJp: 俺たちに何をさせようってんだ――
MsgEn: What the hell do you want us to do--

MsgJp:
隊長――
あの悪しき竜にとって
わたしたちは観客――
MsgEn:
Captain— 
To that wicked Dragon, 
we are mere spectators—

MsgJp: そんな気がしたんだけど――ちがうかな
MsgEn:
I felt that way, but— 
I could be wrong.

MsgJp: この絶望の大陸を楽しめって――
MsgEn: He told me to enjoy this land of despair--

MsgJp:
もしや、悪しき竜は自分の力を
見せつけるために俺たちを呼んだとか
MsgEn:
Maybe the Evil Dragon called us here
to show us his power.

MsgJp: 違いますかね！？
MsgEn: Is there a difference!?

MsgJp:
よくやってくれた！
おかげで仲間にはかすり傷ひとつないよ
MsgEn:
You did a great job! 
Not a scratch on my guys thanks to you.

MsgJp:
王子も、ずいぶん意気揚々と
引き上げてきたじゃないか
MsgEn:
The Prince has certainly come back
with great enthusiasm.

MsgJp: うん、見直したよ
MsgEn: Yeah, I was impressed.

MsgJp:
でもね、王子だ覚者だと
もてはやされてもあの子はまだ子供
MsgEn:
But you know, even though he's being hailed
as a Prince and an Arisen, he's still just a kid.

MsgJp:
母親が恋しい年頃だ
それを忘れるんじゃないよ
MsgEn:
He's at that age where he still misses his mother.
Don't forget that.

MsgJp:
疲れただろう？
すこし、休むといい
MsgEn:
You're tired, aren't you?
It's good to take a break.

MsgJp:
聞いたよ
ついに悪しき竜が現れたんだってね
MsgEn: I heard that the Evil Dragon has finally appeared.

MsgJp:
しかも、君たちを呼びつけたのは
自分の力を見せつけるため――
そう言ったんだよね？
MsgEn:
Moreover, you all were summoned
so that he could demonstrate his power— 
That's what he said, right?

MsgJp:
そうか――
竜からの力の継承が可能となれば
ネド王子は正真正銘の希望というわけだ
MsgEn:
I see... If it is indeed possible to inherit power
from the Dragon, then Prince Nedo
is a genuine hope for Acre Selund.

MsgJp: ――が、しかし！
MsgEn: ―― However!

MsgJp:
悪しき竜の傲慢な言葉が許せんな！
おまえたちの見聞が白竜の耳に入ることは必然だ
MsgEn:
Such arrogant words spouted by the Evil Dragon
are unacceptable! It is inevitable
that the White Dragon will hear of this!

MsgJp:
つまり、それは白竜を意識した言葉――
これはわたしの想像以上に厄介な
巻きこまれ方だぞ――うーむ
MsgEn:
I mean, these are words said
with the White Dragon in mind--
This is trickier foe than I envisaged it to be.

MsgJp: 悪しき竜はおまえに会いに来たのだな――
MsgEn: The Evil Dragon came to see you――

MsgJp:
これはフィンダムを巡る出来事を
思い出さずにはいられない――
MsgEn:
This can't help but remind me of the events 
surrounding Phindym--

MsgJp:
あの黒騎士と悪しき竜――
似ているとは思わぬか
MsgEn:
That Black Knight and the Evil Dragon――
don't you think they're similar?

MsgJp: 気になることがあるのだが――
MsgEn: I'm curious about something--

MsgJp:
ネド王子が竜力の継承者たり得るとして
しかしその場合でも竜にその気がなければ
どうしようもあるまい
MsgEn:
With the assumption that Prince Nedo
could be the heir to the Dragon's power...
But even in that case, 
if the Dragon is not willing...
There's nothing we can do about it.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜が好んで王子に竜力を継承するなど
ありえないことだろう？
MsgEn:
Surely, it is unthinkable for the Evil Dragon to
willingly pass on its Dragon Force to the Prince?

MsgJp:
何か別の方法があるのか、それとも
フィンダムの時のような結末になるのか――
MsgEn:
Is there any other way,
or will it end up like in Phindym――

MsgJp:
いやいや、"悪しき竜"は一筋縄では
いかなさそうだ
――うーむ
MsgEn:
No, no, it looks like the Evil Dragon
won't be so simple.
Hmm...

MsgJp: 悩ましいのはそれだけではない
MsgEn: That's not the only thing that bothers me.

MsgJp:
"悪しき竜"がおまえたちにアッカーシェランの
状況を見せつける意図は、ひとつしかない
すなわち、警告――いや予告というべきか
MsgEn:
The Evil Dragon has only one intention
in showing you the situation in Acre Selund,
and that is to warn you... or rather, an omen.

MsgJp: "悪しき竜"と呼ばれてはいても竜は竜――
MsgEn:
They may be called the Evil Dragon,
but a Dragon is still a Dragon.

MsgJp:
そんな気持ちもどこかにあったんだけど
倒しておかないと大変なことになりそうだね
MsgEn:
I had that feeling in the back
of my mind somewhere.
We're going to be in big trouble
if we don't defeat it soon.

MsgJp:
戦局を大きく変える、今がその好機
でも、急いては事をし損じるって言うからね
MsgEn:
Now is the time for a major change 
in the war situation.
But they say that haste makes waste.

MsgJp: おかえりなさい、隊長さん
MsgEn: Welcome back, Captain.

MsgJp:
突破口だ――突破口を開いて
戦局をひっくり返さねばならん
MsgEn:
A breakthrough-- 
we must make a breakthrough
and turn the tide of the war.

MsgJp:
解放軍はまだまだ小さな組織です
しかし増強にはもっと時間が必要です
MsgEn:
The Liberation Army is still a small organization,
but it needs more time to build up.

MsgJp:
となればこの不利を利に変えるような
作戦を立案するしかありませんね
MsgEn:
Then we have no choice but to devise a strategy 
to turn this disadvantage into an advantage.

MsgJp: ここだけの話――
MsgEn: Just between you and me...

MsgJp:
砦に盗賊の親玉がいるなんてゾッとするな
まあ、ここには盗られる物は何もないから
気にすることはないか
MsgEn:
The thought of a bandit leader 
being in the fortress is frightening. 
However, there's nothing here to steal, 
so I suppose it's not worth worrying.

MsgJp:
最終的な結論は俺たちの顔色を見て
決める――そんな雰囲気だなこれは
MsgEn:
Here's the final conclusion.
Look upon our faces.
The decision has been made―― 
This is the kind of atmosphere this is.

MsgJp:
なんだか空気が重いですよね――
どうしちゃったのかな
MsgEn:
The air is kind of heavy, isn't it――
I wonder what happened.

MsgJp:
戦略が決まらないみたいだね
隊長、話を聞いてくる？
MsgEn:
Looks like they can't decide on a strategy.
Captain, do you want to go and talk to them?

MsgJp:
あたしはしばらくここにいるよ
お目付役みたいなものさ
MsgEn:
I'll be here for a while.
I'm kind of a chaperone.

MsgJp:
王子とメイロワを見張っていないと
どんな無茶をするかわからないからね
MsgEn:
We need to keep an eye on the Prince and Meirova,
as we don't know what kind of reckless things
they might get up to.

MsgJp: おぬしたち、頼むぞ
MsgEn: You guys, do me a favor.

MsgJp:
イェルハルド、ジリアンとともに
ロスギル村へ行ってくれ
MsgEn:
I want you to go to Rothgill Village 
with Gillian and Gerhard.

MsgJp:
あたしは王子と一緒にここに残るよ
心配しなさんな
いざとなったら、また一緒に逃げるからさ
MsgEn:
I'll stay here with the Prince. 
Don't worry, if push comes to shove, 
we'll run away together again.

MsgJp:
みんなが留守の間は、わたしが仕切るよ
オークが右往左往する様子を
ここから見物しながらな
MsgEn:
I'll be in charge while everyone else is away, 
watching the sight of the orcs floundering about.

MsgJp:
ロスギル村ってのはイェルハルドの村だよな？
さあ、行こうぜ
MsgEn:
Rothgill Village is Gerhard's village, right? 
Come on, let's go.

MsgJp: 陽動作戦か
MsgEn: Diversionary tactics?

MsgJp:
レスタニアのオークなら確実にひっかかるけど
こっちのオークはどうかな？
MsgEn:
If it were orcs in Lestania, 
I'm sure they'd fall for it, 
but I'm not so sure about the orcs over here.

MsgJp:
敵の野営地に攻撃を仕掛けて
城詰めのオークを引っ張り出し――
MsgEn:
By attacking the enemy's encampment, 
we can lure the orcs from the fortress.

MsgJp:
そしたらこっちはサッと退いて――
向こうが帰ったら、また攻めて――
MsgEn:
Then we'll quickly step back—
once they leave, we'll attack again.

MsgJp: オークを翻弄するのは面白そうですね
MsgEn: Playing mindgames with orcs sounds fun.

MsgJp:
詳しいことはロスギルで話そう
村で待ってるよ
MsgEn:
Let's talk about the details in Rothgill.
I'll be waiting for you in the village.

MsgJp:
展望城への侵入には、王家専用の
隠された通路が使えるはずです
MsgEn:
To enter the Lookout Castle, 
we should be able to use a hidden passageway 
reserved exclusively for the Royal Family.

MsgJp:
残念ながら僕は入り口を知りませんけど
隊長さんが戻るまでには
必ず見つけておきますからね
MsgEn:
Unfortunately, I don't know the entrance, 
but I'll find it before the Captain returns.

MsgJp:
陽動作戦の狙いは頭に入った？
いま一度、イェルハルドから確認してね
MsgEn:
Have you memorized the plan
for the diversionary tactics yet?
Check it once more from Gerhard.

MsgJp:
"嘆きの湿原"と呼ばれる湿地帯には
いくつもの敵の砦があります
西の辺境に睨みをきかせているのでしょう
MsgEn:
The marshy area known as the "Wailing Wetland" 
is home to a number of enemy strongholds, 
which may be staking out the western frontier.

MsgJp:
中でも巨大な"ジフール砦"は敵の重要拠点
物資は一度そこに集められてから
他の砦に運ばれるのです
MsgEn:
The huge "Jifule Fortress"
is a key enemy stronghold,
and supplies are gathered there 
before being transported to the other forts.

MsgJp:
しかし、砦の襲撃は我々の負担も
軽くはありません
そこで、目標を"ジフール砦"周辺の野営地に
限定するのです
MsgEn:
However, storming the fort will not be easy on us,
so we will limit our targets to the encampments
around Jifule Fortress.

MsgJp:
敵は物資の供給拠点が襲われると誤解して
おそらく、オークの大軍を派遣してくるはず
MsgEn:
The enemy, under the mistaken impression
that their supply base will be attacked, 
will probably dispatch a large force of orcs.

MsgJp:
この作戦で我々の目的は十二分に
果たせると思います
MsgEn:
I believe this operation
will more than serve our purposes.

MsgJp:
嘆きの湿原に向かい、ジフール砦の
物資目当てと思わせて野営地を襲うのです
MsgEn:
Head for the Wailing Wetlands
and raid the encampment,
making it look like we're aiming for 
the supplies in Jifule Fortress.

MsgJp: 強欲なオークどもを慌てさせてやりましょう
MsgEn:
Let's make those greedy orcs panic!
Scatter their forces!

MsgJp:
まず、嘆きの湿原と展望城の位置関係を
把握しておかないと
もちろんジフール砦の場所も
MsgEn:
First, you need to learn the location
of the Wailing Wetland and the Lookout Castle,
and of course, the location of Jifule Fortress.

MsgJp:
どこを攻めれば効率良く城のオークを
引っ張り出すことができるか――
MsgEn:
Where to attack to efficiently
pull orcs out of the castle--

MsgJp:
やっぱり現地を見て確認しないとね
じゃあ、向こうで会おう
MsgEn:
I guess I'll have to check it out on the spot. 
I'll see you on the other side.

MsgJp:
集合場所は地図で確認してほしい
湿原へ続く谷と、展望城が見える丘の上だ
MsgEn:
Please check the map for the meeting place. 
It's on a hill with a view of the valley leading 
to the marsh and the Lookout Castle.

MsgJp:
おとり部隊ってのも難しいもんだな
決着をつけちゃいけないんだろ？
MsgEn:
It's a difficult thing being a decoy unit.
You're not allowed to be the deciding factor,
are you?

MsgJp: 湿原、行くんだよね
MsgEn: Alright, off to the marshland.

MsgJp:
湿原って、いい湿原かな
それとも、虫がブンブン飛んでいる
よくない湿原かな
MsgEn:
Is it a good marshland, 
or is it a bad marsh full of buzzing insects?

MsgJp:
さあ、行きましょうか
基本的にはイェルハルドの作戦で良いと
思いますけど――
MsgEn:
Well, let's go. 
Basically, I think Gerhard's plan is good, but--

MsgJp:
現地を見たら事情が変わっていたなんて
よくあることですからね
MsgEn:
It's not uncommon to find that the situation
has changed when you get there.

MsgJp:
ほら、あれが展望城――
それから嘆きの湿原へと続く谷の広がり――
よく見ておいてね
MsgEn:
Look, there's the Lookout Castle--
And the expanse of valley that leads on
to the Wailing Wetland--take a good look.

MsgJp:
湿原への経路には魔物が多いみたいだから
まず、それを片付けて
こっちの動線を確保した方がいいね
MsgEn:
There seem to be a lot of enemies
on the path towards the marsh,
so we'd better clear them out first
to make sure we have a clear path this way.

MsgJp:
それが終わりしだい、湿原へ突入する
本格的な陽動作戦の開始
MsgEn:
As soon as that's done, 
we'll move into the marshland and begin
the full-scale diversionary operation.

MsgJp:
この襲撃で砦を落としてやる！
――そんな勢いで派手に暴れてやろうよ
MsgEn:
We'll bring down the fort with this raid!
――Let's go on a wild rampage
with that kind of momentum.

MsgJp: まずは湿原へと導く経路の魔物退治
MsgEn:
First, exterminate the enemies on the path 
leading to the marsh.

MsgJp:
きっと陽動作戦は何度も必要になるから
消耗は最小限に抑えよう
MsgEn:
I'm sure we'll need to trick the orcs
more than once, so don't wear yourselves out!

MsgJp:
陽動作戦ってのは本来難しいものだが
まあ、相手はオークだ
なんとかなるだろうよ
MsgEn:
Diversionary tactics are inherently difficult, 
but hey, they're orcs, so we'll manage.

MsgJp: さあ、暴れるよ～！
MsgEn: Now, let's go～!

MsgJp:
現地の状況にもよりますけど
ここからは散開して攻めた方が
良さそうですね
MsgEn:
Depending on the local conditions, 
it might be better to spread out 
and attack from here.

MsgJp: こちらの人数を多く見せることができます
MsgEn:
We can give the impression
that we have more people here.

MsgJp:
城への通路が見つかったという連絡は
まだ来ないね
MsgEn:
Still no word on whether they've found
a way into the castle just yet.

MsgJp: 今のうち、レスタニアに帰っておいたら？
MsgEn:
Why don't you go back to Lestania 
while you're at it?

MsgJp:
さあ、どこへ行く？　ロスギル村か
王子のいる砦かそれともレスタニアか
MsgEn:
So, where to? Rothgill Village,
the fortress with the Prince, 
or to Lestania?

MsgJp:
ジリアン、大丈夫かなあ
心配だなあ
MsgEn:
Gillian, I hope you're okay. 
I'm worried about you.

MsgJp:
作戦にケチをつけるつもりはないけれど
陽動部隊は戦果がわかりにくいですよね
MsgEn:
I don't mean to be stingy with the strategy, 
but it's hard to tell the results
of a diversionary unit.

MsgJp:
ご苦労でした
あとは我々でつつき回してやりますよ
MsgEn:
Thank you for your hard work.
We'll keep on poking and prodding them.

MsgJp: なるほど、陽動と奇襲か
MsgEn: I see. Diversion and surprise.

MsgJp:
古今東西、効果的な作戦は
同じということだね
MsgEn:
The most effective operations, 
both ancient and modern, are the same.

MsgJp: 継承を望まぬ竜から竜力を得る――
MsgEn:
Dragon Force obtained from a Dragon
who does not wish to bestow it--

MsgJp:
いったいどのような秘策が
あるというのか
MsgEn: Exactly what kind of secret plan is this?

MsgJp: 陽動作戦か――
MsgEn: A diversion...

MsgJp:
長く続いたオークとの戦争で学んだとおり
奴らは陽動にひっかかり易いが――
MsgEn:
As we learned in the long war with the orcs, 
they are easy to divert.

MsgJp:
騙されたと気づいた時の怒りは凄まじい
陽動部隊が心配だな
MsgEn:
The anger when they realize
they've been duped is terrible. 
I'm worried about the diversionary forces.

MsgJp: それにしてもだ――
MsgEn: But still--

MsgJp:
おまえたちがいなければ
今頃アッカーシェランは完全に悪しき竜と
オークに支配されていたと思わんか
MsgEn:
Don't you think that without you, 
Acre Selund would be completely ruled
by the Evil Dragon and orcs by now?

MsgJp:
しかしおまえたちがいても事の進みに
少しばかりの遅れが出る程度だと
考えているのだとすればこれは良い機会
MsgEn:
But if you think your presence
will cause more than a slight delay, 
then this is a good opportunity.

MsgJp:
白竜の覚者たちの力を見くびるとどうなるか
"悪しき竜"に教えてやらねば！
MsgEn:
We must show the "Evil Dragon" what happens
when he underestimates the power
of The White Dragons' Arisen!

MsgJp: 悪しき竜の、おまえたちを呼んだ目的なのだが――
MsgEn:
The Evil Dragon's purpose 
was to call out to you—

MsgJp:
力の誇示とレスタニアへの恫喝に加えて
覚者の勧誘ということはないだろうか
MsgEn:
In addition to the show of force
and intimidation of Lestania, 
I wonder if it's trying to recruit Arisen.

MsgJp:
レスタニアの、大勢いる覚者の中には
"悪しき竜"の圧倒的な暴力に惹かれる者が
いないとも限らない
MsgEn:
It is not impossible that some of the many Arisen 
in Lestania are attracted to the overwhelming 
violence of the "Evil Dragon."

MsgJp:
そのような覚者を誘い出すための
誘惑――
MsgEn: The temptation to lure such Arisen--

MsgJp:
もちろん、わたしはおまえたちを
信頼しているがな
MsgEn: Of course, I trust in you wholeheartedly.

MsgJp:
――隊長よ
早々にネド王子に竜力を継承させて
わたしを安心させてくれ
MsgEn:
Captain,
let Prince Nedo inherit the Dragon's power
as soon as possible, so I can rest easy.

MsgJp:
我ながらなんとも身勝手な考えだと思うが
これが本心だ
レスタニアを思う気持ちは偽れない
MsgEn:
I know it sounds selfish, 
but it's the way I really feel,
and I can't fake my feelings for Lestania.

MsgJp: 何しろ覚者は大勢いるからな
MsgEn: After all, there are a lot of Arisen out there.

MsgJp:
ひとりくらい、悪しき竜になびく者が
いるかもしれん
ああ、由々しき問題だ！
MsgEn:
There may be one or more that would be swayed 
by the Evil Dragon!

MsgJp: ジョゼフ様が変なことを言い出したね
MsgEn:
Master Joseph started saying something 
strange again, didn't he.

MsgJp:
まあ、僕も気持ちはわからないでもないし
ひとつの可能性として否定はできないよね
MsgEn:
Well, I don't know how I feel. 
I can't deny that it's a possibility.

MsgJp:
君たちが望まなくても、何かしらの方法で
竜力を押しつけることだってできるのかもしれない
MsgEn:
Maybe it can even impose Dragon Force on you
in some way, even if you don't want it.

MsgJp:
隊長さん、お待ちしていました
まず報告です
最初は良い報せから
MsgEn:
Captain, we've been waiting for you. 
I'll start with the good news.

MsgJp:
展望城のオークたちが大きな戦いの準備を
始めたという報せがありました
イェルハルドやジリアンたちの陽動作戦に
まんまと引っかかったようです
MsgEn:
We have just received word
that the Orcs of Lookout Castle
are preparing for a major battle, 
and it appears that Gerhard, Gillian,
and the others have succeeded in diverting them.

MsgJp: 次に――
MsgEn: What's next――

MsgJp:
実は、城に潜入するための王家の通路が
まだ見つかっていません
MsgEn:
Actually, we still haven't yet located
the Royal Passage to sneak into the castle.

MsgJp:
でも、あと少しなんです
城の周辺はたいてい調べ終わって
残りは限られた地域だけ
王家の通路へと通ずる入り口は必ずそこにあります
MsgEn:
But we're almost there.
We've done most of the work around the castle.
There are only a few areas left.
The entrance to the royal passage 
is definitely there.

MsgJp:
隊長さん、皆さん
どうか"秘密の入り口"を見つけ出してください
MsgEn:
Captain, Sers,
please find the "The Secret Entrance."

MsgJp:
すでにメイロワ将軍が探しています
皆さんのことを待ち侘びているはずですから
よろしくお願いします！
MsgEn:
General Meirova is already searching for you all, 
and surely awaits your arrival eagerly. 
Please take care!

MsgJp:
"秘密の入り口"の場所の詳細はわからない
のですが
展望城近くの山間にあることだけは確かです
MsgEn:
I do not know the exact details
of where the "Secret Entrance" could be located,
but it is certainly somewhere in the mountains 
nearby Lookout Castle.

MsgJp:
成人の儀の時に教えてもらえるはずだったのですが
このような事態になって――面目ありません
MsgEn:
I was supposed to be taught this at my 
coming of age ceremony,
but with the situation as it is――
I deeply apologize.

MsgJp:
年寄りはここでどっしり構えてりゃあいいのに
自分で動かないと気が済まないらしいね
MsgEn:
The elderly ought to stay put here, but it appears 
they won't rest unless they act for themselves.

MsgJp:
まあ、あたしも同じだから気持ちはわかるけど
もしものことがあったら大ごとだ
自分がもっと重要人物だということを
自覚してもらわないとね
MsgEn:
I understand since I'm like that too, 
but if anything were to happen, 
it would be disastrous. They must 
recognize how critical their role is.

MsgJp: メイロワ将軍とベルタはうまくやっているようだ
MsgEn: General Meirova and Bertha seem to be doing well.

MsgJp:
わたしもわだかまりは捨てて
うまく対応しなければな
MsgEn:
I too must let go of my grudges and handle things 
properly.

MsgJp:
この感じだと、秘密の入り口は
まだ見つかっていないようだな
MsgEn:
From the looks of it, the secret entrance 
hasn't been found yet.

MsgJp:
このまま見つからないようだと
作戦全体の見直しが必要になるぜ
MsgEn:
If we don't find it, 
we're gonna have to rethink the whole operation.

MsgJp:
ジリアン、陽動部隊で
なんだか、いきいきしていたなあ
もしかしてガルドリンと同じタイプ！？
MsgEn:
Gillian was so energetic in the 
diversionary squad. 
Could she be just like Gurdolin!?

MsgJp:
現状をまとめると
ロスギル村を拠点にして陽動作戦を
展開しつつ――

こちらは秘密の入り口を探して
見つかり次第奇襲作戦ということですよね
MsgEn:
The task is to find the hidden entrance, 
then proceed with a surprise attack 
as soon as it's discovered.

MsgJp:
おお、ご一同！
"秘密の入り口"はこの祠の奧にあるらしい――
ここでしかありえない！
MsgEn:
Ah, everyone! 
It seems the "Secret Entrance" lies deeper 
in this shrine―― 
It can only be here!

MsgJp:
と、そこまではわかったのだが
どうやらこの祠、魔物どもの巣になって
しまっているらしい
MsgEn:
I grasp that much, yet it appears this shrine 
has turned into a nest for beasts.

MsgJp: 隊長、早く戻ろう？
MsgEn: Captain, shall we go back soon?

MsgJp: 久々のいい報せだよ？
MsgEn:
It's been a long time since we've had 
good news, right?

MsgJp: おい、砦まで戻るんだろう？
MsgEn: Hey, you're going back to the fort, right?

MsgJp:
秘密の入り口の報せ
早く王子に知らせましょう！
MsgEn:
The news of the secret entrance. 
Let the Prince know as soon as possible!

MsgJp: 秘密の入り口の扉が見つかったんですね！
MsgEn: You've found the secret entrance!

MsgJp:
では、その先の通路が正しく城内に
続いているのか――
展望城のどこに出ることになるのか
確認しなくてはなりません
MsgEn:
Now, we need to check if the corridor ahead 
truly connects to the castle―― 
We must ascertain where it leads within 
the Lookout Castle.

MsgJp:
陽動部隊との連携作戦は、おそらく一度きり
念には念を入れましょう
隊長さん、一緒に来てくださいね
MsgEn:
A coordinated operation with a diversionary force 
is probably a one-off.
Let's just be sure.
Captain, you're coming with us.

MsgJp:
出発の準備に少し時間がかかるようです
申し訳ありません
今のうちにレスタニアに戻ってはいかがですか？
MsgEn:
It seems it will take a little time to prepare 
for your departure. 
Sorry, why don't you go back to 
Lestania while you can?

MsgJp:
通路の入り口を見つけたことを陽動部隊に
知らせるべく、伝令を走らせたところだ
MsgEn:
I've just sent a messenger to inform the 
diversionary forces that we've found 
the entrance to the passage.

MsgJp:
通路内部の確認が終わるまで
活動を控えよとな
MsgEn:
I'm going to hold off on any activity
until we've cleared the corridors.

MsgJp:
おぬしらには通路の中まで同行してもらう予定だが
まだ間がある
レスタニアに戻って、故郷の空気でも
吸ってくるといい
MsgEn:
I'm going to ask you to accompany me into the 
passage, but there's still time for you to go 
back to Lestania and breathe 
some of your native air.

MsgJp:
通路の行き先の確認なんて
まだるっこしいだろうけどね
あたしたちの稼業じゃ当然の手順なんだ
MsgEn:
I know it's a pain in the ass to have to check 
the destination of a passageway, 
but in our line of work, 
it's a standard procedure.

MsgJp:
ああ、あたしが王子に提案したんだ
悪く思わないでおくれ
MsgEn:
Yeah, I was the one who suggested it
to the Prince; don't think ill of me.

MsgJp:
別の場所で同時に進行する作戦の時間を
合わせるのは大変なことだ
入念な準備が必要になる
MsgEn:
Timing operations that are going on at the same 
time in different locations is a challenge, 
and requires careful preparation.

MsgJp:
通路の行き先の確認なんて、どうせ
息苦しい地下の旅なんだろ？
MsgEn:
Verifying the exit of the passage
is bound to be an uncomfortable journey
in the depths, isn't it?

MsgJp:
今のうちにレスタニア戻って
うまい空気をたらふく吸い込んでやろうぜ
MsgEn:
Let's go back to Lestania and breathe in some 
fresh air while we still can.

MsgJp:
王子の顔を見るとホッとするんだよね
王家に仕えるって、こんな気分なのかな
MsgEn:
It's such a relief to see the Prince's face. 
I wonder if this is what it feels like
to serve the Royal Family.

MsgJp:
作戦決行まで少し時間がかかりそうですよ
いまのうちに準備を進めておきましょう
MsgEn:
It's going to be a little while
before we can launch the operation, 
so let's get ready while we still can.

MsgJp: 戻ってきていいのかい？
MsgEn: Can I come back?

MsgJp:
隠された王家の通路への入口が
見つかったって聞いたよ？
MsgEn:
I heard you found the entrance to the hidden 
royal passageway, right?

MsgJp:
そうか――通路の入り口が見つかり
次は内部の確認か
MsgEn:
Okay, so... we found the entrance to the 
passageway and now you're going to check inside.

MsgJp:
攻城作戦ともなれば慎重に進めねばならぬが
なんとも焦れったいものだな
MsgEn:
In a siege operation, we must proceed with 
caution, yet it is undeniably exasperating.

MsgJp:
まあ、ゆっくり休むがいい
歳のせいだろうが、気が急いてな
含むところは何もない
ただ、早く答えを知りたいだけだ
MsgEn:
Well, take your time to rest. Maybe it's 
my age, but I'm feeling pressed for time. 
I have no ulterior motives; I just want 
to know the answer quickly.

MsgJp:
さて――
次の作戦は、秘密の通路の出先を
探ることだったな
MsgEn:
Well then―― the next plan is to locate 
the exit of the hidden passage.

MsgJp:
おまえたちならなんの苦もなく
やってのけるだろうと思っていたが
考えてみれば秘密の通路など
何があるかわからん
MsgEn:
I think you guys would have no trouble at all, 
but come to think of it, 
there's no telling what you might find 
in the passage.

MsgJp:
何より――
何より、その通路、敵方にとっては
秘密でもなんでもなく、出先には軍勢を
配備していることも考えられる
MsgEn:
Pertinently――
Above all, that passageway is no secret
to the enemy, there may be an army
stationed at the other end awaiting your arrival.

MsgJp:
いいな？
敵に勘付かれぬよう、慎重に進むのだぞ
MsgEn:
Understood? 
Proceed with caution, 
so as not to be detected by the enemy.

MsgJp:
いいな？　慎重に行けよ
今回の目的は、陽動作戦の成功にあるのだ
それを忘れるな
MsgEn:
Is that clear? Proceed carefully.
Our objective this time is to ensure the success
of the diversionary operation.
Don't forget that.

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様は君たち――
君や、レスタニア中の他の覚者を
疑ってしまったことを気にしているんだ
MsgEn:
Master Joseph's concern about you――
About all Arisen in Lestania,
he doubted you so...

MsgJp:
君たちにしてみれば不愉快な話だろうけど
何しろ"悪しき竜"の目的は想像するしか
ないからね
MsgEn:
While this may be an uncomfortable 
discussion for you, we can only 
speculate on the aims of the 
"Evil Dragon."

MsgJp:
こういう想像は悪い方へ行きがちだ
ね？　わかるだろう？
MsgEn:
These imaginations tend to go
from bad to worse, don't they? 
You know what I mean?

MsgJp:
嘆きの湿原の陽動部隊はかなり疲労している
加えて、物資も不足しているようだ
これ以上の兵の増強はできないが
物資を届けてやろうと思ってな
MsgEn:
The diversionary force in the Wailing Wetland is 
quite exhausted, and in addition, 
supplies seem to be running low. 
I can't increase the force any further, 
but I can deliver supplies.

MsgJp:
そこで、おぬしの配下の３人を貸してくれ
悪いが、連中にはもう話してある
後先が逆になってしまったが、許してくれ
MsgEn:
So, lend me three of your men. 
I'm sorry, but I've already spoken to them. 
The order may be backward, but I hope 
you can forgive me.

MsgJp: 通路の出先調査へはあたしも行くからね
MsgEn: I'll go with you to the passageway inspection.

MsgJp:
せいぜい、足手まといにならないように――
しておくれよ
MsgEn:
Just try not to let me slow you down――
please.

MsgJp:
展望城にはかつて幾度となく訪れたことがある
今回の任務はわたしも共に行こう
MsgEn:
I've been to the Lookout Castle many times before.
I'll go with you on this mission.

MsgJp:
ネド王子と物資じゃあ、物資の方が
気い使わなくてすむ
MsgEn:
Between Prince Nedo and supplies, 
supplies are better.
It's easier to take care of them.

MsgJp: 王子のお守り、せいぜい頑張ってくれ
MsgEn: The Prince is a good luck charm, at least.

MsgJp:
物資を届けがてらジリアンたちの様子を
見てくるね
MsgEn:
I'm going to go deliver some supplies and check 
on Gillian and the others.

MsgJp:
イェルハルドたち陽動部隊は、おとりだと
ばれないように本気で攻めているはずです
MsgEn:
Gerhard and his diversionary forces must be 
attacking seriously to avoid being 
discovered as a decoy.

MsgJp: 疲労の程度が気になりますね
MsgEn: I'm worried about the degree of fatigue.

MsgJp:
では、そろそろ参りましょうか
まず、王家の通路の扉を開き――
MsgEn:
Well, let's get to it.
First, open the door to the royal passageway--

MsgJp:
その先がどこに通じているのかを確かめ
突入の際の経路を定めます
MsgEn:
Check where it leads beyond that
and determine the route for the raid.

MsgJp:
展望城の玉座の裏に出るかもしれないし
城内の台所かもしれません
MsgEn:
It could be out behind the throne
in Lookout Castle, 
or it could be in the castle's kitchens.

MsgJp:
いずれにしても敵に気取られないように
少数でこっそり動くのがよさそうということで
隊長、クインタス、ベルタ、僕の４人で動きます
MsgEn:
In any case, it would be better to move 
stealthily and in small numbers so that the enemy 
won't notice us.

MsgJp:
祠までは、隊長に先行していただき
僕は後からベルタと続きます
MsgEn:
The Captain will lead the way to the shrine, 
and I'll follow with Bertha.

MsgJp:
それでは祠に入って
すぐのあたりで落ち合いましょう
MsgEn:
Now, head into the shrine.
I'll meet you just around the corner.

MsgJp: 少人数での行動は緊張しますね
MsgEn: It's nerve-racking with a small group.

MsgJp:
王子を頼んだぞ
その代わりと言ってはなんだが
おぬしの部下たちはわしが守る
MsgEn:
Take care of the prince, and in return, 
I'll protect your men.

MsgJp:
王子は任せな
ふたりであんたの後をコソコソ付いていくよ
MsgEn:
Leave the prince to me. 
The two of us will 
quietly follow behind you.

MsgJp:
後ろにはクインタスがいるから
魔物が上から降ってこない限り――
いやいや、悪い想像はやめておこうか

展望城がオークどもに襲われた時
城にはかなり多くの者がいたはずだ
MsgEn:
There must have been quite a few people in the 
castle when the Orcs attacked.

MsgJp:
彼らの消息がまったくわからなくてな
友人も大勢いたのだが――
MsgEn:
I've had no idea what happened to them. 
I had a lot of friends, but--

MsgJp:
じゃあ、イェルハルドのしかめっ面を
おがみに行ってくるぜ
MsgEn:
Well, I'm off to admire the frown 
on Gerhard's face.

MsgJp: 隊長、ネド王子をよろしくね
MsgEn: Captain, take care of Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
では、ロスギル村まで行ってきます
隊長、無茶しないでくださいよ！
MsgEn:
Well, then, I'm going to Rothgill Village. 
Captain, don't be reckless!

MsgJp:
ここから先は、一緒に向かいましょう
隊長さん、お願いします
MsgEn:
Let us head onward together from here. 
I ask this of you, Captain.

MsgJp:
なるほど、中は魔物の巣窟だな
しんがりはまかせておけ、王子を扉の前へ頼む
MsgEn:
I see, it's a den of demons inside. 
I'll take care of the security. 
Take the prince to the door.

MsgJp:
後ろは任せておくれ
いざとなったら盗賊の本気を見せてやるよ
さあ、王子を連れて先に行っとくれ
MsgEn:
Leave the rear to me. 
When push comes to shove, I'll show you what 
bandits are really made of. 
Now, go on ahead and take the prince with you.

MsgJp:
見てください
これはまさしく僕が伝え聞いていた
王家の秘密の扉に間違いありません
MsgEn:
Look, I'm sure this is indeed the secret royal 
door I've heard so much about.

MsgJp: 今から僕の秘蹟の力でこの扉を解放します
MsgEn:
Now I will release this door 
with the power of my Sacrament.

MsgJp:
この先は城のどのあたりへと繋がっているのか――
さあ、出先を確かめましょう
MsgEn:
Where does this lead to in the castle - 
let's see where we're going!

MsgJp:
僕はベルタ、クインタスと先に行きます
隊長さん、しんがりをよろしくお願いします
MsgEn:
I'll go ahead with Bertha and Quintus.
Captain, please take care of the guards.

MsgJp: では、行きましょう
MsgEn: Okay, let's go.

MsgJp:
さあ、オークが出るか魔物が出るか――
暗いから五感を研ぎ澄ませて行かねばな
MsgEn:
Now, whether it's orcs or monsters-- 
it's dark, so we'll have to sharpen our senses.

MsgJp:
どうだい、この辛気くさい風
のろのろと吹きやがって、幾年も閉ざされていた場所
って感じじゃないかい
MsgEn:
How's that pungent wind?
Blowing lazily, 
like a place that's been shut up for years.

MsgJp: さっさと仕事を終わらせようか
MsgEn: Let's get on with it and get the job done.

MsgJp:
ああ、上手く城内へ通じていたもんだ
そして見つけたよ！　この先だ！
この先がオークひしめく城の上層へと続いている
MsgEn:
Oh, it was a good way to get inside. 
And I found it! It's just up ahead! 
This leads to the upper levels of 
the orc-infested castle!

MsgJp: ほら、臭うだろ？
MsgEn: See, it stinks, right?

MsgJp:
隊長さん、やりました！
ここは展望城、城内の中層です
MsgEn:
Captain, we did it! 
This is the Lookout Castle, the middle level.

MsgJp:
そして、この先こそ、城内上層へと
続くエレベーターのある場所です
MsgEn:
Also, ahead is where there is an elevator that
continues to the upper floors of the castle.

MsgJp:
これで城を突入する際の経路は確認できました
敵に悟られないうちに、引き返すべきだと思いますが
ひとつお願いがあります
MsgEn:
Now that we have identified the route we will 
take when we raid the castle, I think we should 
turn back before the enemy realizes what we've 
done, but I do have one request.

MsgJp:
この城が占領された時、城にいた人々の行方が
わからなくなりました
MsgEn:
When this castle was occupied, the people who 
were in it were lost.

MsgJp:
でも、どうやら、クインタスの進言によると
その人たちはこの城内の地下牢に
閉じ込められているようなのです
MsgEn:
But apparently, according to Quintus, those 
people are locked up in the dungeons.

MsgJp:
もしそうであれば
――僕はその人たちを見捨てることなどできません
隊長さん、お願いです！
彼らを助けてあげてください
MsgEn:
If that's the case--
I can't abandon those people, Captain, please! 
Please help them.

MsgJp:
クインタスがこの先にある
城内地下へと通じる場所へ先行しています
よろしくお願いします
MsgEn:
Quintus is just up ahead.
He'll lead you to the basement of the castle.
Thank you, Ser.

MsgJp:
湿原での陽動が功を奏しているのか
敵の部隊のほとんどは城の城外に
集まっているようです
MsgEn:
Is the diversion in the wetlands working?
Most of the enemy troops seem to have gathered 
outside the castle walls.

MsgJp:
あたしらの常識じゃあ、目的を達した今
これ以上、ここで時間を使うのはご法度なんだがね
MsgEn:
Now that we've accomplished what we set out to 
do, it's not prudent for us to spend 
any more time here.

MsgJp:
まあ万一、見張りの兵隊と出くわした際は必ず
仕留めるんだよ
MsgEn:
Well, just in case you run into any soldiers on 
guard duty, make sure you take them out.

MsgJp:
城の地下には広大な地下牢があると
聞いたことがある
おそらく、この先がその入口なのだろう
MsgEn:
It is said that a large underground prison 
lies beneath the castle. This is likely 
the entrance up ahead.

MsgJp: そしてほら――感じるだろう？
MsgEn: And you see - you feel it, don't you?

MsgJp:
人が息を潜め、耳を澄ましている気配
大勢の同胞がこの先に監禁されている
ああ、間違いない
わたしの友人もいるに違いない！
MsgEn:
Signs that people are holding their breath and 
listening carefully. A lot of our people are 
locked up down there. 
Oh, no doubt about it. 
My friends must be there too!

MsgJp:
急ごう、城が魔軍に襲われてから
既にかなりの時が過ぎている
MsgEn:
Let's hurry. It's already been quite a while 
since the castle was attacked by the Demon Army.

MsgJp:
囚われた人が地下にいたとしても
もう、限界のはずだ
MsgEn:
Even if the prisoners were kept underground,
they should be at their breaking point by now.

MsgJp:
隊長さん、ありがとうございます！
おかげでこんなにも多くの人たちを
解放することができました
MsgEn:
Thank you, Captain! 
Thanks to you, 
we were able to liberate so many people.

MsgJp:
僕とクインタス、ベルタは、この人たちを連れて
王家の通路を使って脱出します
MsgEn:
Me, Quintus and Bertha will take these people and 
use the royal passage to escape.

MsgJp:
隊長さんも、いち早く
ここから脱出してください
MsgEn:
Captain as well, quickly,
you must leave this place at once.

MsgJp:
間に合って良かった――
ざっと見たところ、この地下は封鎖されたまま
かなり日が経っている
MsgEn:
Glad I got here in time-- 
a quick look around shows that this basement has 
been sealed off for quite some time now.

MsgJp:
オークどもめ、ここの人たちのことなど
すっかり忘れてしまったのだろう
MsgEn:
Those orcs, they must have forgotten all 
about the people here.

MsgJp:
見つからずにみんなを助け出すには
好都合だな
MsgEn:
This is convenient for rescuing everyone 
without being noticed.

MsgJp:
あんたのおかげでここの連中は
ぎりぎり飢え死にせずに済んだようだ
MsgEn:
Thanks to you, it looks like the people here just 
barely escaped starving to death.

MsgJp:
さあ、突入経路の確認も済んでいることだし
とっととずらかろうじゃないか
――陽動部隊の情報も気になるだろう？
MsgEn:
Now, we've already checked the raid route, 
so let's get the hell out of here.
--And you're probably wondering about information 
on the diversionary forces, aren't you?

MsgJp:
よもやこんな場所でネド王子様と
お会いできようとは、ぐ、言葉もない――
MsgEn:
I never thought I'd meet Prince Nedo in a place 
like this... I'm speechless...

MsgJp:
――さ、わしよりも、はやくみんなをここから
連れ出してやってくれ
MsgEn:
Now, I'd better get them out of here 
as quickly as I can.

MsgJp: あ、あんたたちは一体誰なんだ？
MsgEn: Oh, who the hell are you guys?

MsgJp:
え？　解放軍！？
俺、本当に助かるのか――
MsgEn:
Eh?　The Liberation Army!?
Am I really going to be saved--?

MsgJp:
うう、王子様ったら
こんなあぶない真似までして来てくれるなんて
ほんと身に余る光栄だよ
MsgEn:
Oh my, the prince has come to do 
such a dangerous thing. 
I truly feel unworthy of this honor.

MsgJp: ああ、許してください、許してください
MsgEn: Oh, forgive me, forgive me.

MsgJp:
わたしはなんでも言うことを聞きますから
どうか――家族だけは見逃してください
MsgEn:
I'll do whatever you say, so please... 
just save my family.

MsgJp:
ネド王子様――
なんとご立派に成長されたことか
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo--
How splendidly you have grown!

MsgJp: アデライデ様、クレス様、ああ、お喜びあれ！
MsgEn: By Queen Adelaide, Queen Cress, oh, rejoice!

MsgJp:
本当にありがとう
もうみんな、ここ数日は食べる物も無くなって
ほんと、ぎりぎりだったの――
MsgEn:
Thank you so much.
We've all been on the brink of starvation 
for the last few days...

MsgJp: う、あっちにいるのは大盗賊のベルタじゃないか
MsgEn:
Oh, isn't that the infamous bandit Bertha 
over there?

MsgJp:
盗賊が俺たちを助けてくれたのか――
だが、もう何が起きたって驚きゃあしないぜ
MsgEn:
So the bandit helped us, huh― 
but I won't be surprised by anything 
that happens now.

MsgJp: お疲れさまでした
MsgEn: Thank you.

MsgJp:
おかげで王家の通路の調査は終わり
そればかりか、消息不明だった城の人々も
保護することができました
MsgEn:
Thanks to your help, we were able to complete 
the search of the royal passage and protect the 
people of the castle who had disappeared.

MsgJp: 次は――いよいよ、展望城への侵攻ですね
MsgEn:
Next up - 
the invasion of the Lookout Castle, at last!

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍たちも戻っています
陽動部隊との評定も終えたようですから
ええ、きっとうまくいくでしょう
MsgEn:
General Meirova and his men are back, and they've 
finished their assessment of 
the diversionary forces.
Yes, I'm sure everything will be fine.

MsgJp:
城から助け出してもらった連中に代わって
礼を言わせてくれ
ありがとう
MsgEn:
On behalf of the people who were rescued from 
the castle, I'd like to thank you.

MsgJp:
わたしの友はオークと戦い、命を落とした
ようだが、その家族は無事だった
それだけでも良しとしよう
MsgEn:
My friend lost his life fighting orcs, 
but his family is safe, 
so let's be thankful for that.

MsgJp:
地下に閉じ込められていた連中は
意気も元気もなくしてまるで屍のようだった
MsgEn:
The people who were trapped in the basement were 
like corpses, out of energy and out of mind.

MsgJp:
今にして思えばそれが良かったのだろうね
静かに、水が流れるがごとくに脱出できた
オークどもめ、全然気づいちゃいないよ
MsgEn:
In hindsight, it's probably for the best that we 
got out as quietly as flowing water, 
the orcs not even noticing us at all.

MsgJp:
おぬしらの首尾は上々と聞いている
しかし、陽動部隊は消耗が激しい
MsgEn:
I hear you have done well.
But the diversionary force is wearing thin.

MsgJp:
あと一度の攻撃が限度だろう
つまり、わしらの機会もあと一度ということだ
MsgEn:
One more attack would be the limit, 
which means we have one more chance.

MsgJp:
エリオットがロスギルに残った
陽動部隊に参加するってよ
MsgEn:
Elliott is staying behind in Rothgill.
He's going to join the diversionary unit.

MsgJp:
エリオット、疲れ切った陽動部隊の人たちに
すっかり同情しちゃって――
MsgEn:
Oh, Elliott, you're totally feeling bad for the 
exhausted diversionary unit――

MsgJp:
まあ、気持ちはわかるな
あいつなら、大丈夫だよね
MsgEn:
Well, I know how you feel. 
He's gonna be okay.

MsgJp:
城の地下で大勢の人たちを
助けたんだってね
MsgEn:
I heard you saved a lot of people in the basement 
of the castle.

MsgJp:
良かったよ――本当に良かった
僕は、つい、そういう人たちと
自分を重ね合わせてしまうんだ
MsgEn:
That was ―― really good
I tend to identify myself with people like that.

MsgJp:
いてもいなくても、誰も気にしないような
そんな人たちにさ
MsgEn:
To those people who are there and aren't there, 
and nobody cares.

MsgJp:
なるほど――
城への突入準備が整ったというわけか
MsgEn:
I see... 
so you're ready to storm the castle.

MsgJp: 順調に城を奪回すれば次は王都メガド――だったな
MsgEn:
If the castle is taken in good time, 
the next step is Megado, 
the royal capital - right?

MsgJp:
ふむ――奪回か
ネド王子が悪しき竜から竜力を"奪回"するまでは
気が休まらないな
MsgEn:
Hmm... recapture.
I won't feel at ease until Prince Nedo 
"recaptures" the Dragon Force 
from the Evil Dragon.

MsgJp:
いかんな――
寝ても覚めてもレスタニアの損失ばかりを
考えてしまう
MsgEn:
I can't--
every time I wake up, all I can think about 
is losing Lestania.

MsgJp:
そのあげく、おまえたちを疑うようなことまで
してしまった
MsgEn: And then I went so far as to question you all.

MsgJp: どうか許してほしい
MsgEn: I hope you forgive me.

MsgJp:
長い付き合いのおまえたちが
思いもよらぬ方法で奪われてしまう――
そう考えたら、たまらなくてな――
MsgEn:
The idea of you and your friends, 
who I've known for so long, 
being taken away from me in a way I never 
thought possible...
I can't stop thinking about it.

MsgJp: さて、次はいよいよ城攻めなのだろう？
MsgEn: So, is the castle siege finally next?

MsgJp:
くれぐれも、気をつけてな
無事な顔を見せてくれよ？
MsgEn:
Take care of yourself and show me a secure 
countenance, will you?

MsgJp:
どうもこらえ性がなくなってな――
これも老いなのだろうなあ
MsgEn:
I'm losing my composure- 
I guess that's just old age.

MsgJp:
レスタニアは平穏無事――とは言わないけど
君たちの手をわずらわせるほどじゃない
MsgEn:
I'm not saying that Lestania is at peace- 
but it's not enough to trouble your hands.

MsgJp:
こっちのことは僕たちでなんとかするから
君たちはアッカーシェランに専念してよ
MsgEn:
We'll take care of things over here.
You guys just concentrate on Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
僕たちの、展望城の地下での活動が
敵に知られて状況が変わってしまうかもしれない
MsgEn:
The enemy might find out about our activities in 
the basement of the Lookout Castle 
and alter the situation.

MsgJp:
――そんな不安があったのですが
どうやら、大丈夫のようです
敵は相変わらず"嘆きの湿原"だけを
警戒しています
MsgEn:
――I had such fears, but it seems that we're fine.
The enemy is still only on the lookout in 
the Wailing Wetland.

MsgJp:
今は陽動部隊からの報せを待っています
――緊張しますね
MsgEn:
Right now I'm waiting for word from the 
diversionary unit.
―― I'm nervous.

MsgJp:
おお、間に合ったか
良かった、良かった
MsgEn: Oh, you made it. Good, good, good.

MsgJp:
様々な条件を勘案し、おぬしらを
待たずに作戦を動かしたものの
実際のところは、おぬしたち抜きでは
心許なくてな
MsgEn:
Taking into account various conditions, I 
considered proceeding with the strategy without 
waiting for you. 
In truth, without you all here, 
I feel rather uneasy.

MsgJp:
いい時に来てくれたよ
まさに救世主だね
MsgEn:
You came at the right time. 
You are a true savior.

MsgJp:
ほどなく出陣ということになるだろうが
ネド王子を頼んだぞ
MsgEn:
I'm sure it won't be long before we're off to 
war, but I'm counting on you to take care 
of Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
イェルハルドたちがどんだけのオークを
城から引っ張り出せるのか――
MsgEn:
How many orcs can Gerhard and his men lure 
out of the castle?

MsgJp: それが勝負の分かれ目だろうな
MsgEn:
That would be the difference 
between winning and losing.

MsgJp: エリオット、ちゃんとやってるかなあ
MsgEn: I hope Elliot is doing alright.

MsgJp: いよいよ展望城へ攻め入ります
MsgEn: Finally, we will attack the Lookout Castle.

MsgJp:
経路は、王家の通路から突入し
城内を掃討しつつ、ベルタの見つけた扉を使い
上層階を目指します
MsgEn:
We'll enter through the royal passageway, 
sweep the castle, 
and use the door Bertha found 
to get to the upper floors.

MsgJp:
出会う敵はすべてなぎ払う覚悟で行きましょう
僕は将軍、ベルタと一緒に行きます
すべての武運が解放軍と共にありますように！
MsgEn:
Let's go with the determination to dispatch all 
enemies we meet. 
I will go with Bertha and the General. 
May all good fortune be with the Liberation Army!

MsgJp: 僕は隊長さんの後方にいます
MsgEn: I'm behind the Captain.

MsgJp:
