メイロワ将軍とベルタが一緒ですから
どうかご安心を
MsgEn:
General Meirova and Bertha are with me.
Please, don't worry.

MsgJp:
強襲部隊の人選はこれしか考えられなかった
おぬしたちが誉れと思ってくれるといいのだが――
MsgEn:
This was the only way I could think of to pick 
the raiding party. 
I hope you guys will consider it an honor--

MsgJp: さあ、頼んだぞ
MsgEn: Come on, I'm counting on you.

MsgJp:
あたしはあとから行って
あんたの取りこぼしを始末してやるよ
MsgEn:
I'll go after you and take care of 
your loose ends.

MsgJp:
何もかも自分で倒そうと無理することはない
いいね？
MsgEn:
Don't force yourself to take everything down 
yourself. Okay?

MsgJp:
留守はまかせてくれ
もしも城を奪回できたら、拠点の移転を
提案しようと思っている
MsgEn:
Leave the watch to me. If we manage to 
recapture the castle, I plan to propose 
relocating our base of operations.

MsgJp: ――頼むぞ
MsgEn: --I'm counting on you.

MsgJp: いよいよ展望城ってわけだな
MsgEn: So it's finally time for the Lookout Castle.

MsgJp:
俺は一足先に、入り口――秘密の扉んところで
待ってるぜ
MsgEn:
I'll be waiting for you at the entrance - 
the secret door.

MsgJp: わたしたちは扉の前で合流ってことで、よろしく！
MsgEn:
We are meeting in front of the door, 
so please take care!

MsgJp:
陽動作戦はこれっきりで使えなくなる
次はないぞ？
MsgEn:
The diversionary tactics will be 
obsolete after this.
There won't be a next time, alright?

MsgJp:
ってことだから、後腐れのないように
大暴れしてやろうぜ
MsgEn:
So, let's go on a rampage so we don't have to 
worry about the aftermath.

MsgJp: 隊長、わたし、どきどきしてきた！
MsgEn: Captain, I'm getting excited!

MsgJp: シュワアッ！
MsgEn: Gaah!

MsgJp: ギ様らッ！
MsgEn: Baz-turds!

MsgJp: ムクロよ！　アッ！　屠れ！　アッ！　貪れ！
MsgEn:
Death! Ah!
Butcher all! Ah!

MsgJp: シュワ！　ジね、ギ様、ジね
MsgEn: Gah! Die, you die!

MsgJp: 俺はムクロ使い、アッ！　ムクロの将！
MsgEn:
Death, heed my will! Ah! 
I, commander of corpses!

MsgJp: まず男からだ！　ジね！
MsgEn: Start with him! Die!

MsgJp: 俺ノ城は渡ザん！
MsgEn: You'll have no passage through my castle!

MsgJp: バハハハ――異国ノ覚者め！
MsgEn:
Bahahaha...!
Pesky Arisen from another land!

MsgJp: 異国ノ男ノ、アッ！　ムクロが欲ジい！
MsgEn:
Outsider! Ah!
I want that corpse!

MsgJp: 異国ノ女ノ、アッ！　ムクロが欲ジい！
MsgEn:
Outsider! Ah!
I want that corpse!

MsgJp: ジジのムクロは川に流ゼ！　アッ！
MsgEn: Corpses of the old ones come from the river! Ah!

MsgJp: アッ！　ムクロに、なりたく、アッ！　ない――
我らの城を取り戻すのだ！
MsgEn: Let's take back our castle!

MsgJp: オークどもを追い払え！
MsgEn: Get rid of those orcs!

MsgJp: こいつを早く倒さねば――この腐臭、城が腐るわ！
MsgEn:
If we don't beat this guy fast - 
this castle will reek of rot!

MsgJp: 出ていけ悪しき竜の傀儡め！
MsgEn: Get out, you puppet of the Evil Dragon!

MsgJp: 骸の将よ、おまえもムクロになるがいい！
MsgEn: You too may become a corpse!

MsgJp: 客人たちよ、戦功には報いる！
MsgEn:
Our guests, you will be rewarded 
for your war efforts!

MsgJp: 退くな！　押せ！　あとひと押しだ！
MsgEn: Don't retreat!　Push!　One more push!

MsgJp: こりゃ骨のありそうな相手だ
MsgEn: This guy's got a bone to pick!

MsgJp: 隊長、押して行こうぜ
MsgEn: Captain, let's push on.

MsgJp: リズ、口閉じて戦え！
MsgEn: Lise, shut your mouth and fight!

MsgJp: メイロワ将軍、無理すんな！
MsgEn: General Meirova, don't overdo it!

MsgJp: 爺さん、俺に任せろ
MsgEn: I'll take care of it, old man.

MsgJp: こいつ、どういうオークだよ！
MsgEn: What kind of orc is this guy?!

MsgJp: ああ――臭い
MsgEn: Ahhh ―― it stinks.

MsgJp: 陽動部隊には負けないんだから！
MsgEn: We won't be outmatched by the diversion squad!

MsgJp: 隊長、今のいい感じ！
MsgEn: Now that's a good one, Captain!

MsgJp: ガルドリン、休んでるんじゃない？
MsgEn: Gurdolin, are you taking a break?

MsgJp: このオーク、気持ち悪いよね
MsgEn: This orc is sickening.

MsgJp: ムクロって、死体のこと！？
MsgEn: He's talking about corpses!

MsgJp: あー、こいつにやられたくない！
MsgEn: Oh, I don't want this guy to do that to me!

MsgJp:
僕の呼びかけで民たちが集まってくれました！
展望城から、希望城へと名を変えた方が
よいかもしれません
MsgEn:
My call brought the people together! 
Maybe we should change the name from 
Lookout Castle to Hope Castle.

MsgJp:
そうそう、オークに破壊された
礎が見つかったらしいですよ
MsgEn:
Oh yes, I heard they found a Portcrystal that 
they orcs busted up.

MsgJp:
職人たちが修繕を進めていますから
今頃は完成しているかもしれません
MsgEn:
The craftsmen are working on the repairs, 
it may be completed by now.

MsgJp:
そうだ、解放の儀は皆さんにお願いします！
礎の場所は――ごめんなさい
僕も知らないので誰かに聞いてください
MsgEn:
Yes, I'll ask you all to do the liberation ceremony! 
The location of the Portcrystal--
sorry, I don't know it either, 
so please ask someone.

MsgJp: 城巡りは終わったのか？
MsgEn: Are you done touring the castle?

MsgJp:
オークどもに壊され、汚されてしまったが
もうすっかり元通りだ
大勢の手があるのは実に素晴らしいことだな
MsgEn:
The orcs ravaged and defaced it, 
but it's all back to normal now.
It's wonderful to see so many hands helping out.

MsgJp:
ここには幾度か盗みに入ったことが
あるけどね――
MsgEn:
I've been in here a couple of times to steal 
things, though――

MsgJp:
大手を振って歩けるようになるなんて
感慨深いよ
MsgEn:
It's so emotional to be able to walk around here 
with a big smile on my face.

MsgJp:
城ってのは、俺にとっちゃあ
取ったり取られたりの戦場なんだが――
元々は、んな場所じゃねえんだよなあ
MsgEn:
A castle is a battlefield where I can be caught 
or killed- 
but it wasn't always a place like that.

MsgJp:
お城ってさあ、やっぱり人が大勢いるのが
いいよね
MsgEn:
When it comes to castles,
is nice when there are a lot of people.

MsgJp:
陽動作戦では、多くの死傷者が出たけれど
みんなこの城の奪還のために命をかけたんだ
取り戻してくれて、本当にありがとう
MsgEn:
We had a lot of casualties in the diversionary 
operation, but we all put our lives on the line 
to take this castle again.
Thank you so much for helping us get it back.

MsgJp:
ロスギルの人たちが癒えるまで
当面はこちらと向こうを行き来するよ
MsgEn:
I'll be shuttling back and forth between here and 
there for the time being, until the people of 
Rothgill heal.

MsgJp: 隊長！　俺、無事戻りました！
MsgEn: Captain! I've returned safely!

MsgJp:
戦いの最中、展望城が襲われたのを知ると
奴ら慌てふためいて引き返していきましたよ
MsgEn:
During the battle, when they heard that the 
Lookout Castle had been attacked, 
they panicked and turned back.

MsgJp:
奪われた城を取り戻さんと、城外は
いまだ敵に埋め尽くされていますが
なーに、ここからです
MsgEn:
We have regained the castle that was taken from 
us, although the outside of the castle is still 
filled with enemies.

But it all starts here.

MsgJp: それにほら、みんなの笑顔、見ました？
MsgEn: And look, did you see everyone's smiles?

MsgJp:
ネド王子と出会う前と比べると
雲泥の差ですよ
MsgEn:
It's a far cry from what it was before we 
met Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
見事、展望城を取り戻してくれたな
わたしからも礼を言わせてもらおう
MsgEn:
You've done a fine job of restoring the 
Lookout Castle to us, and I thank you for it.

MsgJp:
すぐさま城へ駆けつけたいが
この砦を空にするわけにもいかない
MsgEn:
I would run to the castle immediately, 
but I can't leave this fort empty.

MsgJp:
展望城再建に必要な物資は、王家の通路を通じ
順次、運び込ませて貰うよ
MsgEn:
The supplies needed to rebuild the 
Lookout Castle will be brought in one by one 
through the royal passageway.

MsgJp: 城内の散歩はいかがですか？
MsgEn: How about taking a walk around the castle?

MsgJp:
まだオーク臭が残っているという者もいますが
僕にとってはそれも勝利の香りです
MsgEn:
There are people who say it still smells like 
orc, but for me, that's also the scent of victory.

MsgJp:
隊長さんも、僕と同じように
この勝利を満喫してくれるとうれしいです
MsgEn:
I hope you enjoy this victory as much as I do, 
Captain.

MsgJp:
大きな勝利が、守りの気持ちに繋がることが
よくあるんだ
MsgEn: Often, big wins lead to feelings of safety.

MsgJp:
失いたくないという気持ちが強すぎて
攻勢に出られなくなる――
MsgEn:
The feeling that you don't want to go on the 
offensive - you don't want to lose too much.

MsgJp:
道はまだ半ばだよね
王子たちがそうならなければいいけど
MsgEn:
We're halfway there, and I hope the prince 
doesn't let that happen to us.

MsgJp: 大戦にもかかわらず悪しき竜は姿を見せずか――
MsgEn:
Despite the great battle, 
the Evil Dragon was nowhere to be seen――

MsgJp:
奪われた城の奪回――
これが歴史物語であればひとつの大団円だ
MsgEn:
Reclaiming a lost castle- 
if this is a historical tale, it's one big circle.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランの民たちには
その喜びを心ゆくまで味わって
もらおうではないか
MsgEn:
Let the people of Acre Selund enjoy that elation 
to their hearts' content.

MsgJp:
何しろ、戦いはまだまだ続くのだ
文字通りの勝利体験が、士気をつなぐことになる
MsgEn:
After all, the battle is far from over, 
and the experience of a real victory 
is a morale booster.

MsgJp:
そしておまえたちは――
次に起こりそうなことに思いを巡らしつつ
しばしの休暇を楽しむがいい
MsgEn:
And you... 
Enjoy a short break while you ponder what 
might happen next.

MsgJp:
殲滅できなかった魔物の残魂が、
骸の将の力として吸収される！
MsgEn:
The lingering souls of the enemies
that couldn't be completely exterminated
are absorbed by the power of the Necro Master!

MsgJp:
これほど戦況が変化しても姿を見せないとは
悪しき竜め、いったい何を考えているのか
皆目見当がつかんわ
MsgEn:
I have no idea what the Evil Dragon is thinking, 
that it hasn't shown itself even after all these 
changes in the war situation.

MsgJp: ここからの戦略は判断が難しいと思うよ
MsgEn:
I think it's difficult to determine 
the strategy from here on.

MsgJp:
解放軍全体にみなぎる力と勢いを
どう評価するかだよね
MsgEn:
It's about how we assess the strength and 
momentum coursing through the entire 
Liberation Army.

MsgJp:
僕が指揮官なら君たちの活躍を見込んで
次から次へと――
MsgEn:
If I were the commander, 
I would count on your success and send you on 
mission after mission――

MsgJp:
いや、ごめん
現場のことなんて何も知らないのに――
MsgEn:
No, sorry.
I don't know anything about the frontline, 
but――

MsgJp:
悪しき竜も動き出す頃合いだろう
その動向、見誤るなよ
MsgEn:
It's time for the Evil Dragon to make its move.
Do not misjudge its plans.

MsgJp: おかえりなさい、レスタニアの皆さん
MsgEn: Welcome back, Lestanians!

MsgJp:
皆さんのお力添えで見事取り戻したこの展望城を
ぜひご案内したいところですが
MsgEn:
With everyone's help, the Lookout Castle has been 
splendidly restored.
I'd love to show you around.

MsgJp:
まずはメイロワ将軍から取り急ぎ、皆さんに
お話があるそうです
MsgEn:
First of all, General Meirova would like to have 
a quick word with everyone.

MsgJp:
よく戻ってくれた、レスタニアの覚者たちよ
早速だが聞いてくれ
MsgEn:
Welcome back, Arisen of Lestania, 
and please listen promptly.

MsgJp:
展望城を手に入れた我々が
次に目指すは王都メガド――
MsgEn:
Now that we have the Lookout Castle, 
our next stop is the Royal Capital of Megado.

MsgJp:
メガド突入のため
まずは北の地へ侵攻し、足掛かりを作らねばならん
MsgEn:
To enter Megado, we must first invade the north 
and establish a foothold.

MsgJp:
それには城の背後にそびえ立つ険しい岩山を
縦断する必要があり、これは悩ましい問題で
あったが、解決の目処が立ったところだ
MsgEn:
This required traversing the steep rocky 
mountains that rise up behind the castle, which 
was a vexing problem, but one that we are now on 
the verge of solving.

MsgJp:
幸いなことに、城で飼育されていた使役獣が
従順な奴でな、こいつがおぬしらを乗せて
山を越えてくれるだろう
MsgEn:
Luckily, the castle kept a docile messenger 
beast, who will carry you across the mountain.

MsgJp:
北の地とは、久しく連絡が途絶えており
どのような状態にあるか分からん
MsgEn:
We have been out of touch with the north for a 
long time. 
We don't know what kind of condition they are in.

MsgJp:
であるからして、まずは、おまえたちに
先に向かってほしいのだ
MsgEn: Therefore, I want you to go first.

MsgJp:
ジリアンらと行動を共にして欲しい
使役獣の乗り場で合流してくれ
MsgEn:
I want you to go with Gillian and the others. 
Meet them at the boarding station.

MsgJp:
一度にしゃべりすぎたか？
簡単に言うと、北の地に王都メガド攻略の
拠点を確保したいということだ
MsgEn:
Did I talk too much at once? 
The short version is that we want to secure a 
base in the north of the country for the attack 
on the royal city of Megado.

MsgJp:
ジリアンと一緒に行ってくれ
使役獣乗り場は地図で確認できるはずだ
MsgEn:
Go with Gillian.
The station should be on the map.

MsgJp: 使役獣に乗ったことはありますか？
MsgEn: Have you ever ridden on a messenger beast?

MsgJp:
ああ、初めてですか！
楽しいですよ
僕が保証します！
MsgEn:
Oh, is this your first time?
It's fun.
I guarantee it!

MsgJp:
奪われた領地を取り戻すのもいいが
悪しき竜対策も考えないとね
MsgEn:
I'm all for taking back lost territory, 
but we've got to figure out a way to combat 
the Evil Dragon.

MsgJp:
ロスギルの村が落ち着いたから
戻って来たんだ
MsgEn:
I came back because the village of Rothgill 
has calmed down.

MsgJp:
イェルハルド、なんだか若返ったみたいで
わたしの出番はなさそうだしね
MsgEn:
Gerhard, he's kind of rejuvenated again, 
and I don't think there'll be a chance for me 
to be a part of it.

MsgJp:
そしていきなり使役獣さ
久しぶりだから緊張するよ
MsgEn:
And then suddenly there's this beast, 
and I'm nervous because it's been a long time.

MsgJp:
俺たちが行くのはいつだってギスギスした
無愛想な道だろ？
MsgEn:
Whenever we travel, it's always a tense, 
unfriendly path, right?

MsgJp: 今回も、快適にはほど遠いだろうな
MsgEn: This time, too, it's probably far from comfortable.

MsgJp: うれしいな、ついに使役獣に乗れるよ！
MsgEn:
I'm so happy, 
I finally get to ride a messenger beast!

MsgJp:
使役獣はそりゃ楽しみですけど
いったいどんなところを通るんでしょうね
MsgEn:
I'm looking forward to seeing the messenger 
beasts, but I wonder what the hell they're going 
to go through.

MsgJp: もし敵襲になったらわたしを守ってくださいね
MsgEn: Please protect me if the enemy attacks.

MsgJp:
わたし、戦闘には全然慣れていなくて――
ああ、こわい！
MsgEn:
I'm not used to combat at all―― 
it's scary!

MsgJp: なんだか気持ちが悪いぞ
MsgEn: I'm feeling kind of queasy here.

MsgJp:
おまえは平気そうだな
なんだこれは――
MsgEn:
You seem fine to me.
What is――

MsgJp:
使役獣に乗ると、揺れで気持ちが
悪くなる人がいるって聞いたけど
隊長はどう？
MsgEn:
I've heard that some people get sick from the 
shaking when they ride on a messenger beast.
How about you, captain?

MsgJp: さて、ここからどうするんでしょうね
MsgEn: Well, what do we do from here?

MsgJp: もしかして気持ち悪くなったりしてる？
MsgEn: Are you feeling sick by any chance?

MsgJp:
そんな時はね、大声で笑ったり歌ったり
騒げばいいのさ
敵に気づかれたらその時はその時だよ
MsgEn:
When that happens, you know, you can 
laugh and sing and make a lot of noise.
If the enemy notices you, 
that's when it's time to go.

MsgJp: 使役獣の出番はここまでね
MsgEn: So much for the messenger beast.

MsgJp:
ここからは洞窟をくぐって、メガド近くにある
拠点となる場所を目指す
MsgEn:
From here, you go through a cave to a base 
location near Megado.

MsgJp: そこには小さな石塔があって――
MsgEn: There is a small stone tower there and――

MsgJp:
メガドが落城するまでは、王都を守る
警備塔として使われていたのだけれど
今はどうなっているか分からない
MsgEn:
It was used as a guard tower to protect the 
Royal Capital until Megado fell, 
but I don't know what it is now.

MsgJp: とにかく先へ進もう
MsgEn: Let's just move on.

MsgJp:
使役獣はここまで
乗り心地はどうだった？
MsgEn:
Have you had a good ride so far 
with the messenger beasts?

MsgJp:
こんなに長く乗ったことは
わたしは初めてだよ
MsgEn: I've never ridden for so long.

MsgJp:
洞窟を抜け
どうなってるか分からねえ石塔を目指すか――
MsgEn:
We could go through the cave to the stone tower, 
who knows what the hell is going on--

MsgJp:
まあ、獣の背中で揺られるよりは
ずっといいぜ
MsgEn:
Well, it's a lot better than being bucked around 
on the back of a beast.

MsgJp:
次は洞窟だって
中、渇いているといいな
湿った洞窟は苦手なんだ
MsgEn:
Next time it's a cave, I hope it's dry inside.
I don't like damp caves.

MsgJp:
使役獣の活用は、レスタニアでも
検討する価値があるかもしれませんね
MsgEn:
The use of messenger beasts may be worth 
considering in Lestania.

MsgJp:
ふう――
ここにも敵が入り込んでいたか
MsgEn:
Phew...
The enemy has gotten in here, too.

MsgJp:
ぜんぶ片付けてやったけど――
油断はできないね
MsgEn:
I cleaned everything up but ――
You can't let your guard down.

MsgJp: でもまず最初に、ほら、礎を解放してね
MsgEn: But first, look, attune to the Portcrystal.

MsgJp:
ほら、礎の解放だ
忘れたら大ごとだぞ
MsgEn:
Look, it's time to attune to the Portcrystal.
It'll a big deal if you forget.

MsgJp:
こんなところが勤務地なんて
きっと不人気任務だよね
MsgEn:
I bet it's an unpopular assignment to work 
in a place like this.

MsgJp:
ここが王都攻略の拠点になるわけだ
パッとしねえところだな
MsgEn:
So this is where we're going to base our attack 
on the capital, and what a mess it is.

MsgJp:
礎があって良かったよね
使役獣は面白かったけど
一度でじゅうぶん！
MsgEn:
I'm glad we have the Portcrystal. 
The messenger beast was fun, 
but once was enough!

MsgJp: 王子の迎えを、エリオットに頼んだんだ
MsgEn: I asked Elliot to pick up the prince.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍も一緒に来るから
全員揃うまで、ここで待とう
MsgEn:
General Meirova will come with us.
Wait here until everyone's here.

MsgJp:
ジリアンの父親はわしが選んだ娘婿だ
人を見る目には自信があったのだが――
MsgEn:
Gillian's father was my choice for a son-in-law, 
and I was confident in my ability 
to judge people, but――

MsgJp:
まあ、戦向きではない、というだけで
好漢ではあった
MsgEn:
Well, he was a good man, 
just not a good man for war.

MsgJp:
しかし、全滅したと思っていたこの地に
兵が残っていたとはな
ひょっとすると、あてにできるかもしれん
MsgEn:
But I didn't know there were any troops left 
here, where I thought we'd been wiped out.
Perhaps we can count on them.

MsgJp:
父は優しかったけれど臆病もので
戦いからはいつも逃げていた
MsgEn:
My father was kind but timid and always 
ran away from battles.

MsgJp:
それをあちこちから聞かされて
バカにされて――
そのうち父を嫌うようになったの
MsgEn:
I heard it all over the place, 
and people made fun of me for it, 
and eventually I started to hate my father.

MsgJp:
でも――
本当は、大事な時には、誰よりも
勇気を振りしぼることができたんだ――
MsgEn:
But--
The truth is, when it mattered, he could muster more courage than anyone else--

MsgJp:
ずっと誤解していたよ
許してくれるかな
MsgEn:
I've misjudged you all these years.
I hope you can forgive me.

MsgJp: ネド王子、ちょっと逞しくなった気がします
MsgEn:
I feel like Prince Nedo has 
gotten a little stronger.

MsgJp: もちろん、身体じゃなくて、心の方ですけどね
MsgEn: Of course, it's not the body, it's the mind.

MsgJp: 黒い鎧の騎士かよ――
MsgEn: the Knight in black ――

MsgJp:
あの黒騎士なのか？
だとしたら――どうしてくれようか
MsgEn:
Is it that Black Knight? 
If so-- what do we do?

MsgJp:
隊長、違うよね？
あの黒騎士じゃないよね？
だってアイツは――
MsgEn:
Captain, no, right?
Not that black knight, right?
Because that's not--

MsgJp:
きびしい戦闘続きで何度も諦めかけたが――
いや、こうなってくると生きる欲が出てきたよ
MsgEn:
I almost gave up many times because of the 
hard fighting, but...
No, when it comes to this, 
I've got the desire to live.

MsgJp:
ジリアンの父上を始めとする多くの犠牲の上で
わたしは生かされている
この命、無駄にはせんぞ
MsgEn:
Gillian's father and many others have sacrificed 
their lives to keep me alive, 
and I will not let this life be in vain.

MsgJp:
皆さんのおかげで無事に拠点が確保
できました
MsgEn:
Thanks to all of you, 
we have successfully secured a base.

MsgJp:
でも、メガドにいるという黒い鎧の騎士は
かなりの強敵のようです
MsgEn:
But the knight in black armor who is said to be 
in Megado seems to be quite a formidable opponent.

MsgJp:
ここは一度、展望城に戻り
作戦を練り直しましょう
MsgEn:
Let's go back to the Lookout Castle 
and rethink our strategy.

MsgJp:
でもその前に――
ユーリから報告を受けたのですが
この石塔の地下室に、メガドから逃げ延びた
人達が潜んでいるようです
MsgEn:
But first--
I received a report from Yuri.
It seems that the people who escaped from Megado 
are hiding in the basement of this stone tower.

MsgJp: その中にはこの辺りのエリアマスターのドリスも！
MsgEn: Among them is Doris, the area master around here!

MsgJp: ドリスには、ぜひ会って、話を聞きましょう
MsgEn: Be sure to meet Doris and listen to her story.

MsgJp: 拠点の確保は完了しました
MsgEn: The Portcrystal has been secured.

MsgJp:
ドリスとの挨拶が済んだら
一度、展望城に戻りましょう
MsgEn:
Once we're done greeting Doris, 
we'll head back to the Lookout Castle.

MsgJp: 王子の言う通りだ
MsgEn: The prince is right.

MsgJp:
メガド攻略となるとそれ相応の
準備が必要だからな
MsgEn:
If you're going to attack Megado, 
you have to be ready for anything.

MsgJp:
どこから来た？
所属と名を名乗りたまえ
MsgEn:
Where are you from?
Tell me your affiliation and name.

MsgJp:
ハッ――貴方が覚者様でしたか！
ご無礼をお許しください
MsgEn:
Ha - you must be that one, Ser Arisen! 
Forgive me for being rude.

MsgJp:
私はメガド近衛隊副隊長のドリス――
まずは簡単に現状をご報告いたします
MsgEn:
I'm Doris, Vice Captain of the Megado Royal Guards――
First of all, I would like to give you a brief 
report on the current situation.

MsgJp:
王都メガドはアッカー家三代当主キリーク様の治世に
計画された城塞都市であります
MsgEn:
Megado was planned as a fortified city during the 
reign of the third head of House Acre, Lord Kilik.

MsgJp:
我々近衛隊はメガドおよび王族の方々の護衛を
務めておりました、が――
MsgEn:
We, the Royal Guards, served as guards for Megado 
and members of the royal family, but――

MsgJp:
魔軍の襲撃によりメガドはあえなく陥落
近衛隊の大半は今も消息不明、生存した者も
殆どが負傷しています
MsgEn:
Megado fell to the Demon Army, 
most of the Royal Guards are still missing, 
and those who survived are almost all injured.

MsgJp:
隊長であるベイジルについても王都メガド陥落時より
姿を見た者はおりません
よって、この場では私が指揮をとっております
MsgEn:
As for the captain, Basil, no one has seen him 
since the fall of Megado.
Therefore, I am in command here.

MsgJp:
――メガドに竜も王も不在という現状は
おそらく王都が始まって以来の非常事態と言えます
このことがさらなる災いを呼ばねば良いのですが――
MsgEn:
--The absence of a Dragon and king in Megado is 
perhaps the greatest emergency in the city since 
its inception, and I hope this doesn't spell 
more disaster.

MsgJp: 以上、ご質問があれば何なりと
MsgEn:
If you have any questions about the foregoing, 
please feel free to ask.

MsgJp:
ネド王子との無事の再会を、誰よりもいち早く
ベイジル隊長にお伝えしたいところです
MsgEn:
I want to be the first to inform 
Captain Basil about my safe reunion 
with Prince Nedo.

MsgJp: 黒騎士を見たか？
MsgEn: Have you seen the Black Knight?

MsgJp:
俺は長年この仕事をしているが
いやはや――
姿を見たら迷わず逃げた方がいい
MsgEn:
I've been in this business for many 
years, and no―― 
if you see him, you should run away immediately.

MsgJp:
――戦闘で脚を負傷してね
敵がここまで来たらもう逃げることもできない
MsgEn:
--I was wounded in battle.
When the enemy gets this far, there's no escape.

MsgJp:
でもいいんだ
ここで君たちの役に立てればね
MsgEn:
But that's okay, as long as I can be of 
service to you guys here.

MsgJp: 盗賊の時は、メガド潜入は苦労したもんだ
MsgEn:
When I was a bandit, 
I had a hard time infiltrating Megado.

MsgJp:
解放軍になっても変わらないなんて
わたしはメガドに嫌われているのかね
MsgEn:
I cannot believe that being in the 
Liberation Army has changed that.
Megado doesn't like me.

MsgJp: アッカーシェランに黒騎士が現れたって？
MsgEn: The Black Knight appeared in Acre Selund?

MsgJp: ちがう？　どういうこと？
MsgEn: It's different?　What do you mean?

MsgJp:
――ああ
黒い鎧の騎士が現れたというだけで
正体はまだ未確認なんだ
そうか、そういうことか
MsgEn:
―― Oh.
It's just that a knight in black armor has 
appeared, but his true identity is 
still unconfirmed.

MsgJp:
黒騎士が現れたと聞いたぞ？
奴め、生きていたのか？
MsgEn:
I heard the Black Knight showed up. 
He's alive?

MsgJp: どうなんだ？
MsgEn: How is that?

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランに現れたという
黒い鎧の騎士――
MsgEn:
The knight in black armor who appeared 
in Acre Selund--

MsgJp: その者はいったい何者――
MsgEn: Who the hell is that guy--

MsgJp:
我らの知る黒騎士であれば
事態は深刻と言わねばなるまい
MsgEn:
If it is the Black Knight we know, 
I must say the situation is serious.

MsgJp: 覚者たちよ、見極めてくるのだ
MsgEn: O ye Arisen, go forth and seek insight.

MsgJp:
長く決めあぐねていたのだが――
おまえたちの不在がちな理由を
他の覚者たちにも伝えることにしたぞ
MsgEn:
I've been trying to decide for a long time-
and I've decided to share the reason for your 
frequent absences with the rest of the Arisen.

MsgJp:
フィンダムに続いて、アッカーシェランという
新たな大陸と繋がったのだ
竜力の交わりがなんらかの影響を
覚者に及ぼさなんとは限らんからな
MsgEn:
After Phindym, we are now connected to a new 
continent, Acre Selund, and there is no guarantee 
that the Dragon Force will not have some kind 
of effect on the Arisen.

MsgJp:
しかも黒い鎧の騎士の登場は
耳の早い連中の知るところとなった
MsgEn:
And the arrival of the knight in black armor was 
known to all who were quick to listen.

MsgJp:
となれば隠し立てするよりも
皆を巻きこんだ方が協力を得やすい
まあ、こっちのことは任せておけ
MsgEn:
And if that's the case, it's easier to get 
everyone to cooperate than to keep it under wraps.
Well, we'll take care of this.

MsgJp:
いよいよ王都メガドを攻めるのだろう？
大胆に、かつ、慎重にな
MsgEn:
You are finally going to attack the 
Royal Capital of Megado, aren't you? 

Be bold, but cautious.

MsgJp:
よくよく聞けば、黒い鎧の騎士というだけで
我々の知る黒騎士だと確認されたわけでは
ないらしいな
MsgEn:
If you listen carefully, it appears that just 
because he is a knight in black armor it does 
not mean that he has been confirmed as the 
Black Knight we knew.

MsgJp: となれば、まず、その確認を頼む
MsgEn: If so, please check that first.

MsgJp:
素性はともかくとして――
その黒い騎士の登場で王都メガドは
陥落したんだよね？
MsgEn:
Aside from his true identity...
this black knight is responsible for the fall of 
Megado, right?

MsgJp:
戦況を変えるほどの力を持つ騎士なんて
相当だよ？
気をつけてくれよ
MsgEn:
A knight with the power to change the course of a 
war is quite a thing, no? Be careful.

MsgJp:
待っていたぞ
策はできている
MsgEn:
We've been waiting for you. 
The plan is ready.

MsgJp: さあ、軍議に参加しておくれ
MsgEn: Come on, join the war council.

MsgJp:
作戦の選択肢はあまりないのに
人手が足りなくてどれも綱渡りなんだ
MsgEn:
There aren't many strategies available, 
and we're short on people, 
so everything feels like a balancing act.

MsgJp: おい、早く詳しいとこを聞こうぜ
MsgEn: Come on, let's hear the details.

MsgJp:
そういえば、生きのびた兵が
結構いるって話だったよね
MsgEn:
Now that I recall, there were talks about a 
decent number of soldiers making it out alive, 
weren't there?

MsgJp:
黒い騎士はメガドに潜んでいるんでしょうかね
なんだか――静かで気味が悪いですよ
MsgEn:
I wonder if the Black Knight is lurking in Megado. 
It's kind of――quiet and creepy.

MsgJp: 今回の作戦もよろしくお願いします
MsgEn:
I look forward to working with you 
on this operation.

MsgJp:
一気に突入したいところだが
ここはこらえて戦力の増強を優先する
MsgEn:
I'd like to go in at once, 
but we'll hold out and prioritize 
building up our forces.

MsgJp: 具体的な作戦はジリアンから聞いてくれ
MsgEn:
You'll have to hear from Gillian about the 
specifics of the plan.

MsgJp:
悪いけどよ――
真っ黒野郎との戦いに備えて
俺は、６割くらいでやらせてもらうぜ
MsgEn:
Sorry but ――
I'll be working at 60 percent capacity 
as we prepare for the fight with that 
black-clad bastard.

MsgJp:
生きのびた兵の保護が最優先
それでいいんだよね？
MsgEn:
The protection of the surviving soldiers is the 
top priority, right?

MsgJp:
黒い騎士のことが気になるけど――
ま、仕方ないか
MsgEn:
I'm worried about the Black Knight... 
but...
Well, it can't be helped.

MsgJp:
逃げのびた兵たちの士気は
どんな感じでしょうね
MsgEn:
I wonder what the morale of the soldiers 
who escaped is like.

MsgJp:
打ちひしがれているのか――
それとも反撃のきっかけを
待っているのか――
MsgEn:
Are they devastated――
or are they waiting for
a chance to fight back――

MsgJp: うん、俺たち次第かもしれませんね
MsgEn: Yeah, maybe it's up to us.

MsgJp:
皆さんが気にしている黒い鎧の騎士の
情報を集めてみたのですが
MsgEn:
I've been trying to gather information on the 
knight in black armor you all are concerned about.

MsgJp:
文字通り、黒い鎧を着た騎士がオークどもを
差配していたということしか
今のところ、わからないようです
MsgEn: So far, all we seem to know is that there was a knight in black armor literally leading the orcs!

MsgJp: 北の盗賊たちは警戒心の強い連中だ
MsgEn: The bandits in the north are a wary lot.

MsgJp:
たとえ解放軍に賛同しても
表には出ない活動を望むだろうね
MsgEn:
Even if they agree with the Liberation Army, 
they'll want to keep their activities out of 
the public eye.

MsgJp: わたしたちは生きのびた兵の捜索だ
MsgEn: We are searching for surviving soldiers.

MsgJp:
こっちは南を当たるから、隊長は
エリ警備塔から先のエリアをお願いするね
MsgEn:
We'll take the south side, 
and the Captain will take the area beyond 
the Eli Guard Tower.

MsgJp:
彼らが隠れていそうな場所については
エリ警備塔前で待つユーリから聞いてくれる？
MsgEn:
Can you ask Yuri, who's waiting in front of 
the Eli Guard Tower, 
about where they might be hiding?

MsgJp:
生きのびた兵たちを見つけたら
ネド王子のことを伝えてね
MsgEn:
If you find any surviving soldiers,
tell them about Prince Nedo.

MsgJp: 無事で、覚者で、展望城に入ったって
MsgEn:
Say that he's safe, he's an Arisen, 
and he's in the Lookout Castle.

MsgJp:
伝令から話しは聞いたよ
いよいよ解放軍はメガド奪回へ向けて
準備を進めているそうだね
MsgEn:
I heard from the messenger that the 
Liberation Army is now preparing to retake Megado.

MsgJp:
メガドから生きのびた仲間たちは
方々の手で、今も各所で息を潜めているはずだ
MsgEn:
Our allies who escaped from Megado are 
probably lying low in scattered locations, 
aided by various supporters.

MsgJp:
この先のエリアでは、おそらくだが――
この辺りを探すといいはずだ
MsgEn:
In the area ahead, perhaps--
you should look around there.

MsgJp:
全部で３箇所だ――
それぞれかなり離れているから順番に
向かうと良い
MsgEn:
There are three locations in total-- 
and they're all pretty far apart, 
so you'll have to go in order.

MsgJp:
だが、魔軍も彼らを狩ろうと追っている
十分に気をつけてくれ
MsgEn: But be careful, the Demon Army is after them too.

MsgJp:
再びメガドを取り戻す機が訪れるなんて――
想像もしてなかったよ
MsgEn:
I never imagined that I would ever have the 
opportunity to take back Megado in my lifetime.

MsgJp:
ほう、おまえが異国の覚者というわけか
希望をもたらすものよ、噂は聞いていた
MsgEn:
Well, you must be the exotic Arisen who brings 
hope. 
I've heard so much about you.

MsgJp:
わたしの名はキルスティ
この地への助力、礼を言わせて貰う
MsgEn:
My name is Kirsty, and I would like to thank 
you for your help in this land.

MsgJp:
この者たちの他にも、メガドから落ちのびた
兵士はいるようだ
――そうだ、ここから東に進んだ森の方だ
MsgEn:
It seems that there are other soldiers who have 
escaped from Megado besides these men- 
yes, in the forest east of here.

MsgJp:
ああ、おまえの国でもオークは臭うのか
これ以上、奴らを好きにさせる気はさらさらない
早々に御退場頂くつもりだよ
MsgEn:
Oh, so orcs stink in your country too.
I'm not going to let them have their way any 
longer, and I'm going to ask them to leave as 
soon as possible.

MsgJp: ふん、流浪の旅から戻ってみれば、この有様だ
MsgEn:
Hmmm, back from wandering, 
and what do we have?

MsgJp:
メガドを取り戻す作戦が進んでいるらしいな
もちろん、おれも戦うぞ
MsgEn:
I hear there's a plan afoot to get Megado back, 
and of course, I'm going to join the fight.

MsgJp: なに――こんなケガなんぞ、なんでもないわ
MsgEn: What ―― this kind of injury, it's nothing.

MsgJp:
ぼくは敵から逃げたわけじゃありません
ここで指示を待っていたんです――本当です！
MsgEn:
I wasn't running from the enemy, 
I was here waiting for instructions - I swear!

MsgJp: ありがとう、助かったよ
MsgEn: Thank you. That helped.

MsgJp:
ネド王子がメイロワ将軍の元へ戻られたと
聞いたが――
MsgEn:
I've heard that Prince Nedo has returned 
to General Meirova――

MsgJp:
ほう！　やはり本当であったか！
ならば俺も隠れているわけにはいかん！
MsgEn:
Well...!　It was true, after all! 
Then I can't hide either!

MsgJp:
約束しよう
必ず我々で、メガドから敵を引き付けて見せると
MsgEn:
I promise you.
I promise you that we will lure the 
enemy out of Megado.

MsgJp:
まだまだやれるぞ！
ああ、やれるとも！
MsgEn:
We can still do it!
Of course we can!

MsgJp:
おまえは――
なんと、メイロワ将軍の使者！？
MsgEn:
You are...
An emissary of General Meirova!?

MsgJp:
――おう、承知した
陽動作戦、喜んで参加しよう
MsgEn:
--Oh, yes, 
I'll gladly participate in the diversion.

MsgJp:
な、なんだ貴様らは――
なに？　メイロワ将軍の頼み事？
MsgEn:
What the hell are you--
What is it?　A favor for General Meirova?

MsgJp:
――なるほど、メガドにつかず離れず
攻撃をしかけて敵の気を引けば
いいのだな？
MsgEn:
--I see... So, I should just stay close to Megado 
and attack them, to get their attention, right?

MsgJp: ネド王子がご無事だって！？
MsgEn: Prince Nedo is safe!?

MsgJp:
ならばこうしてはいられない
わたしは何をすればいい？
MsgEn:
Then I can't stay like this. 
What should I do?

MsgJp:
たいした腕前だな
おまえがベルタの言う異国の戦士か
MsgEn:
That's some skill you got there.
You're what Bertha calls an exotic warrior.

MsgJp: ――なるほど、いい面構えをしている
MsgEn: ...I see. You have a rather nice demeanor.

MsgJp:
彼らはメガドの住人だ
王都落城の際、敵に見つからず
今日まで身を潜めていたようだ
MsgEn:
They are the inhabitants of Megado.
They were lying low after the fall of the 
Royal Capital, 
undetected by the enemy, until today.

MsgJp:
この隙に、俺が連中を安全な場所まで
送り届けよう
MsgEn: I'll take this opportunity to get them to safety.

MsgJp:
ああ、今は時間が惜しい
すぐに出発させて貰う
MsgEn:
Yeah, time is of the essence right now, 
so we'll be leaving shortly.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍たちがメガドを取り戻してくださる！？
また商売ができるようになるんですね！
MsgEn:
General Meirova and his team will bring 
Megado back! 
We will be able to do business again!

MsgJp:
おお、メイロワ将軍が戻られたか――なんと！？
ネド王子も一緒！？
MsgEn:
Oh, General Meirova has returned―― what!?
Prince Nedo is with him!?

MsgJp:
王子はご無事でいらっしゃったか
おお――胸に希望の灯がともるわ
MsgEn:
The prince is safe.
Oh, my-- 
there's a light of hope in my heart.

MsgJp:
終わりだ――もうアッカーシェランは終わりだ
何もかも失われてしまった――
MsgEn:
It's over―― it's already over for Acre Selund.
Everything's lost ――

MsgJp: なに！？　ネド王子がご無事！？
MsgEn: What!? Is Prince Nedo safe!?

MsgJp:
俺、行かないと！
馳せ参じて、隊列に入れてもらうんだ
MsgEn:
I gotta go!
I've got to get back out there and join the ranks!

MsgJp: ネド王子がメガドを取り戻してくれるの？
MsgEn: Is Prince Nedo going to take back Megado?

MsgJp:
オークや魔物を追い払ってくれるの？
信じてもいいの？
MsgEn:
Will you drive away the orcs and monsters?
Can I trust you?

MsgJp:
上手く生きのびた兵たちを
見つけ出したみたいだね
MsgEn:
Looks like you did a good job of 
finding the survivors.

MsgJp:
南でも、隠れて蜂起の機会をうかがっていた
兵たちの数は予想以上
MsgEn:
Even in the south, the number of soldiers hiding 
and waiting for an opportunity to rise up was 
greater than expected.

MsgJp: かなり柔軟に配備できそうだよ
MsgEn:
It's going to be pretty easy to deploy with 
a lot of flexibility.

MsgJp: ああ、生きているって素晴らしいわ！
MsgEn: Oh, how wonderful it is to be alive!

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍が奮闘しているとなれば
わしもまだまだ隠居するわけにはいかんよ
MsgEn:
If General Meirova is fighting the good fight, 
I'm not ready to retire just yet.

MsgJp:
活躍すれば王子か将軍の目にとまって
大出世も夢じゃない
そう考えれば希望もわいてくるよ
MsgEn:
If you do well, you'll catch the eye of a prince 
or a general, and you'll be on your way 
to a big promotion.

MsgJp:
ネド王子、がんばれー！
――ってつたえてね！
MsgEn:
Good luck, Prince Nedo!
--Tell him I said "good luck!"

MsgJp:
ご苦労さまでした
突入の段取りはメイロワ将軍にまかせて
皆さんはゆっくりお休みください
MsgEn:
Thank you for your efforts, and leave it 
to General Meirova to set up the raid.
I hope you all have a good night's rest.

MsgJp:
どうだい？
北の盗賊たちはやる気満々だろう？
盗賊業の縄張りを見直してもいいって
言ってやったのさ
MsgEn:
What do you think?
The northern bandits are motivated, aren't they?
I told them it's okay to reevaluate their 
home turf in the bandit business.

MsgJp:
あたしにゃ大きな譲歩だけど
アッカーシェランがなくなるよりはマシさ
MsgEn:
It's a big concession for me, 
but it's better than losing Acre Selund.

MsgJp: まっ黒野郎――ったく、どこにいやがる
MsgEn:
That pitch-black bastard―damn it, 
where the hell is he hiding?

MsgJp: ネド王子とメイロワ将軍は凄いよ
MsgEn: Prince Nedo and General Meirova are amazing.

MsgJp:
隠れていた人たちを、名前だけで
奮い立たせちゃうんだもの
MsgEn:
Their name alone is enough to inspire those 
who have been hiding.

MsgJp: 一度レスタニアへ帰りましょう
MsgEn: Let's go back to Lestania.

MsgJp:
あっちの方がよく休める気がしませんか？
やっぱり大地に満ちる竜力が違うんでしょうね
MsgEn:
Don't you feel like you can rest better there?
I guess the Dragon Force that 
fills the land is different.

MsgJp:
隊長、ジリアン
生き残りの兵たちを、よくぞ集めてくれた――
MsgEn:
Captain, Gillian, you've done a great job of 
gathering the surviving soldiers--

MsgJp:
ベルタは北の盗賊を連れて戻ってきた
どう説得したのか知らんが
北の盗賊たちめ、やけに士気が高い
MsgEn:
Bertha returned with the northern bandits, 
and I don't know how she convinced them, 
but their morale is awfully high.

MsgJp:
さて、わしは王子とともに部隊の編制に入る
おぬしらは一度休まれるといい
MsgEn:
Now, I will go with the prince to organize the 
troops, and you can take a rest.

MsgJp:
次はいよいよメガド突入――正念場だ
おぬしたちは戦の中軸に組み込ませてもらうぞ
それまではゆっくり休んでおいてくれ
MsgEn:
Next, we're entering Megado - the moment of truth.
You will be part of the core of the conflict.
Until then, get some rest.

MsgJp:
次はいよいよメガド突入――正念場だ
おぬしたちは戦の中軸に組み込ませてもらうぞ
MsgEn:
Next, we're entering Megado - the moment of truth.
You will be part of the core of the conflict.

MsgJp: それまではゆっくり休んでおいてくれ
MsgEn: Until then, please take a good rest.

MsgJp: 黒い鎧の騎士、未だ姿を見せず――だね
MsgEn:
The Knight in black armor 
hasn't shown up―― yet.

MsgJp:
これは策略かもしれないよ？
だって、姿が見えないことで
僕たちの不安は膨らむばかりだからね
MsgEn:
This could be a scheme, don't you think? 
The more he's unseen, the more 
our worries keep increasing.

MsgJp:
ふむ――
王都メガド突入目前というわけだな
MsgEn:
Hmm...
So, you're on the verge of entering Megado, 
the capital of the kingdom.

MsgJp:
とすれば、噂の、黒い騎士の登場も
近いと予想されるわけだが――
MsgEn:
If this is the case, then you can expect the 
rumored black knight to 
make an appearance soon...

MsgJp:
気を取られて、悪しき竜を忘れては
いかんぞ
MsgEn:
Do not be so distracted that you 
forget the Evil Dragon.

MsgJp:
展望城に続き、王都メガドも
悪しき竜討伐への通過点に過ぎんのだからな
MsgEn:
After the Lookout Castle, 
the Royal Capital Megado is just a stepping 
stone on the way to defeating the Evil Dragon.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランの解放軍とともに
戦う一方で――
MsgEn:
While fighting alongside 
Acre Selund's Liberation Army--

MsgJp:
やはりおまえたちには黒い鎧の騎士を
気にしてもらわねばならない
MsgEn:
After all, you must be concerned about 
your knight in black armor.

MsgJp:
我々の知るあの黒騎士か――
それとも、似て非なる敵か――
せめてそれだけでも知りたい
MsgEn:
Is that the Black Knight we know――
or is it a similar and different enemy――
I want to know at least that.

MsgJp:
いずれにしても王都メガドに攻め込めば
否応なく対峙することになるのだろう

その鎧の中身、しかと見極めよ
いいな？
MsgEn:
You're going to find out what's in that armor.
Okay?

MsgJp:
あの黒騎士が蘇ったというのであれば――
レオも、もしや――
そう思わずにはいられない
MsgEn:
If that Black Knight has been revived ――
What if Leo ――
I can't help but think so.

MsgJp:
黒騎士のことはもちろん気になるけど
メガドを巡る攻防は戦略の大きな節目
MsgEn:
I'm concerned about the black knight, 
of course, but the attack on Megado is a major 
strategic milestone.

MsgJp: この神殿から勝利を祈っているよ
MsgEn: I'm praying for your victory from this temple.

MsgJp:
こっちの準備はできているよ
詳しいことはメイロワに聞いておくれ
MsgEn:
We're ready for you.
You'll have to ask Meirova for the details.

MsgJp:
メガドを落とした黒い騎士の姿を
あれ以来見ていないことが気がかりだが――
MsgEn:
I'm concerned that we haven't seen 
the black knight who conquered Megado since...

MsgJp: 見てよ、この士気の高さ！
MsgEn: Look at this high level of morale!

MsgJp:
戦闘の前の静けさ――
何度体験しても身が引き締まりますね
MsgEn:
The calm before the battle--
No matter how many times you experience it, 
it's always sobering.

MsgJp:
どう立ち回ればいいんだ？
まだなら将軍に聞いてこいよ
MsgEn:
How should we proceed? 
If you don't know yet, go ask the general.

MsgJp:
メガドの敵はオークが中心だけど
結構魔物も入り込んでいるって
MsgEn:
Megado's enemies are mainly orcs, 
but there's a fair amount of monsters 
in the mix as well.

MsgJp:
ついにこの時が来ました
皆さん、よろしくお願いします
MsgEn:
The time has finally come, 
ladies and gentlemen.

MsgJp:
皆集まったな――
では、メガド奪回作戦の概要を話そう
MsgEn:
Well, now that we're all here - 
let's talk about the mission to retake Megado.

MsgJp:
元メガド守護兵を中心とする部隊は
メガド周辺の小塔を襲撃する
MsgEn:
Troops, led by former Megado defenders, will
raid small towers around Megado.

MsgJp:
もちろんこれは陽動作戦だ
騒ぎを大きくして、可能な限り多くの
オークどもを引きつけてもらう
MsgEn:
This is a diversion, of course, 
to create more noise and attract as 
many orcs as possible.

MsgJp:
そしてベルタ率いる盗賊団を加えた本隊は
陽動部隊の動きに呼応して城内へと突入
MsgEn:
Then, the main body, 
including the bandits led by Berta, 
storms into the castle as a response to the 
diversionary force's movement.

MsgJp:
レスタニアの覚者たちも
城内へと進む戦力の要として加わって頂く
MsgEn:
The Arisen of Lestania will also be a key part of 
the forces advancing on the castle.

MsgJp:
個々の力量、裁量が頼りとなる
決死戦となるだろう
MsgEn:
It will be a deadly battle that will rely on 
individual competence and discretion.

MsgJp:
それでは作戦を遂行する
必ずみな生きて再会しよう――
MsgEn:
Now let's carry out the operation,
and make sure we all live and meet again ――

MsgJp: もう何も言わぬ
MsgEn: I won't say another word.

MsgJp:
おぬしたちなら、為すべきことを
知っているだろうからな
MsgEn: You know what to do.

MsgJp:
乱戦になるから同士討ちには
注意してくれよ
MsgEn:
It's going to be a melee, 
so be careful not to hit each other.

MsgJp:
北から来ている盗賊連中は
利害が一致して参戦しているだけだ
MsgEn:
The bandits from the north are only entering the 
war because of a mutual interest.

MsgJp:
誤解されるようなことが起これば
お互い不幸になるよ
MsgEn:
If something happens that could be 
misinterpreted...
We'll both be in a bad situation.

MsgJp: 頼りにしているよ、異国の方々
MsgEn: I'm counting on you, Arisen.

MsgJp: メガドに入ったら思う存分暴れてね
MsgEn:
When you get into Megado, 
go as wild as you want.

MsgJp:
何しろ、どれだけの敵が街の中に
潜んでいるのか見当がつかないの
MsgEn:
After all, we have no idea how many 
enemies are hiding in the city.

MsgJp:
来てます――来てますよ
俺、武者震い来てます！
MsgEn:
It's here―I can feel it! 
The warrior's thrill is hitting me!

MsgJp:
正体はともかく、まっ黒い鎧で
格好つけてるような奴は
大嫌いだぜ！
MsgEn:
I hate those who dress up in black armor, 
regardless of who they are!

MsgJp: き、緊張してきた！
MsgEn: Hey, I'm getting nervous!

MsgJp: たったいま伝令が来ました！
MsgEn: A messenger has just arrived!

MsgJp:
メガド居住層への進入路を
確保したとのことです
MsgEn:
They have cleared an entry route into 
the Residential Level.

MsgJp:
皆さん、よろしくお願いします！
僕はここでイェルハルドの部隊を迎えます
MsgEn:
Everyone, I appreciate your assistance! 
I will be welcoming Gerhard's troops here.

MsgJp:
皆さんはメガド居住層へ！
僕はイェルハルドを待ちます！
MsgEn:
You all go to the Residential Level! 
I'll wait for Gerhard!

MsgJp:
この先の水路の中に、メガドへの進入路を
確保した
MsgEn:
In the channel ahead of you, 
you will find the entryway to Megado.

MsgJp: さあ、行ってくれ――俺たちも続く
MsgEn: Now go on-- we'll follow.

MsgJp:
負ければ何も残らない
これはそういう戦いだ
MsgEn:
If we lose, we have nothing left.
That's what this fight is about.

MsgJp:
さあ、あんたが最後だよ
こっから入って、大暴れしてやりな！
MsgEn:
Come on, you're the last one.
Get in here and go on a rampage!

MsgJp:
ベルタがおまえたちを信頼するその理由――
見せてもらおうか！
MsgEn:
Let's see why Bertha trusts you――
Show us!

MsgJp:
隊長、レスタニアから人が来ています
隊長さんを探しています
MsgEn:
Captain, there are people from Lestania 
looking for you, Ser.

MsgJp:
それから！
メガドで何が起こったんですか！？
MsgEn: After that! What occurred in Megado!?

MsgJp: 将軍とジリアンがしんがりを引き継いだ
MsgEn:
The General and Gillian have taken command of 
the rear guard.

MsgJp:
あいつらのことだ
首尾良く撤退してくるだろうが――
くそっ！　いったい何が起こってるんだ？
MsgEn:
They're gonna make a successful retreat, but...
Shit!　What the hell is going on?

MsgJp: 隊長、ファビオが来てる！
MsgEn: Captain, Fabio is here!

MsgJp:
きっとレスタニアで――痛ッ！
あ、頭が痛い！？
MsgEn:
I'm sure it's in Lestania ―― Ow!
Ah, my head hurts!?

MsgJp:
隊長、具合はどうです？
つらいってほどじゃないけど
この感じは――初めてです
MsgEn:
Captain, how are you feeling? 
It's not bad, but I've never felt this way before.

MsgJp: 話している時間が惜しい、一緒に戻ってくれ！
MsgEn:
I don't have time to talk, 
just come back with me!

MsgJp: 白竜神殿に敵襲だ、黒騎士が現れた！
MsgEn:
It's an enemy attack on the White Dragon Temple, 
the Black Knight has appeared!

MsgJp:
おい、早く戻るぞ！
黒騎士は白竜神殿だ！
MsgEn:
Come on, let's get back to it!
The Black Knight is in the White Dragon Temple!

MsgJp:
隊長、急がないと！
この胸騒ぎ――
MsgEn:
Captain, we must hurry!
The feeling in my chest--

MsgJp:
急いでレスタニアへ帰りましょう！
白竜様の――いえ、レスタニアの一大事です！
MsgEn:
Let's hurry back to Lestania!
It's a serious matter for the White Dragon - 
no, it's a crucial matter for Lestania!

MsgJp:
隊長さん！
ここは僕らに任せて行ってください！
MsgEn:
Captain!
Please leave this up to us!

MsgJp:
神殿で好き勝手にされて――
逃げられて――ああ、最悪だ！
MsgEn:
They did what they wanted in the temple―― 
they got away with it―― 
oh, that's the worst!

MsgJp: おい、白竜の容態は！？
MsgEn: Hey, what's White Dragon's condition!?

MsgJp: どうしよう――どうしよう隊長！
MsgEn: What should I do―― what should I do, Captain!

MsgJp:
咄嗟にあんたを呼びに行ったけど
おれも残って戦うべきだったのか――
MsgEn:
I ran for you as soon as I could, 
but I don't know if I should have 
stayed and fought--

MsgJp:
そうすれば白竜はこんなことにならずに――
くっ、判断を誤ったのか！？
MsgEn:
Then the White Dragon wouldn't have had to--
Damn, I must have misjudged!

MsgJp:
さあ、急ごう！
まず、白竜様の容態を確認するんだ
そして、何ができるか考えよう！
MsgEn:
Come on, let's hurry!
First, let's check on Lord White Dragon's condition 
and see what we can do!

MsgJp:
白竜よ、いったいどうすれば――
我々にできることはありますか？
MsgEn:
White Dragon, what should we do―― 
Is there something we can do for you?

MsgJp: 不覚――
MsgEn: Alas――

MsgJp:
この傷――如何ほどの痛手か――
竜力の流出――計り知れぬ――
MsgEn:
This wound――
what a painful toll it dost extract――
The flow of dragon force――
untold and vast――

MsgJp:
黒騎士め――
あやつの狙いは我にあったとは――
MsgEn:
That dark knight―― 
His designs were set upon my self――

MsgJp: すべてはこのためであったか――
MsgEn: Is it all for this end that it hath been――

MsgJp:
白竜の傷は深く、深刻な状況だ
竜力の流出はなはだしく
自然治癒はおそらく難しい
MsgEn:
The White Dragon's wounds are deep and serious, 
and the drain of Dragon Force is so great that 
natural healing will likely be difficult.

MsgJp:
しかも、巡る竜力が消えてしまえば
大地は枯れ果て――
MsgEn:
Moreover, 
if the Dragon's circulating power disappears...
The land will wither and die.

MsgJp:
いや、それよりも先に、おまえたち覚者に
影響が及ぶはずだ
覚者と白竜の絆は竜力によるもの
だからな
MsgEn:
No, before that,
it should have an effect on you, the Arisen.
The bond between the Arisen and 
the White Dragon is based on Dragon Force.

MsgJp:
ともあれ、急ぎ、その擬竜を探して
竜力を白竜の元へと持ち帰ってくれ
MsgEn:
Anyway, hurry up and find that pseudo-dragon and 
bring the Dragon Force back to the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
擬竜を探して、竜力を調達し
白竜の傷ついた身体に注ぐのだ
MsgEn:
Find the pseudo-dragon, procure Dragon Force, 
and pour it into the White Dragon's wounded body.

MsgJp: 効果に期待しようではないか
MsgEn: Let's hope it works.

MsgJp:
君たち覚者の力は白竜あってのもの
優先すべきは白竜様の回復だよ？
MsgEn:
The power of you Arisen is only possible because 
of the White Dragon, so your priority should be 
the recovery of Lord White Dragon, right?

MsgJp: ごめん、言うまでもないよね
MsgEn: Sorry, I don't need to tell you.

MsgJp: ――この傷は――深い――
MsgEn: ――This wound――doth cut deep――

MsgJp: 我が身――滅する明日も――あり得る――
MsgEn:
It may come to pass――
that I perish on the morrow――

MsgJp:
擬竜んところ行くんだろ？
だったら、禊の神殿だな？
MsgEn:
You're going to the location of the pseudo 
dragon, right?
If so, it's the Temple of Purification, right?

MsgJp: 隊長、わたし、思ったより辛いかも――
MsgEn:
Captain, 
I think I'm having a harder time than I thought――

MsgJp: 頭が――痛くて――重くて――
MsgEn: My head... hurts... it ――

MsgJp: 急ぎましょう隊長
MsgEn: Let's hurry, Captain.

MsgJp:
俺たちまで動けなくなったら
レスタニアは大変なことになります
MsgEn:
If we're getting immobilized too, 
Lestania will be in big trouble.

MsgJp:
ブラッドオーブ探しはもちろんだが
騎士団は大勢いる
MsgEn:
There are plenty of Knights, of course, 
looking for Blood Orbs.

MsgJp:
できそうなことがあれば言ってくれ
なんでもする用意がある
MsgEn:
If there's anything I can do, just let me know, 
and I'm ready to do whatever it takes.

MsgJp:
俺が――もっとうまく立ち回っていれば
白竜様は――くそっ
MsgEn:
If I―― if I had fought better...
Lord White Dragon―― damn it...

MsgJp: 白竜様、大丈夫だよね？　よくなるよね？
MsgEn:
Lord White Dragon, you're fine, right? 
It'll get better, right?

MsgJp:
よその大陸から来た騎士が神殿まで
入ってくるなんて
MsgEn:
I can't believe a knight from another continent 
could invade the temple.

MsgJp: なんて怖ろしい時代なのかしらね
MsgEn: What a frightful time we live in.

MsgJp:
俺たちも戻りましょう
ここには何もありません
MsgEn:
We should go back too. 
There's nothing here.

MsgJp:
リズは任せて――
胸を張ってそう言えたらいいのだけれど――
MsgEn:
I'll take care of Lise――
I wish I could say that with all my heart――

MsgJp: リズ、頑張れ――頑張れ！
MsgEn: Lise, hang in there -- hang in there!

MsgJp:
もう地味にブラッドオーブを
探すしかねえのかね――
MsgEn:
I guess we'll just have to be realistic and look 
for the Blood Orbs now――

MsgJp:
リズはいつも明るいから
こうなると余計に――はぁ
MsgEn:
Lise is always cheerful, so when this happens, 
it makes it even more--haha.

MsgJp: 隊長さん、お願い
MsgEn: Captain, please.

MsgJp:
リズやガルドリン――覚者さんたちみんなが
良くなる方法を探して
急いで探して！
MsgEn:
Lise, Gurdolin, and the rest of the Arisen 
are all trying to find a cure. 
Please hurry and help them find a way!

MsgJp:
ガルドリンは意識を取り戻しましたが
そのまま診療所に預けてきました
MsgEn:
Gurdolin regained consciousness, 
but we left him at the infirmary.

MsgJp: 隊長と俺でなんとかするしかありませんよ
MsgEn: The captain and I will just have to make do.

MsgJp:
リズはまるで深い眠りの中にいるみたい
話しかけても揺らしても目覚めないの
MsgEn:
It's like Liz is in a deep sleep, 
and no matter how much I talk to her or shake her, 
she just won't wake up.

MsgJp:
黒騎士がアッカーシェランに現れたのは
君たちを引きつけるためだろうね
MsgEn:
I'm guessing the Black Knight showed up in 
Acre Selund to draw you all away.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜の思惑が先か、黒騎士が先か
なんとも言えないけど――
MsgEn:
It's hard to say whether the Evil Dragon's 
intentions came first or the Black Knight did.

MsgJp:
幸いブラッドオーブは次々と
運び込まれている
MsgEn: Fortunately, the blood orbs keep coming in.

MsgJp:
しかし、効果はさほどでもないようだ
なんとも歯がゆいぞ！
MsgEn:
However, the impact appears to be minimal. 
How vexing this feels!

MsgJp:
まだ――竜力は巡っているか？
今のうちに――ぞんぶんに――
MsgEn:
Doth―― 
the dragon force yet course through the land? 
Whilst it flows――thou must make use of it――

MsgJp:
かつて白竜が、黄金竜との戦いで
傷ついた時――
MsgEn:
In the past, when the White Dragon was wounded 
in battle with the Golden Dragon--

MsgJp:
白竜の力は衰え
その結果、悪しき魔物が力をつけた
MsgEn:
The White Dragon's power waned, 
and as a result, the evil fiend gained strength.

MsgJp:
幸いにして覚者、騎士団の献身により
白竜は命を繋ぎ、事なきを得たが――
MsgEn:
Fortunately, thanks to the dedication of the 
Arisen and the Knights, the White Dragon 
survived and was brought back to life.

MsgJp:
はて、今回はどうであろうな
覚者が次々と倒れているという報告が
舞い込んできている
MsgEn:
But, what about this time?
Reports are pouring in that the Arisen 
are collapsing one by one.

MsgJp:
竜が死に、力が継承されなければ
世界は滅ぶと考えられているが――
MsgEn:
It is believed that if the Dragon dies and his 
power is not passed on, the world will perish――

MsgJp:
ああしかし、これが狙いだったとは！
悔しい――不覚だ！
MsgEn:
Ah, but I didn't know this was their aim!
It is frustrating--I was so unaware!

MsgJp:
相談がある
実はな、フィンダムからの使者が来て
族長ガラダからの伝言を置いていった
MsgEn:
I need to talk to you. 
Actually, a messenger from Phindym came and left 
a message from Chief Gearóid.

MsgJp:
なんでも、精霊竜セシリーに
目覚めの予兆があるというのだ
MsgEn: The spirit dragon Cecily shows signs of awakening.

MsgJp:
白竜が危うい状態が続いており
覚者達の力も下がる一方――
こんな状態でよその竜など構っては
いられない――
MsgEn:
The White Dragon continues to be in danger, 
and the power of the Arisen is declining... 
We can't afford to worry about other Dragons in a 
situation like this...

MsgJp:
そう思い、黙殺していたのだが
白竜の危機に呼応するように
精霊竜が目覚めることに意味があるやもしれず
――そこに気づくべきだったと思い至ってな
MsgEn:
I thought so, and kept quiet about it, 
but then I realized that the awakening of the 
Spirit Dragon might be in response to the crisis 
of the White Dragon, 
and that I should have noticed it.

MsgJp:
動ける者を連れてフィンダムへ
渡ってくれんか？
MsgEn:
Will you please cross over to Phindym with anyone 
who is able to move?

MsgJp:
精霊竜の目覚めに立ち会い
白竜の窮状を訴えてくれ
MsgEn:
Witness the awakening of the Spirit Dragon, 
and speak of the plight of the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
エリオットは元気そうだったぞ
フィンダムに連れて行ってくれ
MsgEn: Elliot looked fine, take him to Phindym.

MsgJp: ミシアル――ミシアル――
MsgEn: Mysial―― Mysial――

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様がやっと考えを変えてくれたよ
僕は最初から進言していたんだ
MsgEn:
Master Joseph has finally changed his mind. 
I've been telling him from the very beginning.

MsgJp:
白竜様が危機的な状況の時に
竜になったセシリーが目覚めるだなんて
偶然だとしたら出来すぎだろう？
MsgEn:
Wouldn't it be too much of a coincidence that 
Cecily, in dragon form, would awaken at a time 
when Lord White Dragon is in dire straits?

MsgJp: いや、偶然と考える方がどうかしているよね
MsgEn: No, it's crazy to think it's a coincidence.

MsgJp:
吉兆、凶兆、どちらかはわからないけど
セシリーと君たちの結びつきを考えると
良い報せだと、僕は信じるよ
MsgEn:
I don't know if it's a good omen or a bad omen, 
but given your connection to Cecily, 
I believe it's good news.

MsgJp:
隊長、フィンダムへ行きましょう
黒騎士や悪しき竜が何をしたって
これ以上悪いことにはなりませんよ？
MsgEn:
Captain, let's go to Phindym. 
Whatever the Black Knight or that vile Dragon 
may try, it can't get worse than this, can it?

MsgJp:
ああ、セシリーが目を覚ますらしいってのに
俺もいつまでも寝てられねえぜ
MsgEn:
Yeah, I thought Cecily might wake up.
I can't sleep forever either.

MsgJp:
身体はまだまだだが
――まあなんとかなるだろうよ
MsgEn:
My body's not quite up to snuff yet, but...
--I'm sure we'll manage.

MsgJp: リズはまだ眠っているよ
MsgEn: Lise is still sleeping.

MsgJp:
色々な薬を試したのだけど
全然効果がなくて――
MsgEn:
I tried all kinds of medicines, 
but they didn't work at all――

MsgJp:
よく来てくれた――
精霊竜は、芯なる樹から力を授る間
長き眠りにつくならわしなのだが――
MsgEn:
Welcome--
It is customary for a Spirit Dragon to lie 
dormant for a long time while the 
Core Tree gives it power...

MsgJp:
驚いたことに
セシリーに目覚めの兆しが現れたのだ
MsgEn:
Surprisingly,
Cecily already showed signs of waking up.

MsgJp:
しかし、それっきり状況は変わらない
セシリーはまだ目を閉じたままだ
MsgEn:
But things didn't change again. 
Cecily's eyes are still closed.

MsgJp:
おそらく、常ならぬ目覚めに必要な
あと少しの竜力が足りないのであろう
MsgEn:
Possibly, for this abnormal awakening, 
what's missing is a bit more dragon force.

MsgJp:
フィンダム大陸にいにしえより存在する塔――
その中には長い歳月を経て溜めこまれた
竜力が存在する
MsgEn:
A tower that has existed on the continent of 
Phindym since time immemorial-- 
inside it exists Dragon Force that has been 
accumulated over many years.

MsgJp:
アデルドナハの元を訪ね、その竜力の解放に
どうか力を貸してもらえないだろうか
MsgEn:
Please visit Adair Donnchadh and help him to 
release this Dragon Force.

MsgJp:
こんなつもりで来てもらったのでは
なかったのだが――
MsgEn:
This was not what I had intended for 
you to come to me for--

MsgJp:
アデルドナハの元を訪ね、その竜力の解放に
どうか力を貸してもらえないだろうか
MsgEn:
Please visit Adair Donnchadh and help him to 
release this Dragon Force.

MsgJp: また力を借りることになるとは面目ない
MsgEn: I'm sorry to have to ask for your help again.

MsgJp:
ガラダから話は聞いた
セシリーの目覚めのために
平原の塔の竜力を解放するらしいな
MsgEn:
Gearóid told me about it.
I heard you're going to release the Dragon Force 
in the tower on the plain to awaken Cecily.

MsgJp:
塔の入口は解放されているが
中の様子は分からない
じゅうぶんに気をつけるがいい
MsgEn:
The entrance to the tower is open, 
but we don't know what's inside. 
Be very careful.

MsgJp:
塔の入口は解放してある
中に入る時は気をつけてくれ
MsgEn:
The entrance to the tower is open. 
Be careful.

MsgJp:
レスタニアの白竜に大変なことが
起こったと聞いている
MsgEn:
I've heard that something terrible has happened 
to the White Dragon in Lestania.

MsgJp:
そして呼応するようなセシリーの目覚めの兆し
無関係とは思えんな
MsgEn:
And the corresponding signs of Cecily's 
awakening, I don't think they're unrelated.

MsgJp:
セシリーの、この目覚め――
フィンダムの未来に禍根を残さぬようにと
祈るしかないな
MsgEn:
This awakening of Cecily's--
I can only hope that it won't be a blight 
on the future of Phindym.

MsgJp:
ふむ――
塔の竜力は解放されたようだな
MsgEn:
Hmmm-- 
it seems the Dragon Force in the tower 
has been released.

MsgJp:
しかしまだ目覚めないということは
竜力が足りていないのであろう
MsgEn:
But if she hasn't woken up yet, 
it's probably because she doesn't have 
enough Dragon Force.

MsgJp:
実はな
そちらで魔赤島と呼ばれている孤島――
かつてフィンダムより切り離されたその地にも
塔は存在するのだ
MsgEn:
As a matter of fact.
On the isolated island you call Bloodbane Isle...
There is also a tower on that island, 
which was once cut off from Phindym.

MsgJp: すまぬが、その塔の竜力も解放してほしい
MsgEn:
I'm sorry, but I want you to release that tower's 
Dragon Force too.

MsgJp:
セシリーがこれほど早く、目覚めの兆しを
見せたことには何か特別な理由があるに違いない――
MsgEn:
There must be some special reason for Cecily to 
show signs of awakening so early--
and it is a good thing that she did.

MsgJp:
わたしの心に働きかけてあなたたちを呼ぶように
命じたのは、他でもないセシリーだ――とな
MsgEn:
Cecily is the one who worked through my 
heart to command me to call you― 
 or so it seems.

MsgJp: セシリーは今のままでは目覚めることができない
MsgEn: Cecily can't wake up as she is now.

MsgJp:
助けが必要だと気づいた時に
真っ先に思い浮かべたのはあなたの顔だった
MsgEn:
Your face was the first thing I thought of when 
I realized I needed help.

MsgJp: それはセシリーの意志かもしれないぞ？
MsgEn: That might be Cecily's will, right?

MsgJp:
あなたたちのおかげでフィンダムはずっと
落ち着いた日々が続いていた
MsgEn:
Thanks to you and your friends, 
Phindym has remained calm all this time.

MsgJp:
だから突然慌ただしくなっても
我々は右往左往するばかりだ
MsgEn:
So when things suddenly grow chaotic, 
all we can do is run around in confusion.

MsgJp: 隊長、案の定ですよ
MsgEn: Captain, you get the idea.

MsgJp:
ガルドリンが、ジッとしていられるかって――
結局、ここまで来ちゃいました
MsgEn:
Gurdolin couldn't sit still― 
In the end, he came all the way here.

MsgJp:
セシリーはまだ起きねえのか？
だったら、叩き起こしてやろうぜ
MsgEn:
Cecily still ain't up yet?
Then let's give her a good wake-up call.

MsgJp: ああ、早かったな
MsgEn: Oh, that was fast.

MsgJp:
フィンダムから連絡を受け
おおよその事情は把握している
MsgEn:
Phindym contacted me, 
and I have a rough idea of what's going on.

MsgJp:
目的とされる塔の入り口はこじ開けたが
中に入るのはお前が初めてだ
MsgEn:
I've pried open the entrance to the tower you're 
supposed to be in, but you're the first to go inside.

MsgJp:
心許ない話だが
内部がどうなっているか、手掛かりはない
十分注意してくれ
MsgEn:
I know it's a bit disconcerting, 
but we don't have a clue what's going on inside, 
so be very careful.

MsgJp:
塔の中に魔物が入り込んでいる痕跡があります
気をつけて下さい
MsgEn:
There are traces of monsters entering the tower.
Please be careful.

MsgJp:
この島でも、動ける覚者は半数にも
満たなくなりました
MsgEn:
Even on this island, less than half of the 
Arisen population is able to move.

MsgJp: もはや白竜様を救う手立てはないのでしょうか
MsgEn:
Is there no longer any way to save 
Lord White Dragon?

MsgJp:
首尾はどうだ？
精霊竜の目覚めが、レスタニアの破滅の回避に
うまくつながってくれればいいんだがな
MsgEn:
Did it go well?
I hope the awakening of the Spirit Dragon 
will lead to the averting of Lestania's doom.

MsgJp:
おお、首尾良く、問題を解決したようだな
私からも礼を申し上げたい
――本当に助かったよ
MsgEn:
Well, it looks like you've successfully solved 
the problem, and I'd like to thank you for that.
--You've been a big help.

MsgJp: あなたたちも感じることができるだろうか
MsgEn: I wonder if you can feel it too.

MsgJp:
この始まりの洞が力強く竜力を巡らせ――
いやいや、それどころではなかったな
MsgEn:
Here at the Hollow of Beginnings, 
powerful Dragon Force now circulates...
Nay, it's truly has never been so.

MsgJp:
さあ、わたしなんかよりもセシリーに
話しかけてやってくれ
MsgEn: Go ahead, talk to Cecily instead of me.

MsgJp:
隊長、さあ
セシリーの近くへ行きましょう
MsgEn:
Captain, come on.
Let's get closer to Cecily.

MsgJp:
ここはなんだ――おかしなもんだな
ちょっと調子がいいみたいだ
MsgEn:
What is this place-- it's crazy.
I think I'm feeling a little better.

MsgJp: ああ――澄んだ竜力を感じるぜ
MsgEn: Yeah--I can feel the pure Dragon Force in the air.

MsgJp:
セシリーはレスタニアとあなたたちのために
ひとときの竜力を使い――
巫女と巡り合わせたというわけか
MsgEn:
Cecily used her Dragon Force for a moment to help 
Lestania and you...
Guiding you to the priestess.

MsgJp:
時間がないようだから、早く行きなさい
この災難が落ち着いたら、ゆっくり話そう
MsgEn:
Since you don't seem to have much time, 
you'd better get going, 
and when this mishap is over, 
we'll have a long talk.

MsgJp: あなたたちの勝利を信じて待っているよ
MsgEn: I believe in you and await your victory.

MsgJp:
セシリーは再び眠りについたようだ
我々の竜は問いかけに答えることなく
眠り続けるばかり
MsgEn:
Cecily seems to have fallen asleep again, 
and our Dragon continues to slumber without 
answering our prayers.

MsgJp:
しかし、それでも穏やかな気持ちでいられるのは
このフィンダムから黒騎士を追い出してくれた
あなたたちのおかげだ
MsgEn:
But still, I can't help but feel calm.
It is you and your friends who drove the 
Black Knight out of Phindym.

MsgJp:
我々に何ができるのかわからないが――
いつでもあなたたちの味方だ
それだけは忘れないでほしい
MsgEn:
I don't know what we can do for you.
But we'll always be on your side.
I just want you to remember that.

MsgJp:
ありがとう、ミシアル
ありがとう、セシリー
MsgEn:
Thank you, Mysial.
Thank you, Cecily.

MsgJp:
さて隊長！
白竜様をお救いする方法はわかりました
MsgEn:
Alright, Captain!
I know how to save Lord White Dragon.

MsgJp:
一度レスタニアに戻って報告したら
事にあたりましょう
MsgEn:
Once we report back to Lestania, 
we'll take care of it.

MsgJp:
絶好調だな
なんなら、前よりいい感じだぜ
MsgEn:
I'm doing great.
If anything, I'm doing better than ever.

MsgJp:
また頼りにしてしまったと後ろめたかったが
我々も役に立てたようでうれしいよ
MsgEn:
I felt guilty for relying on you again, 
but I am glad we were able to be of help.

MsgJp:
聞いたよ
黒騎士の剣を奪い返すんだろ？
MsgEn:
I've heard.
You're going to take the Black Knight's sword 
away from him, right?

MsgJp:
相手が傷を負っているとはいえ
そう簡単なことではないよね
MsgEn:
It's not that easy, 
even if the other guy is wounded.

MsgJp:
わかっちゃいるけど――頼むよ
レスタニアの未来のためだ
MsgEn:
I know, I know... but please.
It's for the future of Lestania.

MsgJp:
我が命――あと少しでいい――
つないでくれ――
MsgEn:
My breath――let it linger yet awhile――
Hold it fast――

MsgJp:
無事に戻って何よりだ
良からぬ事が起こって足止めされるのではないかと
気が気ではなかったぞ
MsgEn:
Glad you're back safe and sound.
I was afraid something bad would happen 
and you'd be stranded.

MsgJp:
して、ミシアルが現れ、黒騎士から
剣を取り戻せと策をくれたのだろう？
MsgEn:
Then, Mysial appeared and provided you with a 
plan to get the sword back from the 
Black Knight, did she not?

MsgJp:
しかも黒騎士は傷を負い、動けないと
いうではないか
MsgEn:
Moreover, the Black Knight is wounded 
and unable to move.

MsgJp:
楽な戦いにも思えるが
その実、この機会を逃せばレスタニアは終わりだ
おお、事の重大さに身も震えるわ
MsgEn:
It may seem like an easy fight, but the fact is, 
if we don't seize this opportunity, 
it will be the end of Lestania.

Oh, I shudder at the gravity of the situation.

MsgJp:
それとな――
良い知らせがひとつある
MsgEn: Oh, and――one piece of good news.

MsgJp:
メイリーフのもとで寝込んでいたリズが
少しではあるが、力を取り戻したようだ
MsgEn:
Lise, who was bedridden under Mayleaf's care, 
seems to have regained some of her strength, 
if only a little.

MsgJp:
あらためて、おまえたちにレスタニアの未来を託すぞ
あの憎っくき黒騎士を打ち倒し
剣を持ち帰ってくれ
MsgEn:
Once again, 
I entrust the future of Lestania to you. 
Defeat that hateful Black Knight 
and bring back the sword.

MsgJp:
こういう言い方をすると、またクラウスが
何か言いそうだが――
MsgEn:
If I put it like this, Klaus might 
have something to say again――

MsgJp:
いいか、今は、黒騎士から
剣を取り戻すことが最優先だ
MsgEn:
Look, right now, our priority is to get the sword 
away from the Black Knight.

MsgJp:
敵は傷を負っているのだろう？
その傷を我々の味方にせねばならん
MsgEn:
The enemy has wounds, does he not? 
We must make those wounds our allies.

MsgJp: つまり、時間がない
MsgEn: In other words, time is short.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランについたらネド王子に
事情を話して、黒騎士討伐に
協力させるのだ――いいな？
MsgEn:
When you get to Acre Selund, you must tell 
Prince Nedo about the situation and get him to 
help you defeat the Black Knight--understood?

MsgJp:
フィンダムからの加護がいつまで
持ってくれるのかは分からぬが
MsgEn:
I don't know how long the blessing
from Phindym will last.

MsgJp:
今はその力だけが頼みの綱
加護のあるうちに、迅速に――慎重に――
事を進めて欲しい
MsgEn:
That power is our only hope now. 
While you have the blessing, 
I want you to proceed quickly--and carefully--
with the matter at hand.

MsgJp:
油断するな――黒騎士は――
傷ついても尚――手強いぞ――
MsgEn:
Be not lulled――
the Black Knight――
Though stricken, he is yet fierce――
A foe not easily felled――

MsgJp:
メガド侵攻作戦の途中で戻って来たから
向こうは向こうで大変だろうね
MsgEn:
You came back in the middle of the 
Megado invasion, so it's likely to be a lot 
more complicated over there.

MsgJp:
いいかい？
メガド攻略の流れの中で黒騎士を探すといい
状況によっては、向こうから出てくるよ
MsgEn:
Okay?
You can look for the Black Knight in the process 
of attacking Megado, and under the right 
circumstances, he'll come out in the open.

MsgJp:
好機は何度も来ないから
焦ってし損じちゃダメ――いい？
MsgEn:
Opportunities don't come around again and again, 
sodon't be in a hurry and miss out--okay?

MsgJp:
わたしも行くからね――
隊長と一緒に――わたしも行くんだから
MsgEn:
I'll be there--
with the Captain--I'll be there too!

MsgJp: リズが出て行っちゃったの
MsgEn: Lise left.

MsgJp:
大丈夫かなあ
隊長さん、やさしくしてあげてね
MsgEn:
I wonder if she's okay.
Be gentle with her, Captain.

MsgJp:
リズに無理をさせないでくださいよ
本調子にはほど遠い状態ですからね
MsgEn:
Don't push Lise too hard.
She's far from peak condition.

MsgJp: 覚者さま、よくぞ戻って来て下さいました
MsgEn: Good to have you back, Master Arisen.

MsgJp:
我々解放軍はあれ以来、敵の攻勢にさらされ
メガド再攻略は難しい状況と
言わざるをえません
MsgEn:
We, the Liberation Army, have been under enemy 
offensive since then, and I must say that it is 
becoming more and more difficult for us 
to retake Megado.

MsgJp:
今も展望城周辺で、武装した敵隊列の
目撃を受け、主力軍は急遽展望城へ
引き返したところです
MsgEn:
Even presently, the main army has just hurriedly 
retreated back to the Lookout Castle after the 
sighting of an enemy column in the vicinity.

MsgJp:
どうか、覚者さまも展望城へ向かい
ネドさまと合流ください
MsgEn:
Please, Master Arisen, 
head for the Lookout Castle and join Lord Nedo.

MsgJp: 敵は我々を追い詰めつつあります
MsgEn: The enemy is hunting us down.

MsgJp:
どうか展望城へ向かい
我らに力をお貸しください
MsgEn:
Please head to the Lookout Castle
and lend us your strength.

MsgJp:
あの大軍、奴ら展望城を強襲するつもりです
ああ、急がないと大変なことに！
MsgEn:
That big army, 
they're going to storm the Lookout Castle.

Ah, we're in trouble if we don't hurry!

MsgJp:
あんたたち――
きっと帰ってくると信じていたよ
MsgEn:
You guys...
I knew you'd come back.

MsgJp:
さあ、俺にも出来ることがあれば
何でも言ってくれ
MsgEn:
Now, if there's anything I can do to help, 
just tell me.

MsgJp:
おお、レスタニアの勇者たちよ！
戻られたか！
MsgEn:
Oh, the brave warriors of Lestania!
You're back!

MsgJp: 急ぎ城内に避難指示を出したところだ
MsgEn:
I've just issued an urgent evacuation 
order for the castle.

MsgJp:
ほら、聞こえる？
いやーなオークの咆哮さ
MsgEn:
See, can you hear it?
That's the roar of a loathsome orc.

MsgJp:
ありがとうございます
レスタニアはどうでしたか？
MsgEn:
Thank you.
How was Lestania?

MsgJp:
戻ってくれて良かった
こっちは大変なことになっていてね
MsgEn:
It's good to have you back. 
It's been a rough night over here.

MsgJp: 聞かなくてもわかりますよね――
MsgEn: No need to ask--you know what I mean.

MsgJp: この、漂うオークの攻撃臭！
MsgEn: The smell of an orc attack is in the air!

MsgJp:
さっさとネドと話せよ
もう、どうするか決めてあんだろ
MsgEn:
Just talk to Nedo and get on with it, we already 
decided what we're going to do about it.

MsgJp:
なんでもいいから――
早くやっちゃおうよ――
MsgEn:
Whatever it is...
Let's just get it over with――

MsgJp:
この難局は必ずや乗り切らねばならん
この城を失うわけにはいかんのだ
MsgEn:
We must get through this predicament, 
and we cannot afford to lose this castle.

MsgJp:
リズは顔色が悪いね
まだ本調子じゃないのか
MsgEn:
Liz doesn't look so good... 
like she hasn't recovered from 
her bout of lethargy.

MsgJp:
ガルドリンも暗い顔して――
隊長、エリオット、ふたりの分まで頼むよ
MsgEn:
And Gurdolin looks a bit gloomy―― 
Captain, Elliott, 
you'll need to cover for both of them.

MsgJp:
攻め込まれちゃいるが
解放軍の士気はまだ高い
MsgEn:
Though under attack, morale is still high 
among the Liberation Army forces.

MsgJp:
この心意気が消えないうちに
なんとか終わらせるんだよ
MsgEn:
We've got to get this thing done 
before this spirit dies out.

MsgJp:
城内に逃げ遅れた人たちが出たようです
まずはその人たちの救助を急ぎましょう
MsgEn:
It seems that some people have failed to 
escape into the castle.
Let's hurry to rescue them first!

MsgJp:
レスタニアの問題は解決したのですよね？
だから戻って来てくれたのですよね？
本当にありがとうございます！
MsgEn:
The problem in Lestania was solved, wasn't it?
That's why you came back, right?
Thank you so much!

MsgJp:
隊長、ここをきれいにしないと
黒騎士討伐もままなりません
やるしかないですね
MsgEn:
Captain, if we don't clean this place up, 
we won't be able to defeat the Black Knight. 
We have to do it.

MsgJp:
黒騎士のところに行くには
解放軍の協力が不可欠だ
MsgEn:
In order to get to the Black Knight, 
the cooperation of the
Liberation Army is essential.

MsgJp:
さあ、盛大に恩を売って
がっぽり見返りをもらおうぜ
MsgEn:
Come on, let's do them a grand favor 
and reap the rewards!

MsgJp: 負けないぞ――わたしは負けない！
MsgEn: I won't―― I won't lose!

MsgJp:
ああ、また助けて頂きましたね
ありがとうございます
MsgEn: Ah, you've helped us again. Thank you.

MsgJp:
敵はこの階下の中層へも入り込んで来ています
どうか人々を、展望城をお救い下さい
MsgEn:
The enemy has entered the middle level, 
below this floor.
Please save the people and the Lookout Castle.

MsgJp:
も、もう敵はいないの？
もう、安全なの？
MsgEn:
Are there no more enemies? 
Are we safe now?

MsgJp: 覚者さん、ありがとう！
MsgEn: Thank you, Ser Arisen!

MsgJp:
敵の強襲部隊の将、戦の将が
城門広場に現れたとの情報です
MsgEn:
We have information that the general of the enemy 
assault force, the War Master, 
has appeared at the Castle Gate Plaza.

MsgJp:
この機を逃してはなりません
急ぎ城門広場へ向かいましょう！
MsgEn:
Don't miss this opportunity. 
Hurry and head to the Castle Gate Plaza!

MsgJp:
さあ！　戦況を変える千載一遇の機会です
戦の将を討ち果たしましょう！
MsgEn:
Come on! This is a once-in-a-thousand opportunity 
to change the course of the war. 
Let's defeat the War Master!

MsgJp:
あんたが来てくれて助かったよ
俺たちの希望は、ああ、消えちゃいなかった！
MsgEn:
I'm glad you came. 
Our hope, ah, it hasn't vanished!

MsgJp: 助力、誠に感謝します
MsgEn: Thank you so much for your help.

MsgJp:
すぐにでもメガドへ攻め込みたいが
防衛戦が終わったばかり
MsgEn:
I'd love to attack Megado right away, 
but we just finished our defense.

MsgJp:
守るも攻めるも編成の組み直しと
休息が必要だ
MsgEn:
We need to reorganize and rest, 
both defensively and offensively.

MsgJp:
戻り、アッカーシェランの心意気を
レスタニアのお歴々にお伝え願いたい
MsgEn:
I hope you will return and convey the spirit of 
Acre Selund to the people of Lestania.

MsgJp: ごめんなさい
MsgEn: I'm sorry.

MsgJp:
僕たちは自分のことばかり考えて――
本当にごめんなさい
MsgEn:
We only think about ourselves――
I'm really I'm sorry.

MsgJp:
――黒い鎧の騎士と戦う時は
これまでにあなたたちから受けた恩――
全部返す意気込みで頑張るよ
MsgEn:
--When you fight the knight in black armor, 
I will do my best to repay all the favors you 
have done for us so far.

MsgJp: それがアッカーシェランのためでもあるしね
MsgEn: And it's in Acre Selund's best interest.

MsgJp:
ごくろうだったね
すぐに黒騎士討伐に行きたいところだろうが
休息は大事だよ？　いいね
MsgEn:
I know you're probably going to want to take 
down the Black Knight right away, 
but it's important to get some rest, okay? 
All right.

MsgJp:
いつもなら、じれったいと思うでしょうが
この休止はありがたいですね
MsgEn:
Normally, you'd think I'd be impatient, 
but I appreciate this pause.

MsgJp:
リズもガルドリンも本調子とは
言い難いですから
MsgEn: Lise and Gurdolin aren't exactly in top form.

MsgJp: 仕方ねえ、休んでやるか
MsgEn: No choice, I'll take a break.

MsgJp: ちょっと――疲れたかな
MsgEn: I'm a little--I'm a little tired.

MsgJp:
リズだけじゃなくて
みんなもゆっくり休んでね
MsgEn:
Not just Lise.
I hope you all get a good night's rest.

MsgJp:
ご自由におくつろぎください
どうぞ、自分の家だと思って
MsgEn: Please feel free to make yourself at home.

MsgJp:
黒騎士の傷はいかほどだろうね
痛みに苛まれていればいいのに
MsgEn:
I wonder how badly the Black Knight is hurt. 
I hope he's in a lot of pain.

MsgJp: ――黒騎士を――逃がすな――
MsgEn:
――Let not the Black Knight―― 
Escape from thy grasp――

MsgJp: メイロワ殿の言葉は心強い限りだ
MsgEn: Master Meirova's words are reassuring.

MsgJp:
だが、わたしは、もう黒騎士と
一戦交えた頃だと思っていたぞ
MsgEn:
But I figured it was time you had a fight with 
the Black Knight.

MsgJp: 次は、いよいよということになろうが――
MsgEn: Next, I wonder if it's finally――

MsgJp: 頼むぞ、必ず剣を持ち帰ってくるのだ
MsgEn: Please make sure to bring back his sword.

MsgJp:
頼む！
白竜の衰弱が目に見えて進んでいる
MsgEn: Please! The white dragon is visibly weakening.

MsgJp:
一刻の猶予もなさそうだ
なんとしても黒騎士を打ち倒して
剣を持ち帰ってくれ
MsgEn:
There's not a moment to lose, 
so do whatever you can to defeat the 
Black Knight and bring back the sword.

MsgJp:
奴めが傷をいやして
どこぞの世界に姿を消すのかと思うと
夜も眠れんわ
MsgEn:
I can't sleep at night knowing that he's going 
to heal his wounds and disappear into 
some other world.

MsgJp: 向こうの連中と話し、早々に挑んでくれ
MsgEn:
Talk to the guys over there and try to tackle 
it as soon as possible.

MsgJp: 心苦しいが、ねぎらいの言葉が今は浮かばない
MsgEn:
It pains me, but I cannot think of any 
words of encouragement at this moment.

MsgJp:
宿命として受け入れ、必ずや白竜を傷つけた
剣を持ち帰ってくれ
MsgEn:
Accept it as destiny and be sure to bring back the
sword that hurt the White Dragon.

MsgJp: 最早――頼むと――願うばかり――
MsgEn:
At this point―― 
I can but beseech――

MsgJp:
一応報告しておこう
ブラッドオーブでは、もう、白竜様の
状況を押しとどめることもできない
MsgEn:
In case you're wondering, 
I'm afraid I have to report that the Blood Orbs 
are no longer enough to stifle 
Lord White Dragon's condition.

MsgJp: ここだけの話――オーブ収集は気休めさ
MsgEn: Between you and me--collecting orbs is a comfort.

MsgJp: ありったけのオーブを使ったが白竜様はよくならん
MsgEn:
We spent all the orbs we had, 
but Lord White Dragon is not getting any better.

MsgJp:
くっ――泣けてくるわ
もう、おまえたちにレスタニアの未来を
預けよう――それしか策はない
MsgEn:
Damn-- it makes me weep.
I'll leave the future of Lestania in your hands
 now--that's all I can do.

MsgJp:
川や池から腐臭が漂っていたという
報告があるんだ
MsgEn:
There have been reports of a rotten smell 
wafting from rivers and ponds.

MsgJp: 大地を巡る竜力があちこちで淀んでいるらしい
MsgEn:
It seems that Dragon Force that circulates 
the land is already stagnating.

MsgJp:
隊長さん、大丈夫？
休まなくていい？
MsgEn:
Captain, are you okay? 
Do you need to rest?

MsgJp:
白竜様が傷ついてから
覚者様たちの顔色がどんどん悪くなって
いるのです
MsgEn:
Since Lord White Dragon's injury, 
the complexion of the Arisen has 
been getting worse and worse.

MsgJp:
自覚があるかどうかわからないけど――
隊長さん、あなたもね
MsgEn:
I don't know if you're aware of this, but-- 
Captain, you too.

MsgJp:
敵側に動きありとの情報がはいり
あろうことかネド王子はジリアンを伴って
出撃してしまった
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo, upon receiving word of movement on 
the enemy side, 
unexpectedly set out accompanied by Gillian.

MsgJp:
おぬしたちも急ぎメガド居住層へ
向かってくれ
MsgEn:
I need you all to hurry and head for the 
Megado Residential Level.

MsgJp:
状況ははっきりとはわかっていない上に
あの黒騎士が潜む城塞だ
MsgEn:
We don't know exactly what's going on, 
and it's a fortress with that 
Black Knight lurking in it.

MsgJp:
用心して事に当たってくれ
わしもすぐに追いかける
MsgEn:
Be careful what you do.
I'll be right behind you.

MsgJp:
ネド王子が独断専行とは――
おぬしたちへの恩返しに取りつかれているようだ
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo is acting on his own initiative... 
he seems to be obsessed with repaying the 
favor he owes you.

MsgJp: 部隊編成を終えたらここを出よう
MsgEn:
We'll leave here when we're done 
with the troop formation.

MsgJp:
あんたたちの後に続く、勇猛な軍隊を
作ってやろうじゃないか
MsgEn:
Let us build a valiant army to 
follow in your footsteps.

MsgJp:
隊長、一度で決めたいですね
白竜様も覚者も限界に近い――
俺、そう感じています
MsgEn:
Captain, I'd like to settle this once and for all.
Lord White Dragon and the Arisen are both 
nearing their limits-- that's how I feel.

MsgJp:
さあ、行こうぜ
メガド居住層とやらへよ
MsgEn:
Come on, let's go to this 
Megado Residential Level.

MsgJp:
行こう、隊長――
黒騎士をやっつけて剣を取り戻そう――
MsgEn:
Let's go, Captain--
Let's take out the Black Knight and get 
the sword back--

MsgJp: はぁはぁ――
MsgEn: Haah――

MsgJp:
ふん――キツい戦いだな
勝利はそう簡単じゃないんだね
MsgEn:
Hmph -- a tough fight.
I guess victory isn't that easy.

MsgJp:
いつ黒騎士が来るかと思うと――
ああ、緊張するよ
MsgEn:
I'm just wondering when the Black Knight is--
Oh, I'm getting tense.

MsgJp:
黒騎士は手負いなんだろう？
だったら、きっと簡単さ
MsgEn:
The Black Knight is wounded, right?
Then it should be easy.

MsgJp:
黒騎士を見た者の話では
とてつもなく強いとのこと――
MsgEn:
According to those who have seen the 
Black Knight, he is incredibly strong--

MsgJp: まあ用心に越したことはないですね
MsgEn: Well, you can never be too careful.

MsgJp:
この戦闘が始まってから、黒騎士の姿を
見た者がいない
MsgEn:
No one has seen the Black Knight at any 
time since this battle began.

MsgJp:
レスタニアの竜に負わされた傷で
すでに死んだという噂も流れている
MsgEn:
Rumor has it that he has already died from the 
wounds inflicted by the Lestanian Dragon.

MsgJp: でも、竜を沈黙させるほどの力を持った相手
MsgEn:
But, an opponent with enough power 
to silence a Dragon...

MsgJp:
もし目の前に現れたら兵たちの士気が
どうなるか怪しい
MsgEn:
I dread to think what would happen to the 
morale of the soldiers if he 
appeared before them.

MsgJp: ねえ、隊長
MsgEn: Hey, Captain.

MsgJp:
もし、もしも、この地が敵の手に落ちるような
ことがあれば
MsgEn:
If this land should ever fall into 
the hands of the enemy...

MsgJp:
一人でも多くの民たちをレスタニアに
連れて行ってくれないか？
MsgEn:
Would you take as many of our people 
as possible to Lestania?

MsgJp: ありがとう――これで、心おきなく戦えるよ
MsgEn: Thank you--now I can fight without worrying.

MsgJp:
正直、こんなにいっぱいの感謝の気持ち――
未来への希望――どっちも初めてなの
MsgEn:
I can honestly say that I've never felt so much 
gratitude - and hope for the future - either!

MsgJp: こんな状況だけど、ああ、悪くはない気分だよ
MsgEn:
I'm in this situation, but yeah, 
I'm not feeling too bad.

MsgJp:
僕はベルタの部隊と合流して、メイロワ将軍に
続きます！
MsgEn:
I joined Bertha's unit and followed 
General Meirova!

MsgJp:
さあ、行きましょう
ここにいないなら、黒騎士はもっと奧に
いるはずですよ
MsgEn:
Come on, let's go. 
If he's not here, the Black Knight must 
be further back.

MsgJp:
黒騎士め――
どっかでぶっ倒れてるんじゃねえか？
MsgEn:
The Black Knight――
he's probably collapsed somewhere, isn't he?

MsgJp:
勝手に死なれちゃ困るぜ
最後は俺が見送ってやる
MsgEn:
Don't let him die on his own.
I'll take care of him in the end.

MsgJp:
早く行かないとメイロワ将軍たちが
孤立しちゃうよ
MsgEn:
If we don't go soon, General Meirova and his men 
will be isolated.

MsgJp:
やったぞ！　メガド回廊を制圧！
この勢いのままにメガド王宮に突入だ！
MsgEn:
We did it! 
The Megado Corridor is ours! 
Let's keep this momentum going into 
the Royal Palace of Megado!

MsgJp: なまじろき竜とともに死ぬがいい
MsgEn:
It would be best for you to die with 
that dragon of yours.

MsgJp: 弱者は滅ぶ、それが道理だ
MsgEn: The weak will perish, that's the way it is.

MsgJp: 理の呪縛に囚われ、闇に沈め！
MsgEn:
Caught in the spell of order, 
sink into darkness!

MsgJp: 力を付けたようだが――無駄なこと！
MsgEn:
Seems to have gained strength――
but to no avail!

MsgJp: 白竜から奪いし竜力は我が手にあるぞ
MsgEn:
The Dragon Force that was taken from 
the white dragon is in my grasp.

MsgJp: 渡さぬ――この力、誰にも渡すものか――
MsgEn:
I will not surrender this power――
I will not yield it to anyone――

MsgJp: 早くこの魔物をやっつけないと
MsgEn:
We need to get rid of this monster 
as soon as possible.

MsgJp: 黒騎士は、何がなんでもここで倒すよ！
MsgEn:
I'll defeat the Black Knight here, 
no matter what it takes!

MsgJp: 逃がすものか！
MsgEn: I won't let you get away with it!

MsgJp: くっ、睨まれると足がすくむ
MsgEn:
Damn, I get a bit shaky on my feet 
when they glare at me.

MsgJp: 黒騎士よ！　卑怯だぞ！　戦え！
MsgEn:
Black Knight! 
Fight me, you coward! 
Fight!

MsgJp: くそっ！　もどかしい！
MsgEn: Damn! This is frustrating!

MsgJp: さあさあさあ！
MsgEn: Come on, come on!

MsgJp: 今度こそ倒す！
MsgEn: This time we'll beat them!

MsgJp: 邪魔な魔物め！
MsgEn: Get away, you bothersome fiend!

MsgJp: 俺が相手だ！　かかってこい！
MsgEn: I'm your opponent! Come on!

MsgJp: 隊長、戦況が見えません！
MsgEn: Captain, I can't see the battlefield!

MsgJp: くっ――逃げられる！
MsgEn: Damn―― they're getting away!

MsgJp: エリオット、突っこめ！
MsgEn: Elliot, push forward!

MsgJp: こっち見るな！
MsgEn: Don't look at me!

MsgJp: 隊長、リズ、行け！
MsgEn: Captain, Lise, go!

MsgJp: ジリアン、回り込め！
MsgEn: Gillian, go around!

MsgJp: なんだってんだ！
MsgEn: What the hell!

MsgJp: くっ――手強いぜ
MsgEn: Damn--that's a tough one.

MsgJp: セシリー、力を貸してね
MsgEn: Cecily, give me your strength.

MsgJp: 大丈夫、結構動ける！
MsgEn: It's okay, I can move quite a bit!

MsgJp: ジリアン、気をつけて！
MsgEn: Gillian, be careful!

MsgJp: 竜力を返せ！
MsgEn: Return the Dragon Force!

MsgJp: 急がないと黒騎士が逃げちゃう！
MsgEn: Hurry up or the Black Knight will escape!

MsgJp: くっ――セシリー、もう少し――お願い――
MsgEn: Damn... Cecily, just a little more―― please ――

MsgJp: 女を追って来たか
MsgEn: You came for the girl.

MsgJp: 仲間など、見捨てれば良かろう
MsgEn: Just abandon your comrades.

MsgJp: この闇が気になるか
MsgEn: Is this darkness bothering you?

MsgJp: 我が闇の中で、おまえに勝機はない
MsgEn: In my darkness, you stand no chance.

MsgJp: 血が香るアッカーシェランはおまえに相応しい
MsgEn: You deserve Acre Selund reeking of blood.

MsgJp: 悪しき竜は戦いを望んでいる
MsgEn: The Evil Dragon wants a fight.

MsgJp: 戦い無きレスタニアにはおまえの居場所はない
MsgEn:
There is no place for you in Lestania 
if you do not fight.

MsgJp: おまえこそ、戦いを求めているのではないのか
MsgEn: You're the one looking for a fight.

MsgJp: 激情に身を投じろ――そして死ね
MsgEn: Throw yourself into the fury―― and die.

MsgJp: 白竜とともに滅ぶがいい
MsgEn: May you perish with the white dragon.

MsgJp: おまえはまだ、世界を知らぬ
MsgEn: You still don't know the real world.

MsgJp: 今こうしている間にも全ては変わりつつある――
MsgEn:
Even now, while we do this, everything 
is beginning to change――

MsgJp: 何も知らずに消えろ
MsgEn: Fade away, ignorant of everything.

MsgJp:
広大なメガドを守り切ることは、今のわしらでは
困難を極める
MsgEn:
It would be extremely difficult for us to 
defend the vast area of Megado.

MsgJp:
さあ、敵に気づかれないうちに
あたしたちも展望城へ帰ろうじゃないか
MsgEn:
Now, let's get back to the Lookout Castle 
before the enemy notices us.

MsgJp:
お急ぎください
白竜様が待っていらっしゃいますよ
MsgEn:
Please hurry.
Lord White Dragon is waiting for you.

MsgJp:
照れくさいけど――
思いを口にするのは気持ちがいいね
MsgEn:
I know it's embarrassing, but... 
it feels good to say what's on my mind.

MsgJp: ほら、早く剣を持ってレスタニアへ！
MsgEn:
Here, quickly, 
take the sword and go to Lestania!

MsgJp:
隊長、城はあとで見物しようぜ
今は――さあ、急ごう
MsgEn:
Captain, we'll check the castle later.
For now - come on, let's hurry up.

MsgJp: 早く～！　白竜様に剣を～！
MsgEn:
Quickly～! 
Give the sword to Lord White Dragon～!

MsgJp:
今のところ首尾良く物事が進んでいます
この勢いをレスタニアに持って帰りましょう
MsgEn:
So far, things are going well. 
Let's bring this momentum back to Lestania.

MsgJp: 白竜様に元気になってもらうんです
MsgEn:
I'm trying to get 
Lord White Dragon to feel better.

MsgJp: メイリーフは神殿にいるはずです
MsgEn: Mayleaf should be in the temple.

MsgJp: どうだった？
MsgEn: How did it go?

MsgJp:
ん？　エリオット――リズ――
その顔はやったのか！？
MsgEn:
Hmm? Elliot— Lise――
What's with that look!?

MsgJp:
隊長さん、おかえりなさい
でも白竜様が――急いで！
MsgEn:
Welcome back, Captain. 
But Lord White Dragon―― Hurry!

MsgJp: そ、それは――ほら、もっとよく見せてくれ
MsgEn: Oh, that's--here, let me get a better look at it.

MsgJp:
やってくれると思っていたよ
さあ、みんながお待ちかねだ
MsgEn:
I knew you would do it.
Now, everyone's waiting for you.

MsgJp: さすがだ！
MsgEn: That's what I'm talking about!

MsgJp:
期待にたがわず剣を持ち帰ってくれると
一瞬たりとも疑ったことはなかったぞ
MsgEn:
I never doubted for a moment that you would bring 
back the sword, as expected.

MsgJp: さあ、剣を白竜様へ
MsgEn: Now, give the sword to Lord White Dragon.

MsgJp: やはり――おま――え――だな
MsgEn: Indeed―― it is―― thou――

MsgJp: ネド王子に関する相談か――
MsgEn: You're asking for advice about Prince Nedo--

MsgJp:
大ごとでなければいいが
とにかく早く行ってあげなさい
MsgEn:
I hope it's nothing serious. 
Regardless, go quickly!

MsgJp:
時間を取らせてしまったな
もう大丈夫だ
MsgEn:
Sorry to take up so much of your time. 
You're all set.

MsgJp: アッカーシェランの力になってやるがいい
MsgEn: Let Acre Selund help you.

MsgJp:
ひと段落ではあるけれど――
黒騎士と悪しき竜がどこまで通じて
いたのかわからないよね
MsgEn:
It's a break of sorts, but— 
I can't tell how deep the connection was between 
the Black Knight and the Evil Dragon.

MsgJp:
それはこれからの悪しき竜の動きから
見極めるしかないかな
MsgEn:
I guess we'll just have to wait and see what the 
Evil Dragon does from here on out.

MsgJp: おお、おぬしか
MsgEn: Oh, no.

MsgJp:
ネド王子のことは聞いたな？
まだ、ここだけの話にしておいてくれ
MsgEn:
You heard about Prince Nedo, right?
For now, let's keep it between us.

MsgJp:
あれやこれやと王子に押しつけ
過ぎたのかねえ
MsgEn:
I wonder if I pushed the prince too hard 
on this and that.

MsgJp:
あたしも口で心配するほど
気づかいがなかったかもしれないね
MsgEn:
Maybe I wasn't as thoughtful 
as I should have been.

MsgJp:
たしかに王子はまだケツの青いガキだ
でも、重圧から逃げ出すようなやつじゃあ
なさそうだけどよ――
MsgEn:
Yes, the prince is still a boy, but he doesn't 
seem to be the kind of man who would 
run away under pressure...

MsgJp: まあ、わかんねえな
MsgEn: Well, I don't know.

MsgJp: 隊長！
MsgEn: Captain!

MsgJp:
ネド王子が行方不明なの
急いで探しに行かなくちゃ
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo is missing. 
We have to hurry and find him.

MsgJp:
王子はどこでしょうね――
行き先の見当くらい
つきそうなものですけど――
MsgEn:
Where could the prince be―― 
We should at least have 
some notion of where he is――

MsgJp:
皆さん、おそろいですね
さて、黒騎士との戦いの直後に姿を消した
王子ですが――
MsgEn:
Well, I see you're all here now.
Now, the prince disappeared shortly after the 
battle with the Black Knight--

MsgJp: メガド離宮で姿を見たという者を見つけました
MsgEn:
I found someone who said he saw 
him at the Megado Detached Palace.

MsgJp:
目撃者は王子と面識のある兵士ですし
離宮は、メガドに隣接する竜の神殿
となれば、ネド王子であることは確実でしょう
MsgEn:
The witness is a soldier who knows the prince, 
and since the palace borders 
Megado's Dragon Temple, 
it is clear this must be Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
すでにジリアンが向かっていますが
皆さんもお急ぎください
MsgEn:
Gillian is already on her way, 
but I urge you all to hurry.

MsgJp: 王子にもしものことがあれば――終わりです
MsgEn:
If something happens to the prince―― 
it's over.

MsgJp: しかし、わからないのは王子の気持ちですね
MsgEn:
But what I don't understand 
is how the prince feels.

MsgJp:
無事に保護しても、それがわからなければ
また同じことが起こるでしょう
MsgEn:
Even if you protect them safely, 
if you don't know that, it will happen again.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍が何か知っているかも
しれませんが今のところ黙して語らずを
決め込んでいるようですね
MsgEn:
General Meirova may know something, 
but so far he seems to have 
decided to remain silent.

MsgJp:
メガドの離宮は竜の神殿さ
あんたの故郷にも神殿はあるんだろう？
MsgEn:
Megado's Detached Palace is a dragon temple.
You have temples in your homeland, too, don't you?

MsgJp:
今は、竜はいないってのに――
そんなところで王子は何をしているんだろうね
MsgEn:
Now, even though there is no Dragon--
I wonder what the prince is doing 
in a place like that.

MsgJp:
当然と言えば当然ですが、メイロワ将軍の
表情が冴えませんね
話を聞いてみたらどうです？
MsgEn:
Not surprisingly, General Meirova's 
expression is a bit sullen.
Why don't you talk to him?

MsgJp: 王子と覚者――
MsgEn: The Prince and the Arisen--

MsgJp:
両方ともしっかりやれってのは
荷が重いかもしれねえな
MsgEn:
Doing a good job of both 
might be a heavy burden.

MsgJp: 王子、どうしちゃったのかなあ
MsgEn:
Prince, I wonder what's the 
matter with you.

MsgJp: 分からん――
MsgEn: I don't know--

MsgJp:
体制が整い次第、次なる準備のために
神殿へ行くという話は
王子ともすでにしていたのだ
MsgEn:
We had already discussed with the prince that 
as soon as we were ready, we would go to the 
temple to make the next preparations.

MsgJp: それなのにひとりで行ってしまうとは――
MsgEn: And yet, to go there alone--

MsgJp:
とにかく、一刻も早く王子と会って
話を聞かなくてはな
MsgEn:
Anyway, I must see the prince as soon as possible 
and hear what he has to say.

MsgJp:
さあ、離宮へ行こうではないか
離宮へと繋がるメガド王宮層に
案内人を待たせている
MsgEn:
Now, let's go to the Detached Palace. 
We have a guide waiting by the 
Megado Royal Palace that will lead you to it.

MsgJp: それぞれ現地集合だ
MsgEn: We'll each meet there.

MsgJp:
面目ない
いよいよこれからと言うときに――
MsgEn:
I am ashamed, 
just as things were about to truly begin――

MsgJp: ここに来る途中でジリアンと会いましてね
MsgEn: I met Gillian on the way here.

MsgJp:
あの子は先に離宮に向かいました
向こうで合流できるでしょう
MsgEn:
She's headed to the Detached Palace. 
She'll meet you there.

MsgJp: 待っていたよ
MsgEn: I've been waiting for you.

MsgJp:
メガド離宮は、このすぐ先で
王子が目撃された場所は
離宮の最下層にある祭壇だということだ
MsgEn:
The Megado Detached Palace is just down the 
road, and that place where the prince was seen 
is the altar at the lowest level 
of the Detached Palace.

MsgJp:
だが、大地の衰えと共に離宮の中は
邪悪な魔物で満たされてしまっている
MsgEn:
But as the land has decayed, 
the Detached Palace has been 
filled with foul fiends.

MsgJp: 十分に気をつけて進んでくれ！
MsgEn: Proceed with extreme caution!

MsgJp: わたしもさっき着いたんだ
MsgEn: I just got here too.

MsgJp:
王子の気持ちに寄り添っていたつもりだけど
わたしの思い上がりだったのかな
MsgEn:
I thought I was being attentive to the prince's 
feelings, but I guess I was just 
being presumptuous.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍には王子の行き先の
心当たりがある――
MsgEn:
General Meirova has an idea of 
where the prince is headed--

MsgJp: んな感じだったな
MsgEn: It was something like that.

MsgJp:
耳を澄ますと笛の音が聞こえる――
なんてことは全然ないね
何も聞こえないや
MsgEn:
If you strain your ears, 
you should hear a flute―― 
but no, nothing like that. 
I can't hear anything.

MsgJp:
俺たちが当てずっぽうに動いても
王子にはたどり着けませんよね
MsgEn: Our guesswork won't get us to the prince.

MsgJp: 何か情報をもらわないと――
MsgEn: We need to get some information--

MsgJp:
笛を手に入れたのなら、おそらく
王子の行き先は火垂れ山
MsgEn:
If he got the flute, 
then perhaps the prince's destination is 
Firefall Mountain.

MsgJp:
火垂れ山は竜の住み処なのだが
道中はおそろしい魔物の巣窟だ
MsgEn:
Firefall Mountain is the home of dragons, 
but along the way it's a lair of 
horrifying demons.

MsgJp:
王子はおそらく、王家に伝わる抜け道を
使うだろうが、わしらは入り口さえ知らん
MsgEn:
The prince will probably use the royal path, 
but we don't even know the entrance.

MsgJp:
ここはいったん展望城に戻り
情報を集めようではないか
MsgEn:
Let's go back to the Lookout Castle and 
gather some information.

MsgJp:
こと、抜け道などに関しては
ベルタが何か知っているかも知れん――
MsgEn:
Bertha may know something 
about the paths and so on.

MsgJp: ――おっと、忘れるところであった
MsgEn: --Oops, almost forgot!

MsgJp:
この離宮を出たすぐその場所には、小さな礎が
あったはず
MsgEn:
Just outside the palace, there must have 
been a small Portcrystal.

MsgJp:
再度ここを通り抜けずとも良いように
礎を解放しておくと良いだろう
MsgEn:
It would be good to attune so we don't have to go 
through here again.

MsgJp:
さあ、礎を解放した後は、急ぎ城へ戻って
ベルタに聞こうではないか
MsgEn:
Now, after doing so, 
let's hurry back to the castle and ask Bertha.

MsgJp:
火垂れ山へ通じる王家の道がわかれば
しめたものだ
MsgEn:
If we can find the royal road to 
Firefall Mountain, we'll be all right.

MsgJp:
なんだって？
火垂れ山の行き方？
MsgEn:
What's that?
How to get to Firefall Mountain?

MsgJp:
そりゃ火垂れ山へ通じる
魔物がうじゃうじゃいる山の麓を辿って――
ああ、王家に伝わる、秘密の経路かい？
MsgEn:
Well, you'd have to trace the demon-infested 
trail that leads up Firefall Mountain at the foot 
of the mountain--oh, the secret royal route?

MsgJp:
北の土地に関する秘密の情報は
北の盗賊が、がっちり固めていてね
あたしらでもおいそれと嗅ぎまわるわけには
いかないのさ
MsgEn:
The secret information about the lands in 
the north is firmly secured by 
the northern bandits.
Even we can't just go snooping around.

MsgJp:
だけど、国が滅ぶかどうかの瀬戸際に
そんなこともいってられないね
MsgEn:
But we can't afford to say that when our country 
is on the brink of destruction.

MsgJp: そうさね――ちょっと時間をおくれよ
MsgEn: I guess so -- just give me a minute.

MsgJp:
北の盗賊の頭目にかけあってみよう
進展があったらすぐ連絡するからね
MsgEn:
I'll talk to the head of the Northern Bandits.
I'll call you as soon as I make any progress.

MsgJp:
ちょっと時間をくれと言っただろう？
年を取ると旅支度ひとつにも手間取っちまうものさ
MsgEn:
I told you to give me some time, didn't I?
