Many thanks for your time.

MsgJp: フィンダムの時と同じだな
MsgEn: It's just like in Phindym.

MsgJp: 黒剣が刺さってて、そこに魔物が集まるんだ
MsgEn:
A Black Sword is thrust into it, 
and that's where the fiends congregate.

MsgJp:
隊長、急ごうよ
きっとジリアンも戦ってるよ
MsgEn:
Captain, let's hurry.
I'm sure Gillian is fighting too.

MsgJp:
前例にならうなら、まず黒剣のところへ行って
魔物を倒し――
MsgEn:
If we are to follow precedent, we must first go 
to the Black Sword and slay the monster...

MsgJp:
そして黒い渦に対処するという流れのはずです
準備を完璧にして向かいましょう
MsgEn:
Then we will deal with the black vortex.
Let's head there fully prepared.

MsgJp: 状況は使者の方から聞いたフィンダムと同じです
MsgEn:
The situation is the same as Phindym's, 
as the messenger told me.

MsgJp:
大地に突き刺さった黒剣がこの地の竜力を
吸い上げて、上空の黒い渦に送っているのだとか
MsgEn:
The Black Sword that pierced the land sucks up 
the Dragon Force and sends it to the 
black vortex in the sky above.

MsgJp:
クインタスが、メガド上空に現れた渦の様子を
監視してくれているようです
MsgEn:
Quintus has been monitoring the vortex 
that appeared over Megado.

MsgJp:
まずはそちらへ向かって頂けますか？
僕も準備を整えて、状況の対応に当たります
MsgEn:
Could you please head that way first?
I'll get ready and take care of any situations.

MsgJp: 僕の中にある火竜の竜力――
MsgEn: The Dragon Force of the Fire Dragon within me――

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランの恩人の力になれるのであれば
僕には拒む理由はありません
MsgEn:
If I can help the benefactor of Acre Selund, 
I have no reason to refuse.

MsgJp:
ですがその前に、このアッカーシェランを守るため
今一度、力をお貸し下さい
MsgEn:
But first, I ask you once again for your help in 
protecting Acre Selund.

MsgJp: やはり来てくれたな、感謝する
MsgEn: I knew you'd come. Thank you.

MsgJp:
あれが見えるか？
あの巨大な渦は、瞬く間にメガドの王宮層
回廊、離宮を包み込んでしまった
MsgEn:
Do you see that?
That huge whirlpool quickly enveloped 
Megado's Royal Palace layer and the 
Detached Palace.

MsgJp:
偵察兵からの報告では、建物には闇の結界が張られ
中へ入ることは出来なくなってしまったようだ
MsgEn:
The scouts report that the building has been 
shrouded in darkness and no one can get inside.

MsgJp:
フィンダムという大陸に起きた状況は
聞いている
MsgEn:
I've heard of the situation that happened on the 
continent of Phindym.

MsgJp:
大地の各所には突き刺さった黒剣があり
それを破壊すれば、おまえたちは結界を
破ることができるのだろう？
MsgEn:
There are Black Swords impaled in various parts 
of the land, and if you destroy them, you will be 
able to break the barrier, right?

MsgJp:
魔物が現れた場所からして
すでに最初の黒剣の場所の目星は付けてある
MsgEn:
We already have a good idea of where the first 
Black Sword is, 
based on where the monsters appeared.

MsgJp: 地図で言うとこのあたりだ
MsgEn: It's right here on the map.

MsgJp:
これほどはやく、共に戦う日がまた来ようとは
考えもしなかったが――
歓迎しよう！
MsgEn:
Never did I think the day we would fight 
together again would come so soon――
But I welcome it!

MsgJp:
よお、覚者たち
あの黒い剣は黒騎士のものらしいな
MsgEn:
Hey, Arisen.
That Black Sword belongs to the 
Black Knight, I hear.

MsgJp: ともあれ、俺たちがやれることはただひとつ
MsgEn: At any rate, there's only one thing we can do.

MsgJp:
絶望から救われたこの国の未来のため
命を掛けてあんたと共に戦うのみだ
MsgEn:
We have been saved from despair, 
and we will fight with you for the future of this 
country, at the cost of our own lives.

MsgJp: ったく、おっかねえたらありゃしねえ！
MsgEn: Sheesh, that's downright terrifying!

MsgJp:
あの黒剣の周りに、あんな化け物が
集まってるなんてな
MsgEn:
I can't believe all those monsters gathered 
around that Black Sword.

MsgJp: ふぅ、危うくアーシェに、心配をかけるとこだったぜ
MsgEn: Phew, I almost had Ashe worrying about me.

MsgJp:
"悪しき竜"の時もこれ以上はない危機感だったが
これはもっと深刻なんだな？
MsgEn:
The "Evil Dragon" was a crisis that I couldn't 
have imagined being any worse, 
but this is more serious, isn't it?

MsgJp: あんたたちの顔を見ればわかるよ
MsgEn: I can see it in your faces.

MsgJp: ありがたいことだ
MsgEn: I'm grateful.

MsgJp:
"悪しき竜"を退けて、これから国を
立ち直らせようとしたら次はあの黒い剣
MsgEn:
After defeating the "Evil Dragon" and trying to 
get the country back on its feet, 
next comes that Black Sword....

MsgJp:
渦だ、黒竜だ、黒い騎士がまた現れたと
やっぱりアッカーシェランは滅ぶしかないのかと
思っていたら、恩人たちがまた来てくれた
MsgEn:
A vortex, the Black Dragon, and the 
Black Knight appeared again.
I knew Acre Selund would inevitably be destroyed, 
but our benefactors have come again!

MsgJp: ああ、闇の世界にまた希望の光が灯ったようだよ
MsgEn:
Ah, it's like another ray of hope 
in a world of darkness.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍が次の黒剣の場所に向かったらしい
急ぎ、加勢してやっておくれ
MsgEn:
General Meirova is headed to the next 
Black Sword location, so hurry up and join him.

MsgJp:
あんたたち、空の渦はもう見たのかい？
これまでにも随分と、色んな物を見てきた
つもりだったけどね
MsgEn:
Have you seen the vortex in the sky yet?
I thought I had witnessed a lot of 
things in my life.

MsgJp:
あんな禍々しいものは見たことがない
まるで闇の深淵に引き込まれるようだよ
MsgEn:
I've never seen anything so sinister.
It's like being drawn into an abyss of darkness.

MsgJp:
気をつけてくれよ
あの闇の向こうに行ってはいけないよ
MsgEn:
Be careful out there.
Don't delve beyond that darkness.

MsgJp: 加勢に来てくれて助かりました
MsgEn: Thank you for coming to join us.

MsgJp:
ここだけの話、黒騎士を見たという噂が
流れていましてね
MsgEn:
Between you and me, there have been rumors 
circulating that you have seen the Black Knight.

MsgJp:
もし真実だとすれば由々しき問題です
あの絶望の日々を思い出して
戦意を喪失する者は少なくないでしょう
MsgEn:
If true, this is a serious matter.
Many of us might lose our will to fight, 
remembering those days of despair.

MsgJp:
ここはもう大丈夫だ
早く次の場所へ急いでくれ
MsgEn:
We're all good here. 
Hurry on to the next place.

MsgJp:
ジリアンが、解放軍戦士と共に向かったが敵は手強い
彼女を守ってやってくれ
MsgEn:
Gillian is on her way with the 
Liberation Army soldiers, 
but the enemy is formidable.

MsgJp:
あの子にもしものことがあれば
父親が報われん！
MsgEn:
If anything happens to that child, 
the father will never be at peace!

MsgJp: 待っていたぞ！
MsgEn: I've been waiting for you!

MsgJp:
黒き渦は、ここに突き立てられた黒い剣から
大地の竜力を――
なんと、すでに知っていたか
さすがレスタニアの覚者殿！
MsgEn:
The Black Vortex emerges from the black sword 
embedded here, 
drawing the Dragon Force of the land―― 
What, you already knew? 
As expected of the Arisen of Lestania!

MsgJp:
ならば、話は早い！
全ての黒剣を早々に破壊せねば
MsgEn:
Then the rest is quick!
We must destroy all the 
Black Swords as soon as possible.

MsgJp:
次の黒剣には、ジリアンが向かっておる
力を貸してやってくれ
MsgEn:
Gillian is on her way to the next Black Sword. 
Lend her your strength.

MsgJp:
おぬしらは最初から戦力の頭数に入っているから
早く来てもらわねば困るぞ
MsgEn:
You've been included in our estimations from the 
start, so you'll have to move quickly.

MsgJp:
さあ、ともに駆け巡り、魔物を倒すのだ
渦のせいで魔物どもの勢いは増している
心してかかるのだ
MsgEn:
Now, we must charge forward and slay the monsters 
together, for the vortex has increased their ferocity, 
and we must be ready for anything.

MsgJp:
おお、あんたか――
ありがとう
MsgEn:
Oh, it's you--
Thank you.

MsgJp: あんたに命を救われたのは、これで何度目だろうか
MsgEn: How many times have you saved my life now?

MsgJp:
ははっ
魔物どもめ！　俺はまだ、倒れちゃねーぞ――
MsgEn:
Ha ha!
You fiends!　I ain't going down yet――

MsgJp: これを見てくれ――
MsgEn: Take a look at this――

MsgJp:
剣はこうして折られたが
奴らは、俺の心までも砕くことは出来なかったようだ
MsgEn:
The sword was broken like this, 
but it seems they could not 
shatter my spirit as well.

MsgJp:
ああ、みんな
来てくれると思っていたよ
MsgEn:
Oh, you guys.
I knew you'd come.

MsgJp: 状況はわかってるんだよね？
MsgEn: You know the situation, right?

MsgJp:
苦難の果てに取り戻した希望の光も
あの渦を何とかしないとまた消えることになる
そういうことだろう？
MsgEn:
The light of hope that we regained at the end of 
our hardships will disappear again if we don't 
do something about that vortex, right?

MsgJp:
全ての黒剣を破壊することで
空の渦への道が現れると考えると
MsgEn:
To think that by destroying all the Black Swords, 
a path to the vortex in the sky would appear.

MsgJp:
あの渦が呑み込もうとしている王都メガドに
その場所、道の入り口があるのだろう？
MsgEn:
The royal capital, Megado, 
is being consumed by the vortex. 
Could it be that the entrance is there?

MsgJp:
わたしはボロボロになった部隊を
再編してから出立する
隊長たちは先にメガドへ向かってくれないか？
MsgEn:
I'm going to reorganize my battered troops and 
then I'm heading out, so why don't you guys go 
ahead and head to Megado, Captain?

MsgJp:
ネド王子とメイロワ将軍達には
わたしから伝令を出しておくよ
MsgEn:
I will send word to Prince Nedo and 
General Meirova.

MsgJp: わたしもすぐに行く
MsgEn: I'll be there soon.

MsgJp:
黒い渦が王都メガドの玉座を呑み込む前に――
急いで
MsgEn:
Before the Black Vortex engulfs the throne of the 
Royal Capital Megado - hurry!

MsgJp:
状況はフィンダムの時と同じだな
俺たちはここで様子を探る
MsgEn:
Well, the situation seems to be the same as it 
was in Phindym, 
and we're here to find out what's really going on.

MsgJp: 隊長はレスタニアに戻り準備してくれ
MsgEn: Captain, go back to Lestania and get ready.

MsgJp:
王都が、これほど容易く闇化されるなんざあ
おったまげるぜ
MsgEn:
I'm shocked that the capital can be so 
easily plunged into darkness.

MsgJp:
これって、フィンダムの時と同じってことだよね
だとしたら、白竜が力を貸してくれるはず
MsgEn:
This means it's the same thing that 
happened with Phindym.
If that's the case, then the White Dragon 
should be able to help.

MsgJp:
隊長、空の渦への入り口を探すためにも
まずはこの闇の波動を鎮めましょう
MsgEn:
Captain, 
to find the entrance to the vortex in the sky, 
we must first quell this wave of darkness.

MsgJp:
戻ったか
我が力により、王都メガドを覆っていた
闇の結界はすでに解かれている
MsgEn:
Thou hast returned. 
By mine own power, the dark barrier that once 
shrouded the Royal Capital of Megado 
is now undone.

MsgJp:
我が覚者よ
メガドへ向かい、闇の波動を打ち払うのだ
MsgEn:
O Arisen of mine, 
make thy way to Megado and 
dispel the waves of darkness.

MsgJp: アッカーシェランに、起きた事態は既に掌握済みだ
MsgEn:
The situation in Acre Selund is 
already under control.

MsgJp:
白竜様によって、王都メガドを包む
闇の結界は解かれた
MsgEn:
Lord White Dragon has dispelled the dark wards 
surrounding the royal city of Megado.

MsgJp:
我々白衛騎士団も、ネド王子と協力の元
目下アッカーシェランの救済に向けて活動中だ
安心すると良い
MsgEn:
Rest assured that we, the White Guard Knights, 
in cooperation with Prince Nedo, 
are currently working to save Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
さあ、貴君は王都をこれ以上
闇化させないように防ぎつつ、その時が来る準備を
整えてくれ
MsgEn:
Now, you must be ready when the time comes, while 
preventing the Royal Capital from 
darkening any further.

MsgJp:
王都メガドをこれ以上、闇に呑ませてはならない
さあ、ミッションを受けてくれ
MsgEn:
Let no more darkness consume Megado.
Now, embark on your mission.

MsgJp: 突入の準備が整ったようだな
MsgEn: Looks like we're ready to go in.

MsgJp:
王都メガドの回廊入口前で待つ
ガルドリン達から連絡が来ている
MsgEn:
Gurdolin and his team have contacted us, they 
are waiting in front of the entrance in Megado.

MsgJp:
貴君たちの武運を祈ろう
さあ、行ってくれ
MsgEn:
I wish you all the best of luck. 
Now go.

MsgJp:
王都を取り戻すには、またとない日だ！
さあ、行くんだ
MsgEn:
This is a prime day to reclaim the capital!
Come on, let's go.

MsgJp: ああ、こっちも準備は出来てるぜ！
MsgEn: Yeah, we're ready to go, too!

MsgJp:
空の渦への入口が出そうな場所はこのあたりだ
隊長には竜の加護がついている
臆せず行くぞ！
MsgEn:
The entrance to the vortex in the sky is likely 
to be somewhere around here, and the 
Captain has the blessings of the Dragons 
on their side.
We will go without fear!

MsgJp:
あれこれ考えたって仕方ねえ
今は、渦を鎮めるのが先決だ
MsgEn:
There's no point in mulling it over.
We've got to calm the vortex now.

MsgJp:
またレオや黒騎士が現れても
もう、絶対油断しないんだから
MsgEn:
And if Leo or the Black Knight shows up again, 
you're not to be caught off guard again.

MsgJp: 行きましょう、隊長！
MsgEn: Let's go, Captain!

MsgJp:
ジリアンたちや、白衛騎士団のみんなが力尽きない
うちに渦を鎮めましょう
MsgEn:
Let's quell the vortex before Gillian and the 
White Guard Knights run out of steam.

MsgJp:
隊長、ジリアンの言った通りだよ
やっぱり門はここにあった
MsgEn:
Captain, Gillian was right, 
the gate was here after all.

MsgJp: フィンダムの時と同じだね
MsgEn: It's just like in Phindym.

MsgJp: これは空の渦に通じる門――
MsgEn: This is the gateway to the vortex in the sky--

MsgJp:
いや長いですね
ゲートと呼ぶことにしましょう
さあ、今度は何が待っているんでしょうね
MsgEn:
No, that's a bit long.
Let's call it a Gate. 
Now, what's waiting for us?

MsgJp:
こっから先は、どんな化けもんが待ち受けて
いやがるかわからねえ
MsgEn:
Who knows what kind of monsters 
await us from here on out?

MsgJp: いいか、気合い最高で行くぞ！
MsgEn:
Get ready, we're charging in with 
everything we've got!

MsgJp:
おい、行かねえのか？
準備不足ならさっさと済ましちまおうぜ
MsgEn:
Hey, aren't you going? 
If you're not ready, let's finish up quickly.

MsgJp: てめえはなんだ！？
MsgEn: What are you!?

MsgJp: 黒竜の手先か！？
MsgEn: Black Dragon's minions?!

MsgJp: ただの魔物ならさっさと消えろ！
MsgEn:
If you're just a regular enemy, 
get the hell out of here!

MsgJp: レオはいねえのか！？
MsgEn: Where is Leo!?

MsgJp: 黒騎士はどこだ！
MsgEn: Where is the Black Knight!

MsgJp: 話のわかる奴を出せよ
MsgEn:
Get me someone who knows 
what's going on.

MsgJp: ここはこの前と同じ、渦の中、だよね！
MsgEn: This place is in the same vortex as before, isn't it?

MsgJp: 隊長、まずは倒す、でいい？
MsgEn: Captain, we'll take them down first, okay?

MsgJp: わたしたちは答えを知りたいの
MsgEn: We want answers.

MsgJp: あんたなんかに用はないんだから！
MsgEn: I'm not here for you!

MsgJp: こいつ、嫌らしい攻撃ばっかり！
MsgEn: This guy is all about dirty attacks!

MsgJp: やっぱり渦の中は不利みたい
MsgEn: It seems being in the vortex is a disadvantage.

MsgJp: 黒竜の好きにはさせない！
MsgEn: We will not let the Black Dragon do as it pleases!

MsgJp: 破壊の先に何があるというんだ！
MsgEn: What is there beyond this path of destruction!

MsgJp: これ以上竜力は渡さないぞ！
MsgEn: We're not letting you take any more Dragon Force!

MsgJp: おまえじゃ話にならないよ
MsgEn: You're no help to me.

MsgJp: アッカーシェランから出て行け！
MsgEn: Get out of Acre Selund!

MsgJp: みんな！　もうひと押し！
MsgEn: Everyone!　One more push!

MsgJp: さあ、用は済んだ
MsgEn: Come on, we're done.

MsgJp:
いや、大事な用があったな
ほら、ネドと話せよ
MsgEn:
No, you got important things to do.
Come on. Talk to Nedo.

MsgJp: 隊長、胸騒ぎがする
MsgEn: Captain, I feel a stirring in my chest.

MsgJp: 早くレスタニアに戻ろうよ
MsgEn: Let's get back to Lestania as soon as possible.

MsgJp:
黒騎士は色々言ってましたけど
狙いは隊長ひとりのようです
MsgEn:
The Black Knight had a lot to say, 
but it seems he's after just the Captain.

MsgJp:
でも安心してくださいね
俺たちはいつも側にいますから！
MsgEn:
But don't worry,
we'll always be by your side!

MsgJp:
助かったよ――
正直、もうダメだと思った
MsgEn:
Thanks for the help--
I honestly thought I was screwed.

MsgJp:
あんたは今や全ての竜の世界の守護者だ
重荷だろうが、最後の時まで――頼むよ
MsgEn:
You are now the protector of the 
Dragons' world. It is a heavy burden, 
but I ask you to endure until the 
last possible moment――please.

MsgJp:
事態はわしの想像より遥かに大きな規模で
進んでいるようだな
MsgEn:
The situation seems to be progressing on a much 
larger scale than I could have imagined.

MsgJp:
この古臭い頭では我が祖国アッカーシェランと
ネド王子の未来しか思うことはできないが
おまえたちへの協力は惜しまん
なんなりと言いつけてくれ
MsgEn:
In this outdated mind, I can only envision 
my homeland, Acre Selund, and Prince Nedo's 
future, but my support for you is unwavering. 
Command me as you see fit.

MsgJp:
僕は竜どころか、覚者として、人として
未熟な子供です
MsgEn:
I am a child, immature not only as a Dragon, 
but also as an Arisen.

MsgJp:
未熟であることがこんなに歯がゆくて
悔しいことだなんて知りませんでした
MsgEn:
I never knew being inexperienced could be 
so teeth-grindingly frustrating!

MsgJp:
でも、この思いも力になると信じて
火竜の竜力とともに隊長さんに託しました
思い切り敵にぶつけてください！
MsgEn:
However, I entrusted this thought to you along 
with the Dragon Force of the Fire Dragon, 
believing that it will also become a 
force for good!
Please strike the enemy with all your might!

MsgJp:
それにしても恐ろしいのは黒竜の思惑
何もかも壊してしまうのが目的なんて
悲しくて仕方がありません
MsgEn:
Still, what terrifies me is the Black Dragon's 
intent. To destroy everything is its 
purpose, and I can't help but feel 
a profound sadness.

MsgJp: いったい何が起こっているのでしょうか
MsgEn: What in the world is going on?

MsgJp:
精霊竜、そして火竜の竜力をその身の内に
預かったというわけだな
MsgEn:
So you have the Dragon Force of the Spirit Dragon 
and the Fire Dragon both within your body.

MsgJp:
素晴らしい人望だな
おまえを選んだ我が眼に曇りなし――
これからも存分に戦うがよい
MsgEn:
You possess a great character, 
and my eyes were clear when I chose 
you to lead us.
I chose you... 
to fight this war to the bitter end.

MsgJp:
やあ、おかえり
どうやら火竜の竜力も預かってきたようだね
MsgEn:
Ah, welcome back.
It looks like you've been entrusted with the 
Dragon Force of the Fire Dragon as well.

MsgJp:
もうこわい物なしじゃないのかい？
そういうわけでもないのかな
MsgEn:
So, now there's nothing to fear, then?
I'm not so sure.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランでの奮戦は聞いている
疲れているだろうが、まだ休ませるわけには
いかない
MsgEn:
I've heard about your hard work in Acre Selund. 
I know you're tired, 
but we can't let you rest just yet.

MsgJp:
火竜と精霊竜の力
そして、我々白竜の覚者達の力で
なんとしてもこの世界を守るのだ
MsgEn:
With the power of the Fire Dragon and the 
Spirit Dragon's Dragon Force, as well as our own 
Arisen of the White Dragon, 
we will protect this world at all costs!

MsgJp:
今、レスタニア各地の調査をさせている
おまえ達にもすぐに現地に向かって貰うことに
なるだろう
MsgEn:
I'm having them survey the various regions of 
Lestania, 
and I'm sure you'll be heading there soon.

MsgJp: 今しばらくは力を備えよ
MsgEn: For now, gird your strength.

MsgJp:
ついに恐れていた事態が起きてしまった――
覚悟はしていたが、滅びの渦が
レスタニアの空に出現した
MsgEn:
At last, what I had feared has happened- 
I was prepared for it, 
but a Vortex of Stagnation has appeared 
in the skies of Lestania!

MsgJp:
我らレスタニアの総力を挙げて立ち向かう
時がきたのだ
MsgEn:
The time has come for all of us in 
Lestania to stand together.

MsgJp:
今、戦える者たちが各地へ散り、黒剣を
探している
そろそろ情報が入っていることだろう
MsgEn:
Now, the able-bodied are scattered all over the 
country looking for the Black Sword, 
and word should be coming in soon.

MsgJp:
状況の掌握に関してはファビオが
引き受けてくれている
MsgEn: Fabio is taking care of the situation.

MsgJp:
ファビオの指示に従い行き先を
決めてくれ
MsgEn:
Follow Fabio's directions and 
determine where you're going.

MsgJp:
騎士団、覚者の別なく事に当たっているが
全員が強い腕と心の持ち主ではない
MsgEn:
Knights and Arisen alike are in their element, 
but not all of them have strong arms and hearts.

MsgJp: 行って、皆を安心させてやってくれ
MsgEn: Go and reassure everyone.

MsgJp:
レスタニアには大勢の覚者がいて
全員が白竜様の盾と爪だから最強――
MsgEn:
There are many Arisen in Lestania, 
and all of them are the shield and claws of 
Lord White Dragon, 
so they are powerful-- the best.

MsgJp:
これまでも幾多の危機を乗り越えてきた
強者たちにこの大陸は守られている
MsgEn:
This continent is protected by strong individuals 
who have survived many crises in the past.

MsgJp:
うん、頭ではわかっているし
君のことはずっと信頼している
それなのにこの胸騒ぎはなんだろう
MsgEn:
Yes, I know this in my head, 
and I've always trusted you, 
but I can't shake this nagging 
feeling that I've got.

MsgJp:
わたしね
このレスタニアの様子や
隊長さんたちの活躍を全部見て
未来に届けることに決めてるの
MsgEn:
I know.
I've decided to watch everything that's going on 
in Lestania, and what Captain and the others are 
doing, and to deliver it to the future.

MsgJp:
だから隊長さん
ずっとずっと先の未来にまで届けられるように
お願いね
MsgEn:
So, Captain.
I hope to deliver it far, far into the future.
Please.

MsgJp:
我が後継者よ
おまえの身の内でたぎる
精霊竜、火竜の竜力を感じるぞ
MsgEn:
O my successor, 
within thee stirs the power 
of the Spirit Dragon and the Fire Dragon.

MsgJp:
しかし、我が心眼がとらえていた
黒竜の心象がもう見えぬ
MsgEn:
Yet, mine heart's vision doth no 
longer perceive the form of the 
Black Dragon—it eludes me now.

MsgJp:
竜の域を超えし存在となったか
あるいは闇に同化し、気を封じたのか
MsgEn:
Dost it now dwell as a being surpassing Dragons, 
or hath it assimilated with darkness, 
stifling its force.

MsgJp: 我が理解、最早及ばぬ
MsgEn: My understanding hath now reached its limit.

MsgJp:
来たか
時間はあまりないから良く聞いてくれ
MsgEn:
You're here. 
We don't have much time, so listen up.

MsgJp:
今、ゲルト騎士団長および
ハインツ率いる白衛騎士団――
MsgEn:
Now, the White Guard Knights, 
led by Knight Commander Gerd and Heinz--

MsgJp:
それぞれが黒騎士の目撃情報があった
土地に向かった
そこには黒剣が突き刺さって
いるはずだからな
MsgEn:
Each of them headed for the land where the 
Black Knight had been sighted, 
because that's where the Black Sword 
should have been impaled.

MsgJp:
さて、可能性のある場所は３箇所
おまえには、そのうちの１箇所に向かってもらう
MsgEn:
Now, there are three possible locations, 
and I want you to head to one of them.

MsgJp:
場所は地図で確認して――
そこが終わったら、他の部隊の
援護に向かってほしい
MsgEn:
Check the map for the location--
When you're done there, I want you to head 
out to cover the rest of the unit.

MsgJp:
全ての黒剣の破壊が成功した後
ヴァネッサ率いる白翼覚者隊が、滅びの渦の
直下、ドリード城へ突入する予定だ
MsgEn:
After all the Black Swords have been successfully 
destroyed, the White Wings Arisen Corps, 
led by Vanessa, 
will enter Dreed Castle, 
just below the Vortex of Doom.

MsgJp:
なあ？　こんなのありえない状況だよな？
俺はこないだまでの楽しい日常に戻りたい
MsgEn:
You see?　This is an insane situation, right?
I just want things to go back 
to the way they were before.

MsgJp:
そのためならなんでもするつもりだ
そして、今がその時だろう
おれの竜力をおまえに託すよ
だから、頼む！
MsgEn:
I'll do whatever it takes to make that happen, 
and now is the time.
I entrust you with my Dragon Force, so please!

MsgJp:
まずすべきは黒剣の破壊だ
地図で場所を確認して向かってくれ
フィンダムやアッカーシェランと同じ事が
起こっているが、たったひとつ違いがある
MsgEn:
First thing we need to do is destroy the 
Black Sword.
Check the map to see where it is and head there.
The same thing happened in Phindym and 
Acre Selund, with only one difference.

MsgJp:
竜力の争奪という段階はもう終わっている
つまり――やつらは本気で滅ぼしにくる
負けたら、終わりさ
MsgEn:
The battle for Dragon Force is already over.
In other words... 
they're really going to destroy us.
If we lose, it's over.

MsgJp:
神殿の騎士や覚者たちが
各地を慌ただしく駆け回っているけれど
噂は本当のようね
MsgEn:
There's a flurry of Temple Knights and Arisen 
running around the land, 
but the rumors seem to be true.

MsgJp:
森の魔物がおかしいのも
その黒剣と、あの渦のせいなんだね
MsgEn:
It's that Black Sword and the vortex that's 
making the forest monsters crazy.

MsgJp: だとしたら、私たちも戦います
MsgEn: If so, we will fight too.

MsgJp:
今は、ロンドジールから
君へ伝言を持って来たの
MsgEn: Now, I have a message for you from Rondejeel.

MsgJp:
君の仲間が、白衛騎士団を救うため
次の黒剣のあるガルドノック砦へ向かったわ
MsgEn:
Your friends are on their way to 
Gardnox Fortress, the location of the next 
Black Sword, to save the White Guard Knights.

MsgJp: 許せない
MsgEn: Unforgivable.

MsgJp: この森も、大地も、空も――
MsgEn: This forest, the soil, the sky--

MsgJp:
霊の宿りし母なる存在を穢してまで
生きるすべなどあるはずもないのに
MsgEn:
There's no way to live without defiling the 
Mother, in whom the spirits dwell.

MsgJp: よう、見ろよ
MsgEn: Hey, look.

MsgJp: ――ひどい有様だぜ
MsgEn: --It's a mess, buddy.

MsgJp:
隊長――
倒れているのは騎士団の人たちだよ？
MsgEn:
Captain--
The fallen are the Knights of the Order, you know?

MsgJp:
理やレスタニアの未来は大事だけど
何よりこんな事をするやつらが許せない！
MsgEn:
I care about the future of order, 
and Lestania.
But above all, 
I can't forgive those who would do this!

MsgJp: 隊長、騎士団の被害は想像以上です
MsgEn:
Captain, the damage to the Knights is 
beyond imagination.

MsgJp:
ファビオの情報によると、次の剣はこの先――
今はハインツ率いる部隊が黒剣の
対処にあたっているみたいです
MsgEn:
According to Fabio's information, 
the next sword is just down the road―― 
right now, Heinz's team is dealing 
with the Black Sword.

MsgJp: さあ、急いで行きましょう
MsgEn: Come on, let's go.

MsgJp:
ハインツと隊長は結構古い付き合いですよね？
早く応援に向かいましょう
MsgEn:
Heinz and the Captain are pretty 
old friends, aren't you?
Let's head over to support them 
as soon as possible.

MsgJp:
ああ――あんたたちが来てくれたのか
だったらもう安心だな――
MsgEn:
Oh... you guys are here.
Well, I guess we're in the clear then...

MsgJp:
俺は――イテテテ――
俺のことはいいから――早く、残りの剣を――
MsgEn:
I'm-- that hurts――
Don't worry about me... 
just get the rest of the swords...

MsgJp:
ありがとう
ハインツ副団長は無事だ
だが、囮となったゲルト団長が気掛かりだ
MsgEn:
Thank you.
Vice Commander Heinz is safe, 
but I'm worried about Commander Gerd, 
who acted as a decoy.

MsgJp: 早く応援に行かないと――
MsgEn: I have to go and support-- quickly――

MsgJp:
おお、あんたか――
来た早々に悪いがここはもう大丈夫だ
急ぎ、ゲルト団長のところへ向かってくれ
MsgEn:
Oh, it's you.
I'm sorry to bother you so soon, 
but we're all good here, 
and I need you to hurry up and 
get to Commander Gerd.

MsgJp:
俺たちの被害がこの程度で済んだのは
団長の部隊が魔物を引き付けようと
派手に戦ってくれたおかげだ
MsgEn:
The only reason we got away with this little 
damage was because the Commander's troops 
fought so spectacularly to attract the fiends.

MsgJp:
だが今回ばかりは、これまでのように
どうにかなる状況とは思えない
団長もそれを感じ、囮を買ってくれたのだ
MsgEn:
But I think this time around, the situation 
was not as manageable as in the past.
The Commander sensed this and 
decided to act as a decoy.

MsgJp:
俺は、ここの後始末ができしだい出立する
先行してゲルト団長の援護を頼む！
MsgEn:
I'll go as soon as I'm done cleaning up here.
Please forge ahead and cover Commander Gerd!

MsgJp:
ゲルト騎士団長の戦いぶりは騎士の鏡
しかし我々は生身の人間ゆえに
奮闘にも限界がある
MsgEn:
Commander Gerd's fighting spirit is the very 
definition of a knight's... 
but we are flesh and blood.
There is a limit to our struggle.

MsgJp:
あとは覚者の貴様――
いや、あんたたちに頼る他はないのだ
頼んだぞ！
MsgEn:
And now, we must depend on you, the Arisen...
No, we have no other choice but to rely on you!

MsgJp: 目が霞む、くそっ――
MsgEn: My eyes are blurry, damn it--

MsgJp: 剣は――黒剣はどうなった――
MsgEn: The sword ―― what happened to the black sword ――

MsgJp: 深手を負ったようだ――
MsgEn: I think I've taken a grave wound--

MsgJp:
俺に構わず、レスタニアを魔物から守ってくれ――
頼んだぞ――
MsgEn:
I don't care what happens to me, 
you protect Lestania from the fiends――
I'm counting on you――

MsgJp:
貴殿ら、どうしてここに――
そうかハインツか、要らぬ気遣いを――
MsgEn:
You guys, why are you here――
Ah, Heinz, always a worrier――

MsgJp:
我々騎士団は多大な犠牲を払って
黒騎士のものと思しき黒い剣に
集まる魔物どもを撃破した
MsgEn:
We, the Knight's Order, have at great cost 
defeated the fiends that gathered around the 
Black Sword, believed to belong to the 
Black Knight.

MsgJp:
今頃はドリード城に貴殿らの言う
ゲートが現れようとしていることだろう
そこから先の闇の世界では
我々はおそらく無力
MsgEn:
By now, the gate you speak of should be emerging 
at Dreed Castle, and from there we will likely be 
rendered powerless in the dark realm beyond.

MsgJp:
時間稼ぎなら命の続く限り引き受けよう
しかし戦いを終わらせることができるのは
貴殿たち覚者だけなのだ
MsgEn:
I'll stall for time as long as my life lasts, 
but only you Arisen can end the fight.

MsgJp:
さあ、急いでくれ
ヴァネッサ殿が、ドリード城で突入の準備を
している筈だ
MsgEn:
Come on, hurry up!
Lady Vanessa is supposed to be at 
Dreed Castle getting ready for the raid.

MsgJp: あとは貴殿に頼らせてくれ
MsgEn: Let me rely on you to do the rest.

MsgJp:
ドリード城へ急ぐんだ
ヴァネッサを始めとする覚者たちが
突入の準備をしている筈だ
MsgEn:
Hurry to Dreed Castle.
Vanessa and the other Arisen should be 
preparing to storm the castle.

MsgJp: よぉ、真打の登場だな
MsgEn: Hey, the real deal is here.

MsgJp:
お前たちの動きに合わせて突入する
なぁに、覚悟はできてるぜ
MsgEn:
I'm going in as soon as you make your move, 
I'm ready for it.

MsgJp:
そうか――
白衛騎士団の被害は聞きしに勝るな
MsgEn:
I see... The damage to the White Guard Knights 
is beyond description.

MsgJp:
彼らの犠牲が無駄にならないよう
俺たちも死力を尽くそう
MsgEn:
We'll do everything in our power to make sure 
their sacrifice was not in vain.

MsgJp: おまえが来るのを待っていたんだ
MsgEn: I've been waiting for you.

MsgJp:
我々は、闇の結界が解かれるタイミングに合わせ
渦へのゲートを探りに向かう
MsgEn:
Just in time for the unraveling of the 
dark warding. We are going to seek out the 
gate to the vortex.

MsgJp:
おまえも、神殿のトラバースの元へ行き
ドリード城内の、闇の波動を弱体化する
任務に当たってくれ
MsgEn:
You will go to Travers in the temple and take on 
the task of weakening the dark waves 
within Dreed Castle.

MsgJp:
おまえは城内に立ち込める
闇の波動を弱めてくれればいい
MsgEn:
All you have to do is weaken the waves 
of darkness in the castle.

MsgJp:
我々はそのタイミングを逃さず突入
渦へ繋がるゲートを見つけ出し確保する
MsgEn:
We'll seize the moment, rush in, find the 
gate leading to the vortex, and secure it.

MsgJp:
闇の波動の弱体化に手間取れば
その分、我々は疲弊していく
MsgEn:
The longer it takes to weaken the waves of 
darkness, the more holding on will drain us.

MsgJp: あまり待たせるなよ
MsgEn: Don't keep us waiting too long.

MsgJp:
我々も、闇の波動の弱体化のため
城内の魔物を掃討しつつ探索を行う
MsgEn:
We, too, will search the castle while clearing 
out the fiends in order to weaken 
the surge of darkness.

MsgJp: わたしは掃討の方が、好みだがな
MsgEn: I prefer sweeping up.

MsgJp:
ファビオから聞いたよ
ゲルト団長を救ってくれたらしいな
俺からも、礼を言わせて貰おう
MsgEn:
Fabio tells me that you saved Commander Gerd.
I'd like to thank you too.

MsgJp:
貴君と騎士団の協力の元
レスタニアに突き立てられた黒剣は
全て破壊できたようだ
MsgEn:
With your help and that of the Knights, 
it seems that we have destroyed all of the 
Black Swords that have been thrust into Lestania.

MsgJp:
いま、白竜様によってドリード城を包む
闇の結界は解かれた
MsgEn:
Lord White Dragon has just broken the dark 
wards surrounding Dreed Castle.

MsgJp:
これより白衛騎士団は、覚者たちと協力の元
ドリード城への魔物の集結を阻むため
各地で遊撃戦を展開する
MsgEn:
From now on, the White Guard Knights, in 
cooperation with the Arisen, will launch a series 
of coordinated assaults in various regions to 
prevent the monsters from gathering 
at Dreed Castle.

MsgJp:
さあ、貴君はドリード城をこれ以上
闇化させないように防ぎつつ、その時が来る準備を
整えてくれ
MsgEn:
Now, you must be ready when the time comes, while 
preventing the Dreed Castle from 
darkening any further.

MsgJp:
ドリード城をこれ以上、闇に呑ませてはならない
さあ、ミッションを受けてくれ
MsgEn:
Let no more darkness consume Dreed Castle.
Now, embark on your mission.

MsgJp: 突入の準備が整ったようだな
MsgEn: Looks like we're ready to go in.

MsgJp:
ドリード城の前で待つ
スケルツォから連絡が来ている
MsgEn:
We've received word from Scherzo, 
he's waiting in front of Dreed Castle.

MsgJp:
貴君たちの武運を祈ろう
さあ、行ってくれ
MsgEn:
I wish you all the best of luck. 
Now go.

MsgJp:
ドリード城を取り戻すには、またとない日だ！
さあ、行くんだ
MsgEn:
This is a prime day to reclaim the castle!
Come on, let's go.

MsgJp:
よお、調子はどうだ？
いよいよお前の出番ってわけだ
MsgEn:
All right, are you good?
It's finally your time.

MsgJp:
ヴァネッサ副隊長は、渦へのゲートを確保する
ために、城内中枢への突入を開始した
MsgEn:
Vice Captain Vanessa has begun the raid into the 
castle center to secure the gate to the vortex.

MsgJp:
お前も急ぎ、ヴァネッサ副隊長の元に向かってくれ
頼んだぞ
MsgEn:
You, too, hurry on over to 
Vice Captain Vanessa, please.

MsgJp:
あー、これで最後になるんなら、俺もはやく
副隊長の傍へ戻らないとな
MsgEn:
Ah well, if this is the last time I'm ever going 
to see her, I'd better get back to the 
Vice Captain as soon as possible.

MsgJp:
見てくれよ――
被害は甚大だが魔物はかなり倒したぜ？
MsgEn:
Look at that-- 
the damage is extensive, but we've killed a 
lot of monsters, eh?

MsgJp: あとは任せるよ
MsgEn: I'll leave the rest to you.

MsgJp: いくら倒しても魔物が次から次へと――
MsgEn:
No matter how many monsters I killed, 
one after the other--

MsgJp:
しかし、こちらもそろそろ限界だ
悪いが仕上げを頼む
MsgEn:
But we're almost at the end of our tether.
I'm sorry, but I'm gonna need you 
to finish it up.

MsgJp:
いいところに来てくれたな
助かったぞ
MsgEn:
You've come to the right place.
Thank the Dragon you're here.

MsgJp: 間に合って良かった
MsgEn: Glad you made it in time.

MsgJp:
ここに集まる魔物の強さは類を見ない
おまえはこんな魔物を相手に
他の大陸を巡ってきたのだな
MsgEn:
The monsters gathered here 
possess incredible power. 
You've fought such creatures across other 
continents, haven't you?

MsgJp:
普段なら嫉妬や羨望の気持ちも湧こうが
今はそんなものはない
MsgEn:
Normally, I would feel jealousy and envy of 
that, but right now I don't have 
anything like that.

MsgJp:
ただただ間近に迫る終焉に抗い
おまえの強さに未来を託す覚悟だ
MsgEn:
I am simply prepared to resist the imminent doom, 
and entrust the future to your strength.

MsgJp: さあ、わたしの竜力を受け取れ
MsgEn: Come, take my Dragon Force.

MsgJp:
おまえならわたし自身よりもこの力を
活かせるはずだ
MsgEn: You will have more use for this power than I do.

MsgJp:
みんな、お前を信じている、わたしも同じだ
ここはもう大丈夫
行くんだ！
MsgEn:
They believe in you, and so do I. 
We're gonna be okay here.
Go!

MsgJp:
おまえと初めて会った時のことは
忘れはしない
MsgEn: I'll never forget the first time I met you.

MsgJp:
――あの時の――初対面の印象が
聞きたければ無事に戻って来いよ
けして闇に飲まれるな
MsgEn:
...If you want to hear my impression of that first 
meeting... come back safe and sound, 
and don't let the darkness consume you.

MsgJp: ここは我が庭も同然――
MsgEn: This place is my garden...

MsgJp: 闇がおまえたちを蝕む――
MsgEn: The darkness will consume you...

MsgJp: ああ力がみなぎる――
MsgEn: Oh, how empowering it is...

MsgJp: 互いの名残りを惜しむがいい
MsgEn: Linger in the sorrow of parting ways.

MsgJp: おまえたちの声はどこにも届かぬ
MsgEn: Your voices will reach nowhere.

MsgJp: なぜそこまで戦う
MsgEn: Why do you fight so hard?

MsgJp: 理なき世におまえたちの居場所はない
MsgEn:
There is no place for you 
in a world without order.

MsgJp: 絶望の世を見ずにすむとは運がいい
MsgEn: You are lucky not to see a world of despair.

MsgJp: 自慢の竜力はどうした？
MsgEn:
What happened to the Dragon Force 
you are so proud of?

MsgJp: 終わりにしてやろう
MsgEn: Let's end this.

MsgJp: 無に帰すが良い
MsgEn: You may return to nothing.

MsgJp: さらば白竜の覚者たちよ
MsgEn: Farewell, Arisen of the White Dragon.

MsgJp: 好き勝手言いやがって
MsgEn: Say whatever you want.

MsgJp: おまえには負ける気はしねえよ
MsgEn: I don't feel like losing to you.

MsgJp: おまえには何度も勝ってるからな
MsgEn: Because I've won over and over again.

MsgJp: この奥にレオはいるのか？
MsgEn: Does Leo lie deeper within?

MsgJp: 頭が重いぜ――
MsgEn: My head is――

MsgJp: やっぱりここでの戦いは不利か――
MsgEn: It seems we're at a disadvantage in this fight――

MsgJp: もう逃がさないよ真っ黒男！
MsgEn: I won't let you get away with it anymore, shade!

MsgJp: 何度も負けたくせに、しつこいのよ！
MsgEn:
You may be persistent, 
but you've lost many a time!

MsgJp: うっ――何これ――闇の魔法！？
MsgEn: Ugh――what is this――dark magic!?

MsgJp: 強くなってる――黒騎士が強くなってる！
MsgEn:
It's getting stronger―― 
the Black Knight is getting stronger!

MsgJp: 隊長！　大丈夫！？
MsgEn: Captain!　You all right?!

MsgJp: エリオット――手、抜いてない？
MsgEn:
Elliott--
you're not holding back, are you?

MsgJp: 黒騎士め、ここで終わりだ！
MsgEn: This is where it ends, Black Knight!

MsgJp: 俺たちがその他大勢なら、おまえもだ！
MsgEn:
If we're nothing special, 
then neither are you!

MsgJp: 白竜様の覚者を舐めるな
MsgEn: Don't underestimate the White Dragon's Arisen.

MsgJp: 闇の中がお似合いさ
MsgEn: You belong in the dark.

MsgJp: ガルドリン、リズ、大丈夫かい？
MsgEn: Gurdolin, Lise, are you okay?

MsgJp: 俺――ちょっと休みたい
MsgEn: I--I need a break.

MsgJp:
レオめ――ありゃあなんだ？
勝ち誇って、予告か？
MsgEn:
Leo... What in the world was that? 
Is he showing off or giving us a heads-up?

MsgJp:
俺たちには勝ち目がないと
決め付けてやがる
MsgEn: They're convinced we don't stand a chance.

MsgJp:
いやな感じでしたね
あのままあの闇の中にいたら
どうなっていたことか
MsgEn:
It was a disgusting feeling.
I don't know what would have happened if we 
had stayed in that darkness.

MsgJp:
俺たちも統率みたいに
なっちゃうんでしょうかね
MsgEn:
I wonder if we'd end up 
like the commander.

MsgJp:
レオとか黒竜とか気になるけど
とにかく黒騎士は倒したんだから――
MsgEn:
I'm concerned about Leo and the Black Dragon 
and all that, but at any rate, 
we beat the Black Knight--

MsgJp:
もっと喜びたいけど――無理！
ああ、憂鬱～！
MsgEn:
I wish I could rejoice more - but I can't!
Oh, so depressing～!

MsgJp: どうなったんだ？
MsgEn: What happened?

MsgJp:
問題は解決したのか？
俺たちは勝ったのか？
MsgEn:
Have we solved the problem?
Did we win?

MsgJp: ごくろうだったな
MsgEn: You've worked hard.

MsgJp:
これでやっと落ち着いて仲間を
弔ってやることができるよ
ほんと――大勢やられたな
MsgEn:
Now I can finally calm down and mourn my friends.
It's just-- we lost a lot of people.

MsgJp:
この犠牲は――
意味があったのだろうか
MsgEn:
I wonder if this sacrifice was――
worth it.

MsgJp:
いや無意味だなんて思いたくない
あそこに倒れていたのは
俺だったかもしれないのだから
MsgEn:
No, I don't want to think it's pointless. 
It could easily have been me lying on 
the cold ground.

MsgJp:
よく帰ってきたな
話したいことは山ほどあるが
まずは覚者の責任を果たそうか
MsgEn:
I'm so glad you're home.
There's so much I want to tell you.
But first, let's fulfill our responsibilities as Arisen.

MsgJp:
レオの予告通り黒竜が来るとなれば――
いや、このレスタニアの土を
踏ませてなるものか！
MsgEn:
If the Black Dragon were to come, 
as Leo predicted--
No, I will not let them step on the 
soil of our Lestania!

MsgJp:
まずはこれからすべきことを
確認する必要があるな
MsgEn:
First, we need to make sure we know 
what we're going to do.

MsgJp:
神殿へ戻れば何か進展があるかもしれない
ファビオやジョゼフ――
白竜と話してくるがいい
MsgEn:
Maybe we can make some progress back at the 
temple, talk to Fabio, Joseph--
Or maybe you should go talk to the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
おかえりなさい隊長さん
リズたちも無事で良かったね
MsgEn:
Welcome back, Captain.
I'm glad Lise and her family are safe.

MsgJp:
でも疲れたら休んでね
もし倒れちゃってもパメラと一緒に
看病するけど――やっぱり無理はダメだよ？
MsgEn:
But if you are tired, take a rest.
If you collapse, Pamela and I will take care of 
you, but you mustn't overdo it, okay?

MsgJp:
おつかれさん
はぁ――ついに、いよいよって感じだ
ジョゼフから聞いてくれ
MsgEn:
Well done. 
Ahh― it truly feels like the moment has 
finally arrived. Please talk to Joseph.

MsgJp:
見たところ、怪我もなさそうだね
顔を見て安心したよ
MsgEn:
From the looks of you, 
you don't appear to be hurt. 
I'm relieved to see your face.

MsgJp:
黒い剣を巡る戦いでは大勢の覚者
そして騎士団も戦力外になってしまった
MsgEn:
The battle for the Black Sword has left many 
Arisen and Knights out of action.

MsgJp:
君たち――いや君が最後の砦さ
いや、最後の剣だろうか――
MsgEn:
You guys - you're the last bastion.
Or perhaps the last sword...

MsgJp:
黒竜がうごめいている――
気配を感じる――
MsgEn:
The Black Dragon doth stir――
I sense its presence――

MsgJp:
我が大地を覗き込んでいるかのようだ――
黒竜よ、そうはさせぬぞ――
MsgEn:
'Tis as if it gazes upon my land――
O obsidian wyrm, thou shalt not prevail――

MsgJp:
ごくろうだったな
しかしあの黒騎士を始末してもなお
状況は好転しない
MsgEn:
I'm sorry you had to go through that.
But even with that Black Knight out of the way, 
things aren't getting any better.

MsgJp:
今はまだ、はっきりと見てはとれぬが
ザンドラ禁域周辺で、天変地異の前触れとも
言える兆しが目撃されているそうだ
MsgEn:
Although it is not clear at this time, 
signs of what could be called a precursor to a 
natural disaster have been seen around the 
Zandora Wastelands.

MsgJp:
おそらく黒竜は彼の地――
メルゴダの上空に自身がくぐり抜けるため
暗黒大陸とレスタニアを繋ぐゲートを
出現させるつもりなのだろう
MsgEn:
It is likely that the Black Dragon plans to open 
a gate linking his dark continent and Lestania, 
to pass through the skies above Mergoda.

MsgJp:
そうなれば、ああ、このレスタニアが
終わるというのか
MsgEn:
If that happens-- 
Ah, it will be the end of our Lestania.

MsgJp:
いや、わたしは滅び行くレスタニアなんぞ
見たくないわ
MsgEn: No, I will not see a dying Lestania.

MsgJp:
おまえたち、信じているぞ
頼れるのは、おまえたちしかいないのだ
MsgEn:
You guys, I believe in you. 
You're the only ones I can truly count on.

MsgJp:
いよいよこの時が来た
ついに滅びの渦がメルゴダの深淵の空に現れた
MsgEn:
At last the time has come.
The Vortex of Stagnation has finally appeared in 
the skies of the Mergoda Abyss.

MsgJp: 暗黒の世界と我がレスタニアを繋ぐ門だ
MsgEn:
It is the gate between the world of darkness 
and our own Lestania.

MsgJp:
黒竜が渦をくぐり抜ける前に倒さなければ
我々の理は破壊され、世界は滅ぶだろう
MsgEn:
If we do not defeat the Black Dragon before it 
passes through the vortex, 
our order will be destroyed 
and the world will fall.

MsgJp: 我が最後の力をおまえに託す
MsgEn: I entrust my final strength unto thee—

MsgJp: 行け、我が覚者よ
MsgEn: Go, my Arisen.

MsgJp:
生ある限り戦いは続く
よって――

これをおまえの最後の戦いにしてはならぬ
いざ――メルゴダの深淵へ

ジョゼフのじいさんめ、妙に穏やかな顔を
しやがって――
MsgEn: Old man Joseph, with his strangely serene face--

MsgJp:
ありゃあ覚悟を決めた顔だ
ふん――
俺たちを信じろってなあ？
MsgEn:
That's a look of determination on his face...
Trust us, huh?

MsgJp:
隊長、いよいよこの時が来た――
そう思っていいんだよね？
ついに黒竜との決戦だよね？
MsgEn:
Captain, the time has finally come--
You think so, don't you?
We're finally going to have the climactic battle 
with the Black Dragon, right?

MsgJp: ああ、震えちゃうなあ
MsgEn: Oh, it makes me shiver.

MsgJp:
俺はね、あちこちに渦が現れるようになってから
ずっと考えてるんです
MsgEn:
Me, I've been thinking about it ever since those 
vortexes started popping up all over the place.

MsgJp:
レオ統率が、この世界にはたくさんの
理があるって言ってからずっと――
MsgEn:
Ever since Commander Leo told me that there's 
a lot of Orders out there--

MsgJp:
俺、何も知らないんだな――って
だから、負けてそのまま死んじゃうなんて
絶対にできませんよ
MsgEn:
I don't know about any of that...
So, I can't just let go and die without a fight.

MsgJp:
ついにだね
最後の滅びの渦がメルゴダの深淵に現れてから
すぐさまテオドール様の元へ行ってきたんだ
MsgEn:
At last.
I went to Master Theodor right after the final 
Vortex of Stagnation 
appeared in the Mergoda Abyss.

MsgJp:
君のために、僕が出来る準備は
すべてしておいたつもりだよ
MsgEn: I think I've done all the preparation I can for you.

MsgJp:
これまで幾多の危機を乗り越えてきた
我がレスタニアだが――
MsgEn:
We have been through many crises in our time here 
in Lestania, but we have always been 
able to overcome them...

MsgJp:
取り分け深刻な危機を回避できたのは
おまえのおかげだ
MsgEn:
Especially since it was you who averted 
a rather serious crisis.

MsgJp:
メルゴダの深淵は、メルゴダ護政区の奥深く
だが、黒剣を探し出して破壊せねば護政区には
近づけんことは既に承知の通りだ
MsgEn:
The Mergoda Abyss is deep within the 
Mergoda Security District, but you already know 
that the Black Sword must be found and 
destroyed in order to get inside.

MsgJp:
テオドールから使いが参ってな
黒剣は亡都メルゴダで発見されたそうだ
MsgEn:
Theodor sent a messenger to tell you that the 
Black Sword was found in the Mergoda Ruins.

MsgJp:
メルゴダでの黒剣の発見は、クラウスが
いちはやく動いてくれたお陰らしい
MsgEn:
The discovery of the Black Sword in Mergoda 
was thanks to Klaus' swift actions.

MsgJp:
クラウスから詳細を聞いた後、亡都メルゴダで待つ
テオドールの元へ向かってくれ
MsgEn:
After you get the details from Klaus, 
go to Theodor. 
He is waiting for you in the Mergoda Ruins.

MsgJp:
今回も頼りにさせてもらうぞ
いや、おまえのことだ
もはや重荷とさえ感じていないかもしれんな
MsgEn:
I'll be relying on you again this time.
Maybe you don't even feel like it's a 
burden anymore.

MsgJp:
クラウスの奴め、なんだかんだでもう
立派にわたしを追い越しておるわ
MsgEn: Klaus has already surpassed me in many ways.

MsgJp:
黒剣の場所は、テオドール様と共に
もう目星は付けてある
MsgEn:
I already have the location of the Black Sword in 
my sights, along with Master Theodor.

MsgJp:
そして、渦が現れたメルゴダの深淵がある護政区は
すでに闇の中だ
MsgEn:
And the district where the Mergoda Abyss is 
located, where the vortex emerged, 
is already shrouded in darkness.

MsgJp:
テオドール様の元へ行く前に
メルゴダ護政区の近くへ行って、渦の様子も
見ておいた方が良い
MsgEn:
You might want to head over to the vicinity of 
the Mergoda Security District and take a look at 
the vortex before you go to Master Theodor's.

MsgJp:
渦は、地図のこの場所ならよく観察できると思う
僕にできることは悔しいけどここまで
MsgEn:
I think the vortex can be better observed at this 
spot on the map, 
though I'm sorry I can only help this much.

MsgJp:
お願いだ、滅びの渦を退けて
帰ってくると約束して
MsgEn:
Please, promise me that you will repel the 
Vortex of Stagnation, and return.

MsgJp: 必ずだよ――
MsgEn: Be sure――

MsgJp: 必ず帰ってきて欲しい――
MsgEn: You must return――

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様とふたりで思い出話なんて
ゾッとするからね！
MsgEn:
Talking about old memories with Master Joseph 
is enough to send chills down my spine!

MsgJp:
あれか！
これまでの渦とは何かが違うな
MsgEn:
There it is!
There's something different about this vortex 
compared to the others we've seen thus far.

MsgJp: おい、急ぎテオドールのところへ向かうぞ！
MsgEn: Hey, let's hurry up and get to Theodor!

MsgJp: とっととかかるぞ！
MsgEn: It's gonna take a while!

MsgJp:
大きい――
あの渦の向こうには、黒竜がいるんだね
MsgEn:
It's big--
Beyond that vortex, 
there's the Black Dragon, right?

MsgJp:
あの渦を通り、黒竜がこの世界に到達する
そういうことですよね！　俺たち急がないと！
MsgEn:
Passing through that vortex, that's how the 
Black Dragon will reach this world!　
We have to hurry!

MsgJp:
メルゴダの深淵に現れた、あの黒い渦――
そして、ここ亡都メルゴダの地面に突き立てられた
黒剣の意味はジョゼフ殿の使者から聞いた
MsgEn:
The black vortex that appeared in 
the Mergoda Abyss...
The meaning of the Black Sword, which was thrust 
into the ground here in the Mergoda Ruins, 
all told to me by a messenger from Master Joseph.

MsgJp:
禍の始まりの地、ディアマンテスの所業から
既にこの日が来る運命となっていたのだろう
MsgEn:
From the actions of Diamantes, the land 
where the calamity began. 
It appears this day was fated to arrive.

MsgJp:
君にはいつも大きなものばかり背負わせてしまうが
それも同じく宿命だと思って受け入れてくれ
MsgEn:
I know I always make you carry a heavy burden, 
but just think of it as your destiny and 
accept it as such.

MsgJp:
さて――問題の黒剣の場所だが
クラウスが、メルゴダの錬金術師の中心となり
調べ上げてくれた
MsgEn:
Now--the location of the Black Sword in question.
Klaus, acting as the central figure of the 
alchemists of Mergoda, 
has done all the research.

MsgJp:
今は、いくばくかの仲間が黒剣を破壊しようと
動いているが、わたしたちの数では
黒剣に集う魔物たちを、完全に追い払う事が
出来ないでいる
MsgEn:
At the moment, some of our comrades are working 
to destroy the Black Sword, but our numbers are 
not enough to completely drive away the 
monsters that are gathering around it.

MsgJp:
力を貸して欲しい
黒剣は全部で２箇所
全ての剣を破壊しなくてはならない
MsgEn:
We need your help.
There are two Black Swords in total, and both 
of them must be destroyed.

MsgJp:
亡都メルゴダの行く末は、君と共にある
よろしく頼む
MsgEn:
The fate of the Mergoda Ruins is 
with you, my friend.

MsgJp:
思えば――
この切り離されたメルゴダをレスタニアに
引き戻してくれたのは君だったな
MsgEn:
When you think about it--
It was you that returned Mergoda, 
this disconnected Mergoda, 
back to Lestania.

MsgJp:
運命――宿命――いや、理というべきか
我々にそれを取り戻してくれたのは
あの日の君だ
もう一度、頼らせてくれ
MsgEn:
Fate-- destiny-- or should I say order-- 
It was you who brought it back to us that day.
Let me rely on you one more time.

MsgJp: 加勢かたじけない、地上の覚者よ
MsgEn:
I am grateful for your help, 
Arisen of the surface.

MsgJp:
黒剣は破壊出来ようとも、もはやあの渦を
消し去る術は、あなたに頼るしかありません
MsgEn:
Even if the Black Sword can be destroyed, 
we must now rely on you to eliminate that vortex.

MsgJp:
クラウスが示した次の黒剣のある場所は
この先です
MsgEn:
Klaus indicated that the next 
Black Sword is just up ahead.

MsgJp: メルゴダと私達の未来を、あなたに託します
MsgEn:
The future of Mergoda, 
and of us, is in your hands.

MsgJp:
あなたから不思議な力を感じます
あなたを見守り、願う、たくさんの祈りのような――
MsgEn:
I can sense a mysterious power coming from you, 
watching over you, wishing you well, 
like so many prayers-- 
I'm not sure what it is, but I'm sure it's there.

MsgJp: すべての竜があなたと共にあらんことを
MsgEn: Let every Dragon be with you.

MsgJp: テオドール様が次の場所に向かわれた
MsgEn: Master Theodor has moved on to the next location.

MsgJp:
ここと同じく、辺りは闇の魔物で溢れている
急いで欲しい
MsgEn:
Like here, the area is full of all sorts of 
dark fiends, so we need you to hurry.

MsgJp:
これで、亡都メルゴダに突き立てられた黒剣は
すべて破壊できた
MsgEn:
With this, we have destroyed all the Black Swords 
that have been thrust upon the Mergoda Ruins.

MsgJp:
この地からの竜力の吸い上げは止まり
闇に閉ざされたメルゴダ護政区を救う算段が
立てれるはずだ
MsgEn:
The Dragon Force will cease to be siphoned from 
this place, and we will be able to make a plan to 
save the Mergoda Security District, 
which is plunged into darkness.

MsgJp:
君の仲間がすでに、メルゴダ護政区の
入口へ向かっている
MsgEn:
Your people are already on their way to the 
entrance of the Mergoda Security District.

MsgJp:
さあ、残りの魔物はわたしたちに任せてくれ
仲間の元へ行くと良い
MsgEn:
Now, leave the rest of the fiends to us.
Go to your comrades.

MsgJp:
このわたしにも、魔物と戦う力が
まだ残っていようとはな
MsgEn:
I can't believe I still have the power to 
battle the beasts.

MsgJp:
しかし、これで終わりだ
クラウスには、錬金術師が戦う必要のない
新たな未来を築いてもらうつもりだからな
MsgEn:
But this is where it ends. I intend for 
Klaus to build a new future where 
alchemists no longer need to fight.

MsgJp: 隊長、黒剣は全部破壊できたみたいだね
MsgEn:
Captain, it appears you were able to destroy 
all the Black Swords.

MsgJp:
ゲートの発見は、わたしたちに任せて
隊長は、急ぎ神殿に戻って準備してきて
MsgEn:
Leave discovering the gate to us, Captain, 
and head back to the temple to get ready.

MsgJp:
わたしたちは、隊長の動きに合わせて
ここで闇の流れを見張ってるからね
MsgEn:
We'll stay here and keep an eye on the 
flow of darkness while Captain works.

MsgJp:
レオが何か考えてんなら
そろそろ動きがあってもおかしくねえ
MsgEn:
If Leo has something in mind, 
it's about time he made a move.

MsgJp:
まあ、何をしてこようが、あいつは俺たちの敵だ
こっちも本気で行くぜ
MsgEn:
Well, whatever he's going to do, he's our enemy, 
and we're going to take him seriously.

MsgJp:
レオ統率が、どんな世界を望もうとも
世界が無くなってしまえば元も子もないですよね
MsgEn:
No matter what kind of world Commander Leo wants, 
if the world disappears, that's it.

MsgJp:
ましてや理を壊すだなんて
レスタニアを守ってきたのは俺たちの隊長なんです
それだけは事実ですから
MsgEn:
Let alone destroying Order.
It's our Captain who has been protecting 
Lestania, that's the real truth.

MsgJp:
亡都メルゴダに突き立てられた黒剣も
全て破壊できたようだな
MsgEn:
It looks like you were able to destroy all the 
Black Swords that were thrust 
upon the Mergoda Ruins.

MsgJp:
すでに白竜様により、メルゴダ護政区を包む
闇の結界は解かれている
MsgEn:
Lord White Dragon has already lifted the wards 
of darkness in Mergoda.

MsgJp:
もはや騎士団に残された力も僅かだ――
しかし、最後のひとりになったとしても
我らは決してあきらめはしない
MsgEn:
The Knight's Order has little strength left.
But even if we are the last...
We will not give up.

MsgJp:
こんな時だが、貴君と初めて出会った
テル村でのガルドリンとの一件が思い出されるよ
MsgEn:
At a time like this, I am reminded of the 
incident with Gurdolin in Tel Village, 
where we first met.

MsgJp:
貴君のあきらめの悪さも、あの時以来変わらないな
俺も見習わせてもらおう
MsgEn:
Your unwillingness to give up hasn't changed 
since then, 
and I'm going to learn from your example.

MsgJp:
さあ、貴君はメルゴダ護政区をこれ以上
闇化させないように防ぎつつ、その時が来る準備を
整えてくれ
MsgEn:
Now, you must be ready when the time comes, while 
preventing the Mergoda Security District from 
darkening any further.

MsgJp:
メルゴダ護政区を、これ以上、闇に呑ませては
ならない
さあ、ミッションを受けてくれ
MsgEn:
Let no more darkness consume the 
Mergoda Security District.
Now, embark on your mission.

MsgJp: 突入の準備が整ったようだな
MsgEn: Looks like we're ready to go in.

MsgJp:
メルゴダ護政区の前で待つ
リズから連絡が来ている
MsgEn:
Lise sent word that she would be waiting in front 
of the Mergoda Security District.

MsgJp:
貴君たちの武運を祈ろう
さあ、行ってくれ
MsgEn:
I wish you all the best of luck. 
Now go.

MsgJp:
メルゴダ護政区を取り戻すには、またとない日だ！
さあ、行くんだ
MsgEn:
This is a prime day to reclaim Mergoda!
Come on, let's go.

MsgJp: 隊長、ゲートの場所がわかったよ
MsgEn: Captain, I think I know where the gate is.

MsgJp:
ゲートは、メルゴダ護政区に入り
まっすぐに進んだその先――
MsgEn:
The gate is straight ahead as you 
enter Mergoda and――

MsgJp:
イリスとミシアルを失った
メルゴダの深淵のある、あの場所だよ
MsgEn:
That place where we lost Iris and Mysial, 
where the Mergoda Abyss is located.

MsgJp:
準備ができたなら――
突入しよう！
MsgEn:
If you're ready --
let's go!

MsgJp:
今がチャンスだよ
行こう、隊長！
MsgEn:
Now's our chance.
Let's go, captain!

MsgJp: レオの野郎、結局、姿を見せなかったな
MsgEn: That bastard Leo didn't show up after all.

MsgJp:
相手が悪かったことに、いまさら気づいたのかもな
さてと、気合い入れて行こうぜ
MsgEn:
Maybe he's just now realizing that he's been 
playing with the wrong guy. 
All right, let's get fired up and go!

MsgJp:
俺、何があっても生き残って
この世界のこと、もう一度見てまわります
MsgEn:
I'll survive no matter what, 
and tour the world one more time.

MsgJp: 共に戦いましょう
MsgEn: Let's fight together.

MsgJp: 全ての結末が近づいています
MsgEn: It's all coming to an end.

MsgJp: さあ、武器を振るうのです
MsgEn: Now, wield your weapons.

MsgJp: 下がりなさい！　闇の魔物よ！
MsgEn: Get back! You creature of darkness!

MsgJp: さすが白竜の覚者です
MsgEn: As expected, it's the White Dragons' Arisen.

MsgJp: 未来はまだ、定まった訳ではありません
MsgEn: The future is not yet settled.

MsgJp: あなたたちが道を切り開くのです
MsgEn: You will lead the way.

MsgJp: 覚者は竜を守り、竜は理を守るのです
MsgEn:
Arisen protect the Dragon, 
and the Dragon protects Order.

MsgJp: 闇の力に屈してはなりません
MsgEn: Do not succumb to the forces of darkness.

MsgJp: ミシアル、下がってろ
MsgEn: Mysial, stand back.

MsgJp: 押して押しまくるか
MsgEn: Just keep pushing.

MsgJp: こりゃ言うほど簡単じゃないぜ
MsgEn: That isn't as easy as it sounds.

MsgJp: ゲートの中が本番だってのによ！
MsgEn: The real challenge is within the gate!

MsgJp: 隊長、リズ、エリオット、休むなよ
MsgEn: Captain, Lise, Elliot, keep moving!

MsgJp: 俺は一回休むぞ
MsgEn: I gotta catch my breath.

MsgJp: ミシアル、かっこいい！
MsgEn: Mysial, how impressive you are!

MsgJp: 戦う巫女さんだね、ミシアル
MsgEn: Mysial, the priestess who fights.

MsgJp: こいつ、見るからに強そうだよ
MsgEn: This guy looks strong.

MsgJp: みんながんばろう！
MsgEn: Let's all do our best!

MsgJp: エリオット、いいところ見せなさいよ
MsgEn: Elliot, show me the good stuff.

MsgJp: 最後の戦いには――しないんだから
MsgEn:
Because I'm not going to―― 
get to the final battle.

MsgJp: ミシアルと共闘なんて夢のようです！
MsgEn:
Fighting together with Mysial 
is a dream come true!

MsgJp: 何をしてくるかわかりません、気をつけて
MsgEn:
You never know what they will do. 
Be careful.

MsgJp: 敵の動きをよく見て
MsgEn: Watch the enemy's movements carefully.

MsgJp: 隊長、ミシアル！　勝利は間近です！
MsgEn: Captain, Mysial! Victory is right around the corner!

MsgJp: うわ――きつい――
MsgEn: Wow――this is tough――

MsgJp: ここで屈するわけにはいかない！
MsgEn: We cannot give in here!

MsgJp:
まあ、こんなもんだ
ミシアルは結構戦力になったしな
MsgEn:
Well, this is what happens when you have 
Mysial. 
Quite a force to be reckoned with.

MsgJp:
さあ、勢いのあるうちに行こうぜ？
残りの戦い全部に俺たちは勝つ
ああ、全財産かけてやってもいいぜ！
MsgEn:
C'mon, let's go while the 
momentum's still good, okay?
We're gonna smash every battle we have left.
Yeah, I'd put all my money on it!

MsgJp:
隊長、このゲートの向こうには
本当の最後の戦いが待ってるんだよね
MsgEn:
Captain, just beyond these gates, 
the real final battle awaits.

MsgJp:
わたしは全力で戦うつもりだけど――
でもこれは隊長ひとりの戦いなのかもしれないね
MsgEn:
I'm going to fight as hard as I can―― 
but this may end up being a 
one-man battle, Captain.

MsgJp: 一番強い覚者は誰か――
MsgEn: ――The strongest Arisen――

MsgJp:
それを決めなくちゃいけないなら
わたしは全力で――隊長を応援するよ
MsgEn:
If that's what must be said, 
I will give my all―― 
to support you, Captain.

MsgJp:
隊長、準備はいいですか？
ついに――
最後の戦いの道半ばという感じですね
MsgEn:
Captain, are you prepared? 
At long last―― 
it feels like we stand halfway 
into the last battle.

MsgJp:
覚者は白竜の爪、牙、うろこ、武器、鎧――
色々言われてますけど俺は隊長の右腕が
しっくりきますよ
MsgEn:
The Arisen are the claws, fangs, scales, weapons, 
and armor of the White Dragon--
I know a lot of people say that, but I feel right 
at home as the Captain's right hand man.

MsgJp: 強くなりましたね――白竜の覚者よ
MsgEn:
You have grown stronger...
Arisen of the White Dragon.

MsgJp: 今こそ、心を強くお持ちなさい
MsgEn: Now is the time to be resolute in your heart.

MsgJp: 真実を見極め、選択を誤らぬように先へ進むのです
MsgEn:
Discern the truth and act on it, 
so you don't make a poor choice.

MsgJp: おまえたち――そこで見ていろよ
MsgEn: You guys―― keep watching from over there.

MsgJp: これは至高を決める戦いだ
MsgEn: This is the battle to determine supremacy.

MsgJp: どうした――そんなものか！
MsgEn: What's wrong―― is that all you have?

MsgJp: ほう――やるじゃないか
MsgEn: Well--that's a good one.

MsgJp: 俺が見込んだ通りだ
MsgEn: Just as I had hoped.

MsgJp: なるほど――あの頃とは違うな
MsgEn: I see ―― it's different from those days.

MsgJp: そろそろ決めにかかるぞ
MsgEn: It's time to make up our minds.

MsgJp: おいおい、それじゃあ黒竜は倒せないぞ
MsgEn:
Oh come on, 
that's not going to defeat the Black Dragon.

MsgJp: 竜力を使いこなすんだ！
MsgEn: You have to master the Dragon Force!

MsgJp: もしや力を温存しているのか？
MsgEn: Are you perhaps conserving your strength?

MsgJp: 俺を甘くみちゃあ困る
MsgEn:
Don't underestimate me; 
it will be a mistake.

MsgJp: ふん――ついにこの日が来たか
MsgEn: Hmph― so, the day has finally arrived.

MsgJp: レオめ、黙っていられないのは変わらんな
MsgEn:
Leo, you can't keep your mouth shut, 
that hasn't changed.

MsgJp: 隊長、迷うなよ！
MsgEn: Captain, don't lose your way!

MsgJp: レオの奴、すげー力を持ってやがる！
MsgEn: Leo's got some serious power in him!

MsgJp: 隊長、おまえが白竜の後継者だ！　いけるぞ！
MsgEn:
Captain, you're the heir to the White Dragon! 
You can do it!

MsgJp: 隊長、もうひと押しだ！
MsgEn: One more push, Captain!

MsgJp: 隊長、耳を貸しちゃダメだよ！
MsgEn: Captain, don't listen!

MsgJp: 言葉に惑わされないで！
MsgEn: Don't be misled by words!

MsgJp: 正しい力の使い方、見せてやって！
MsgEn: Show them the correct way to use power!

MsgJp: あぶない！　気をつけて！
MsgEn: Dangerous! Be careful!

MsgJp: 隊長、深呼吸！
MsgEn: Captain, take a deep breath!

MsgJp: 統率は本気だ！
MsgEn: The commander is serious!

MsgJp: こんな戦いは、見たくなかったです
MsgEn: I didn't want to see this fight.

MsgJp: でも、この戦いの先にしか未来がないのであれば――
MsgEn: But if there is only a future beyond this battle--

MsgJp: 隊長、勝って下さい！
MsgEn: Captain, please win!

MsgJp: 最強なら、隊長に決まってますよ！
MsgEn: If it's the strongest, it has to be the Captain!

MsgJp: 死ぬんじゃねーぞ
MsgEn: Don't you die.

MsgJp: みんなから託されたもん、生きて返さねーとな
MsgEn:
Everyone entrusted you with their lives, 
and you have to return them alive.

MsgJp: 隊長、帰ってきてね
MsgEn: Captain, come back.

MsgJp:
隊長がいないと、ガルドリンやエリオットたち
ううん、わたしも好き勝手しちゃうんだから
MsgEn:
Without the Captain, Gurdolin and Elliot, 
well, I'll do whatever I please too!

MsgJp:
世界を救うことと引き換えに
人が消えるなんて、俺はもう御免です
MsgEn:
I'm not willing to sacrifice people in exchange 
for saving the world.

MsgJp: 俺、隊長が戻るまで、ずっとここで待ってますよ
MsgEn: I'm gonna stay here until the Captain gets back.

MsgJp: 竜は理から生まれた――
MsgEn: Dragons are born from order...

MsgJp: 竜は理の守護者――
MsgEn: Dragons are guardians of order...

MsgJp: わたしは知ったのだ――
MsgEn: I learned that--

MsgJp: 理はわたしを縛りつける――
MsgEn: Order binds me――

MsgJp: 理はこの狭き世界にわたしを閉じ込める
MsgEn: Order confines me to this small world.

MsgJp: 理の外とは如何なるものか――
MsgEn: What is it like to be outside the realm of order--

MsgJp: わたしはその理の外を見たい――
MsgEn: I want to look outside of that order...

MsgJp: 理の壁を壊してやろう
MsgEn: Let's break down the walls of order.

MsgJp: もはや何人もわたしを止めることは出来ぬ
MsgEn: No one can stop me anymore.

MsgJp: この世界を壊して穴をあけるのだ――
MsgEn:
We're going to destroy this world 
and make a hole――

MsgJp: もうすぐ終わる――
MsgEn: It'll be over soon――

MsgJp: おまえたちを倒し――
MsgEn: I will vanquish you――

MsgJp: わたしは理の外を見よう――
MsgEn: I shall look outside the bounds of order--

MsgJp: MsgJp
MsgEn: MsgEn

MsgJp:
ううう――
お、おなかが、いたい――
MsgEn:
Ugh...
My stomach hurts...

MsgJp:
この前拾った変な色の木の実――
いくつか味見してみたんだけど
それがまずかったみたい――
MsgEn:
The odd-colored berries I picked up the other 
day... 
I sampled a few, but they seem to 
have been bad...

MsgJp:
こんなとき――
あれがあれば――
MsgEn:
At times like this...
If I had that...

MsgJp: あの草が食べたい――
MsgEn: I want some of that weed--

MsgJp:
え？　まさか――
あの草を探してきてくれるの？
MsgEn:
What?　Don't tell me--
You're going to go look for that weed?

MsgJp:
アタシが餓えてさまよう子供だった頃
見つけてはかじってた、あの道端の草――
あれをかじると、なぜかお腹の調子がよくなるの
MsgEn:
When I was a starving, wandering child, I used to 
find that roadside weed and nibble on it.
When I chewed on it, for some reason, it made 
my stomach feel better.

MsgJp:
特徴はこれに書いてあるから
お願いね――
MsgEn: The features are written on this, so please--

MsgJp:
子供の頃ね、よく食べた草なの
よくお腹を壊してたから
MsgEn:
When I was a kid, I used to eat a lot of that 
weed because my stomach used to 
get upset a lot.

MsgJp:
餓えてさまようつらい毎日だったなぁ
ゴミみたいなものを食べて
お腹を壊すことも多くて――
MsgEn:
It was hard wandering around starving, 
eating garbage.
I had a lot of stomach problems.

MsgJp:
そのにおい、間違いないわ！
あの草よ！
MsgEn:
That smell, there's no mistaking it!
It's that weed!

MsgJp: （モシャ！）
MsgEn: *Munch!*

MsgJp: （モシャ！モシャ！）
MsgEn: *Munch! Munch!*

MsgJp: （モシャ！モシャ！モシャ！）
MsgEn: *Munch! Munch! Munch!*

MsgJp: （モシャ！モシャ！モシャ！モシャ！）
MsgEn: *Munch! Munch! Munch! Munch!*

MsgJp:
この舌触り、このエグ味――！
ニガい思い出がいっぱい詰まった味！
MsgEn:
This texture, this acrid taste...!
A taste full of niggling memories!

MsgJp:
なんだか懐かしくなっちゃうな
つらかった思い出も
思い出のひとつには違いないんだよね
MsgEn:
It makes me nostalgic. 
I think it must be one of the most 
unpleasant memories I have.

MsgJp:
それに、あの頃に覚えた知識も
こうして活かせてるわけだし――
MsgEn:
And I'm able to use the knowledge 
I learned back then...

MsgJp:
うん、お腹の痛みも落ち着いてきたみたい
食料集め、頑張れそうだよ
MsgEn:
Yeah, my stomach pain seems to be subsiding.
I think I can make it through the food gathering.

MsgJp:
せっかく砦に戻ってこられたけど
食料はまったく残ってなかったし
ここを手伝ってくれていた人たちも行方知れず
MsgEn:
We made it back to the fort, 
but there was no food left, and the people who 
were helping us here went missing.

MsgJp:
それに、みんなに座ってもらう
テーブルや椅子なんかも全部壊されちゃって――
MsgEn:
And they broke all the tables and 
chairs for everyone to sit at...

MsgJp:
――ここね、魔軍の手に落ちる前は
色んな人たちが集まってくる大食堂だったんだよ
MsgEn:
--This used to be a Great Dining Hall where all 
kinds of people gathered before it fell into 
the hands of the Demon Army.

MsgJp:
みんながご飯を食べてニコニコして
疲れを癒していく場所だったの
――今じゃ見る影もないでしょ？
MsgEn:
It was a place where people would eat, smile, 
and relax--
now it's a shadow of its former self, isn't it?

MsgJp:
もう、疲れて砦に帰ってくる人たちに
ご飯を出してあげることはできない――
料理番にとって、こんなに辛いことってないわ
MsgEn:
I can no longer serve food to the people who come 
home to the fort tired--
there is nothing more painful for a cook.

MsgJp:
ううん、料理を出せない料理番なんていないよね
いつかアタシ、ここから追い出されちゃうのかな
MsgEn:
A cook who can't serve food has no place here. 
Will I be cast out of here one day, I wonder?

MsgJp:
え――
砦の――外に出ろって？
MsgEn: What--you want me to go outside the fort?

MsgJp:
外に出て、食料になるようなものを
探してこればいいって？
MsgEn:
You say I should go out and look for
for something that can be used as food?

MsgJp:
それができたらいいんだけど――
無理だよ、そんなの
MsgEn:
I wish I could do that―
but I can't, it's just not possible.

MsgJp:
あなたも知ってるでしょ
そこらじゅう、魔物だらけなんだよ
MsgEn:
You know it too.
There are monsters everywhere.

MsgJp:
戦士のみんなみたいに
魔物と戦ったりなんか、できないから――
MsgEn: I can't fight monsters like all the soldiers...

MsgJp: 護衛を提案する
MsgEn: Suggest an escort.

MsgJp: 鍛練を提案する
MsgEn: Suggest training.

MsgJp:
あなたがなんとかするって？
――ほんとに？
MsgEn:
You say you'll do something about it?
―― Really?

MsgJp:
う～ん――じゃあ
外、出てみようかな――ちょっとだけ
MsgEn:
Hmmm--
well, let's go outside--
just for a minute.

MsgJp:
このままずっとここにいても
何も変わらないもんね
MsgEn: If I stay here forever, nothing will change.

MsgJp:
悩むより動いてみるっていうのはいいかも
とりあえず、まずはここから出ないと
MsgEn:
Maybe it's better to try rather than worry. 
Let's get out there first.

MsgJp:
――え？
そりゃ、アタシも剣を持てたらって
思うことも多くなったけど――
MsgEn:
--What?
Well, there are many times when I wish 
I could hold a sword, but--

MsgJp:
そういうのは向いてないっていうか――
それに、今から鍛練したってアタシが一人で外に
出られるようになるには時間がかかりすぎるよ！
MsgEn:
I'm not cut out for that kind of thing, 
and even if I start training now, 
it will take too long for me to be able 
to go out on my own!

MsgJp:
――それじゃあ一緒についててくれるって？
ううん――それだったら、まぁ、何とか――
MsgEn:
――So, you're going to accompany me? 
Hmm...
in that case, I suppose, somehow...

MsgJp:
突然一人で放り出したりとか
絶対しないって約束してくれるなら――
ちょっとだけ外に出てみてもいいけど――
MsgEn:
If you promise you won't leave me alone all of a 
sudden or anything like that, 
I'll go out for a little bit, but...

MsgJp:
自己紹介、もうしたっけ？
えっと――アタシ、キャリー
これでも、この砦の大食堂を任された料理番
MsgEn:
Have I introduced myself yet? 
Well... I'm Carrie. I'm the cook in charge of the 
big dining hall here at the fort.

MsgJp:
今は、食堂というよりがれきの山だけどさ
――そんなことより、食料！
今日みんなが食べるもの、どうにかしないと
MsgEn:
Right now, it's more of a pile 
of rubble than a diner.
--But that's not the point!
We need to do something about the food we're 
all going to eat today!

MsgJp: 空って――こんなに広かったんだね
MsgEn: The sky--I didn't know it was this big.

MsgJp:
頭の上が無限に開けてるこの感じ
うん、ちょっと気分がいいかも
MsgEn:
This feeling of infinite open space above me.
Yeah, I guess it feels kinda good.

MsgJp:
あ――食料探しに出発するけど
準備はいい？
MsgEn:
Uh--we're leaving to look for food, 
are you ready?

MsgJp: 出発しよう
MsgEn: Let's depart.

MsgJp: ちょっと待ってくれ
MsgEn: Wait a moment.

MsgJp: それじゃあ食料を探しに行こうかな
MsgEn: Okay, let's go find some food.

MsgJp:
ここからすぐ近くの野原なら
まだ安全そうだから、まずはそこかな？
MsgEn:
The field just around the corner from here still 
looks safe, 
so maybe that's where we should start.

MsgJp:
じゃあ――アタシ、ここにいるから
準備できたらまた話しかけてね
MsgEn:
Well--
I'll be here, 
so talk to me again when you're ready.

MsgJp:
うう――あんまり長く待つと
さらにお腹が減っちゃいそうだから
できるだけ早めにお願い

さてと――
とりあえず――まずは近場で食料探しだね
MsgEn:
Well, let's see...
First things first-- 
let's go look for some food in the immediate area.

MsgJp:
このあたりで探してみるよ
魔物もいなさそうだし――多分、大丈夫
MsgEn:
I'll look around here and see what I can find.
There don't seem to be any monsters - 
maybe we'll be okay.

MsgJp:
ふぅ――
このあたりにはもう、何もなさそうかな
MsgEn:
Phew-- 
looks like there's nothing more to 
be found around here.

MsgJp:
こうやって探すと結構あるもんだね
食べられるもの
MsgEn:
There are quite a few things you can 
eat when you look for them like this.

MsgJp:
もう少し集めたいから
あとちょっとだけ手伝ってほしいな
MsgEn:
I'd like to collect a few more things.
I just need you to help me a little while longer.

MsgJp:
次はこの丘で探してみようかな
魔物――いないといいけど――
MsgEn:
Next, maybe I'll look for it in the hills.
I hope there aren't any monsters--

MsgJp: あーびっくりした！
MsgEn: Ah, I was so shocked!

MsgJp:
食べられる草でもないかって
探すのに必死で、魔物の気配に
ぜんぜん気付けなかった！
MsgEn:
I was so busy looking for some weeds to eat 
that I didn't notice any sign of the 
monster at all!

MsgJp:
あなたがいてくれなかったら
危ないところだった――
ついてきてくれて、ありがとう！
MsgEn:
If you hadn't been there, 
it would've been a close call--
Thank you for sticking with me!

MsgJp:
――うーん
やっぱり、砦から少し離れると危ないんだね
覚えておかなきゃ
MsgEn:
--Hmmm...
I knew it. 
It's not safe to go too far from the fort.
I'll have to remember that.

MsgJp:
さ、食料まだ残ってるうちに、帰ろうか
お腹――すいちゃったしね
MsgEn:
Well, let's go home while there's still 
some food left, I'm starving.

MsgJp:
ふぅ、アタシもあなたも
無事戻ってこられてよかった！
MsgEn:
Whew, you and me both.
Glad to see we made it back in one piece!

MsgJp:
ほんと、突然「外に出ろ」なんて言われた時は
どうなることかと思ったよ
MsgEn:
I really wondered what was going to happen 
when I was suddenly told to "go outside."

MsgJp:
――でも、荒れ果てたこの食堂を見ると
やっぱり気分が滅入ってきちゃうな
MsgEn:
--But it's still depressing to see 
this dining hall in ruins.

MsgJp:
せっかく外に連れ出してくれたのに
こんなこと言ってごめん――
でも、ここを元通りにするなんて
途方もない計画かもって思えて――
MsgEn:
I'm sorry to say this after you took me 
outside to see it...
But it just seems like such a crazy plan 
to get this place turned around...

MsgJp:
アタシ――この食堂
どうにかできるのかな
MsgEn:
I wonder―― if there's any way I 
can fix this dining hall.

MsgJp: 今日採ってきた食料を指さす
MsgEn: Point to the food we gathered today.

MsgJp: 泥だらけの靴を指さす
MsgEn: Point to muddy shoes.

MsgJp:
――そうだよね
行動した分だけ、ちゃんと得たものがあるよね
MsgEn:
--I guess you're right.
You get what you get for your efforts, right?

MsgJp:
今日はありがとう
すっごく助かっちゃった
それに、いい気分転換になったみたい
MsgEn:
Thank you so much for your help today.
Besides, it was a nice change of pace.

MsgJp:
こうして手伝ってもらえたら
きっとこのガレキだらけの大食堂も
腹ペコのみんなも――
MsgEn:
I'm sure that with your help, 
this rubble-strewn dining hall and all the hungry 
people in it will be able to get back to their 
normal lives.

MsgJp:
もっともっと元気にできると思うんだ
だから――
MsgEn: I think I can make it even more lively, so...

MsgJp: また、手伝ってくれないかな？
MsgEn: So, will you help me again?

MsgJp:
アタシ、料理しかできないけど
力いっぱい作るからさ
MsgEn:
I can only cook.
But I'll cook with all my might.

MsgJp:
あなたに時間があるとき
また外に連れてってくれると嬉しいなって
MsgEn:
I'm hoping you'll take me out again, 
when you have time.

MsgJp: う～ん　食べられそうなものは――
MsgEn: Hmmm... something edible--

MsgJp: 何かないかなぁ？
MsgEn: I wonder if there is anything?

MsgJp: これは食べられそうだね！
MsgEn: This looks edible!

MsgJp: ねぇ！
MsgEn: Hey!

MsgJp: こっち来ないでってば！
MsgEn: Don't come over here!

MsgJp:
お腹壊してた時
あの草を持ってきてくれて、ありがとうね
MsgEn:
Thank you for bringing me that weed 
when I was having stomach problems.

MsgJp:
気を取り直して――
食料探し、行ってみようかな
MsgEn:
Let's get back on track--
We should go look for food.

MsgJp:
いつまでもここでうずくまってるわけには
いかないよね
MsgEn: We can't just sit here cowering forever, can we?

MsgJp:
外に行くのは、やっぱり怖い
でも――食料が無くなっちゃうのは
もっと怖いんだから
MsgEn:
Going outside is scary after all, but―― 
running out of food is even scarier.

MsgJp:
また――
外に連れてってくれる？
MsgEn: Could you-- take me outside again?

MsgJp:
よかった―――
あなたが一緒にいてくれると思うと
ちょっとは勇気が出てくるよ
MsgEn:
Thank goodness---
I feel a little braver knowing you're with me.

MsgJp:
それじゃあ、出発する？
アタシはいつでも大丈夫だけど――
MsgEn:
So, shall we go?
I'm ready whenever you are.

MsgJp: 出発する
MsgEn: Depart.

MsgJp: ――少し待ってくれ
MsgEn: Just-- just give me a minute.

MsgJp:
とりあえず――
今日は、砦から出たところの野原に
行ってみるね
MsgEn:
At any rate--
Today we'll go to the field just outside the fort.

MsgJp:
うう――
なんか急に決意が揺らいできちゃった
本当に大丈夫かな
あなたも嫌になったりしてない？
MsgEn:
Ugh--
I'm suddenly feeling a bit shaky about 
my decision. 
I wonder if you're really okay with it. 
Are you fed up with it?

MsgJp:
うーん
砦の外に出るまでが一番緊張するみたい
一度出ちゃうと、意外と――
MsgEn:
Hmmm.
I think I'm most nervous about getting out of the 
fort... once I get out, it's surprisingly--

MsgJp: 今のところ魔物もいないし――
MsgEn: So far, there are no enemies...

MsgJp:
よ――よし！
食料、いっぱい見つけるんだから
MsgEn:
Okay--okay!
We're gonna find a lot of food out here.

MsgJp:
や、やっぱり魔物って
けっこう身近なところにいるのね――
MsgEn:
I guess the monsters are 
around us all the time...

MsgJp:
ううん、ちょっとびっくりしただけ
まだ頑張れるわ
MsgEn:
No, I'm just a little surprised. 
I can still do it.

MsgJp:
それにしても、あなたって本当に強いんだね
人を守りながら戦えるって
すごいことなんだって聞いたことがあるよ
MsgEn:
By the way, you are really strong.
I've heard it's an amazing thing to be 
able to fight while protecting others.

MsgJp:
次は丘で食料を集めたいから
もう少し付き合ってね！
MsgEn:
Next, I want to gather food in the hills, 
so stay with me a little longer!

MsgJp:
あ――
ねぇ見て！　ブタの群れ！
MsgEn:
Oh--
Hey look!　A bunch of pigs!

MsgJp:
しかも３匹も！
アタシ、ブタって大好きなんだ！
この子たちも、魔軍から逃げてきたのかな
MsgEn:
And there are even three of them! 
I love pigs! 
I wonder if they escaped from the Demon Army.

MsgJp:
この子たちに何かしてあげたいけど
食料はあげられないし――
どうしようかなぁ
MsgEn:
I wish I could do something for these little 
guys, but I can't give them food--
What do I do?

MsgJp: 名前を付けることを提案する
MsgEn: Suggest to name it.

MsgJp: リボンを結ぶことを提案する
MsgEn: Suggest tying ribbons.

MsgJp:
それって素敵！
どんな名前にしようか迷うなぁ
MsgEn:
That would be lovely!
I can't decide what names to give them though.

MsgJp:
一匹ずつ個性があるもんね
背中の模様とか――
鼻の形とか―シメり気具合も――
MsgEn:
Each one has its own personality, 
like the markings on its back, 
the shape of its nose, 
the way it's all fussy or 
likes to be a bit of a show-off.

MsgJp:
あ――そういえば
こんなことしてる場合じゃなかった！
MsgEn:
Ah--oh, that reminds me.
This is not the time to be doing this!

MsgJp:
さっさと食料を集めて
砦に戻らないといけないよね
MsgEn:
We'll have to quickly gather food and 
get back to the fort.

MsgJp:
リボンかぁ
うーん、あなたの案も悪くはないんだけど――
MsgEn:
Ribbons, huh?
Well, your idea isn't bad, but--

MsgJp:
ブタさんってさ、泥の上で
転がり回るのが好きなんだ
リボンはすぐ汚れて邪魔になっちゃうかも
MsgEn:
Pigs like to roll around in the mud, 
and the ribbon gets dirty fast 
and gets in the way.

MsgJp:
大丈夫、ブタさんはリボンなんてなくたって
そのままで十分素晴らしいからね！
MsgEn:
Don't worry, pigs are wonderful enough 
as they are without ribbons!

MsgJp:
あ――そういえば
こんなことしてる場合じゃなかった！
MsgEn:
Ah-- come to think of it, 
I shouldn't be doing this!

MsgJp:
さっさと食料を集めて
砦に戻らないといけないよね
MsgEn:
We'll have to quickly gather food and 
get back to the fort.

MsgJp:
ふぅ――
"ただの魔物"で良かった――
MsgEn:
Phew-- 
thank goodness it was "just a monster"--

MsgJp:
食料探しに夢中でここまで来ちゃったけど
ここってどう見ても水辺だよね――？
MsgEn:
I've been so busy looking for food that we've 
ended up here, but this is the water's edge, 
no matter how you look at it--right?

MsgJp:
ということはさ
"アイツ"がいるかもしれないよね――
MsgEn:
That means
"that guy" might be ――

MsgJp:
あ――でも、ちょっと待って！
よく見るとこのあたりの地面――
"食料が埋まってそうな地面"だ！
MsgEn:
Oh - but wait a minute!
If you look closely at the ground here...
It's "the kind of ground where food 
might be buried!"

MsgJp:
すぐに掘り返してみるから待ってて
できるだけ早くするから
絶対置いていかないでね！
MsgEn:
I'll dig it up right away. 
Just wait for me, 
and I'll do it as quickly as I can.
Don't you even think about leaving me here!

MsgJp:
やっぱり食料が埋まってたよ！
見えないところにまで気を配らないとね
MsgEn:
I knew the food was buried here!
You have to pay attention to what you can't see.

MsgJp:
うん、食料もある程度集まったし
そろそろ帰ろっか
MsgEn:
Well, we've gathered some food, 
so it's time to go home.

MsgJp:
今日はありがとう！
今晩みんなが食べる分は
なんとか集められたよ
MsgEn:
Thanks for today!
We managed to gather enough food 
for everyone to eat tonight.

MsgJp:
実はね、砦に物資を運ぶ輸送隊が
こっちに向かってるって話なんだ
MsgEn:
Actually, I'm told that a convoy of supplies 
is on its way to the fort.

MsgJp:
物資が届くようになれば
明日食べるものを心配して
うろたえる必要も無くなるよね
MsgEn:
When supplies start arriving, 
we won't have to panic about what 
we'll eat tomorrow.

MsgJp:
もうそろそろ着くって聞いたけど
まだかなぁ――
MsgEn:
I heard they're on their way, 
but I'm not sure if they're--

MsgJp: こっち来ないでってば！
MsgEn: Don't come over here!

MsgJp: う～ん　食べられそうなものは――
MsgEn: Hmmm... something edible--

MsgJp: えぇ！？
MsgEn: Eh!?

MsgJp: う～ん　食べられそうなものは――
MsgEn: Hmmm... something edible--

MsgJp: ねぇ！
MsgEn: Hey!

MsgJp:
実はね、砦に来るはずの輸送隊がまだ到着しないんだ
みんなは大丈夫って言うんだけど
なんだか心配で――
MsgEn:
Actually, the convoy that's supposed to be 
coming to the fort hasn't arrived yet, and 
everyone says they're fine, 
but I'm kind of worried--

MsgJp:
砦が戻ってから初めての輸送隊なの
何かあったら、今後に響くかも――
ねぇ、様子を見て来てくれないかな
MsgEn:
This is our first convoy after we got the fort 
back, so if anything goes wrong, 
it could affect our future plans--
Hey, why don't you go check on them?

MsgJp:
この砦の表にいる兵士さんなら
何か詳しいことを知っているかも――
野営地にいるエディさんに聞いてみて！
MsgEn:
The soldier at the front of this fort 
might know some details--
Ask Eddie at the encampment!

MsgJp:
この砦の表に野営地にいるエディさんなら
何か詳しいことを知っているかも――
MsgEn:
Ser Eddie, who is stationed at the encampment 
out front of this fort, might know something 
more about it--I'm sure he'd be happy to help.

MsgJp:
あっ、ねぇねぇ！
さっき輸送隊の二人が到着したよ
食料も無事だって！
あなたが手助けしてくれたのよね？
MsgEn:
Oh, hey, hey! 
Two guys from the convoy just arrived. 
They said the food is safe! 
You helped them, didn't you?

MsgJp:
ええっ？
凶暴なゴブリンに襲われてた、ですって！？
MsgEn:
What?
They were attacked by a 
ferocious goblin, you say!?

MsgJp:
ちょっと心配しすぎかなって思ってたけど
やっぱりあなたに様子を
見に行ってもらってよかった――！
MsgEn:
I thought I was worrying a little too much, 
but I'm really glad I asked you to go 
check on them!

MsgJp:
助太刀、感謝する！
まさかこの辺りで助けが来るとは
思わなかったよ
MsgEn:
Thanks for the help!
I didn't think we'd get any 
assistance around here.

MsgJp:
――噂には聞いていたが
あれが最近このあたりを荒らし回ってる
ゴブリン一家ってやつだな
MsgEn:
--I've heard rumors, but that's the goblin clan 
that's been raiding these parts lately.

MsgJp:
さて、ここまで来ればもう安心だ
俺たちは荷物をまとめてから砦へ向かうよ
君が道中の敵を減らしてくれたから
この先は俺たちだけでも大丈夫そうだ
MsgEn:
Now that we've come this far, we're safe. 
We'll pack up and head towards the fort soon. 
Since you cleared out the enemies on the way, 
we should be able to handle it from here.

MsgJp:
荷物をまとめたら二人でティネス砦に向かうよ
現地でまた会おう
MsgEn:
Once we pack our bags, 
we'll both head to Fort Thines.
I'll see you there.

MsgJp:
これで無事に荷物を届けることができる――！
あんたのおかげだ、ありがとう
MsgEn:
Now I can deliver the package safely--! 
You did it. Thank you.

MsgJp:
この辺の敵を片付けてくれただろう？
少し休んで動けるようになったら
私たち二人もティネス砦に向かうよ
MsgEn:
You've taken care of the enemies around here, 
haven't you?
When we've recovered a little bit and are able to 
move, we'll both be on our way to Fort Thines.

MsgJp:
ティネス砦に食料を運ぶ輸送隊ですか？
そういえば、ここを通るって聞いてたけど
まだ見てないような――
MsgEn:
Is this about the convoy that is bringing 
food to Fort Thines?
Well, I heard they were coming through here, but 
I don't think I've seen them yet--

MsgJp:
出発したっていう連絡は来てましたから
この近くまでは来てそうですけどね
MsgEn:
I did receive a message that they had departed, 
so I guess they're in the vicinity, but...

MsgJp:
ちょうどいいところに！
ティネス砦への物資運搬中に
魔物が襲ってきたんだ！
MsgEn:
Just in time!
We were hauling supplies to Fort Thines 
when the fiends attacked us!

MsgJp:
この先の桟橋で仲間が戦ってる
彼も少し負傷して、うまく動けてない
手を貸して――！

さっきはありがとうな！
あの助太刀のおかげで
食料を運んでこられたよ
MsgEn:
Thanks for your assistance earlier!
Thanks to you, we were able to deliver the food.

MsgJp:
無事砦に到着できてよかった――
ここには食料を待ってる人がたくさんいるからさ
MsgEn:
I'm glad we made it to the fort in one piece--
there are a lot of people here waiting for food.

MsgJp:
ウガ――ガググ――
ウ――ウ―――
MsgEn:
Gah! Gah-haha...
Oouhh...

MsgJp: （このあたりでは珍しいゴブリンがいる）
MsgEn: (Goblins are rare around here.)

MsgJp:
（先ほどの戦いをずっと見ていたようだが
　襲ってくる様子はない）
MsgEn:
(He's been watching the fight for a while now, 
but there's no sign of him attacking.)

MsgJp:
はぁ、食堂っていっても
マトモな設備が一つも残ってないんだよね
調理台にできそうなものも見当たらないから
料理できないしさ
MsgEn:
Huh, there's not a single decent piece of 
equipment left in the dining hall.
I can't even find anything that could be 
used as a cooktop, so I can't cook.

MsgJp:
実はさ、解放軍の人が
「材料さえあれば調理台や棚を
作ってもいい」って言ってくれたんだ！
MsgEn:
Actually, you know, a guy from the 
Liberation Army said, "As long as you have the 
materials, we can build a cooktop and shelves!"

MsgJp:
でも、調理台にできるような材料というと
大きい木材だとか、あとは石とかでしょ？
MsgEn:
But the materials that could be used for a 
cooktop would be large pieces of wood 
along with stones, right?

MsgJp:
そういうのって、今は全部
砦の外壁だとかの修理に使われるから――
調理台のために材料を分けてください、なんて
言えない雰囲気なんだよね――
MsgEn:
All of that stuff is being used to repair the 
exterior of the fort.
I can't ask them to share their materials 
for cooktops...

MsgJp:
あなたが木材を採ってきてくれるっていうの！？
ほ、本当に頼んじゃって――いいの？
MsgEn:
You're going to go out and get wood for us!?
Are you sure you want to do that?

MsgJp:
ちょっと待ってて！
どのくらい木材がいるのかを
書いておいたメモが――！
MsgEn:
Wait a minute! 
I have a note here telling me 
how much wood we need!

MsgJp:
調理台や棚を作ってもらうためには
<COL ff2600>ラスニテ産ハードウッド</COL>が<COL ff2600>10個</COL>要るみたい
全部頼んじゃって悪いけど、何とかお願い！
このままじゃ料理もできないから――
MsgEn:
I need <COL ff2600>10 pieces</COL> of <COL ff2600>Rathnite Local Hardwood</COL> 
to build a cooktop and shelves! 
Sorry to ask for all of this, 
but please make it work!
I can't even cook without--

MsgJp:
ありがとう！
これで調理台とか棚、作ってもらえるよ！
MsgEn:
Thank you!
Now I can get a cooktop and 
shelves and whatnot made!

MsgJp:
どんな風に作ってくれるのかはわからないけど
調理台ができるのは楽しみだなぁ
きっと、一気に食堂らしくなると思う！
MsgEn:
I don't know how they'll make it, but I'm looking 
forward to having a cooktop. 
I'm sure it will look like a dining hall all at once!

MsgJp:
調理台や棚を作ってもらうためには
<COL ff2600>自然木炭</COL>が<COL ff2600>3個</COL>要るみたい
全部頼んじゃって悪いけど、何とかお願い！
このままじゃ料理もできないから――
MsgEn:
I need <COL ff2600>3 pieces</COL> of <COL ff2600>Natural Charcoal</COL> 
to build a cooktop and shelves! 
Sorry to ask for all of this, 
but please make it work!
I can't even cook without--

MsgJp:
ありがとう！
これで調理台とか棚、作ってもらえるよ！
MsgEn:
Thank you!
Now I can get a cooktop, shelves, etc. made!

MsgJp:
どんな風に作ってくれるのかはわからないけど
調理台ができるのは楽しみだなぁ
きっと、一気に食堂らしくなると思う！
MsgEn:
I don't know how they'll make it, 
but I'm looking forward to having a cooktop.
I'm sure it will make it look 
like a dining hall instantly!

MsgJp:
使う木材によって、必要な数が違うみたい
<COL ff2600>ラスニテ産ハードウッド</COL>は<COL ff2600>10個</COL>
<COL ff2600>自然木炭</COL>なら<COL ff2600>3個</COL>だって！
採りやすい方か、少なくてもすむ方か――
MsgEn:
It looks like you need different amounts 
depending on the wood you use.
For <COL ff2600>Rathnite Local Hardwood</COL>, <COL ff2600>10 pieces</COL>.
For <COL ff2600>Natural Charcoal</COL>, <COL ff2600>3 pieces</COL>!
Easier to find, or less of it--

MsgJp: ラスニテ産ハードウッドを納品したい
MsgEn: Deliver Rathnite Local Hardwood.

MsgJp: 自然木炭を納品したい
MsgEn: Deliver Natural Charcoal.

MsgJp:
うん、やっぱり手に入りやすい物を
探してきてもらう方が
アタシとしても気が楽かな
MsgEn:
Yeah, I think it's easier for you if you bring 
back something that's easy to get.

MsgJp:
個数は多くても、採集してるうちに
すぐに揃えられると思うし――
MsgEn:
It's a lot of pieces, but I'm sure you'll be 
able to get them all in a jiffy.

MsgJp:
でも、いくらあなたが強くても
魔物がいっぱいいるところを木材かついで
歩くわけだから――
気を付けていってきてね
MsgEn:
But no matter how strong you are, you're going to 
be walking through a place full of monsters with 
a load of lumber on your back...
So... take care of yourself.

MsgJp:
うん、やっぱり個数が少なくて済む方を
探してきてもらう方が
アタシとしても気が楽かな
MsgEn:
Yeah, I think it's easier for you if you bring 
back something that needs fewer total.

MsgJp:
ちょっと手に入りにくくても
3個だったら、運が良ければ
すぐに揃えられると思うし――
MsgEn:
They're a little hard to come by, but if you're 
lucky, you'll have three of them in no time.

MsgJp:
でも、いくらあなたが強くても
魔物がいっぱいいるところを木材かついで
歩くわけだから――
気を付けていってきてね
MsgEn:
But no matter how strong you are, you're going to 
be walking through a place full of monsters with 
a load of lumber on your back...
So... take care of yourself.

MsgJp:
調理台ができたから
簡単な料理なら作れるようになったんだ！
やっと料理人らしいことができるようになって
なんだか安心しちゃった
MsgEn:
Now that I have a cooktop, 
I can cook simple meals!
It's a relief to finally be able to 
do something chef-like.

MsgJp:
でも、今の環境じゃ火の扱いが
ちょっと難しいのが悩みどころかなぁ
MsgEn:
But I guess the problem is that fire is a bit 
difficult to handle in the 
current circumstances.

MsgJp:
こんな状況だからこそ
食べるもので病気になったりしないように
生ものはしっかり加熱したいんだけど――
MsgEn:
I want to make sure that raw food is well heated 
so that we don't get sick from what we eat, 
precisely because of this situation...

MsgJp: 釜戸、何とか直せないかなぁ
MsgEn:
The hearth... 
I wonder if it can be fixed somehow.

MsgJp:
あのね、釜戸を直す材料には
心当たりがあって――
MsgEn: Well, I have an idea for fixing the hearth.

MsgJp:
<COL ff2600>《粘土質の土》</COL>があれば、アタシと解放軍の人とで
協力して直せると思うんだよね
釜戸の構造はアタシが覚えてるからさ
MsgEn:
If we have <COL ff2600>《Clay Soil》</COL>, I think 
I and the Liberation Army could cooperate to fix it. 
I remember the structure of the hearth, after all.

MsgJp:
<COL ff2600>《粘土質の土》</COL>ね
ピレモスに行く途中で見た気がするんだ
ほら、食料を届けにいく途中で
ちらっと目にした記憶が――
MsgEn:
<COL ff2600>《Clay Soil》</COL>... 
I think I saw it on my way to Piremoth. 
I remember catching a glimpse of it while I 
was on my way to deliver supplies—
just a fleeting memory.

MsgJp:
今度ピレモスに行く時にでも見つけられないかなぁ
そしたら一石二鳥だよね
よし、探してみよう
MsgEn:
I wonder if I could find it when we next go to 
Piremoth. That would be a win-win, right? 
Alright, let's go search for it.

MsgJp:
もしかしたらアタシ、魔物を避けるので
必死になってるかもしれないから
あなたも一応覚えておいてくれない？
ピレモスに行く途中で<COL ff2600>《粘土質の土》</COL>、ってさ
MsgEn:
Hey, just in case I get too focused on dodging 
monsters, could you keep it in mind? 
That clay-rich soil I was telling you about, 
near Piremoth, okay?

MsgJp:
釜戸を修理するための<COL ff2600>《粘土質の土》</COL>――
今度ピレモスに行く時にでも見つけられないかなぁ
MsgEn:
That clay-rich soil we need to fix the hearth—
I wonder if we can find it 
next time we go to Piremoth.

MsgJp:
もしかしたらアタシ、魔物を避けるので
必死になってるかもしれないから
あなたも一応覚えておいてくれない？
ピレモスに行く途中で<COL ff2600>《粘土質の土》</COL>、ってさ
MsgEn:
I could be busy avoiding monsters, 
so can you remember that? 
On the way to Piremoth, there's<COL ff2600> 《clay soil》.</COL>

MsgJp:
あれっ――
いつの間に見つけたの！？
MsgEn: What?—When did you find it!?!

MsgJp:
ううん、やっぱりアタシってば
魔物を避けるのに必死で
<COL ff2600>《粘土質の土》</COL>を探すのを忘れちゃってたみたい
MsgEn:
I guess I was so focused on avoiding monsters 
that I forgot to look for the <COL ff2600>clay soil</COL>.

MsgJp:
あなたに言っておいてよかったわ！
これで釜戸が直せそう――ありがとう！
MsgEn:
I'm so glad I told you! 
Now we can fix the hearth. Thanks!

MsgJp:
調理台に釜戸――
ここもだいぶ食堂らしくなってきたよね
MsgEn:
The cooking area with the hearth...
This place is really starting 
to feel like a dining hall.

MsgJp:
あとは、潰されちゃった井戸が
元通りになれば言うこと無しだよ

料理ってなんだかんだで水をいっぱい使うでしょ？
食堂の中に井戸があるのと無いのとでは
大違いなんだ
MsgEn:
You know, no matter how you look at it, 
cooking uses a lot of water.
You'd notice a big difference
if there was a well inside the dining hall 
compared with the lack of one.

MsgJp:
うぅん――
やっぱり直したいなぁ――
MsgEn: Hmm... I definitely want to fix it...

MsgJp:
井戸を直すための<COL ff2600>《水はけの良い石》</COL>なんだけど
実は、どこかで見たような気がするんだよね
MsgEn:
The stone for fixing the well is called 
<COL ff2600>《Highland Akadama》</COL>.
I get the feeling I've seen it somewhere before, though.

MsgJp:
どの辺りで見たかは忘れちゃったんだけど
「何かに使えそうだな」って思ったことだけは
覚えてるというか――
MsgEn:
I've forgotten where I saw it, 
but I remember thinking 
"it looks like it could be used for something..."

MsgJp:
ほら、前もだったけど
いつどこから魔物が飛び出してくるかって
警戒してると、つい忘れちゃうんだよね
MsgEn:
See, it was like before. When you're on edge, 
watching for monsters to appear at any time, 
you end up forgetting, don't you?

MsgJp:
この辺りに落ちてる物のこと
詳しそうな人っていないかな――
MsgEn:
Could there be anyone nearby who knows more 
about the items scattered around here――?

MsgJp:
井戸を直すための<COL ff2600>《水はけの良い石》</COL>――
どこかで見たような気はするんだよね
MsgEn:
<COL ff2600>《Highland Akadama》</COL>...
I feel like I've seen that somewhere before.

MsgJp:
この辺りに落ちてる物のこと
詳しそうな人っていないかな――
MsgEn:
Could there be anyone nearby who knows more 
about the items scattered around here――?

MsgJp:
あれっ、<COL ff2600>《水はけの良い石》</COL>――！
またあなたが見つけてくれたの！？
MsgEn:
Oh! <COL ff2600>《Highland Akadama》</COL>! 
You found it again, Ser?!

MsgJp:
アタシも今回はちゃんと覚えてたんだけどなぁ
魔物を警戒するあまり、視野が
狭くなってたのかしら
MsgEn:
I made sure to remember this time, but... 
Maybe I became so wary of the monsters 
that my vision became narrower than usual.

MsgJp:
ともあれ、これで井戸が直せそう
やっぱりあなたに言っておいてよかったわ！
MsgEn:
Well, I think we can fix the well now. 
I'm so glad I told you!

MsgJp:
次にあなたが来てくれる頃には
きっともっと食堂らしくなってるはずよ
ありがとう！
MsgEn:
By the time you come again, 
the dining hall should definitely 
feel more like one. 
Thank you!

MsgJp:
調理台に棚、釜戸に井戸――
一通り料理できるようになったし
ガレキも大方片付いたわ！
MsgEn:
Kitchen equipment, a hearth, and a well. 
Now I can cook a full meal, 
and most of the rubble is cleared away!

MsgJp:
どう？
もうすっかり「大食堂！」って
感じがするでしょ？
MsgEn:
How is it? 
Doesn't it feel like a Great Dining Hall already?

MsgJp:
でも、ここまで来たら
あと何か一つくらい欲しくなっちゃって――
MsgEn:
Now that we've come this far, 
I kind of want to add just one more thing...

MsgJp:
そう、目玉になるようなものがあればなって
来てくれるみんなが喜んでくれそうな何か――
MsgEn:
Yeah, I think something really special would be nice... 
something that would make 
everyone who comes here happy.

MsgJp:
ううん、今に不満があるってわけじゃないんだよ！
――人間、ちょっと上手くいくと
欲が出ちゃってダメだね
MsgEn:
No, I'm not dissatisfied with what we have! 
It's just... people, when things go well, 
sometimes want even more.

MsgJp:
ううん――
戦いに疲れてここに来るみんなが
ちょっと気分をほぐせるような――
MsgEn:
No, no―― 
Those who arrive here, 
tired from their battles, 
ought to relax a bit...

MsgJp:
お酒、かな？
温かい食事に、ちょっとしたお酒が楽しめたら
きっと日々の活力にもなるよね
MsgEn:
Drinks, maybe?
A little drink to go with the warm meals... 
It would certainly give people 
energy for their daily lives.

MsgJp:
この大食堂にはたくさんの人に
集まって欲しいから――
とにかくでっかい酒樽が欲しいな！
MsgEn:
I want a lot of people to gather in this 
Great Dining Hall... 
So I really want a huge keg of wine!

MsgJp:
そうなると相当<COL ff2600>《巨大な木材》</COL>が
必要になるけど――
あったかな、そんなの――
MsgEn:
That means we'll need a ton of <COL ff2600> 《Giant Lumber》 </COL>...
So, where can we get 
something like that...

MsgJp:
――あ、今回は自分で見つけるから
大丈夫だよ！
MsgEn:
--Oh, don't worry, 
I'll find it myself this time!

MsgJp:
酒樽が欲しいっていうのは
何ていうか、アタシの贅沢みたいなものだから
あなたにお願いしちゃいけないと思うの
MsgEn:
Wanting a barrel of wine is, how can I say, 
something like a little indulgence for me.
I think I shouldn't ask you 
for something like that.

MsgJp:
う～ん――
<COL ff2600>《巨大な木材》</COL>さえあれば
後は気合いで作ってもらうんだけどなぁ、酒樽
MsgEn:
I wonder... 
If I could just get my hands on <COL ff2600>《Giant Lumber》 </COL>... Then I could have someone craft a keg, 
you know, with a little extra effort.

MsgJp:
――あ、今回は自分で見つけるから
大丈夫だよ！
MsgEn:
--Oh, don't worry, 
I'll find it myself this time!

MsgJp:
ええっ！
また見つけておいてくれたの！？
MsgEn:
Eh!
You found it again!?

MsgJp:
今回こそは自分で見つけようと思ってたんだけど
やっぱり余裕が違うのかな
MsgEn:
I was hoping to find it myself this time, 
but I guess there's a difference in our abilities.

MsgJp:
<COL ff2600>《巨大な木材》</COL>、ありがとうね――！
これで酒樽が手に入りそう
みんなの喜ぶ顔が今から目に浮かぶわ！
MsgEn:
<COL ff2600>《Giant Lumber》 </COL>! 
Thank you so much! Now I can get a keg. 
I can already see everyone's happy faces!

MsgJp:
見てみて、大食堂としての設備が
だいぶ整ったと思わない？
MsgEn:
Look around, don't you think the dining hall 
is coming along nicely?

MsgJp:
まだまだやらなきゃいけないことはあるけど
ここまでやってこれて、本当に嬉しくって！
MsgEn:
There's still more work to be done, but
I'm really happy to have made it this far!

MsgJp:
いつも本当にありがとう！
